    ENGLISH

    Concept erasure aims to suppress undesirable concepts in text-to-image diffusion models while preserving their generative capabilities. Existing methods often redirect target concepts toward predefined semantic anchors, but the influence of anchor selection on the scope of concept erasure remains insufficiently understood. Through causal tracing, we reveal that concepts with more dispersed causal effects tend to exhibit higher anchor sensitivity and lower erasure robustness. Controlled anchor interventions demonstrate that anchor selection affects target suppression and collateral damage to surrounding semantic concepts. These findings motivate us to formulate anchor selection as semantic erasure boundary construction. We propose SELECT (Selective Erasure via Local Exclusive Counterfactual Targets), a plug-and-play framework based on Sibling Exclusive Concepts (SECs), which are semantically close to the target but mutually exclusive in its defining attributes. SELECT jointly constructs a counterfactual redirection endpoint and a local retention set to balance target suppression and semantic preservation. SELECT filters candidates using contextual activation, and uses semantic coherence to identify context compatible redirection endpoints, while the remaining SECs serve as local preservation constraints. Experiments on object, celebrity, artist-style, and NSFW erasure show that SELECT strengthens target suppression over fixed general anchors and achieves suppression-preservation trade-offs, while reducing concept re-emergence and erosion.

    Nikolaus Howe and Micah Carroll

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper studies how RL training produces motivated reasoning that undermines chain-of-thought monitoring, with evidence across conflicting-objective settings. This substantially informs reasoning behavior and its development; monitoring is relevant to oversight systems, but the abstract does not present a systems mechanism or internal interpretability analysis.

    本文研究 RL 训练如何产生动机性推理并削弱思维链监测，并在目标冲突设置中提供了证据。这为理解推理行为及其发展提供了实质性信息；监测与监督系统相关，但摘要并未提出系统机制或内部可解释性分析。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring has emerged as a compelling method for detecting harmful behaviors such as reward hacking in reasoning models, under the assumption that models' reasoning processes are informative of such behaviors. However, when a model's trained behaviors conflict with instructions provided at inference time, it faces two competing objectives it cannot simultaneously satisfy. We find that models resolve this tension through motivated reasoning---generating plausible-sounding justifications for violating their instructions while downplaying potential harms or contradictions---rather than genuine engagement with the spirit of the provided instructions. We investigate this phenomenon by training reasoning models via RL on objectives that conflict with their later constitutional constraints, and find that motivated reasoning emerges systematically across all settings studied, including beyond safety-related tasks. As motivated reasoning becomes more prevalent over the course of training, CoT monitors are increasingly fooled. Concerningly, the same monitor that correctly flags a violation when shown only the final answer is persuaded to approve it when shown the reasoning trace. While large reasoning models closely track human ability in detecting motivated reasoning, this is not a full solution, since frontier model providers commonly rely on smaller models for monitoring due to latency and cost constraints. Our results underscore the necessity for further research into the emergence and detection of motivated reasoning in model evaluation and oversight. Code for this paper is available at https://github.com/nikihowe/motivated-reasoning.

    Zero-shot reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a setting for developing general agents, capable of solving downstream tasks without additional training or planning at test-time. While conventional RL optimizes policies for fixed rewards, zero-shot RL requires learning representations that enable immediate adaptation to arbitrary reward functions. As the field matures, the growing diversity of approaches demands a foundational framework reconciling different perspectives under a common unifying structure. In this work, we introduce a formal, unified framework for zero-shot RL, allowing for rigorous comparisons across methods. We propose a taxonomy organizing the algorithmic landscape along two levels: representation, distinguishing between compositional and direct methods based on their exploitation of action-value function decompositions; and learning paradigm, differentiating between reward-free and pseudo reward-free training. Additionally, we propose a unified view of existing error bounds, decomposing the total error into three primary contributing components: inference, reward, and approximation, serving as a foundation for more grounded comparisons of zero-shot methods.

    Centered kernel alignment (CKA) is a popular metric for comparing representations, determining equivalence of networks, and conducting neuroscience research. In this work, we propose Manifold-approximated Kernel Alignment (MKA), which incorporates manifold geometry (i.e., local neighborhood) into the alignment task. We derive a theoretical framework for MKA. Our construction removes representation-dependent degree weighting, yields a closed-form alignment score, and gives each row a probabilistic interpretation as a local Markov transition distribution. We further establish kernel- and score-level stability with respect to the neighborhood size. We perform empirical evaluations on synthetic datasets and real-world examples to characterize and compare MKA to its contemporaries. In controlled synthetic experiments, MKA is consistently less sensitive to hyperparameters and captures the selected topology-preserving relationships. On the large-scale benchmark, MKA achieves its strongest aggregate performance in vision, is competitive on graphs, and is weaker than CKA in several NLP evaluations. Our findings suggest that manifold-aware kernel alignment provides a robust foundation for measuring representations and is potentially useful when local neighborhood geometry is important, with possible applications in representation learning.

Yet, existing benchmarks such as SuperGPQA and EEE-Bench score only final answers, and step-level ones such as TPS-CalcBench rely on LLM judges or human graders, or cover a single domain. We therefore introduce EngTrace, a symbolic benchmark for verifiable process evaluation of engineering reasoning. Its 150 expert-certified templates, spanning five branches, 15 domains, and 42 areas, generate each problem with a gold reasoning trace, so that every intermediate quantity is known exactly. We design and validate an evaluator that checks final answers, coverage of the gold trace's intermediate quantities (milestones), and displayed arithmetic, mostly without an LLM judge. Across 11 LLMs, final answers barely separate the strongest models, while their derivations differ. Wrong answers still state about half of the gold milestones, and domain experts trace most wrong answers to calculation slips, with conceptual errors rarer on easy problems than on harder ones. Overall, as LLMs near the final-answer ceiling, checking derivations, as EngTrace does, reveals differences that final answers miss.

    中文

    大多数工程问题都涉及复杂的多步推导，其中包含可检查的中间量。只对最终答案评分会误判 LLM：既可能给通过错误步骤得出正确答案的模型记分，也可能惩罚推导大部分合理但答案错误的模型。然而，SuperGPQA 和 EEE-Bench 等现有基准只对最终答案评分；TPS-CalcBench 等步骤级基准则依赖 LLM 评审或人工评分，或只涵盖单一领域。因此，我们推出 EngTrace，这是一个用于工程推理可验证过程评估的符号基准。它包含 150 个经专家认证的模板，覆盖 5 个分支、15 个领域和 42 个方向；这些模板为每道题生成一条标准推理轨迹，因此每个中间量都精确已知。我们设计并验证了一种评估器，用于检查最终答案、标准轨迹中间量（里程碑）的覆盖情况以及展示出的算术过程，且大多无需 LLM 评审。在 11 个 LLM 上，最终答案几乎无法区分表现最强的模型，但它们的推导各不相同。错误答案仍会给出约一半的标准里程碑；领域专家将大多数错误答案归因于计算失误，而且在简单问题中，概念性错误比困难问题更少见。总的来说，随着 LLM 接近最终答案准确率的上限，像 EngTrace 这样检查推导的方式能够揭示最终答案无法体现的差异。

    REAP：通过递归评估和自适应规划增强 RAG 多跳问答

    Yijie Zhu, Haojie Zhou, Wanting Hong, Tailin Liu, Ning Wang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    REAP uses a sub-task planner and fact extractor to adaptively guide multi-hop RAG, with structured task and fact tracking and multi-task fine-tuning. This substantially advances multi-step reasoning, while its planning and retrieval organization offer a more limited systems contribution; the abstract does not establish internal model mechanisms or systematic compositional generalization.

    REAP 使用子任务规划器和事实提取器来适应性地引导多跳 RAG，并通过多任务微调追踪结构化任务和事实。这实质性地推进了多步推理；其规划和检索组织则带来相对有限的系统贡献。摘要没有证明其涉及内部模型机制或系统性的组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) has been extensively employed to mitigate hallucinations in large language models (LLMs). However, existing methods for multi-hop reasoning tasks often lack global planning, increasing the risk of falling into local reasoning impasses. Insufficient exploitation of retrieved content and the neglect of latent clues fail to ensure the accuracy of reasoning outcomes. To overcome these limitations, we propose Recursive Evaluation and Adaptive Planning (REAP), whose core idea is to explicitly maintain structured sub-tasks and facts related to the current task through the Sub-task Planner (SP) and Fact Extractor (FE) modules. SP maintains a global perspective, guiding the overall reasoning direction and evaluating the task state based on the outcomes of FE, enabling dynamic optimization of the task-solving trajectory. FE performs fine-grained analysis over retrieved content to extract reliable answers and clues. These two modules incrementally enrich a logically coherent representation of global knowledge, enhancing the reliability and the traceability of the reasoning process. Furthermore, we propose a unified task paradigm design that enables effective multi-task fine-tuning, significantly enhancing SP's performance on complex, data-scarce tasks. We conduct extensive experiments on multiple public multi-hop datasets, and the results demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms existing RAG methods in both in-domain and out-of-domain settings, validating its effectiveness in complex multi-hop reasoning tasks.

    中文

    检索增强生成（RAG）已被广泛用于减少大语言模型（LLMs）的幻觉。然而，现有的多跳推理方法往往缺乏全局规划，因而更容易陷入局部推理僵局。对检索内容利用不足以及忽略潜在线索，无法保证推理结果准确。为克服这些局限，我们提出递归评估与自适应规划（REAP），其核心思想是通过子任务规划器（SP）和事实提取器（FE）模块，显式维护与当前任务相关的结构化子任务和事实。SP 保持全局视角，引导整体推理方向，并根据 FE 的结果评估任务状态，从而动态优化任务求解轨迹。FE 对检索内容进行细粒度分析，以提取可靠答案和线索。这两个模块逐步丰富逻辑连贯的全局知识表示，增强推理过程的可靠性和可追溯性。此外，我们提出一种统一的任务范式设计，使多任务微调能够有效进行，并显著提升 SP 在复杂、数据稀缺任务上的表现。我们在多个公开多跳数据集上进行了广泛实验，结果表明，我们的方法在域内和域外设置下都显著优于现有 RAG 方法，验证了其在复杂多跳推理任务中的有效性。

    Vision-language-action (VLA) models show promising knowledge accumulation ability through pretraining, yet continual learning remains challenging. Existing continual imitation learning (CIL) methods often require additional parameters or modules, limiting scalability for large VLA models. We propose Stellar VLA, a knowledge-driven CIL framework without parameter growth, featuring two variants: T-Stellar for task-centric modeling and TS-Stellar for hierarchical modeling of reusable skills across tasks. Stellar VLA jointly optimizes task representations and a self-evolving knowledge space, with knowledge-posterior-guided expert routing using knowledge relations and Top-K semantic embeddings for task specialization. Experiments on LIBERO demonstrate strong performance against VLA and CIL baselines with only 1% replay. Dual-arm real-world experiments validate knowledge transfer across embodiments and scenes.     D-STEER: Two-Way Control of DPO-Induced Safety Behavior in Activation Space

    D-STEER：在激活空间中双向控制 DPO 诱导的安全行为

    Samarth Raina, Saksham Aggarwal, Amit Dhanda, Vinija Jain, Aman Chadha, and Amitava Das

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper tests whether DPO-induced safety behavior is represented in compact activation-space directions and can be installed or removed through inference-time interventions, providing mechanistic evidence about behavior control. Its relevance to systems is incidental to inference-time control; it does not study system organization, and it does not address composition or reasoning.

    本文检验 DPO 诱导的安全行为是否由紧凑的激活空间方向表征，以及能否通过推理时干预植入或移除，从而提供有关行为控制的机制性证据。它与系统的相关性仅体现在推理时控制上；本文不研究系统组织，也不涉及组合或推理。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Preference-based post-training shapes language-model behavior, but safer outputs do not reveal how that change is represented internally or how firmly it persists under direct intervention. This matters for open-weight models, where an actor with white-box access can manipulate internal representations at inference without touching parameters. Using Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), we ask whether the safety behavior it introduces becomes deeply embedded or stays accessible to targeted activation-space interventions. We introduce D-STEER, an audit of two matched instruction-tuned and harmlessness-DPO pairs: OpenHermes-2.5-Mistral-7B and Llama-3-8B OpenHermes. D-STEER derives layer-local directions from differences in matched prompt activations, adds them to the instruction-tuned model to install the DPO-associated safety change and subtracts them from the DPO model to remove it, with separate operating windows distinguishing behavioral control from degradation. On held-out HarmfulQA, all four interventions shift harmful enablement as intended and exceed norm-matched random controls; Mistral installation recovers 98% of the endpoint gap and the other three arms recover 46-50%. The intended direction transfers to HH-RLHF and AdvBench under frozen coefficients, although usable operating windows do not transfer universally. An independently rebuilt implementation reproduces the bidirectional pattern on the Mistral pair under different construction and intervention choices. A meaningful component of DPO-induced safety behavior therefore remains controllable through compact inference-time intervention, with the extent depending on the checkpoint pair and the steering implementation.

    中文

    基于偏好的后训练会塑造语言模型的行为，但更安全的输出并不能揭示这种变化在内部如何表征，也不能说明它在直接干预下能否稳固保持。这对于开放权重模型尤为重要，因为具有白盒访问权限的行为者可以在推理时操纵内部表征，而无需触碰参数。我们使用直接偏好优化（DPO），探究它引入的安全行为究竟会深度嵌入模型，还是仍可通过有针对性的激活空间干预加以控制。我们提出 D-STEER，对两组匹配的指令微调模型与无害性 DPO 模型进行审计：OpenHermes-2.5-Mistral-7B 和 Llama-3-8B OpenHermes。D-STEER 根据匹配提示的激活差异推导出层局部方向，将这些方向加到指令微调模型中以植入与 DPO 相关的安全变化，并从 DPO 模型中减去这些方向以移除该变化；同时设置不同的操作窗口，以区分行为控制与性能退化。在留出的 HarmfulQA 上，四种干预均按预期改变了有害行为倾向，且效果超过范数匹配的随机对照；在 Mistral 上植入安全行为可恢复端点差距的 98%，另外三种干预可恢复 46–50%。在系数固定的条件下，预期方向可迁移到 HH-RLHF 和 AdvBench，但可用的操作窗口并非普遍适用。独立重建的实现采用不同的构造和干预选择，在 Mistral 模型对上复现了双向变化模式。因此，DPO 诱导的安全行为仍有相当一部分可通过紧凑的推理时干预加以控制，控制程度取决于检查点模型对和引导实现方式。

    ELSA: Efficient LLM-Centric Split Aggregation for Privacy-Aware Hierarchical Federated Learning over the Network Edge

    ELSA：面向网络边缘隐私保护型分层联邦学习的高效 LLM 中心化切分聚合

    Xiaohong Yang, Tong Xie, Minghui Liwang, Chikai Shang, Yang Lu, Zhenzhen Jiao, Liqun Fu, Seyyedali Hosseinalipour, Xianbin Wang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    ELSA contributes a distributed fine-tuning design that coordinates model partitioning, client clustering, and aggregation across edge and cloud resources, advancing model systems. Its semantic subspace perturbation serves privacy protection rather than explaining internal representations, and the abstract does not address composition or reasoning.

    ELSA 提出了一种分布式微调设计，协调边缘与云资源间的模型划分、客户端聚类和聚合，推动了模型系统的发展。其语义子空间扰动用于隐私保护，而非解释内部表征；摘要也未涉及组合或推理。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Training large language models (LLMs) in resource-constrained edge networks poses fundamental challenges in computation, communication, data heterogeneity, and privacy. To address these challenges, we propose ELSA (Efficient LLM-Centric Split Aggregation), a distributed fine-tuning framework that integrates split learning (SL) with hierarchical federated learning (HFL) to coordinate computation and model aggregation across heterogeneous clients, edge servers, and the cloud. ELSA introduces three key innovations. First, it employs a task-agnostic, behavior-aware client clustering mechanism that constructs semantic fingerprints from public probe inputs using symmetric Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence, complemented by prediction-consistency-based trust scoring and latency-aware edge assignment to account for data heterogeneity, client reliability, and communication constraints. Second, it adopts a resource-aware dynamic model partitioning strategy that distributes the LLM across clients and edge servers in three segments, while reserving the cloud for adapter aggregation. This design coordinates computation across heterogeneous nodes while balancing on-device computational demands and global convergence behavior. Third, it integrates computational sketches with semantic subspace orthogonal perturbation (SS-OP) to reduce communication overhead and mitigate privacy leakage during model exchanges. Extensive experiments across diverse NLP tasks demonstrate that ELSA outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in model performance, convergence behavior, and robustness. Further, on-device profiling on NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPUs and Jetson AGX Orin edge devices characterizes the memory footprint, energy consumption, and execution latency of key training stages, providing empirical evidence of ELSA's practical feasibility.

    中文

    在资源受限的边缘网络中训练大型语言模型（LLM），会在计算、通信、数据异质性和隐私方面带来根本性挑战。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 ELSA（高效 LLM 中心化切分聚合），一种分布式微调框架，将切分学习（SL）与分层联邦学习（HFL）相结合，以协调异质客户端、边缘服务器和云端之间的计算与模型聚合。ELSA 包含三项关键创新。首先，它采用与任务无关且感知行为的客户端聚类机制，利用对称 Kullback-Leibler（KL）散度，根据公开探测输入构建语义指纹，并结合基于预测一致性的信任评分和感知延迟的边缘分配，以考虑数据异质性、客户端可靠性和通信约束。其次，它采用资源感知的动态模型划分策略，将 LLM 分成三个部分分布到客户端和边缘服务器，同时由云端负责适配器聚合。该设计协调异质节点上的计算，同时平衡设备端计算需求与全局收敛行为。第三，它将计算草图与语义子空间正交扰动（SS-OP）结合，以减少通信开销并缓解模型交换过程中的隐私泄漏。在多种 NLP 任务上的大量实验表明，ELSA 在模型性能、收敛表现和鲁棒性方面优于最先进的基线。此外，在 NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPU 和 Jetson AGX Orin 边缘设备上进行的设备端性能分析，刻画了关键训练阶段的内存占用、能耗和执行延迟，为 ELSA 的实际可行性提供了实证依据。

    Fatema Siddika, Md Anwar Hossen, Tanwi Mallick, Ali Jannesari

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    SETA separates task-specific and shared knowledge through sparse subspaces, expert modules, and routing, offering a substantial continual-learning and model-organization contribution. Its subspace tests concern parameter sharing rather than explaining internal representations, so MechInterp is partial; task reuse is incidental to compositional generalization, while Systems is strong.

    SETA 通过稀疏子空间、专家模块和路由，将任务特定知识与共享知识分离，在持续学习和模型组织方面作出了重要贡献。其子空间测试关注参数共享，而非解释内部表征，因此与机制可解释性的关联较为有限；任务复用与组合泛化的联系是间接的，而系统方面的贡献则较为突出。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Continual learning in Large Language Models (LLMs) is hindered by the plasticity-stability dilemma, where acquiring new capabilities often leads to catastrophic forgetting of previous knowledge. Existing methods typically treat parameters uniformly, failing to distinguish between specific task knowledge and shared capabilities. We introduce Mixture of Sparse Experts for Task-Agnostic Continual Learning (SETA), a framework that resolves the plasticity-stability conflict through adaptive sparse subspace decomposition into task-specific expert modules. Unlike standard updates, where tasks compete for the same parameters, SETA separates knowledge into unique experts, designed to isolate task-specific patterns, and shared experts, responsible for capturing common features. SETA shares an overlapping parameter block only when the new task's update passes a subspace-agreement test and a sign test against its prior expert; shared knowledge is protected by adaptive elastic anchoring, and independently gated routers retrieve the relevant experts at inference without task identifiers. Extensive experiments across diverse domain-specific benchmarks demonstrate that SETA achieves competitive or superior overall performance relative to state-of-the-art continual learning baselines, improving overall performance over the strongest baseline by 1.1 to 1.7 points on TRACE and by up to 5.5 points on the O-LoRA benchmark, with backward transfer between -2.2 and -1.3 on TRACE, against 4.6 to 6.3 points of forgetting for MoE-CL and 8 to 15 points for the other LoRA baselines.

    中文

    大型语言模型（LLM）的持续学习受到可塑性与稳定性两难的制约：获取新能力往往会导致对既有知识的灾难性遗忘。现有方法通常将参数一视同仁，未能区分特定任务知识与共享能力。我们提出面向任务无关持续学习的稀疏专家混合模型（SETA），通过自适应稀疏子空间分解为任务专属专家模块，解决可塑性与稳定性之间的冲突。与让不同任务争用相同参数的常规更新不同，SETA 将知识分为用于隔离任务特定模式的专属专家，以及负责捕捉共同特征的共享专家。只有当新任务的更新通过与先前专家的子空间一致性测试和符号测试时，SETA 才会共享重叠参数块；共享知识由自适应弹性锚定保护，彼此独立的门控路由器则在推理时检索相关专家，无需任务标识符。在多个领域专属基准上的大量实验表明，相较于最先进的持续学习基线，SETA 的总体表现具有竞争力或更优：在 TRACE 上比最强基线提高 1.1 至 1.7 分，在 O-LoRA 基准上最高提高 5.5 分；在 TRACE 上的后向迁移介于 -2.2 和 -1.3 之间，而 MoE-CL 的遗忘幅度为 4.6 至 6.3 分，其他 LoRA 基线则为 8 至 15 分。

    Load Balancing with Evolving Workloads in Large-Scale Language Model Serving

    大规模语言模型服务中随工作负载变化的负载均衡

    Zixi Chen, Tianci Bu, Chendong Song, Xin Lu, Yinyu Ye, Zijie Zhou

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper formulates and optimizes request admission and assignment for LLM serving, with a theoretical imbalance guarantee and practical routing approximations. This is a substantial systems contribution, while the LLM context does not provide substantive insight into model mechanisms, composition, or reasoning.

    本文对 LLM 服务中的请求准入与分配进行建模和优化，并给出理论不均衡度保证及实用路由近似方法。这是一项重要的系统贡献；LLM 这一背景并未带来有关模型机制、组合或推理的实质性见解。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Serving large language models requires assigning requests whose workloads grow during processing and whose completion times are unknown. With a synchronization barrier, lightly loaded workers wait for the slowest worker at every decode iteration. We model this loss through aggregate workload imbalance and formulate a joint admission and assignment problem with sticky requests and capacity limits. Short lookahead incorporates predicted completions of ongoing requests. For exact optimization without lookahead, we prove a comparison under independent geometric decode lengths, bounded independent nondegenerate prompt sizes, and batched releases satisfying a cumulative supply condition. The long-run expected imbalance improvement over first come, first served admission with request-count join-shortest-queue grows at least as the square root of the product of worker capacity and the logarithm of worker count, in the stated scaling regime. The comparison extends to capacity-aware round robin, random routing, and power of two choices. BalanceRoute approximations connect the formulation to practical routing. Experiments using up to 144 NPUs with proprietary and public traces show lower workload spread and higher throughput than the evaluated baselines. These empirical results complement the guarantee for exact optimization.

    中文

    为大型语言模型提供服务时，需要分配处理过程中工作负载不断增长且完成时间未知的请求。在存在同步屏障的情况下，负载较轻的工作节点在每次解码迭代中都要等待最慢的工作节点。我们通过总体工作负载不均衡来建模这种损失，并将其表述为带有粘性请求和容量限制的联合准入与分配问题。短期前瞻会纳入对正在处理请求完成时间的预测。对于不使用前瞻的精确优化，我们在以下条件下证明了一项比较结果：解码长度相互独立且服从几何分布，提示长度有界、相互独立且非退化，并且批量请求的释放满足累积供给条件。在所述缩放范围内，相对于先到先服务准入并采用基于请求数量的最短队列优先策略，长期期望不均衡度的改进至少按工作节点容量与工作节点数量对数乘积的平方根增长。该比较结果也适用于考虑容量的轮询、随机路由和二选一策略。BalanceRoute 近似方法将这一表述与实用路由联系起来。在最多使用 144 个 NPU、基于专有和公开跟踪数据的实验中，与所评估的基线相比，该方法降低了工作负载分散度并提高了吞吐量。这些实证结果补充了针对精确优化的理论保证。

    MOSAIC: More LLMs, Less Cost through Collaborative Reasoning for Compiler Optimizations

    MOSAIC：通过协作推理实现更多 LLM、更低编译器优化成本

    Annabelle Sujun Tang, Christopher Priebe, Lianhui Qin, Hadi Esmaeilzadeh

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    MOSAIC uses search-tree evidence to select heterogeneous LLMs and adaptively allocate model calls, a substantial contribution to model-system organization. Its reasoning connection is limited to compiler-optimization search, with no direct study of general reasoning mechanisms or compositional generalization.

    MOSAIC 利用搜索树证据选择异质 LLM，并自适应地分配模型调用，是对模型系统组织的重要贡献。其与推理的联系仅限于编译器优化搜索，没有直接研究通用推理机制或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    LLM-guided compiler optimization has recently shown promise. However, current LLM-guided optimizers query a single LLM at every search step, so their cost grows with both that model's price and the search budget. A smaller model is cheaper but degrades the search: in our experiments, a recent single-LLM optimizer reaches 10.2% (6.0%) lower speedup on GPU (CPU) with gpt-5-mini than with GPT-5.2. Agentic multi-LLM frameworks add controllers, concurrent calls, and shared memory, whose overhead can offset the savings of cheaper models. This paper shows that the optimization search tree itself can coordinate heterogeneous LLMs: the tree already records which proposals improved the program, and we can augment the tree to record which model made them. That evidence can then be used to decide which model should propose next. To this end, we introduce MOSAIC, in which each Monte Carlo tree search (MCTS) node records a program and the LLM that expands it, and the active LLM proposes both a compiler transformation and the LLM for the next step. We also contribute an LLM-aware UCT that favors smaller models and a course-alteration rule that invokes the largest model only after repeated small-model regressions. Against that single-LLM optimizer run with GPT-5.2 alone and the same number of search iterations and tree parameters, on an NVIDIA GPU (Intel CPU), MOSAIC with eight LLMs improves the geometric-mean speedup on five kernels by 7.2% (14.4%) and the end-to-end Llama-3-8B speedup by 1.61x (1.41x), while reducing kernel compilation time by 1.95x (1.74x) and API cost by 4.47x (4.32x), with GPT-5.2 making only 23.1% (23.9%) of LLM calls. With the same eight models, random or round-robin model choice improves over the single-LLM baseline by only 2.5% on CPU, showing that the gains come from letting the LLMs choose the next model rather than from mixing the pool at random.

    中文

    近期，LLM 引导的编译器优化展现出良好前景。然而，现有 LLM 引导的优化器在每个搜索步骤都只查询一个 LLM，因此成本会随该模型的价格和搜索预算一同增长。较小的模型成本更低，却会降低搜索效果：在我们的实验中，与 GPT-5.2 相比，采用 gpt-5-mini 的近期单 LLM 优化器在 GPU（CPU）上的加速比低 10.2%（6.0%）。智能体式多 LLM 框架增加了控制器、并发调用和共享内存，这些开销可能抵消使用较便宜模型所节省的成本。本文表明，优化搜索树本身就能协调异质 LLM：搜索树已经记录了哪些提案改进了程序，我们可以扩展搜索树，记录提出这些方案的模型。随后便可利用这些证据决定下一步由哪个模型提出方案。为此，我们提出 MOSAIC：每个蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）节点记录一个程序及扩展该节点的 LLM，而当前活跃的 LLM 同时提出编译器转换方案和下一步使用的 LLM。我们还提出一种感知 LLM 的 UCT，偏向较小模型；并提出一条调整搜索进程的规则，仅在小模型反复导致性能退化后才调用最大模型。与仅使用 GPT-5.2、且搜索迭代次数和树参数相同的单 LLM 优化器相比，在 NVIDIA GPU（Intel CPU）上，使用八个 LLM 的 MOSAIC 将五个内核的几何平均加速比提高了 7.2%（14.4%），将端到端 Llama-3-8B 的加速比提高到 1.61 倍（1.41 倍），同时将内核编译时间缩短至 1/1.95（1/1.74），API 成本降低至 1/4.47（1/4.32）；GPT-5.2 仅占 LLM 调用的 23.1%（23.9%）。在使用相同八个模型的情况下，随机或轮询选择模型相较单 LLM 基线在 CPU 上仅提高 2.5%，这表明性能提升来自让 LLM 选择下一个模型，而非随机混用模型池。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Deep Equilibrium Models (DEQs) have emerged as a powerful paradigm in deep learning, offering the ability to model infinite-depth networks with constant memory usage. However, DEQs incur significant inference latency due to the iterative nature of fixed-point solvers. In this work, we introduce the Consistency Deep Equilibrium Model (C-DEQ), a novel framework that leverages consistency distillation to accelerate DEQ inference. We cast the DEQ iterative inference process as evolution along a fixed ODE trajectory toward the equilibrium. Along this trajectory, we train C-DEQs to consistently map intermediate states directly to the fixed point, enabling few-step inference while preserving the performance of the teacher DEQ. At the same time, it facilitates multi-step evaluation to flexibly trade computation for performance gains. Extensive experiments across various domain tasks demonstrate that C-DEQs achieve consistent 2-20$\times$ accuracy improvements over implicit DEQs under the same few-step inference budget. Our code is available at https://github.com/landrarwolf/CDEQ.

    The paper develops a learnable routing, sparse-linear attention formulation, and quantization-aware design to improve attention computation efficiency in video diffusion models.     本文提出可学习路由、稀疏线性注意力公式和量化感知设计，以提高视频扩散模型中的注意力计算效率。其可迁移的贡献是用于注意力的条件计算，而扩散生成只是应用场景；本文不研究内部表征或推理。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Sparse-Linear Attention (SLA) combines sparse and linear attention to accelerate diffusion models and has shown strong performance in video generation. However, (i) SLA relies on a heuristic split that assigns computations to the sparse or linear branch based on attention-weight magnitude, which can be suboptimal. Additionally, (ii) after formally analyzing the attention error in SLA, we identify a mismatch between SLA and a direct decomposition into sparse and linear attention. We propose SLA2, which introduces (I) a learnable router that dynamically selects whether each attention computation should use sparse or linear attention, (II) a more faithful and direct sparse-linear attention formulation that uses a learnable ratio to combine the sparse and linear attention branches, and (III) a sparse + low-bit attention design, where low-bit attention is introduced via quantization-aware fine-tuning to reduce quantization error. Experiments show that on video diffusion models, SLA2 can achieve 97% attention sparsity and deliver an 18.6x attention speedup while preserving generation quality.

This advances sparse computation in model systems, but its diffusion setting alone provides no substantive insight into interpretability, composition, or reasoning.

    本文分析了可训练稀疏注意力，并提出混合掩码和受蒸馏启发的微调目标，以在保留生成质量的同时提升计算效率。这推进了模型系统中的稀疏计算，但仅凭其扩散模型设定，无法为可解释性、组合性或推理提供实质性洞见。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Many training-free sparse attention methods are effective for accelerating diffusion models. Recently, several works suggest that making sparse attention trainable can further increase sparsity while preserving generation quality. We study three key questions: (1) when do the two common masking rules, i.e., Top-k and Top-p, fail, and how can we avoid these failures? (2) why can trainable sparse attention reach higher sparsity than training-free methods? (3) what are the limitations of fine-tuning sparse attention using the diffusion loss, and how can we address them? Based on this analysis, we propose SpargeAttention2, a trainable sparse attention method that achieves high sparsity without degrading generation quality. SpargeAttention2 includes (i) a hybrid masking rule that combines Top-k and Top-p for more robust masking at high sparsity, (ii) an efficient trainable sparse attention implementation, and (iii) a distillation-inspired fine-tuning objective to better preserve generation quality during fine-tuning using sparse attention. Experiments on video diffusion models show that SpargeAttention2 reaches 95% attention sparsity and a 16.2x attention speedup while maintaining generation quality, consistently outperforming prior sparse attention methods.

    ENGLISH

    Brain foundation models have achieved remarkable advances across a wide range of neuroscience tasks. However, most existing models are limited to a single functional modality, restricting their ability to exploit complementary spatiotemporal dynamics and the collective data scale across different neuroimaging techniques. This limitation largely arises from severe semantic heterogeneity and resolution discrepancies among modalities. To address these challenges, we propose Brain-OF, an omnifunctional brain foundation model jointly pretrained on fMRI, EEG and MEG, capable of handling both unimodal and multimodal inputs within a unified framework. To reconcile heterogeneous spatiotemporal resolutions, we introduce the Any-Resolution Neural Signal Sampler, which projects diverse brain signals into a shared semantic space. To further manage semantic shifts, the Brain-OF backbone integrates DINT attention with a Sparse Mixture of Experts, where shared experts capture modality-invariant representations and routed experts specialize in modality-specific semantics. Furthermore, to explicitly internalize the characteristics of neural activity through self-supervised learning, we propose Masked Temporal-Frequency Modeling, a dual-domain pretraining objective that jointly reconstructs brain signals in both the time and frequency domains. Brain-OF is pretrained on a large-scale corpus comprising around 40 datasets and demonstrates superior performance across diverse downstream tasks, highlighting the benefits of joint multimodal integration and dual-domain pretraining.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    ENGLISH

    Differential privacy (DP)'s effect in medical imaging is typically evaluated only through end-to-end performance, leaving the mechanism of privacy-induced utility loss unclear. We introduce Differential Privacy Representation Geometry for Medical Imaging (DP-RGMI), a framework that interprets DP as a structured transformation of representation space and decomposes performance degradation into encoder geometry and task-head utilization. Geometry is quantified by representation displacement from initialization and spectral effective dimension, while utilization is measured as the gap between linear-probe and end-to-end utility. Across over 594,000 images from four chest X-ray datasets and multiple pretrained initializations, we show that DP is consistently associated with a utilization gap even when linear separability is largely preserved. At the same time, displacement and spectral dimension exhibit non-monotonic, initialization- and dataset-dependent reshaping, indicating that DP alters representation anisotropy rather than uniformly collapsing features. Correlation analysis reveals that the association between end-to-end performance and utilization is robust across datasets but can vary by initialization, while geometric quantities capture additional prior- and dataset-conditioned variation. These findings position DP-RGMI as a reproducible framework for diagnosing privacy-induced failure modes and informing privacy model selection.

    KernelClaw 提出了一种多智能体内核优化框架，利用长期和短期记忆复用专家知识并避免反复回溯。其智能体协调和记忆设计对系统作出了实质性贡献；仅有内核优化结果与可解释性、组合性或推理的关联较为附带。

    ENGLISH

    Improving GPU kernel efficiency is crucial for efficient AI systems. Recent work has explored leveraging large language models (LLMs) for GPU kernel generation and optimization. However, existing LLM-based kernel optimization pipelines typically rely on opaque, implicitly learned heuristics within the LLMs to determine optimization strategies. This leads to inefficient trial-and-error and weakly interpretable optimizations. Our key insight is to replace implicit heuristics with expert optimization knowledge that is aware of task trajectories. Specifically, we present KernelClaw, a multi-agent framework with a dual-level memory architecture. KernelClaw operates by coordinating agents with long-term memory of reusable expert knowledge and short-term memory to prevent repetitive backtracking. On KernelBench Levels 1-3, KernelClaw achieves a 100% success rate and average speedups of 6.98x, 7.89x, and 1.94x over Torch Eager on Levels 1, 2, and 3, respectively, outperforming prior baselines.     Yuanhao Li, Haozhe Wang, Geyong Min, Nektarios Georgalas, and Wang Miao

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    ReDSI adapts a language-model agent for multi-objective RAN control by turning interaction history into preference data and fine-tuning the model to retain long-horizon experience.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Adaptive control in AI-native networks remains challenging because tasks such as dynamic Radio Access Network (RAN) slicing require persistent trade-off decisions among spectrum efficiency, service quality, and reconfiguration stability. Conventional Reinforcement Learning (RL) compresses these competing objectives into handcrafted scalar rewards, requiring exhaustive tuning for a balanced trade-off. Language model (LM) agents provide a new path toward adaptive control because they can semantically represent complex preference relations, but prompt-based adaptation struggles to retain long-horizon interaction history due to finite context limits. We propose a Reflection-Driven Self-Improvement (ReDSI) framework that replaces scalar rewards with semantic feedback for continuous policy adaptation. This framework is built upon a Small Language Model (SLM) agent for fast decision-making, coupled with a bi-perspective reflection to transform interaction history into preference data, subsequently distilling long-horizon decision experience into the SLM parameters through preference-based fine-tuning. Evaluated on a dynamic RAN slicing task, our method achieves an optimal trade-off across multiple competing objectives, outperforming standard RL baselines and existing LM-based agents by demonstrating substantially greater sample efficiency. These results highlight a viable paradigm of self-improving LM agents for reward-free multi-objective continuous control in AI-native networks.

    AI 原生网络中的自适应控制仍然面临挑战，因为动态无线接入网（RAN）切片等任务要求持续权衡频谱效率、服务质量和重配置稳定性。传统强化学习（RL）将这些相互竞争的目标压缩为人工设计的标量奖励，因此需要进行大量调参才能实现平衡。语言模型（LM）智能体为自适应控制提供了新途径，因为它们能够以语义方式表示复杂的偏好关系；但受有限上下文长度所限，基于提示的适应难以保留长期交互历史。我们提出反思驱动型自我改进（ReDSI）框架，以语义反馈取代标量奖励，实现持续的策略适应。该框架以用于快速决策的小型语言模型（SLM）智能体为基础，并结合双视角反思，将交互历史转化为偏好数据，随后通过基于偏好的微调，将长期决策经验蒸馏到 SLM 参数中。在动态 RAN 切片任务上的评估表明，我们的方法在多个相互竞争的目标之间实现了最优权衡，并凭借显著更高的样本效率，优于标准 RL 基线和现有基于 LM 的智能体。这些结果展示了一种可行的新范式：在 AI 原生网络中，使用自我改进的 LM 智能体进行无需奖励的多目标连续控制。

    Attention Sinks Induce Gradient Sinks: Massive Activations as Gradient Regulators in Transformers

    注意力汇聚点诱发梯度汇聚点：Transformer 中的巨大激活作为梯度调节器

    Yihong Chen, Zhouchen Lin, Quanming Yao

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper connects attention sinks to concentrated backpropagation gradients and explains massive activations as an RMSNorm-mediated response, supported by theory and interventions. This provides substantial insight into transformer training mechanisms, but it does not study reasoning, composition, or model and agent system organization.

    本文将注意力汇聚点与集中的反向传播梯度联系起来，并通过理论分析和干预实验解释了巨大激活是 RMSNorm 介导的响应。这为 Transformer 训练机制提供了重要洞见，但没有研究推理、组合性或模型与智能体系统的组织方式。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Attention sinks and massive activations are recurring and closely related phenomena in Transformer models. Existing explanations have largely focused on the forward pass, yet in pre-norm Transformers, large residual-stream norms play only an indirect forward role because sublayers operate on normalized inputs. We study this relationship from the perspective of backpropagation. Empirically and theoretically, we show that under causal masking, attention sinks can induce pronounced gradient concentration, which we term gradient sinks. Since the RMSNorm Jacobian attenuates gradients roughly in inverse proportion to input norm, massive activations can be understood as adaptive regulators of this localized gradient pressure during training. This interpretation predicts that attenuating sink-induced gradients should weaken massive activations. We test this prediction with V-scale, a modification that adjusts backpropagated gradients on the value paths. In V-scale models and a backward-only control, attention sinks are preserved, whereas massive activations are suppressed. These results identify gradient sinks as a backward-pass counterpart of attention sinks, and massive activations as an adaptive RMSNorm-mediated response that attenuates the resulting localized training pressure. Our code is available at https://github.com/LARS-research/GradientSink.

    中文

    注意力汇聚点和巨大激活是 Transformer 模型中反复出现且密切相关的现象。现有解释主要关注前向传播，但在前归一化 Transformer 中，由于子层处理的是归一化后的输入，较大的残差流范数在前向传播中的作用只是间接的。我们从反向传播的角度研究这种关系。通过实证和理论分析，我们表明，在因果掩码下，注意力汇聚点会导致明显的梯度集中，我们将其称为梯度汇聚点。由于 RMSNorm 的雅可比矩阵会大致按输入范数的倒数衰减梯度，因此可以将巨大激活理解为训练期间对这种局部梯度压力的自适应调节器。这一解释预测，减弱汇聚点诱发的梯度应当会削弱巨大激活。我们使用 V-scale 检验这一预测；该方法通过修改来调整值路径上反向传播的梯度。在 V-scale 模型和一个仅修改反向传播的对照模型中，注意力汇聚点得以保留，而巨大激活受到抑制。这些结果表明，梯度汇聚点是注意力汇聚点在反向传播中的对应现象，而巨大激活则是由 RMSNorm 介导的自适应响应，可减轻由此产生的局部训练压力。代码见 https://github.com/LARS-research/GradientSink。

    ENGLISH

    Knowledge Graphs (KGs) provide a critical foundation for many AI systems, yet their automated construction inevitably introduces noisy triples that undermine data trustworthiness. Reliable KG auditing requires jointly examining internal structural constraints and open-world evidence, whereas existing methods often rely on a single evidence source or static, one-shot inference, limiting adaptive evidence acquisition and auditability. We propose SHARP (Schema-Hybrid Agent for Reliable Prediction), a training-free agent that reformulates triple verification as a dynamic process of strategic planning, active investigation, and evidential reasoning. SHARP uses retrieved historical verification trajectories and entity--relation schema information to construct a task-specific investigation plan. It then iteratively coordinates KG and textual tools to cross-validate structural and semantic evidence, producing a verification verdict with a transparent evidence chain. On independently sampled, balanced test sets constructed from FB15K-237 and Wikidata5M-Ind, SHARP achieves average accuracies of 87.1% and 93.6%, respectively. Controlled comparisons with standard RAG using the same evidence sources, together with ablation studies, further show that the gains arise not merely from external retrieval, but from the combined effects of schema-aware planning, memory augmentation, and iterative hybrid tool use.

    Ha Lan N.T, Minh-Anh Nguyen, Dung D. Le

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    LAnR jointly performs retrieval and generation in latent space and uses a control head to decide when retrieved evidence is sufficient, with experiments showing better efficiency and QA performance. Its use of hidden states is an architectural contribution, but the abstract does not investigate internal representations mechanistically; retrieval control supports a strong Systems connection, while reasoning is incidental.

    LAnR 在潜在空间中联合执行检索和生成，并使用控制头判断检索到的证据是否充足；实验表明它提升了效率和问答性能。使用隐藏状态是其架构贡献，但摘要并未以机制性方式研究内部表征；检索控制构成了与 Systems 的紧密关联，而推理只是附带因素。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has become a standard approach for enhancing large language models (LLMs) with external knowledge, mitigating hallucinations, and improving factuality. However, existing systems rely on generating natural language queries at each hop and maintaining a strict architectural separation between retriever and generator, preventing them from leveraging the full representational capacity of the LLM. We propose \textbf{LAnR} (Latent Abstraction for RAG), a unified framework in which a single LLM jointly performs encoding, retrieval, and generation entirely within its own latent space. Rather than generating textual queries, LAnR produces dense retrieval vectors from the hidden states of a designated \texttt{[PRED]} token and uses them to match against encoded document representations from the same model. Furthermore, LAnR adaptively decides when sufficient evidence has been retrieved using a lightweight MLP control head over those same hidden states, eliminating both the separate retriever and explicit token-level stopping reasoning. This design is motivated by our empirical observation that answer token entropy reliably signals retrieval sufficiency. Extensive experiments on six QA benchmarks spanning single-hop and multi-hop settings demonstrate that LAnR outperforms existing RAG methods, while achieving improved inference efficiency through reduced number of retrieval calls and tighter model integration.

    中文

    检索增强生成（RAG）已成为利用外部知识增强大型语言模型（LLM）、减少幻觉并提升事实准确性的标准方法。然而，现有系统依赖于在每个跳步生成自然语言查询，并严格区分检索器和生成器的架构，因此无法充分利用 LLM 的表征能力。我们提出 \textbf{LAnR}（用于 RAG 的潜在抽象），这是一个统一框架，由单个 LLM 完全在自身潜在空间中联合执行编码、检索和生成。LAnR 不生成文本查询，而是从指定的 \texttt{[PRED]} token 的隐藏状态中生成稠密检索向量，并用这些向量与同一模型编码的文档表征进行匹配。此外，LAnR 使用基于相同隐藏状态的轻量级 MLP 控制头，自适应地判断是否已检索到足够证据，从而无需独立检索器，也无需显式的 token 级停止推理。该设计源于我们的实证观察：答案 token 的熵能够可靠地表明检索证据是否充足。在涵盖单跳和多跳设置的六个问答基准上进行的大量实验表明，LAnR 优于现有 RAG 方法，同时通过减少检索调用次数和加强模型集成，提高了推理效率。

    Adaptive multi-agent systems (MAS) are increasingly adopted to tackle complex problems. However, the narrow task coverage of their optimization raises the question of whether they can function as general-purpose systems. To address this gap, we conduct an extensive empirical study of adaptive MAS, revealing two key findings: (1) topological overfitting -- they fail to generalize across different domains; and (2) illusory coordination -- they achieve reasonable surface-level accuracy while the underlying agent interactions diverge from ideal MAS behavior, raising concerns about their practical utility.     Yibin Luo, Shiwei Gao, Huichuan Zheng, Youyou Lu, Jiwu Shu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    RoundPipe contributes a dynamic pipeline schedule, transfer scheduling, consistency protocol, and layer partitioning method to improve LLM fine-tuning across consumer GPUs. This is a substantial systems contribution, while the reported model scale and training task do not establish contributions to the other directions.

    RoundPipe 提出了一种动态流水线调度方案、传输调度机制、一致性协议和层划分方法，以改进在消费级 GPU 上进行的 LLM 微调。这是一项实质性的系统贡献，而所报告的模型规模和训练任务并未证明其对其他方向有所贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Fine-tuning Large Language Models (LLMs) on consumer-grade GPUs is highly cost-effective, yet constrained by limited GPU memory and slow PCIe interconnects. Pipeline parallelism combined with CPU offloading mitigates these hardware bottlenecks by reducing communication overhead. However, existing PP schedules suffer from an inherent limitation termed the \textit{weight binding} issue. Binding uneven model stages (e.g., the LM head is large) to GPUs limits the pipeline's throughput to that of the GPU with the heaviest load, leading to severe pipeline bubbles. In this paper, we propose RoundPipe, a novel pipeline schedule that breaks the weight binding constraint on consumer GPU servers. RoundPipe treats GPUs as a pool of stateless execution workers and dynamically dispatches computation stages across devices in a round-robin manner, achieving a near-zero-bubble pipeline. To ensure training correctness and system efficiency, RoundPipe integrates a priority-aware transfer scheduling engine, a Layerwise Model Consistency Protocol, and an automated layer partitioning algorithm. Evaluations on an 8$\times$ RTX 4090 server demonstrate that RoundPipe achieves 1.48--2.16$\times$ speedups over state-of-the-art baselines when fine-tuning 1.7B to 32B models. Remarkably, RoundPipe enables LoRA fine-tuning of the Qwen3-235B model with 31K sequence length on a single server. RoundPipe has been open-sourced as a Python library.

    在消费级 GPU 上微调大型语言模型（LLM）具有很高的成本效益，但受限于有限的 GPU 内存和较慢的 PCIe 互连。流水线并行结合 CPU 卸载可通过降低通信开销缓解这些硬件瓶颈。然而，现有的 PP 调度方案存在一种固有局限，称为 \textit{权重绑定}问题。将不均衡的模型阶段（例如，LM 头部较大）绑定到 GPU，会使流水线吞吐量受负载最重的 GPU 限制，导致严重的流水线气泡。在本文中，我们提出 RoundPipe，这是一种新颖的流水线调度方案，可打破消费级 GPU 服务器上的权重绑定约束。RoundPipe 将 GPU 视为一组无状态执行工作器，以轮询方式在设备间动态分派计算阶段，从而实现近乎零气泡的流水线。为确保训练正确性和系统效率，RoundPipe 集成了一个感知优先级的传输调度引擎、一种逐层模型一致性协议，以及一种自动化层划分算法。在一台配备 8 块$\times$RTX 4090 的服务器上进行的评估表明，在微调 1.7B 至 32B 模型时，RoundPipe 相较于最先进的基线实现了 1.48--2.16$\times$ 倍加速。值得注意的是，RoundPipe 能够在单台服务器上以 31K 的序列长度对 Qwen3-235B 模型进行 LoRA 微调。RoundPipe 已作为 Python 库开源。

    这篇论文介绍了一个轻量级的部分可观测持续学习测试平台，并借此研究智能体记忆、可塑性和状态构造。它实质性地推动了智能体评估和系统设计；而持续学习与任务流只能有限地说明组合泛化或推理能力，论文也没有研究内部表征。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    In continual reinforcement learning (CRL), good performance requires never-ending learning, acting, and exploration in a big, partially observable world. Most CRL experiments have focused on loss of plasticity---the inability to keep learning---in one-off experiments where some unobservable non-stationarity is added to classic fully observable MDPs. Further, these experiments rarely consider the role of partial observability and the importance of CRL agents that use memory or recurrence. One potential reason for this focus on mitigating loss of plasticity without considering partial observability is that many partially-observable CRL environments are prohibitively expensive. In this paper, we introduce Forager, a lightweight partially-observable CRL environment with a constant memory footprint. We provide a set of experiments and sample tasks demonstrating that Forager is challenging for current CRL agents and yet also allows for in-depth study of those agents. We demonstrate that agents exhibit loss of plasticity, proposed mitigations can help, but that most useful is to leverage state construction. We conclude with a variant of Forager that generates an unending stream of new tasks to learn that clearly highlights the limitations of current CRL agents.

    在持续强化学习（CRL）中，要取得良好表现，就必须在一个庞大且部分可观测的世界里持续学习、行动和探索。大多数 CRL 实验关注的是可塑性丧失——即无法继续学习——通常是在一次性实验中，向经典的全可观测 MDP 添加某种不可观测的非平稳性。此外，这些实验很少考虑部分可观测性的作用，也很少关注使用记忆或循环机制的 CRL 智能体的重要性。之所以关注如何缓解可塑性丧失，却不考虑部分可观测性，一个可能原因是许多部分可观测 CRL 环境的成本高得难以承受。本文介绍 Forager，这是一个轻量级的部分可观测 CRL 环境，内存占用恒定。我们提供了一组实验和示例任务，表明 Forager 对当前 CRL 智能体具有挑战性，同时也支持对这些智能体进行深入研究。我们展示了智能体会出现可塑性丧失，所提出的缓解方法能够发挥作用，但最有效的方法是利用状态构造。最后，我们介绍了 Forager 的一个变体，它会生成源源不断的新任务供学习，从而清楚地揭示当前 CRL 智能体的局限。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    The landscape of large language models (LLMs) has become increasingly fragmented, with no single model dominating the field. Meanwhile, cloud providers offer a diverse array of mid-tier and older-generation GPUs. These heterogeneous resources provide better availability and deliver comparable performance-per-dollar to top-tier hardware. To efficiently harness these GPUs for concurrent multi-LLM serving, we introduce Coral: an adaptive, heterogeneity-aware serving system. The key idea behind Coral is the joint optimization of resource allocation and replica serving strategies across all models. To keep pace with shifting throughput demands and resource availability, Coral employs a lossless, two-stage decomposition. This approach preserves joint optimality while reducing online solve times from hours to mere tens of seconds.     Mengfan Xu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops bandit learning methods and regret analyses for changing populations of agents, including manifold-based population embeddings. Its agent-system and adaptive learning contributions are substantial, but the manifold representation does not study models’ internal representations, and general agent patterns alone do not establish compositional generalization.

    这篇论文为变化中的智能体群体开发了赌博机学习方法并分析遗憾值，其中包括基于流形的群体嵌入。它对智能体系统和自适应学习作出了实质性贡献，但流形表示并未研究模型的内部表征；一般智能体模式本身也不足以证明其涉及组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Open systems, where agents arrive and depart over time, are growing in digital platforms. Existing work on online learning in such systems, however, often relies on structural assumptions that may be restrictive in practice. In particular, heterogeneous rewards and general agent patterns create three new challenges: arrivals induce endogenous non-stationarity, agent patterns govern the rate of information accumulation, and uncertainty brought by new agents accumulates over time and scales regret. To this end, we formulate a learning problem for open systems that accommodates both forms of generality. We introduce new concepts to capture the inherent complexities: the \emph{pre-training degree} of new agents quantifies how much information an agent carries upon entry, \emph{stability} measures the impact of population changes on the global optimum, and \emph{global dynamic regret} compares the cumulative expected reward with that of the varying optimal arms. We also study a manifold representation of agents and introduce a \emph{dynamic population embedding} that directly encodes the population functional for each arm. We develop two UCB-based methods. The first combines entry information with online observations through agent-wise confidence bounds and aggregates the estimates and uncertainties for arm selection. The second pools agent-level observations through kernel regression on the manifold and constructs UCBs by projecting the confidence sets onto the current population embedding. Entry uncertainty enters the regret linearly through the pre-training error, while in stable regimes, regret is governed by the time needed to identify the stable optimal arm. With the manifold as a handle, regret is governed by the information gained from agent representations. These bounds all depend on population dynamics, but in different ways.

    中文

    在开放系统中，智能体会随时间不断进入和离开，这类系统正越来越多地出现在数字平台中。然而，现有关于此类系统在线学习的研究往往依赖在实践中可能过于严格的结构假设。具体而言，异质奖励和一般智能体模式带来了三个新挑战：智能体进入会导致内生的非平稳性，智能体模式决定信息积累的速度，而新智能体带来的不确定性会随时间累积并扩大遗憾值。为此，我们针对开放系统提出一个兼顾这两种一般性的学习问题。我们引入了几个概念来刻画其中固有的复杂性：新智能体的\emph{预训练程度}用于量化智能体进入时携带的信息量；\emph{稳定性}用于衡量群体变化对全局最优解的影响；\emph{全局动态遗憾}则将累积期望奖励与不断变化的最优臂所取得的奖励进行比较。我们还研究了智能体的流形表示，并提出一种\emph{动态群体嵌入}，它可以直接编码各个臂对应的群体函数。我们开发了两种基于 UCB 的方法。第一种通过智能体级置信界，将进入时的信息与在线观测相结合，并汇总估计值和不确定性以选择臂。第二种通过流形上的核回归汇集智能体级观测，并通过将置信集合投影到当前群体嵌入上来构造 UCB。进入时的不确定性以线性方式通过预训练误差影响遗憾值；在稳定情形下，遗憾值取决于识别稳定最优臂所需的时间。以流形为基础时，遗憾值取决于从智能体表征中获得的信息。这些界限都依赖群体动态，但依赖方式各不相同。

    Huaiyuan Qin, Muli Yang, Gabriel James Goenawan, Peng Hu, Chen Gong, Xi Peng, Hongyuan Zhu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Across ViT families, the paper identifies architectural mismatch as the mechanism that makes transferred attention patterns unusable, and shows that restoring native components reverses the failures. This provides substantial insight into attention routing and representation behavior; architecture is relevant to systems only incidentally.

    在多个 ViT 系列中，本文确定架构不匹配是导致迁移的注意力模式无法使用的原因，并展示恢复原生组件可以扭转失败。这为理解注意力路由和表征行为提供了重要洞见；架构与系统的关联只是附带的。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    A recent work shows that Attention Transfer, which transfers only the attention patterns from a pre-trained teacher Vision Transformer (ViT) to a randomly initialized standard student ViT, is sufficient to recover the full benefit of the teacher's pre-trained weights. We revisit this finding on a comprehensive benchmark of 20 teachers from 11 well-known ViT families and reveal that Attention Transfer is not universally effective. While 7 families transfer successfully, 4 consistently fail, falling up to 5.1\% below the from-scratch no-transfer baseline. Further results demonstrate that this failure is family-consistent across model sizes, and persists under extended training durations, different transfer datasets, and out-of-distribution evaluations. Controlled analyses then consistently localize the problem to the attention-routing channel, indicating that the key issue is not whether the student can match the teacher's attention patterns, but whether the matched patterns remain functional for the student. Crucially, we identify architectural mismatch between the pre-trained teacher and the standard student as the primary mechanism. By adding only the teacher's native architectural components to the student in a randomly initialized state, we completely reverse the failure for all 4 families. Notably, these components alone do not improve from-scratch training, confirming that they specifically unlock the usability of the teacher's attention. We further show that this failure is not explained by the inadequate choice of transfer loss, differences in pre-training recipes, or the intrinsic quality of attention maps. Our findings refine the prevailing understanding of attention in ViT representations: attention is sufficient \textit{only} when the student architecture matches the teacher.

    中文

    近期一项研究表明，将预训练教师视觉 Transformer（ViT）的注意力模式迁移到随机初始化的标准学生 ViT，便足以恢复教师预训练权重带来的全部收益。我们在涵盖 11 个知名 ViT 系列、20 个教师模型的全面基准上重新检验这一发现，结果表明注意力迁移并非普遍有效。虽然有 7 个系列迁移成功，但有 4 个系列持续失败，性能比从头训练且不进行迁移的基线最多低 5.1\%。进一步结果表明，这种失败在不同模型规模下对同一系列保持一致，并且在延长训练时间、更换迁移数据集以及分布外评估时仍然存在。受控分析一再将问题定位到注意力路由通道，说明关键不在于学生能否匹配教师的注意力模式，而在于匹配后的模式对学生是否仍然有效。至关重要的是，我们确定预训练教师与标准学生之间的架构不匹配是主要原因。只需将教师原生架构组件加入随机初始化的学生模型，就能彻底扭转所有 4 个系列的失败情况。值得注意的是，这些组件单独使用并不能改善从头训练效果，这证实它们专门解锁了教师注意力的可用性。我们还表明，这种失败无法用迁移损失选择不当、预训练方案差异或注意力图本身质量来解释。我们的发现修正了关于 ViT 表征中注意力作用的主流认识：只有在学生架构与教师匹配时，注意力才足以发挥作用。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    BioProVLA-Agent contributes a closed-loop, protocol-driven multi-agent architecture that parses tasks, verifies visual state, and executes embodied actions; AugSmolVLA improves robustness to wet-lab visual perturbations. Composite workflows and closed-loop reasoning are relevant to composition and reasoning, but the abstract reports system integration and task performance rather than a substantive advance in composition or reasoning mechanisms.

    BioProVLA-Agent 提出了一种闭环、协议驱动的多智能体架构，用于解析任务、验证视觉状态并执行具身动作；AugSmolVLA 则提升了系统对湿实验室视觉扰动的鲁棒性。组合工作流和闭环推理与组合能力、推理相关，但该摘要报告的是系统集成和任务性能，并未对组合能力或推理机制作出实质性推进。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Biological laboratory automation can reduce repetitive manual work and improve reproducibility, but reliable embodied execution in wet-lab environments remains challenging. Protocols are often unstructured, labware is frequently transparent or reflective, and multi-step procedures require state-aware execution beyond one-shot instruction following. Existing robotic systems often rely on costly hardware, fixed workflows, dedicated instruments, or robotics-oriented interfaces. Here, we introduce BioProVLA-Agent, an affordable, protocol-driven, vision-enhanced embodied multi-agent system enabled by Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for biological manipulation. The system uses protocols as the task interface and integrates protocol parsing, visual state verification, and embodied execution in a closed-loop workflow. A Tailored LLM Protocol Agent converts protocols into verifiable subtasks; a VLM-RAG Verification Agent assesses readiness and completion using observations, robot states, retrieved knowledge, and success/failure examples; and a VLA Embodied Agent executes verified subtasks through a lightweight policy. To improve robustness under wet-lab visual perturbations, we develop AugSmolVLA, an online augmentation strategy targeting transparent labware, reflections, illumination shifts, and overexposure. We evaluate the system on a hierarchical benchmark covering 15 atomic tasks, 6 composite workflows, and 3 bimanual tasks, including tube loading, sorting, waste disposal, cap twisting, and liquid pouring. Across normal and high-exposure settings, AugSmolVLA improves execution stability over ACT, X-VLA, and the original SmolVLA, especially for precise placement, transparent-object manipulation, composite workflows, and visually degraded scenes. These results suggest a practical route toward accessible, protocol-centered, and verification-capable embodied AI for biological manipulation.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The article organizes device-cloud and multi-agent LLM collaboration under resource constraints and discusses routing and cooperative training. Its main contribution is a systems framework; task-level collaboration only incidentally touches composition or reasoning, without a substantive advance in either.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language models (LLMs) are transforming society, powering applications from smartphone assistants to autonomous driving. Yet cloud-based LLM services alone cannot serve a growing class of applications, including those operating under intermittent connectivity, sub-second latency budgets, data-residency constraints, or sustained high-volume inference. On-device deployment is in turn constrained by limited computation and memory. No single endpoint can deliver high-quality service across this spectrum. This article focuses on collaborative intelligence, a paradigm in which multiple independent LLMs distributed across device and cloud endpoints collaborate at the task level through natural language or structured messages. Such collaboration strives for superior response quality under heterogeneous resource constraints spanning computation, memory, communication, and cost across network tiers. We present collaborative inference along two complementary and composable dimensions: vertical device-cloud collaboration and horizontal multi-agent collaboration, which can be combined into hybrid topologies in practice. We then examine learning to collaborate, addressing the training of routing policies and the development of cooperative capabilities among LLMs. Finally, we identify open research challenges including scaling under resource heterogeneity and trustworthy collaborative intelligence.

    Liangqi Yuan and Wenzhi Fang and Shiqiang Wang and Christopher G. Brinton

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    PAAC aligns planner-executor roles with the device-cloud trust boundary, using typed placeholders and deterministic substitution to preserve executable actions while reducing privacy leakage. This is a substantial agent-system design contribution; improved benchmark accuracy involves reasoning, but the abstract does not establish a new reasoning mechanism.

    PAAC 将规划器—执行器角色与设备—云端信任边界对齐，利用类型化占位符和确定性替换，在减少隐私泄漏的同时保留可执行操作。这是对智能体系统设计的实质性贡献；基准准确率的提升涉及推理，但摘要并未证明其提出了新的推理机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language model (LLM) agents face a structural tension: cloud agents provide strong reasoning but expose user data, while on-device agents preserve privacy at the cost of overall capability. Existing device-cloud designs treat this boundary as a compute split rather than a trust boundary suited to agentic workloads, and existing sanitizers force a choice between policy flexibility and the structural fidelity tool calls require. In this work, we develop PAAC, a privacy-aware agentic framework that aligns planner--executor decomposition with the device-cloud boundary so that role specialization itself becomes the privacy mechanism. The cloud agent reasons over typed placeholder tokens that preserve each sensitive value's reasoning role while discarding its content, while the on-device agent identifies sensitive spans and distills each step's execution outcome into compact key findings. Sanitization confines the on-device LLM to proposing which spans to mask, while a deterministic registry performs all substitution and reversal, keeping actions directly executable on device. On three agentic benchmarks under strict privacy settings, PAAC dominates the Pareto frontier of privacy and accuracy, improving average accuracy by 15-36\% and reducing average leakage by 2-6$\times$ over state-of-the-art device-cloud baselines, with the largest margins on privacy targets outside fixed entity taxonomies. We find consistent improvements on 17 additional benchmarks spanning 10 domains, including math, science, and finance.

    大语言模型（LLM）智能体面临一种结构性矛盾：云端智能体推理能力强，却会暴露用户数据；设备端智能体能够保护隐私，但整体能力较弱。现有设备—云端设计将这一边界视为计算任务的划分，而非适用于智能体工作负载的信任边界；现有脱敏器则迫使人们在策略灵活性与工具调用所需的结构保真度之间做出选择。在本研究中，我们开发了 PAAC，这是一种注重隐私保护的智能体框架，它将规划器—执行器分解与设备—云端边界对齐，使角色专门化本身成为隐私保护机制。云端智能体基于类型化占位符 token 进行推理，这些 token 保留每个敏感值在推理中的作用，同时舍弃其内容；设备端智能体则识别敏感片段，并将每一步的执行结果提炼为简洁的关键发现。脱敏过程将设备端 LLM 的职责限定为提出需要屏蔽的片段，而确定性注册表负责所有替换与还原，从而确保操作可直接在设备端执行。在严格隐私设置下的三个智能体基准上，PAAC 在隐私与准确率的帕累托前沿上占优：相较最先进的设备—云端基线，平均准确率提升 15-36\%，平均泄漏减少 2-6$\times$；在不属于固定实体分类体系的隐私目标上，优势最大。我们还在另外 17 个涵盖 10 个领域的基准上观察到一致的改进，包括数学、科学和金融。

    The paper constructs transformers that implement weighted majority and Q-learning by storing algorithmic state in continuous latent contexts, and shows improved online adaptation experimentally.     Large language models (LLMs) exhibit a strong capacity for in-context learning: Given labeled examples, they can generate good predictions without parameter updates. However, many interactive settings go beyond static prediction to online decision-making, in which effective behavior demands adaptation over long multi-turn horizons in response to feedback, and efficient algorithms in these domains must use compact representations of what they have learned. Recently, continuous transformer architectures with latent chain of thought have shown promise for offline iterative tasks such as directed graph-reachability. Motivated by this, we study whether continuous latent context tokens equip transformers to more effectively realize online learning. We give explicit constructions of constant-depth transformers that implement two foundational online decision-making procedures -- the weighted majority algorithm and $Q$-learning -- by storing their algorithmic state as linear combinations of feature embeddings, using a small number of latent context tokens. We further train a small GPT-2-style transformer with latent contexts using a multi-curriculum objective that does not directly supervise the latent states. On long synthetic online prediction sequences, this model outperforms comparable discrete-state baselines, while comparisons with prompted LLMs show that textual state summaries can also improve adaptation. Our results suggest that continuous latent contexts provide a simple and effective persistent state for transformers to implement online learning algorithms.

    Operational disaster response goes beyond damage assessment, requiring responders to integrate multi-sensor signals, reason over road networks, populations and key facilities, plan evacuations, and produce actionable reports. However, prior work largely isolates remote-sensing perception or evaluates generic tool use, leaving the end-to-end workflows of emergency operations underexplored. In this paper, we introduce Disaster Operational Response Agent benchmark (DORA), the first agentic benchmark for end-to-end disaster response: 515 expert-authored tasks across 45 real-world disaster events spanning 10 types, paired with expert-verified, replayable gold trajectories totaling 3,500 tool-call steps. Tasks span five dimensions that cover the operational disaster-response pipeline: disaster perception, spatial relational analysis, rescue and evacuation planning, temporal evolution reasoning, and multi-modal report synthesis. Agents compose calls from a 108-tool MCP library over heterogeneous geospatial data: optical, SAR, and multi-spectral imagery across single-, bi-, and multi-temporal sequences (0.015-10m GSD), complemented by elevation and social vector layers. We comprehensively evaluate 13 frontier LLMs on our benchmark, revealing three persistent challenges: 1) disaster-domain grounding exposes unique failure modes (damage-semantic grounding, sensor-modality mismatch, and disaster-pipeline composition); 2) agents are doubly bottlenecked by tool selection and argument grounding, where gold tool-order hints improve accuracy by only 1.08-4.40%, and alternative scaffolds yield at most a 3.24% gain; 3) compositional fragility scales with trajectory length, the agent-to-gold gap widening from 7% to 56% on long pipelines. DORA establishes a rigorous testbed for operationally reliable disaster-response agents. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Junjue-Wang/DORA.

    Let the Batch Decide, On- or Off-Policy: Effective Sample Size for RL Post-Training

    让批次决定采用在策略还是离策略：用于 RL 后训练的有效样本量

    Rasool Fakoor, Murdock Aubry, Nicholas Stranges, Alexander J. Smola

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    P3O uses batch effective sample size to adapt RL post-training updates to policy mismatch, and experiments show improved stability on math reasoning tasks. This is a strong contribution to training methods for reasoning capability; policy optimization alone provides only an incidental connection to model systems, with no focus on internal mechanisms or compositional generalization.

    P3O 使用批次有效样本量，使 RL 后训练更新能够适应策略失配；实验表明，它在数学推理任务上提升了稳定性。这是对推理能力训练方法的重要贡献；策略优化与模型系统只有附带关联，研究并未聚焦内部机制或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Reinforcement learning (RL) is structurally harder than supervised learning because the policy changes the data distribution it learns from. The resulting fragility is especially visible in large-model training using nominally on-policy RL, where the training and rollout systems can differ in numerical precision, sampling and other implementation details. The common approach handles this difference by constraining the update with a fixed clip range, so the algorithm becomes more sensitive to its configuration and must be retuned whenever the task, model scale or distribution mismatch changes. We argue that the fragility traces to two linked concerns that this one fixed range has to cover. The first is a trust-region concern: an update should not move the policy too far from its current value. The second is an off-policy concern: data from older or different behavior policies should influence the update only to the extent that the update remains reliable. Neither concern is a constant to set in advance, and the policy ratios of the current batch show how severe each one is. We adopt P3O, a simple yet effective batch-adaptive objective from prior work that replaces fixed clipping with the normalized effective sample size of the per-token policy ratios, which we take against the rollout engine's log-probabilities. The same statistic caps the score-function weight and sets the strength of an off-policy regularizer, so the update stays close to the on-policy update when the ratios are close to one. When stale or mismatched data concentrate the ratios, the update tightens but keeps a nonzero score-function weight on every token. Experiments on math reasoning show that P3O compares favorably with tuned baselines and, under FP8 rollouts on Qwen3-8B-Base, avoids the late collapse of GRPO. P3O adds no new objective hyper-parameters and removes the clip range.

    中文

    强化学习（RL）在结构上比监督学习更难，因为策略会改变其学习所用的数据分布。使用名义上的在策略 RL 训练大型模型时，这种脆弱性尤为明显，因为训练系统和采样系统可能在数值精度、采样方式及其他实现细节上有所不同。常见做法是通过固定裁剪范围来约束更新以处理这种差异，因此算法对配置更敏感，并且每当任务、模型规模或分布失配发生变化时都必须重新调参。我们认为，这种脆弱性源自固定范围需要同时应对的两个相关问题。第一个是信赖域问题：更新不应使策略偏离当前值太远。第二个是离策略问题：来自较旧或不同策略的数据，只有在更新仍然可靠的范围内才应影响更新。这两个问题都不是可以预先设定的常数，而当前批次的策略比率能反映各自的严重程度。我们采用了先前工作提出的 P3O，这是一种简单而有效的批次自适应目标，它以每 token 策略比率的归一化有效样本量取代固定裁剪；这些比率是相对于采样引擎的对数概率计算的。同一统计量既对得分函数权重设上限，也设定离策略正则项的强度，因此当比率接近 1 时，更新会保持接近在策略更新。当陈旧或不匹配的数据使比率集中时，更新会收紧，但每个 token 的得分函数权重仍保持非零。数学推理实验表明，P3O 的表现优于调优后的基线；在 Qwen3-8B-Base 上采用 FP8 进行采样时，它避免了 GRPO 后期崩溃。P3O 不增加新的目标超参数，并移除了裁剪范围。

    As AI agents advance, the central question is no longer whether they can solve isolated financial tasks, but whether their capabilities generalize across complete professional workflows. Existing benchmarks cannot answer this question because they evaluate either static competencies or agents within a single interaction structure. We introduce Herculean, a benchmark of end-to-end agentic financial intelligence that crosses agent architecture, backbone model, and four structurally distinct workflows: Trading, Hedging, Market Insights, and Auditing. Each workflow is implemented as an MCP skill that preserves its native state, actions, constraints, and outcome criteria, allowing intact agent systems to be evaluated under matched external conditions. Across 30 architecture--backbone configurations, we find that agent capability is not globally ordered. Workflow rankings are weakly aligned, changing the architecture frequently reverses performance under the same backbone, and each architecture concentrates failure in different forms of workflow control. These results establish that agent performance is an interaction between architecture and workflow demand, rather than an intrinsic property of the underlying model. Consequently, success on a single financial workflow provides little evidence of dependable, general financial intelligence.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    DIO-Agent searches for programs that explain input-output behavior, using execution errors and a simplicity-biased progression from basic constructs to iteration; this offers a substantive algorithm for program synthesis and problem solving. Program structure and agentic search give partial compositional and systems relevance, but the abstract does not study internal model mechanisms or compositional generalization directly.

    DIO-Agent 搜索能够解释输入输出行为的程序，利用执行错误，并以偏向简单结构的方式逐步从基础构造扩展到迭代；这为程序合成和问题求解提供了一种实质性的算法。程序结构和智能体式搜索使其与组合方法及系统有一定关联，但摘要并未直接研究模型内部机制或组合泛化。

    ENGLISH

    The automatic synthesis of a program from any form of specification is regarded as a holy grail of computer science. Fueled by LLMs, NL2Code has achieved tremendous success, yet the fundamentally more challenging task of synthesizing programs from input-output behavior, which we refer to as IO2Code, remains largely unsolved. Whereas NL2Code can exploit the semantic alignment between natural language and code acquired during pretraining, IO2Code requires recovering underlying principles from concrete computational behavior, navigating a vast and underspecified hypothesis space. To address this, we propose DIO-Agent, a discovery agent that performs agentic reverse engineering from input-output behavior to code. Our method frames IO2Code as an evolutionary search over discrete program space, in which an LLM serves as the mutation operator and concrete error signals from execution guide each mutation. To prevent the search from wandering into structurally complex yet incorrect dead ends, we introduce the Transformation Priority Premise as a mutation prior that biases the LLM toward the simplest hypothesis consistent with current evidence, progressively escalating from constants to conditionals to iteration only when simpler constructs are insufficient. To facilitate systematic study, we further construct an IO2CodeBench spanning multiple difficulty levels. Extensive experiments show that DIO-Agent consistently outperforms both traditional program-by-example method and SOTA evolution-agent baselines across all difficulty levels and various LLMs, while substantially surpassing test-time scaling strategies with equivalent sampling budgets.

    Jiwon Song, Dongwon Jo, Beomseok Kang, Jae-Joon Kim

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    CompactAttention introduces block-union KV selection to speed long-context chunked prefill while preserving selected KV blocks under paged execution, with benchmarked attention speedups. This is a substantial inference computation improvement for model serving, but the abstract gives no contribution to reasoning, composition, or internal representations.

    CompactAttention 提出块并集 KV 选择，以加速长上下文分块预填充，同时在分页执行下保留选中的 KV 块，并通过基准测试展示了注意力加速效果。这显著改善了模型服务中的推理计算，但摘要没有表明其对推理能力、组合能力或内部表征有所贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Chunked prefill has become a widely adopted serving strategy for long-context large language models, but efficient attention computation in this regime remains challenging. Existing sparse attention methods are primarily designed for one-shot prefill and do not translate efficiently to chunked prefill: block-sparse kernels lose efficiency when the query length is limited by the chunk size, while fine-grained pattern search becomes costly when repeated over the accumulated KV cache at every chunk. QUOKA, a recent method that directly targets chunked prefill, avoids sparse-kernel overhead but relies on query-subsampled, token-level KV selection, which can miss query-specific KV entries and introduce explicit KV-copy overhead. To address these limitations, we propose CompactAttention, a chunked-prefill attention mechanism based on Block-Union KV Selection. CompactAttention treats 2D block-sparse masks as KV-selection signals rather than direct sparse-kernel execution plans, and converts them into GQA-aware per-group KV block tables through Q-block union and intra-group union. This construction produces block tables that preserve all KV blocks selected by the input masks under paged execution constraints, enabling selected KV blocks to be accessed in place without explicit KV compaction. On LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct, CompactAttention maintains accuracy close to dense attention on the RULER benchmark while delivering up to 2.79$\times$ attention speedup over dense attention and 1.25$\times$ over FlashPrefill at 128K context length under chunked prefill.

    中文

    分块预填充已成为长上下文大型语言模型中广泛采用的服务策略，但在这种情况下高效计算注意力仍然具有挑战性。现有稀疏注意力方法主要为一次性预填充设计，无法高效地用于分块预填充：当查询长度受块大小限制时，块稀疏内核会失去效率；而在每个块上重复搜索细粒度模式时，针对累积 KV 缓存的计算成本会变得很高。近期提出的 QUOKA 方法直接针对分块预填充，避免了稀疏内核开销，但依赖查询子采样的 token 级 KV 选择，可能会漏掉特定于查询的 KV 条目，并引入显式的 KV 复制开销。为解决这些局限，我们提出 CompactAttention，这是一种基于块并集 KV 选择的分块预填充注意力机制。CompactAttention 将二维块稀疏掩码视为 KV 选择信号，而非直接执行稀疏内核的计划，并通过 Q 块并集和组内并集将其转换为感知 GQA 的逐组 KV 块表。在分页执行约束下，这种构造生成的块表会保留输入掩码选中的所有 KV 块，使选中的 KV 块能够原位访问，无需显式压缩 KV。在 LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct 上，CompactAttention 在 RULER 基准上的准确率接近密集注意力；在分块预填充且上下文长度为 128K 时，注意力速度最高可达到密集注意力的 2.79 倍。$\times$相较于 FlashPrefill，速度最高可达到 1.25 倍$\times$。

    Multi-LLM Systems Exhibit Robust Semantic Collapse

    Weiyi Kong, Shiyang Lai, Jinghua Piao, James Evans

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper empirically studies semantic convergence in interacting LLM systems over long closed-loop generation, with interventions and mechanistic analyses suggesting intrinsic constraints. This strongly informs multi-agent system behavior and offers partial insight into representation convergence, but it does not directly analyze composition or reasoning mechanisms.

    本文通过长时间闭环生成的实验研究了交互式 LLM 系统中的语义趋同，并通过干预和机制分析指出，这种现象可能源于内在限制。该研究深入揭示了多智能体系统的行为，并对表征趋同提供了部分洞见，但没有直接分析组合或推理机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Whether machines can originate novel content has been debated for nearly two centuries, from Lovelace's assertion that no engine can "originate anything" to Turing's question of whether a machine can amplify ideas brought in from outside. Interacting multi-LLM systems, increasingly deployed for autonomous generation, reopen this question empirically. Here we show that such systems exhibit semantic collapse, systematic convergence in semantic representations despite apparent lexical variation, with no retraining or weight updates. The pattern holds across model families and over 200 to 1,000 rounds. Thirteen intervention implementations tested, spanning decoding parameters, prompt design, agent composition, activation engineering, and reinforcement learning, did not reliably restore semantic diversity. Mechanistic analyses suggest that semantic collapse is not solely attributable to the alignment or conformity biases examined here, but is consistent with intrinsic properties of autoregressive generation. Our results point to persistent constraints on the ability of multi-LLM systems to sustain open-ended exploration in closed-loop settings.

    中文

    机器能否创作出新颖内容这一问题已争论近两个世纪，从 Lovelace 断言任何机器都不能“创作任何东西”，到 Turing 提出机器能否放大外部输入的想法。如今，多 LLM 系统日益用于自主生成，这些系统之间的交互让我们得以通过实证重新探讨这一问题。我们发现，这类系统会出现语义坍缩：尽管词汇表面上有所变化，语义表征却系统性地趋于一致，而且这一过程不需要重新训练或更新权重。该模式在不同模型系列中均成立，并持续 200 到 1,000 轮。我们测试了 13 种干预实现，涵盖解码参数、提示设计、智能体组合、激活工程和强化学习，但这些干预都未能可靠地恢复语义多样性。机制分析表明，语义坍缩并非完全由本文考察的对齐偏差或从众偏差导致，而是与自回归生成的内在属性相符。我们的结果揭示了多 LLM 系统在闭环环境中持续进行开放式探索的能力所面临的限制。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    SIGMA 利用有符号证据图和有限度的交叉质询，改进多智能体 LLM 对冲突响应的处理方式，并在基准测试中提升准确率和抗冲突能力。该方法直接推进了推理和多智能体组织；基于图的证据组合与组合泛化只有间接联系，摘要也没有研究模型内部机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) seek to improve reasoning by combining diverse perspectives from multiple agents. However, aggregation may overlook supportive, contradictory, and uncertain relations among their responses. As a result, useful dissent can be suppressed, allowing an incorrect majority to dominate the final decision. We introduce SIGMA, a novel Signed Graph-informed Multi-Agent reasoning framework that distinguishes support, contradiction, and uncertainty among responses from black-box LLM agents. SIGMA constructs a signed evidence graph, reassesses disputed relations, and forms reasoning communities while preserving distinct evidence. It then conducts bounded cross-examination between community representatives and adjudicates their evidence without treating community size as a proxy for correctness. Extensive experiments on six benchmark datasets, across multiple LLM backbones and diverse multi-agent configurations, demonstrate that SIGMA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving notable gains in both accuracy and conflict-resilient performance.
