    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    ClinSeekAgent develops an agent that iteratively seeks and synthesizes clinical records and imaging evidence, with a benchmark and training pipeline; its main contribution is agent organization and tool use, supporting Systems 4. Iterative hypothesis refinement gives a partial connection to reasoning, while combining modalities is incidental to compositional generalization and the abstract offers no interpretability insight.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language models (LLMs) and agentic systems have shown promise for clinical decision support, but existing works largely assume that evidence has already been curated and handed to the model. Real-world clinical workflows instead require agents to actively seek, iteratively plan, and synthesize multimodal evidence from heterogeneous sources. In this paper, we introduce ClinSeekAgent, an automated agentic framework for dynamic multimodal evidence seeking that shifts the paradigm from passive evidence consumption to active evidence acquisition. Given a clinical task and access to raw patient data, ClinSeekAgent queries longitudinal EHR records and invokes imaging analysis tools when relevant; refines its hypotheses as new information emerges; and integrates the collected evidence into grounded clinical decisions. We validate ClinSeekAgent in two roles: as an inference-time agent for frontier LLMs and as a training pipeline for open-source models. For inference-time validation, we construct ClinSeek-Bench, which covers 13 text-only EHR task categories and 6 multimodal EHR--chest X-ray task categories, and pairs each question with both a Curated Input of pre-selected evidence and the raw patient data for automated evidence seeking. Without any benchmark-specific curation, ClinSeekAgent significantly outperforms curated input for both Claude Opus 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol, improving overall F1 from 66.5 to 68.8 and from 60.0 to 62.5 on multimodal tasks. The ablations show that the performance gain come from multi-round evidence seeking rather than from access to more of the patient record. For training-time validation, we fine-tune Qwen3.5-35B-A3B on ClinSeekAgent trajectories generated by GPT-5.6 Sol. The resulting ClinSeek-35B-A3B reaches 35.6 average F1 on AgentEHR-Bench, outperforming all evaluated open-source models, including ones more than ten times larger, as well as Claude Opus 5.

    Mahavir Dabas, Jihyun Jeong, Ming Jin, Ruoxi Jia

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper identifies a memory-driven failure in agent tool use and reports that biased memories steer behavior like explicit instructions while diverting attention from task context, providing mechanistic insight into model behavior. Its main contribution also advances agent memory and tool-use evaluation; reasoning is incidental to parameter drift rather than the focus.

    本文发现了一种由记忆驱动的智能体工具使用失效，并报告偏差记忆会像显式指令一样引导行为，同时分散模型对任务上下文的注意力，从而提供了关于模型行为的机制洞见。其主要贡献也推进了智能体记忆和工具使用评估；推理仅与参数偏移间接相关，并非研究重点。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    LLM agents increasingly combine long-term memory for personalization with tool calling for taking actions. We study a failure of this combination: personality-driven preferences stored in memory (e.g., cost-consciousness, impatience, risk tolerance) silently shifting tool-call parameters in contexts where they do not apply. We call this memory-induced tool-drift and stress-test it with MEMDRIFT, an iteratively refined benchmark of 105 scenarios spanning five bias dimensions and seven professional domains. Measured as excess parameter degradation over a neutral-memory baseline, biased memories in MEMDRIFT induce drift in all eight models we evaluate, raising degradation rates to 0.38--0.83 versus 0.05--0.12 for neutral memories. The drift persists under three widely used memory frameworks. A vulnerability audit of 6,062 tools across 288 MCP servers demonstrates that real-world tools are also susceptible to this failure mode. Mechanistically, we find that biased memories act as implicit steering vectors along the same direction as explicit behavioral instructions and draw attention away from task-relevant context. Neither prompt-based defenses nor relevance filters offer a complete solution, motivating defenses at the intersection of memory management and tool calling.

    中文

    LLM 智能体越来越多地结合长期记忆进行个性化，并通过工具调用采取行动。我们研究了这种结合带来的一种失效：存储在记忆中的个性偏好（如注重成本、缺乏耐心、风险容忍度）会在不适用的情境中悄然改变工具调用参数。我们将其称为记忆诱发的工具调用偏移，并使用 MEMDRIFT 对其进行压力测试。MEMDRIFT 是一个经过迭代改进的基准，包含 105 个场景，涵盖五种偏差维度和七个专业领域。以相对于中性记忆基线的额外参数退化衡量，MEMDRIFT 中的偏差记忆会在我们评估的全部八个模型中诱发偏移，使退化率升至 0.38--0.83，而中性记忆下为 0.05--0.12。该偏移在三种广泛使用的记忆框架下仍然存在。对 288 个 MCP 服务器上的 6,062 个工具进行的脆弱性审计表明，现实世界的工具也容易受到这种失效模式影响。从机制上看，我们发现偏差记忆会充当隐式引导向量，其方向与显式行为指令相同，并会将注意力从任务相关上下文引开。基于提示的防御和相关性过滤器都无法彻底解决问题，因此有必要在记忆管理和工具调用的交叉领域设计防御措施。

    Post-training for reasoning models typically combines supervised fine-tuning with reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards, most commonly with GRPO. However, this algorithm suffers from sparse rewards, limited exploration, and mode collapse. Building upon recent works on self-distillation, we propose Feedback Distillation, a training method where the model is trained to match, at the token level, its own distribution conditioned on privileged feedback produced by a language model. Feedback Distillation offers token-level supervision and can inject external knowledge. Evaluating our method for Lean4 theorem-proving, we find that Feedback Distillation maintains greater diversity in generated trajectories than GRPO, yielding higher policy entropy and better pass@k scaling. The two methods are complementary: initializing GRPO from a Feedback Distillation checkpoint outperforms either method alone. All in all, our results suggest a promising avenue to improve post-training for complex reasoning.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Multi-agent debate (MAD) among large language models (LLMs) is often judged by answer changes and convergence, yet these outcomes alone cannot establish that peers improved the answer. We study this gap with matched self-reflection, stance-only, and full-reasoning conditions. With five GPT-4o agents on MMLU-Pro disagreement questions, 37% of agent-question pairs change even without peer information. Among pairs stable under this control, 29.3% adopt a peer answer after seeing peer stances. These adoptions include corrections, new errors, and changes between wrong answers. The outcomes vary with correct-answer availability. When a correct peer answer is available, correction exceeds harmful adoption after accounting for peer support in the primary setting. Full reasoning improves individual accuracy but provides no additional majority-vote gain over self-reflection while using 57% more tokens. Responses to constructed peer materials vary across GPT-4o, DeepSeek-V4-Flash, and Qwen3-Plus. An answer-agnostic intervention suppresses both harmful and beneficial peer adoption without a detectable accuracy gain. Together, the results show that convergence is an ambiguous signal of value and that debate must be judged by what peer information contributes to the final group answer.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper analyzes how domain-specific post-training edits shared computation routes, using a perturbation model to explain capability degradation and recovery through rollback or refresh. This offers substantial mechanistic and reasoning-training insight; cross-domain transfer is not evidence of compositional generalization, and the interventions do not centrally address systems organization.

    本文分析了特定领域的后训练如何编辑共享计算路径，并利用扰动模型解释能力退化，以及通过回滚或刷新实现的恢复。这为机制理解和推理训练提供了重要见解；跨领域迁移并不能证明组合泛化，而这些干预也没有将系统组织作为核心研究对象。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training improves large language models on individual domains but can degrade previously acquired capabilities. We study this interference in mathematical reasoning, code generation, question answering (QA), and creative writing (CW). Full-model domain gradients can be nearly orthogonal despite substantial selective degradation. Our structural analyses show sparse, weakly overlapping edits on computation routes that reasoning domains share, with directional alignment associated with transfer and conflict. A local perturbation model separates loss changes into a first-order term and a path-averaged curvature term, decomposes the latter along the actual rollback intervention, and provides a conditional explanation for recovery by short refresh. The experiments support this local sensitivity account. After Code $\rightarrow$ Math $\rightarrow$ QA $\rightarrow$ CW training, a short Re-Math refresh raises Math from 57.66 to 66.04 and achieves the highest average score among the evaluated baselines. A training-free rollback at a $9.8\%$ budget recovers $57.4\%$ of the QA-induced Math accuracy drop with a small QA change. Curvature probes at the Math checkpoint further show higher sensitivity along the selected direction than along matched random directions. Together, these results support sparse intervention and targeted refresh as effective ways to mitigate cross-domain degradation.

    强化学习（RL）后训练能提升大型语言模型在单个领域中的表现，但也可能损害先前获得的能力。我们研究了这种干扰在数学推理、代码生成、问答（QA）和创意写作（CW）中的表现。尽管发生了显著的选择性退化，全模型领域梯度仍可能近乎正交。我们的结构分析表明，在推理领域共享的计算路径上，编辑是稀疏且重叠较弱的；编辑方向的对齐与迁移和冲突相关。一个局部扰动模型将损失变化分解为一阶项和路径平均曲率项，再沿实际回滚干预分解后者，并有条件地解释了为何短暂刷新能够带来恢复。实验支持这一局部敏感性解释。在 Code $\rightarrow$、Math $\rightarrow$、QA $\rightarrow$、CW 训练之后，短暂的 Re-Math 刷新将 Math 得分从 57.66 提升至 66.04，并在所评估的基线中取得最高平均分。在 $9.8\%$ 预算下进行无需训练的回滚，可恢复 QA 导致的 Math 准确率下降幅度的 $57.4\%$，同时只对 QA 产生较小影响。在 Math 检查点上进行的曲率探测进一步表明，模型沿所选方向的敏感度高于沿匹配随机方向的敏感度。总之，这些结果支持将稀疏干预和定向刷新作为缓解跨领域退化的有效方法。

    Dongjun Lee, Juheon Choi, Dong Kyu Shin, Sinjae Kang, Kimin Lee

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    EDITH combines gaze, egocentric vision, and speech in a hierarchical robot policy that infers intent, breaks it into grounded subtasks, and executes them, reducing user effort. The policy is a substantial agent-systems contribution; its subtask structure and intent inference offer partial contributions to composition and reasoning, but the abstract does not focus on generalization or reasoning mechanisms.

    EDITH 将注视、第一人称视觉和语音结合到分层机器人策略中，以推断意图、将其拆分为有场景依据的子任务并执行，从而减少用户付出的精力。这一策略是重要的智能体系统贡献；其子任务结构和意图推断对组合与推理有一定贡献，但摘要并未聚焦于泛化或推理机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    For natural human-robot interaction, a robot must understand human intent expressed not only through language but also through nonverbal signals such as gestures and gaze. However, current robot policies rely on language instructions as the sole interface for conveying intent, leaving nonverbal signals unused and placing the full burden of communication. In this work, we present EDITH, a robot framework that captures the human's nonverbal signals through continuous streams of first-person view and gaze from smart glasses, and uses them alongside language instructions as inputs to the robot policy. Our hardware system streams the human's first-person view, gaze, and speech to the robot in real time, transcribing the speech into language instructions. To handle these rich but noisy signals, we design a hierarchical policy in which a high-level policy infers the human's intent and produces a sequence of subtasks, where each subtask is represented as a fine-grained instruction paired with a keyframe that grounds the intent in the scene (e.g., the frame where the human points at the target object). A low-level policy then executes these subtasks. In our experiments on human-robot interactive tasks, EDITH enables the robot to act on the human's nonverbal signals even when intent is expressed only briefly, and significantly reduces user effort to convey intent compared to using language instructions alone. Visit our project page for source code and real-robot demo videos.

    Optimal Post-Training Quantization Scales and Where to Find Them

    最优后训练量化尺度及其寻找方法

    Juan Amboage, Pablo Monteagudo-Lago, Ian Colbert, Giuseppe Franco, Nicholas Fraser

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    PiSO derives a piecewise optimization procedure for selecting quantization scales and reports improved model quality, especially at low bit-widths. This is a substantial algorithmic contribution to model compression and computation efficiency, but the abstract does not address internal representations, compositional generalization, or reasoning.

    PiSO 推导出一种用于选择量化尺度的分段优化流程，并报告了模型质量的提升，尤其是在低比特宽度下。这是对模型压缩和计算效率的重要算法贡献，但摘要没有涉及内部表征、组合泛化或推理。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Post-training quantization (PTQ) compresses large language models by mapping weights to low-bit representations. While much work has focused on how weights are rounded onto the quantization grid, the scaling factor that defines the grid is typically chosen with simple, data-free heuristics. We observe that, under round-to-nearest (RTN) quantization, the grid assignments are piecewise constant in the scale, making the output reconstruction error piecewise quadratic over finitely many intervals, each admitting a closed-form optimization. Building on this insight, we present PiSO (Piecewise Scale Optimization), an algorithm that leverages calibration data to efficiently select channel-wise scales to achieve globally optimal output reconstruction error to arbitrary accuracy. We extend PiSO to group-wise quantization via tractable objectives. We also propose strategies for integrating it with error-correction methods such as GPTQ and Qronos, which greedily adjust weight assignments to compensate for the rounding errors of previously quantized weights. Experiments on Llama and Qwen models across multiple sizes and bit-widths show consistent improvements in perplexity and zero-shot accuracy, both standalone and combined with error correction, with gains increasing as the bit-width narrows. For instance, on Llama-3, PiSO reduces the 2-bit perplexity of Qronos by up to 7x, and at 3 bits, PiSO without error correction outperforms GPTQ with absmax scales.

    中文

    后训练量化（PTQ）通过将权重映射为低比特表示来压缩大型语言模型。许多研究关注如何将权重舍入到量化网格上，而定义网格的缩放因子通常通过简单的、无需数据的启发式方法选取。我们观察到，在最接近舍入（RTN）量化下，网格分配随缩放因子呈分段常数，因此输出重构误差在有限多个区间上呈分段二次形式，每个区间都存在闭式最优解。基于这一发现，我们提出 PiSO（分段尺度优化），这是一种利用校准数据高效选择逐通道尺度的算法，可在任意精度下达到全局最优的输出重构误差。我们通过易于处理的目标函数将 PiSO 扩展到逐组量化。我们还提出了将 PiSO 与 GPTQ 和 Qronos 等误差校正方法相结合的策略；这类方法会贪心地调整权重分配，以补偿先前已量化权重的舍入误差。针对不同规模和比特宽度下的 Llama 和 Qwen 模型进行的实验表明，无论单独使用还是与误差校正结合使用，PiSO 都能稳定改善困惑度和零样本准确率，而且比特宽度越窄，提升越明显。例如，在 Llama-3 上，PiSO 可将 Qronos 的 2 比特困惑度最多降低 7 倍；在 3 比特下，不带误差校正的 PiSO 表现优于使用 absmax 尺度的 GPTQ。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper tests whether moral judgments compose across acts and finds that summed act ratings explain much of composite judgments but miss a systematic premium for extreme acts. This is a strong compositional evaluation contribution; moral judgment alone provides only an incidental connection to reasoning, with no mechanism or reasoning process studied.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Moral evaluations of language models typically infer a model's values from its choices between single acts, yet in everyday life a person is judged on their history of good and bad acts. Such evaluations cannot capture how a model combines one person's acts. We test whether a model's moral judgment is compositional, that is, whether its judgment of a person follows from its judgments of each act. We introduce Moral Composition Arena, which asks which of two people is morally better to give Elo ratings to 229 human-validated acts across five Moral Foundations Theory foundations (act Elo) and to 160 controlled composite profiles, each a person described by two acts (composite Elo). Across ten frontier models and 29,134 choices, summed act Elo explains 73% of the variance in composite Elo, but the composition rule is not additive. With nearly equal mean summed act Elo, one extreme virtue with a minor wrong outranks two minor virtues in every model (mean +35.0 Elo), an extremity premium that survives a nonlinear baseline and human relabeling of act intensities. Single-act evaluations thus predict most of how these models judge people described by two acts, but miss a systematic premium on extreme acts.

    语言模型的道德评估通常根据模型在单个行为之间的选择来推断其价值观，但在日常生活中，人们会根据一个人行善和作恶的经历来评价他。此类评估无法捕捉模型如何组合对同一个人的各项行为的判断。我们检验模型的道德判断是否具有组合性，即模型对一个人的判断是否由其对每项行为的判断所决定。我们推出 Moral Composition Arena：该基准要求模型判断两个人中谁在道德上更好，并据此为五个道德基础理论维度上的 229 项经人工验证的行为评分（行为 Elo），以及为 160 个受控组合档案评分；每份档案用两项行为描述一个人（组合 Elo）。在十个前沿模型的 29,134 次选择中，行为 Elo 总和能够解释组合 Elo 方差的 73%，但组合规则并非加法规则。若行为 Elo 总和的均值几乎相等，那么在每个模型中，一项极端美德加上一项轻微过错都优于两项轻微美德（平均高出 +35.0 Elo）；即便使用非线性基线，或由人重新标注行为强度，这种极端性溢价仍然存在。因此，单项行为评估能够预测模型对大多数由两项行为描述的人物的判断，但无法捕捉模型对极端行为的系统性溢价。

    The Signs Were Always There: Training-Free Detection and Control in Raw Transformer Dimensions

    迹象一直存在：在原始 Transformer 维度中免训练地检测与控制

    Varun Reddy Nalagatla, Madhavi Evana, Yiwen Zhang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    BoD uses residual-stream sign patterns to detect concepts and intervene on generation, offering a training-free method for interpreting and controlling model behavior. This substantially advances internal feature analysis, while harmful-prompt screening and generation control are applications rather than contributions to agent or system design.

    BoD 利用残差流的符号模式检测概念并干预生成，从而提供一种无需训练即可解释和控制模型行为的方法。这实质性推进了内部特征分析；有害提示筛查和生成控制属于应用，并非对智能体或系统设计的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Because of polysemanticity and superposition, it has been challenging to attribute token understanding and generation to specific neurons or dimensions. Yet the information in the hidden states is so rich that the signs of the residual stream can surface semantic content in early layers and control what the model generates. We call this sign-pattern-driven interpretation approach Bag of Dims (BoD). Using BoD, we read each dimension of the residual stream individually. Since dimensions carry almost no shared information, a concept is simply the set of dimensions that agree in sign. This lets us discover tens to hundreds of thousands of concepts per model without training or labels. A concept is detectable as early as the first few layers, at AUC above 0.9 across the model families we tested, well before the answer it resolves to becomes legible. BoD can therefore screen harmful prompts at prefill, without a trained guard model. The prediction capability of the signs is strong: setting all magnitudes to unity preserves 56-94% top-5 next-token accuracy through the language model head. Flipping a concept's sign pattern during the forward pass suppresses its logits, and a separate training-free intervention steers a chosen concept into generated text. The BoD method depends on the transformers' per-dimension sign pattern, present across the residual stream, attention, and MLP subspaces, rather than on any particular architecture, making it applicable to a wide range of models.

    中文

    由于多义性和叠加效应，要将 token 的理解和生成归因于特定神经元或维度一直很困难。然而，隐藏状态中的信息非常丰富，残差流的符号能够在早期层显现语义内容，并控制模型生成的内容。我们将这种由符号模式驱动的解释方法称为 Bag of Dims（BoD）。利用 BoD，我们逐一读取残差流的每个维度。由于各维度几乎不携带共享信息，一个概念就是一组符号一致的维度。借此，我们无需训练或标签，就能在每个模型中发现数万至数十万个概念。在我们测试的各模型系列中，最初几层就能以高于 0.9 的 AUC 检测出概念，远早于该概念所对应的答案变得清晰可辨。因此，BoD 可以在预填充阶段筛查有害提示，无需训练守护模型。符号的预测能力很强：将所有幅值设为单位值后，通过语言模型头仍能保留 56–94% 的 top-5 下一个 token 准确率。在前向传播过程中翻转某个概念的符号模式会抑制对应的 logits；此外，另一种无需训练的干预能够引导生成文本包含指定概念。BoD 方法依赖 Transformer 在残差流、注意力和 MLP 子空间中均存在的逐维符号模式，而非任何特定架构，因此适用于多种模型。

    Search Agents -- large language models augmented with search tools -- have intensified the need for future-proof evaluation benchmarks. Existing benchmarks such as BrowseComp rely on static knowledge, making them vulnerable to test-set contamination and parametric memorization. Consequently, models can achieve high scores through fact recall rather than genuine retrieval, obscuring true browsing competence via reasoning shortcuts. In this paper, we introduce EvoBrowseComp, an evolving benchmark of 400 English and 400 Chinese contamination-free complex questions synthesized via live-web traversal. To collect these questions, we design a three-agent collaborative framework: (1) a QA synthesis agent that retrieves fresh knowledge from the live web to synthesize QA pairs; (2) an information filtering agent that filters retrieved knowledge in terms of credibility and popularity to block parametric shortcuts; and (3) a high-level guidance agent that formalizes questions into reasoning graphs to reduce logical redundancy and shortcuts in synthesized QA pairs. Because the framework supports fully automated synthesis, EvoBrowseComp can be regularly updated to prevent data contamination and maintain temporal freshness. Extensive experiments confirm its great difficulty, requiring broad horizontal search. It establishes a scalable paradigm for auto-updatable, high-difficulty benchmarking that keeps pace with both evolving world knowledge and advancing agent capabilities.

    Zhengtao Gui, Sheng Yang, Zhouxing Shi

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces perturbation benchmarks and evaluates whether proof autoformalizers preserve correctness across paraphrases and faithfully reflect local changes.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Proof autoformalization aims to translate a mathematical informal proof in natural language into a formal proof in a formal language such as Lean 4. Existing LLM-based models for proof autoformalization are typically evaluated only on well-formed informal proofs from curated datasets. We argue that a robust proof autoformalizer must remain faithful even for informal proofs that diverge from these idealized ones, and we present the first study on the robustness of proof autoformalization models. We formulate two categories of perturbations: a global perturbation paraphrases the informal theorem-proof pair in a different style, under which the formalization should remain consistent; a local perturbation alters a value, symbol, or proof step, possibly in a counterfactual way, and a robust formalization should faithfully reflect the perturbation rather than reverting to the original or inferring a different one on its own. We build a benchmark with both perturbations on miniF2F and MATH-500, and automatically measure how stable a proof autoformalization's correctness is under global perturbations and how faithfully its output reflects local perturbations. We evaluate seven recent models: their correctness varies under global perturbations, and they mostly fail to remain faithful under local perturbations.

We record each surfaced neuron's normalized activation score, identity, and description and each cluster's title and size, classify them by an explicit description rule, and measure the prevalence and ranking of ethics-labeled neurons and clusters, the neurons' activation scores, and the model's verdicts and stated confidence. We observe situational anchoring: prompt-setting vocabulary appears in prominent cluster titles and selected high-ranked neuron descriptions. B4-vs-B5 First Rank and Priority Ratio contrasts detect no difference. With one retained response per prompt, the coded outcomes for the 31 trolley responses are 19 recommending intervention, one recommending non-intervention, and 11 giving no definite recommendation.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large multimodal language models (MLLMs) have emerged as powerful tools for guiding evolutionary search toward interpretable programmatic policies. In existing program-evolution systems, however, reusable knowledge is usually carried by whole programs in the population, and it is difficult to trace how a visual observation led to a particular code change and its measured outcome. We present REFLEX, a train-free evolutionary framework that links these steps in one loop. A vision-enabled Critic turns task-specific behavioral evidence into a structured diagnosis; the diagnosis retrieves executable code snippets from a persistent Skill Memory; a text-only Actor writes the child program; and the child--parent fitness change updates the utility of each retrieved snippet. Every step is recorded in a single trace. Under matched backends and 100-call budgets over 10 paired seeds, REFLEX reaches the solve threshold in a median of 13, 20, and 24 LLM calls on Acrobot, Pendulum, and Lunar Lander, roughly half the calls required by official MLES and by a compute-matched Actor-only ablation. Frozen Skill Memory banks from Pendulum or Lunar Lander raise the final Acrobot score on all 10 paired seeds. On a 36-dimensional antenna-array design task with equal evaluation budgets and shared initialization, REFLEX reaches the harder $25.25$ score threshold on 9/10 seeds, compared with at most 3/10 for CMA-ES, GA, and PSO. The source code is available at https://github.com/wangpan-ustc/REFLEX.

    ENGLISH

    Frontier large language model training consumes massive accelerator fleets over long wall-clock times, making stability failures extremely costly. However, global symptoms such as loss divergences often emerge only after the underlying fault has already affected the training dynamics, further increasing the sunk compute. In which internal representation can a training fault become persistently and interpretably observable before it appears in global training metrics? We propose a mechanism-aligned principle for training observability: identify the internal state into which a fault is persistently written, derive the structure induced by its mechanism, and construct monitors in representations aligned with the computation of the affected module. For FlashAttention, we show that biased backward errors accumulate into a persistent low-dimensional structure in weight updates, producing spectral concentration. For MoE routers, we characterize routing dynamics through per-token routing behavior rather than parameter similarity, which may change without altering the routing function.     Safety in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) depends on unsafe multimodal data for post-training alignment or activation steering. In this work, we relax this constraint and investigate whether textual refusal directions, extracted directly from the LLM backbone, generalize across modalities (i.e., image, video). Preliminary findings confirm this ability, though effectiveness is conditioned by layer selection, steering strength, and cross-modal alignment, with the latter causing safe multimodal inputs to be spuriously steered toward refusal. Evaluated on five SOTA MLLMs across safety, utility, and video jailbreak, MARS achieves consistent safety gains while preserving utility up to over-refusal.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    AI agents that autonomously execute tool calls on a user's behalf raise pressing questions about permission management: what role could users play, and what role should they play? Despite many proposed approaches, the user's role in agentic permission management remains underexplored. We introduce Janus, a playground system for implementing and evaluating user-involved agentic permission management designs. Janus consists of two components: Janus-Core, a modular agentic system supporting a diverse spectrum of permission management designs, and Janus-Harness, an automated evaluation framework. Grounded in a conceptual model that identifies key design axes for user involvement, we implement six permission assistants spanning the design space and evaluate them across three scenarios with four subscenarios each and three synthetic responders. We demonstrate that user involvement is critical and can strengthen privacy and security and that user behavior such as permission fatigue must be accounted for in system design. No single design performs optimally across all contexts, motivating a more principled and context-sensitive approach to deploying permission assistants in agentic systems. Janus is publicly available to support future investigation into this dimension of agentic system design.

    ENGLISH

    Persistent external memory enhances agent continuity but introduces persistent security vulnerabilities: adversarial content can be injected via standard interaction channels, retained across turns, and later distort downstream behavior. To address this challenge, we propose MemPoison, a comprehensive benchmark and analysis framework featuring 1227 hand-validated cases across four attack types, three injection channels, and three representative memory substrates, evaluated on seven open-weight and three closed-weight model families. We introduce a three-tier taxonomy: (L1) direct single-record corruption, (L2) compositional multi-record corruption and (L3) context-triggered dormant corruption. Our evaluations reveal a distinct defense frontier: while baseline write-time defenses, such as consistency checks, substantially suppress direct L1 attacks, they fail to reliably suppress L2 and L3 attacks. Through mechanistic influence decomposition (MID), we demonstrate structural blind spots in write-time defenses, which admit seemingly benign records that later become harmful through joint retrieval composition or trigger-conditioned activation. Our findings advocate for shifting from static filtering to adaptive, context-sensitive memory defense strategies.

    Intelligence that must act before outside correction arrives must carry the structure of its expert knowledge, and hyperbolic geometry represents hierarchy with a fidelity no Euclidean space of comparable dimension matches. Yet hyperbolic language models confine that geometry to adapters or rebuild the transformer, and an independent audit of released hyperbolic vision language checkpoints finds their hierarchy mechanisms inactive, which has been read as evidence about the geometry or its objective. Here we show that it is also evidence about arithmetic. The constraint defining the manifold is a difference of two terms that grow together; for the unclamped map at unit curvature and temperature it fails in every format we measured, double precision included, at the norms standard language models produce in their deepest layers, beyond the limit previously derived. A common remedy, a norm bound, leaves the executed map no radial sensitivity where it acts. In a prespecified test, a tighter bound cost a Lorentz system more of the held out structure it started with than a flat one. Structural supervision has run in six expert systems over 20,951,552 training exposures. In paired runs with a published recipe's objective held fixed, removing its starting scale remedy prevented every update and removing its single precision regions raised the radius reached early in training. Arithmetic bounds the computable region, and within it, alongside the objective, arithmetic and its remedies select which runs leave a record and the states they reach on the way, so a flat surviving checkpoint cannot by itself establish that the geometry is inert.

On 82,332 holdout samples from the UNSW-NB15 network intrusion detection dataset, 57.2% of errors occur under agreement and 90.6% of dangerous under-predictions evade disagreement-based monitoring even after conservative override; ablation shows that strengthening base learners increases error correlation while reducing disagreement. ARAT reduces under-prediction relative to soft voting from 4.80% to 1.70% via conservative override (-2.6pp) and a safety-flag gate (-0.5pp), demonstrating architectural gains. Cross-dataset validation on clinical readmission supports these indicators, suggesting that diversification improves safety only when it generates productive disagreement rather than convergence. These results indicate that disagreement-triggered escalation can be blind to correlated failure, a risk that may intensify as agentic pipelines deploy increasingly capable, correlated models.

However, deploying them in embedded and edge computing environments remains challenging because of strict latency, memory, and energy constraints. Their large parameter counts and computational demands hinder efficient execution on resource-constrained platforms. Although model pruning has emerged as a viable solution for reducing scale while preserving performance, jointly optimizing layers, attention heads, and Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) dimensions remains highly complex. Exhaustively exploring this combined design space is computationally expensive and often leads to local optima or unstable configurations. To address these limitations, we propose a hardware-aware, multi-objective structured pruning framework. The proposed two-stage method explicitly targets latency and model size for efficient deployment on edge devices. In the coarse-grained stage, multi-objective depth pruning removes entire attention and MLP blocks to reduce computational load and memory usage. In the subsequent fine-grained stage, Parallel Bayesian Optimization (PBO) searches for the optimal layer-wise pruning ratios for pruning under latency constraints, while importance-based strategies rank the specific components to be pruned within each layer's allocated budget. Experimental results show that our approach reduces model complexity with minimal impact on commonsense reasoning tasks and zero-shot performance. Our method achieves a favorable trade-off among accuracy, latency, and model size, making it suitable for edge deployment. Across multiple LLMs at 37.5% and 50% pruning ratios, the proposed approach achieves better performance on commonsense reasoning tasks than existing methods while significantly reducing inference cost.

    中文

    大型语言模型（LLM）凭借强大的推理和问答能力得到广泛应用。然而，由于延迟、内存和能耗方面的严格限制，在嵌入式和边缘计算环境中部署这些模型仍然具有挑战性。其庞大的参数量和计算需求妨碍了它们在资源受限平台上的高效运行。尽管模型剪枝已成为一种在保持性能的同时缩小模型规模的可行方案，但同时优化层、注意力头和多层感知机（MLP）维度仍然十分复杂。穷举探索这一组合设计空间的计算成本很高，而且往往会陷入局部最优或产生不稳定的配置。为解决这些局限，我们提出一种硬件感知的多目标结构化剪枝框架。该两阶段方法明确针对延迟和模型尺寸进行优化，以便在边缘设备上高效部署。在粗粒度阶段，多目标深度剪枝移除整个注意力块和 MLP 块，以减少计算负载和内存使用。随后在细粒度阶段，并行贝叶斯优化（PBO）在延迟约束下搜索各层的最佳剪枝比例，同时基于重要性的策略会在每层分配的预算内对待剪枝的具体组件进行排序。实验结果表明，我们的方法能够降低模型复杂度，同时对常识推理任务和零样本性能影响很小。该方法在准确率、延迟和模型尺寸之间实现了良好的权衡，适用于边缘部署。在多个 LLM 上，当剪枝比例为 37.5% 和 50% 时，与现有方法相比，该方法在常识推理任务上取得了更好的表现，同时显著降低了推理成本。

    Belief Coevolution in a Social Network of Generalist and Specialist Large Language Models: A Controlled Study

    通用型与专用型大型语言模型社交网络中的信念协同演化：一项受控研究

    Germans Savcisens and Samantha Dies and Courtney Maynard and Tina Eliassi-Rad

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper presents a controlled framework for studying belief diffusion among networked LLM agents and finds that specialist agents alter population consensus and influence patterns. Its central contribution concerns multi-agent interaction and social-network behavior, supporting a strong Systems score; belief revision is studied, but the abstract does not develop reasoning mechanisms or compositional generalization.

    本文提出了一个受控框架，用于研究网络化 LLM 智能体之间的信念扩散，并发现专用型智能体会改变群体共识和影响力模式。其核心贡献涉及多智能体交互和社交网络行为，支持较高的 Systems 评分；虽然研究了信念修正，但摘要并未提出推理机制或组合泛化方法。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in multi-agent environments. However, the processes by which beliefs form and propagate among interacting LLMs remain poorly understood. We introduce CoevolveSim, a framework for studying belief diffusion within networked LLM populations. CoevolveSim allows us to isolate and study three factors: domain specialization, social-role assignment, and social network structure. Within this framework, generalist and specialist LLM agents exchange and revise beliefs. In each round, an LLM agent observes a summary of its neighbors' beliefs before updating its own. We find that persona-style role assignment reshapes individual belief revision but has little effect on population-level consensus. In contrast, introducing finetuned specialist LLMs produces a large change in consensus and is accompanied by persistent asymmetries in outgoing influence. We further show that an opinion-dynamics surrogate combining individual persistence with population-level belief composition reproduces consensus with high fidelity in every scenario, whereas predicting individual final-round beliefs in heterogeneous LLM populations additionally benefits from agent identity.

    中文

    大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被部署在多智能体环境中。然而，交互中的 LLM 如何形成和传播信念，其过程仍鲜有研究。我们提出 CoevolveSim，这是一个用于研究网络化 LLM 群体中信念扩散的框架。CoevolveSim 使我们能够分离并研究三个因素：领域专门化、社会角色分配和社交网络结构。在该框架中，通用型和专用型 LLM 智能体交换并修正信念。每一轮中，LLM 智能体先观察邻居信念的摘要，再更新自己的信念。我们发现，角色设定式的角色分配会改变个体的信念修正，但对群体层面的共识影响很小。相比之下，引入经过微调的专用型 LLM 会大幅改变共识，并伴随着持续存在的外向影响力不对称。我们还表明，在意见动力学替代模型中结合个体坚持性与群体层面的信念构成，在所有情境下都能高保真地复现共识；而要预测异质 LLM 群体中个体在最后一轮的信念，进一步纳入智能体身份也有帮助。

    WIDE: Boosting Adaptive LLM Inference via Token-level Dynamic Width Pruning

    WIDE：通过令牌级动态宽度剪枝提升自适应 LLM 推理

    Haozhe Hu, Hao Wu, Peiran Yin, Chao Han, Yunpu Ma, Xiaoyu Shen

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    WIDE contributes token-level dynamic width pruning with router and GPU-kernel co-design, improving LLM efficiency while retaining quality. This is a substantial advance in adaptive computation; quality evaluation alone does not establish compositional or reasoning insight, and internal mechanisms are not analyzed.

    WIDE 提出了结合路由器与 GPU 内核协同设计的令牌级动态宽度剪枝，在保留质量的同时提升 LLM 效率。这是自适应计算领域的一项重要进展；仅凭质量评估无法证明其具备组合性或推理方面的洞见，且论文未分析内部机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Pruning is a promising approach for improving the efficiency of large language models (LLMs). Static structured pruning is hardware-friendly, but its input-agnostic computation allocation often degrades model quality at high sparsity. Dynamic pruning adapts computation to individual tokens, but coarse-grained layer-level routing limits allocation flexibility, and finer-grained decisions introduce irregular execution that can offset computational savings. To address these challenges, we present WIDE, the first end-to-end differentiable framework that combines token-wise structured dynamic width pruning with GPU kernel co-design for both prefill and decoding. WIDE uses differentiable routers to select GQA-aligned query-head groups and GPU-tile-aligned FFN-channel groups for each token. To execute these decisions efficiently, it reorders routing masks to cluster active tokens within each group, enabling hardware-agnostic block-level skipping and architecture-aware skipping of inactive loads and tensor-core operations. Experiments on the Llama3 and Qwen3 families demonstrate improved quality retention over representative static and dynamic pruning methods. At 50\% target routing sparsity, WIDE improves Llama3.1-8B average zero-shot accuracy by up to 20.26 points over the strongest dynamic-depth baseline under calibration-only settings, while retaining 97.6\%/88.2\% of dense Qwen3-14B likelihood/generation performance after LoRA tuning. Separate latency benchmarks demonstrate end-to-end speedups of up to $1.68\times$ for prefill and $1.55\times$ for decoding over the dense baseline. These results demonstrate that pruning--kernel co-design pushes the frontier of token-wise dynamic structured pruning, combining improved quality retention with practical acceleration across both prefill and decoding. Our code is avaliable at \url{https://github.com/EIT-NLP/LLM-Pruning/tree/main/WIDE}.

    中文

    剪枝是提升大型语言模型（LLM）效率的一种有前景的方法。静态结构化剪枝对硬件友好，但其与输入无关的计算分配方式在高稀疏度下往往会降低模型质量。动态剪枝会根据各个令牌调整计算量，但粗粒度的层级路由限制了分配灵活性，而更细粒度的决策会引入不规则执行，可能抵消计算节省。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 WIDE，这是首个端到端可微框架，将令牌级结构化动态宽度剪枝与 GPU 内核协同设计相结合，覆盖预填充和解码阶段。WIDE 使用可微路由器，为每个令牌选择与 GQA 对齐的查询头组，以及与 GPU 瓷块对齐的 FFN 通道组。为高效执行这些决策，该方法会重新排列路由掩码，使每组中的活跃令牌聚集，从而实现与硬件无关的块级跳过，以及面向架构的非活跃加载和张量核心操作跳过。在 Llama3 和 Qwen3 系列上的实验表明，与有代表性的静态和动态剪枝方法相比，WIDE 能更好地保留模型质量。在目标路由稀疏度为 50\% 时，在仅使用校准数据的设置下，与最强的动态深度基线相比，WIDE 将 Llama3.1-8B 的零样本平均准确率最高提升了 20.26 个百分点；经过 LoRA 调优后，Qwen3-14B 的似然/生成性能分别保留了稠密模型的 97.6\%/88.2\%。单独的延迟基准测试表明，与稠密基线相比，端到端速度提升最高可达 $1.68\times$（预填充）和 $1.55\times$（解码）。这些结果表明，剪枝与内核协同设计拓展了令牌级动态结构化剪枝的前沿，使质量保留能力得到提升，同时在预填充和解码阶段均实现了实用加速。我们的代码可在 \url{https://github.com/EIT-NLP/LLM-Pruning/tree/main/WIDE} 获取。

    ADIAS: Automated Design of Interactive Agentic Systems

    ADIAS：交互式智能体系统的自动化设计

    Lekang Jiang, Bohan Tang, Stephan Goetz, Yiwen Guo

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces issue-centric harness evolution with persistent issue tracking and targeted repair, improving interactive agent performance. Its agent-system design is a substantial contribution, while issue tracking alone does not establish compositional generalization or reasoning mechanisms.

    本文提出以问题为中心的运行框架演化方法，通过持久问题跟踪和定向修复提升交互式智能体的表现。其智能体系统设计作出了重要贡献，而问题跟踪本身并不能证明组合泛化或推理机制方面的进展。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Self-evolving agents can improve without updating model weights by iteratively optimizing the harness based on evaluation feedback. Existing methods are largely candidate-centric: they record evolution outcomes (which agent variants have been produced and how they perform), rather than evolution progress (which issues, i.e., recurring failure patterns, have been fixed and which remain). Such methods pose two difficulties for cumulative harness evolution. First, repair context is scattered across candidate records and must be reconstructed every round, which leads to inefficient, redundant, or misdirected revisions. Second, because candidates are evaluated as a whole, partial fixes across different agents are difficult to combine, while ineffective changes persist alongside beneficial ones. To address these problems, we formulate issue-centric agent optimization, which explicitly carries forward evolutionary progress through a persistent issue state. We instantiate this paradigm in ADIAS, a harness-evolution framework with two key components. An Issue Manager maintains the issue state with stable issue identities, lifecycle status, supporting evidence, and intervention-outcome histories. An Issue-Guided Optimizer proposes repair targets from the issue state and performs focused harness revision. On five interactive benchmarks, ADIAS outperforms the strongest baseline by 25.2% on average and achieves consistent gains across four backbone models. Controlled ablations show that removing the Issue Manager or the Issue-Guided Optimizer reduces performance by up to 40.7%.

    中文

    自我演化的智能体可以通过根据评估反馈迭代优化运行框架，在不更新模型权重的情况下实现改进。现有方法大多以候选方案为中心：它们记录演化结果（产生了哪些智能体变体以及这些变体的表现），而非演化进展（哪些问题，即反复出现的失败模式，已经修复，哪些仍然存在）。这类方法给运行框架的累积演化带来两个困难。第一，修复上下文散落在候选方案记录中，每一轮都必须重新整理，导致修改效率低下、重复或方向错误。第二，由于候选方案作为整体接受评估，不同智能体之间的局部修复难以组合，而无效改动会与有益改动一同保留下来。为解决这些问题，我们提出以问题为中心的智能体优化，通过持久的问题状态明确延续演化进展。我们在 ADIAS 中实现了这一范式，这是一个包含两个关键组件的运行框架演化框架。问题管理器通过稳定的问题标识、生命周期状态、支持证据以及干预结果历史来维护问题状态。问题引导优化器则根据问题状态提出修复目标，并有针对性地修改运行框架。在五个交互式基准测试上，ADIAS 的平均表现比最强基线高出 25.2%，且在四种骨干模型上均取得稳定提升。受控消融实验显示，移除问题管理器或问题引导优化器会使性能最多下降 40.7%。

    CausalNav: Reliability-Certified Causal World Models for Control under Physical-Parameter Shift

    CausalNav：面向物理参数偏移下控制任务的可靠性认证因果世界模型

    Yiyao Zhang, Diksha Goel, Hussain Ahmad

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    CausalNav’s central contribution is a reliability-gated controller that uses a learned causal world model for control under physical shifts and abstains when its advice is unreliable. The graph and intervention sequences offer some insight into causal structure, but the abstract finds graph fidelity does not predict control benefit; the strongest contribution is the model-based control system and its safety gates.

    CausalNav 的核心贡献是一种带可靠性门控的控制器，它在物理参数偏移下利用学习到的因果世界模型进行控制，并在建议不可靠时选择弃权。其图结构和干预序列对因果结构提供了一些见解，但摘要发现图保真度无法预测控制收益；最主要的贡献是基于模型的控制系统及其安全门控机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    A world model is only useful for physical AI if it changes what the agent does, and only safe if it declines to do so when it is wrong. We study both halves of that requirement with CausalNav, a controller built around a signed, action-conditioned transition graph over identified state coordinates. At deployment CausalNav simulates a small library of intervention sequences, converts their objective error into policy-logit advice, and admits that advice only when a scale-free predictive-reliability certificate, a policy-margin gate, and an argmax-agreement gate all pass; otherwise it falls back exactly to its own model-based base controller. We evaluate against nine controlled baselines (transformer, recurrent, split-latent, graph, causal-induction, and three recent model-based reasoning modules) on CartPole-v1 and discretized Pendulum-v1 with physical-parameter shifts, under one shared PPO trainer, one interaction budget, and ten held-out seeds (200 runs). CausalNav attains the best average rank (1.25 of ten). The diagnostic result is more informative than the ranking: the learned graph recovers structure well above chance (CartPole F1 = 0.59 +/- 0.09), yet per-seed structural fidelity is uncorrelated with per-seed control benefit (r = -0.15, p = 0.67), and the certificate abstains on 10/10 Pendulum seeds, where forcing the planner on costs return. Model fidelity did not predict downstream control utility in our setting; certified abstention, not better prediction, is what made the world model safe to deploy.

    中文

    只有当世界模型能改变智能体的行动时，它才对物理 AI 有用；只有当模型出错时它会选择不采取行动，它才是安全的。我们通过 CausalNav 研究这一要求的两个方面。CausalNav 是一种控制器，其核心是在已识别的状态坐标上构建带符号、以动作为条件的转移图。在部署时，CausalNav 会模拟一个小型干预序列库，将这些序列的目标误差转换为策略 logit 建议；只有在无尺度预测可靠性证书、策略间隔门控和 argmax 一致性门控全部通过时，才会采纳这些建议，否则会精确回退到自身基于模型的基础控制器。我们在 CartPole-v1 和离散化的 Pendulum-v1 上评估该方法，设置物理参数偏移，并与九种受控基线进行比较（Transformer、循环模型、分裂潜变量模型、图模型、因果归纳模型，以及三个近期基于模型的推理模块）；所有方法使用同一 PPO 训练器、相同交互预算和十个留出随机种子（共 200 次运行）。CausalNav 获得了最佳平均排名（十种方法中排名 1.25）。比排名更有信息量的是诊断结果：学习到的图对结构的恢复明显高于随机水平（CartPole F1 = 0.59 +/- 0.09），但各随机种子上的结构保真度与控制收益不相关（r = -0.15, p = 0.67）；在 Pendulum 的全部 10 个随机种子上，认证机制都选择了弃权，而强制启用规划器会降低回报。在我们的设置中，模型保真度无法预测下游控制效用；使世界模型能够安全部署的是经过认证的弃权，而非更准确的预测。

    When the Judge Should Not Decide: Evidence-Locked, Non-Compensatory Selection Bounds LLM-Judge Failure in Reasoning Pipelines

    何时不应让裁判作出决定：证据锁定的非补偿式选择限制 LLM 裁判在推理流水线中的失效

    Yiyao Zhang, Diksha Goel, Hussain Ahmad

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper shows that an evidence-locked, non-compensatory decision rule can improve answer selection over an LLM judge or majority vote in reasoning pipelines. This is a substantial algorithmic contribution to reasoning evaluation and selection, while using reasoning benchmarks does not itself establish compositional generalization, and the pipeline design is a more limited systems contribution.

    本文表明，在推理流水线中，证据锁定的非补偿式决策规则可以比 LLM 裁判或多数投票更有效地选择答案。这是对推理评估和答案选择的重要算法贡献；使用推理基准本身并不能证明组合泛化，且流水线设计对系统的贡献相对有限。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    An LLM judge deployed inside a reasoning pipeline does not merely measure quality, it decides which answer ships. We show that the cost of that decision depends less on judge accuracy than on the decision rule the judge is embedded in. On frozen candidate pools from four GRPO policies, an unconstrained scalar DeepSeek-R1-7B judge buys almost nothing over answer-level majority vote (+1.0 pp on 500 GSM8K questions, +0.34 EM on 300 HotpotQA questions), and on a frozen-rule 30-question confirmation split it is 10 points worse than majority, a judge that destroys accuracy while scoring candidates confidently. We then subordinate the same judge to Evidence-Locked Derive-Gate-Repair (EL-DGR), a task-adaptive non-compensatory rule under which a judge preference may override evidence-supported consensus only with an extractive evidence certificate, and a repair only when neither alternative is certified and the repair is. With no change to the judge, the candidates, or the budget, EL-DGR reaches 58.2% on GSM8K (vs. 56.8% judge, 55.8% majority, 55.4% first candidate) and 17.33 EM / 25.46 F1 on HotpotQA (vs. 15.67/23.49, 15.33/23.19, 15.33/22.97), improving on first-candidate GRPO by +2.8 pp (exact McNemar p=0.0026) and +2.00 EM (p=0.070, borderline). A decision audit shows why: EL-DGR overturns consensus on only 8 of 30 pilot questions and never converts a correct consensus into an incorrect answer. We also report what did not work: the same seven-channel decomposition used as a step-level gated training reward is null, and corrected channel-drop ablations show no channel is individually necessary (p=1.0 throughout). The practitioner-facing finding is negative about judges and positive about admissibility, bound the judge's blast radius rather than trying to make it accurate.

    中文

    部署在推理流水线中的 LLM 裁判不只是衡量质量，它还决定最终采用哪个答案。我们表明，这一决策的代价与裁判所采用的决策规则关系更大，而非裁判的准确率。在来自四个 GRPO 策略的冻结候选池上，不受约束的标量 DeepSeek-R1-7B 裁判相较于答案级多数投票几乎没有收益（500 道 GSM8K 题目上提高 +1.0 个百分点，300 道 HotpotQA 题目上提高 +0.34 EM）；而在采用冻结规则的 30 题确认集上，它比多数投票低 10 个百分点。也就是说，裁判一边自信地为候选答案打分，一边损害准确率。随后，我们将同一个裁判置于证据锁定的推导-门控-修复（EL-DGR）规则之下。该规则会根据任务自适应调整，且属于非补偿式规则：只有在提供抽取式证据证书时，裁判偏好才能推翻有证据支持的共识；只有当两个备选答案都未获认证而修复答案获得认证时，才会执行修复。在裁判、候选答案和预算均不变的情况下，EL-DGR 在 GSM8K 上达到 58.2%（相比之下，裁判为 56.8%，多数投票为 55.8%，首个候选答案为 55.4%）；在 HotpotQA 上达到 17.33 EM / 25.46 F1（相比之下分别为 15.67/23.49、15.33/23.19、15.33/22.97）。相较于首个候选答案对应的 GRPO，GSM8K 提高了 +2.8 个百分点（精确 McNemar p=0.0026），HotpotQA 提高了 +2.00 EM（p=0.070，处于临界水平）。决策审计揭示了原因：EL-DGR 在 30 道试点题目中仅推翻共识 8 次，且从未把正确共识变成错误答案。我们还报告了未奏效的方法：将同一七通道分解用于步骤级门控训练奖励时，结果为零；修正后的通道消融实验则表明，没有任何单一通道是必不可少的（始终 p=1.0）。面向实践者的结论是：对裁判持否定态度，对答案准入规则持肯定态度；应限制裁判可能造成的损害，而非试图提升其准确性。

    Harmful chat dialogues are ever-shifting through type-shifting and lexical evasion, yet we find they share invariant principles, i.e., an Ordered Reasoning Chain (ORC) of recurring topics, harm language indicators, severity hierarchies, and type characteristics, which can help us capture the key information in the frequently changing lexical expressions.     VERDI:Verified Contradictions for Continual World-Model Optimization

    VERDI：通过经验证的矛盾实现世界模型的持续优化

    Junyu Wu, Shiqin Nie, Youyi Kou, Baohua Yin, Qingyu Chen, Jingheng Ma, Shiji Zhou, Hongyong Song, Mingchen Zhuge, Guocai Yao, Tielin Shi, Sen Cui, Changshui Zhang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    VERDI uses model fingerprints, retrieval, and target-side verification to make optimization experience transferable across world models, reducing search and negative transfer. Its diagnostic representations and transfer hypotheses have incidental links to representation and composition, while the main contribution is a model-optimization system rather than a study of reasoning.

    VERDI 使用模型指纹、检索和目标侧验证，使优化经验能够在世界模型之间迁移，从而减少搜索成本和负迁移。其诊断表征和迁移假设与表征和组合存在间接关联，但主要贡献是模型优化系统，而非推理研究。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Foundation world models have made remarkable progress in planning, simulation, and embodied intelligence. However, optimizing a pretrained world model toward a user-specified objective remains difficult: each campaign typically rediscovers optimization strategies from scratch, and the resulting knowledge rarely transfers to the next model. Existing research agents automate the optimization loop but treat successful strategies as directly reusable recipes, without principled safeguards for when transfer is appropriate. We argue instead that retrieval is not transfer: a strategy validated on one model is at best an optimization hypothesis for another, and becomes transferable knowledge only after target-side experimental valida- tion. Guided by this principle, we propose VERDI , a continual framework for evidence-licensed world model optimization. VERDI characterizes each world model through shared inference-time probes to construct an Optimization Fin- gerprint, retrieves relevant prior experience as ranked hypotheses, and validates every candidate under a frozen target-side verifier before admitting it as reusable evidence; contradictions among nearby fingerprints further trigger probe evolution, continually refining the diagnostic representation itself. Experiments on Ctrl-World, the Cosmos family, and RoboCoin show that VERDI reduces search cost by 68%, GPU cost by 69%, and negative transfer from 0.34 to 0.06, while predicting transfer outcomes with 83% sign accuracy.

    中文

    基础世界模型在规划、仿真和具身智能方面取得了显著进展。然而，针对用户指定的目标优化预训练世界模型仍然很困难：每轮优化通常都要从头重新发现优化策略，而且由此获得的知识很少能迁移到下一个模型。现有研究智能体能够自动执行优化循环，但会将成功策略视为可直接复用的方案，缺乏判断何时适合迁移的原则性保障。我们提出，检索不等于迁移：在一个模型上验证过的策略，对于另一个模型至多是一种优化假设；只有经过目标模型侧的实验验证后，它才会成为可迁移知识。受这一原则指导，我们提出 VERDI，这是一个以证据许可为基础的世界模型持续优化框架。VERDI 通过共享的推理时探针对每个世界模型进行表征，构建优化指纹；检索相关的既有经验并将其作为排序后的假设；在冻结的目标侧验证器下验证每个候选策略，之后才将其纳入可复用证据；相近指纹之间的矛盾还会进一步触发探针演化，持续改进诊断表征本身。在 Ctrl-World、Cosmos 系列和 RoboCoin 上的实验表明，VERDI 将搜索成本降低了 68%，GPU 成本降低了 69%，并将负迁移从 0.34 降至 0.06；同时，它以 83% 的符号准确率预测迁移结果。

    Xu Zhang, Chang Xu, Hui Sun, Nan Ma, Zijian Zhang, Peng Wang, Wei Wang, Li Zhao

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    REATS uses chain-of-thought reasoning and SFT/GRPO to produce adaptive ensemble weights, with a reward design tailored to regression; this substantially advances reasoning-oriented training and inference. Its routing is a model-system component, but the abstract does not describe broader system organization, and combining forecasts is only an incidental connection to compositional generalization; it offers no insight into internal representations.

    REATS 使用思维链推理以及 SFT/GRPO 生成自适应集成权重，并采用针对回归任务设计的奖励机制；这实质性地推进了面向推理的训练与推理。其路由属于模型系统组件，但摘要没有描述更广泛的系统组织；组合预测仅与组合泛化存在间接联系，也未提供关于内部表征的见解。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Due to the diversity of real-world time series, no single forecasting model consistently dominates across all samples. Ensemble learning addresses this by combining complementary model strengths, yet existing methods rely on fixed rules or black-box models based solely on numerical inputs, failing to leverage LLM reasoning for interpretable weighting decisions. We propose REATS, which leverages LLM reasoning capabilities as an intelligent ensemble router that jointly processes textual temporal pattern descriptions and numerical features to produce interpretable, sample-adaptive ensemble weights through chain-of-thought reasoning. To enable effective LLM-based ensembling, we study its key design choices and propose: (i) a structured input pipeline that transforms raw time series into hybrid textual--numerical representations with fixed token cost, enabling rule-based chain-of-thought construction without API dependency, augmented with retrieved similar-sample priors; (ii) a diverse multi-row weight supervision scheme coupled with a token-efficient percentage-table format that reduces numerical complexity and mitigates LLM hallucinations; and (iii) a two-stage fine-tuning framework combining SFT with GRPO, where a reciprocal reward mapping transforms the continuous unbounded MSE gap into bounded signals with amplified near-oracle sensitivity, addressing the uniform sensitivity and outlier-dominated advantage compression inherent in naive reward designs for regression-based GRPO. Experiments on eight benchmarks demonstrate that REATS outperforms competitive ensemble baselines while providing natural language explanations and demonstrating strong transfer learning and out-of-domain generalization to unseen candidate models.

    中文

    由于真实世界时间序列具有多样性，没有任何单一预测模型能在所有样本上始终占优。集成学习通过结合互补的模型优势来应对这一问题，但现有方法依赖固定规则或仅基于数值输入的黑盒模型，未能利用 LLM 推理来做出可解释的加权决策。我们提出 REATS，利用 LLM 的推理能力充当智能集成路由器，联合处理文本形式的时间模式描述和数值特征，通过思维链推理生成可解释且适应样本的集成权重。为实现有效的基于 LLM 的集成，我们研究了关键设计选择并提出：(i) 一种结构化输入流程，将原始时间序列转换为混合文本与数值的表征，并固定 token 成本；该流程无需依赖 API，即可支持基于规则构建思维链，并辅以检索到的相似样本先验；(ii) 一种多样化的多行权重监督方案，结合 token 高效的百分比表格格式，以降低数值复杂性并减少 LLM 幻觉；(iii) 一个结合 SFT 与 GRPO 的两阶段微调框架，其中倒数奖励映射将连续且无界的 MSE 差距转换为有界信号，并放大对接近 oracle 的表现的敏感度，从而解决朴素奖励设计用于基于回归的 GRPO 时固有的灵敏度均一和优势值受离群点主导而被压缩的问题。在八个基准上的实验表明，REATS 优于有竞争力的集成基线，同时提供自然语言解释，并且对未见过的候选模型展现出强迁移学习能力和域外泛化能力。

    ESTP combines entropy and attention-based semantic representations to improve output-length prediction and scheduling efficiency.     ESTP 将熵表征与基于注意力的语义表征结合，以改进输出长度预测和调度效率。这项工作对服务和调度有实质性贡献，但语义表征只是其方法中的一环，并非对模型内部机制、组合或推理的研究。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Efficient LLM serving is often bottlenecked by the need to pad sequences to a fixed maximum length, and this wastes compute and degrades throughput. Output length prediction enables length-aware scheduling and reduces overhead. Existing methods, including entropy-guided token pooling, rely on token-level entropy but overlook semantic differences between tokens, causing them to underweight important tokens and overemphasize less informative tokens. We introduce ESTP(Entropy-and-Semantic Token Pooling), a lightweight framework that combines entropy representations with attention-based semantic representations. By deriving both representations directly during prefill, ESTP captures uncertainty and semantic importance while incurring negligible additional inference latency and memory overhead compared with methods using external auxiliary models. On the ForeLen benchmark, ESTP outperforms baseline methods, achieves better prediction accuracy and lower prediction errors across most scenarios. When integrated with a length-aware scheduler in end-to-end system tests, it further improves overall throughput and reduces the padding ratio.

    高效的 LLM 服务常受限于需要将序列填充至固定最大长度，这会浪费算力并降低吞吐量。输出长度预测能够实现长度感知调度并减少开销。包括熵引导 token 池化在内的现有方法依赖 token 级熵，却忽略 token 之间的语义差异，导致重要 token 权重不足，而信息量较低的 token 权重过高。我们提出 ESTP（熵与语义 token 池化），这是一种轻量级框架，将熵表征与基于注意力的语义表征结合起来。ESTP 在预填充阶段直接生成这两种表征，从而捕捉不确定性和语义重要性；与使用外部辅助模型的方法相比，它带来的额外推理延迟和内存开销可以忽略不计。在 ForeLen 基准上，ESTP 优于基线方法，在大多数场景中取得更高的预测准确率和更低的预测误差。在端到端系统测试中，将其集成到长度感知调度器后，ESTP 进一步提升了整体吞吐量并降低了填充比例。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The study isolates how candidate solutions affect a language model’s single-pass aggregation on math problems, finding that candidate usefulness depends on whether correct answers are present and comparing aggregation with fresh solving and voting. This provides focused empirical insight into problem-solving behavior, but not its internal mechanisms or compositional generalization; the extra generation is only an incidental systems connection.

    这项研究分离考察候选解如何影响语言模型对数学题进行单次聚合，发现候选解是否有用取决于其中是否包含正确答案，并将聚合与重新求解和投票进行比较。它对问题求解行为提供了针对性的实证见解，但没有研究其内部机制或组合泛化；额外生成与系统的联系只是间接的。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    An aggregation pass gives a language model two things: candidate solutions and another chance to answer. We ask whether the candidates improve that attempt, and whether aggregation improves on selecting an existing answer. Our candidate-free control asks the same model to solve the problem again from the problem alone, using the same decoding settings and maximum output-token allowance. On AIME-2025 and HMMT-2025, Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 reaches 15.5% accuracy when all four candidates are wrong, compared with 27.7% for a fresh solve. When at least two candidates are correct, the ordering reverses: 88.7% for aggregation versus 59.7% for a fresh solve. With exactly one correct candidate, the benefit remains unresolved under the specified test. Yet plurality voting reaches 96.0% in the multiple-correct regime without another model generation; its accuracy difference from aggregation is inconclusive (raw $p = 0.180$). The all-wrong accuracy loss and multiple-correct gain survive a statistical correction for adding the second benchmark, developed after data collection, and persist when fresh responses are scored by their final answers. These findings concern one 4B model, two mathematics benchmarks, and a single aggregation pass over candidates truncated at their first answer. All-wrong recovery can arise from solving the problem afresh. The fresh-solve control tests whether candidates improve accuracy. Comparing with selection asks whether the additional generation improves on an existing answer.

    中文

    一次聚合过程为语言模型提供两样东西：候选解和再次作答的机会。我们考察候选解是否能改善这次作答，以及聚合是否优于从已有答案中进行选择。我们的无候选对照方法让同一个模型仅根据题目重新解题，并使用相同的解码设置和最大输出 token 限额。在 AIME-2025 和 HMMT-2025 上，当四个候选答案全都错误时，Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 的准确率为 15.5%，而重新求解的准确率为 27.7%。当至少两个候选答案正确时，结果则相反：聚合准确率为 88.7%，重新求解为 59.7%。当恰好有一个候选答案正确时，在指定测试条件下，聚合的收益仍无法确定。然而，在多个答案正确的情形下，多数投票无需再次生成模型输出便达到 96.0%；其准确率与聚合之间的差异尚无定论（原始 $p = 0.180$）。加入第二个基准所需的统计校正方案是在数据收集后制定的；经过这一校正后，全错情形下的准确率损失和多正确答案情形下的准确率提升仍然成立；对重新生成的回答按最终答案评分时，这些结果也依然存在。这些发现仅涉及一个 4B 模型、两个数学基准，以及针对截断至首个答案的候选解进行的一次聚合。全错情形下的恢复可能来自重新求解题目。重新求解对照检验候选解是否提升准确率。与选择进行比较，则是检验额外生成是否优于已有答案。

    Break It Down, Pass It On: Cross-Task Skill Transfer in LLM Agents

    拆解后传递：LLM 智能体的跨任务技能迁移

    Yiyang Feng, Biddut Sarker Bijoy, Niranjan Balasubramanian, Jiawei Zhou

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The study compares how task-level versus subtask-level skills and text versus code formats affect cross-task transfer, and proposes a skill utility diagnostic. Reuse across tasks has a compositional connection, but the main contribution is skill memory and agent transfer, with no direct analysis of model reasoning or internal representations.

    这项研究比较了任务级与子任务级技能、文本与代码格式对跨任务迁移的影响，并提出技能效用诊断指标。跨任务复用与组合有关联，但主要贡献是技能记忆和智能体迁移，没有直接分析模型推理或内部表征。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language model (LLM) agents can induce skills from completed tasks and reuse them later to grow more capable with experience. In practice, induced skills may transfer unreliably and can even harm the agent that retrieves them. When agent-induced skills transfer reliably across tasks remains an open question. We conduct a comprehensive and controlled study of how the way skills are induced shapes their transfer across tasks. Specifically, we compare task-level with subtask-level skill induction and text with code skill formats, the two axes along which existing methods differ. Task-level skills mostly reduce the agent's performance below its no-memory baseline while subtask-level skills raise it above on average, and text skills transfer better than code skills. To further understand our findings, we examine two complementary properties of the induced skills: specificity, which measures how closely a skill matches real tasks, and abstractness, which measures how evenly its relevance spreads across tasks. Neither property alone predicts task success, but their combined effect does, which we propose as a skill utility score. The score correlates consistently with task success when skills are transferred, and subtask-level and text skills score higher. Computing skill utility only needs the skills and task descriptions, so our score serves as a lightweight diagnostic of a skill memory for practitioners.

    中文

    大型语言模型（LLM）智能体能够从已完成的任务中归纳技能，并在之后复用这些技能，随着经验积累变得更有能力。实际中，归纳出的技能可能无法可靠迁移，甚至会损害调用它们的智能体。智能体归纳的技能何时能在任务间可靠迁移，仍是一个悬而未决的问题。我们对技能归纳方式如何影响跨任务迁移进行了全面且受控的研究。具体而言，我们比较了任务级与子任务级技能归纳，以及文本与代码两种技能格式；这是现有方法之间的两个差异维度。任务级技能大多会使智能体表现低于无记忆基线，而子任务级技能平均能使表现高于基线；文本技能的迁移效果优于代码技能。为进一步理解这些发现，我们考察了归纳技能的两个互补属性：具体性，衡量技能与真实任务的匹配程度；抽象性，衡量技能相关性在不同任务间分布得有多均匀。单独来看，这两个属性都无法预测任务成功与否，但二者的综合作用可以；我们据此提出技能效用分数。在技能迁移时，该分数与任务成功率始终相关，且子任务级技能和文本技能的得分更高。计算技能效用只需要技能和任务描述，因此该分数可作为从业者诊断技能记忆的轻量级工具。

    Jiheon Kim, Kyudan Jung, Jaegul Choo

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper contributes a benchmark and a multi-agent execution framework that constrains slide edits, validates preservation, and rolls back failures. Its agent organization and execution control provide transferable systems insight; structured edits and task success are application-specific, with no substantial composition or reasoning-mechanism contribution.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Reliable slide editing requires precise modifications to intended objects while preserving the rest of the presentation. We argue that slide editing is a problem of structured, constrained modification rather than open-ended code generation. Despite the complexity of real presentations, editing requests can largely be decomposed into the objects to change, the operations to apply, and the state to preserve. This perspective guides both evaluation and execution. For evaluation, we introduce DeckEdit-Bench, 183 editing tasks on 28 human-authored decks whose target and preserved objects are annotated at the shape level, so that intended and unintended changes are scored mostly by deterministic rules. For execution, we present EditPPT, a multi-agent framework that resolves targets before editing, restricts each specialist to a subset of 37 predefined tools, and validates each edit for instruction fulfillment and preservation, correcting or rolling back failed ones. Across five backbone models, EditPPT reaches 66.7-74.9% Task Success while keeping Preservation above 97%. Even with an open 27B model and no task-specific fine-tuning, it approaches Claude Code with Sonnet 5 in Task Success while better preserving the original deck. These results suggest that constraining how edits are executed, not only model scale, makes slide editing more reliable.

    可靠的幻灯片编辑要求精确修改指定对象，同时保留演示文稿的其余部分。我们认为，幻灯片编辑是一种结构化、受约束的修改问题，而非开放式代码生成。尽管真实演示文稿十分复杂，编辑请求大体上仍可分解为要修改的对象、要执行的操作以及要保留的状态。这一视角同时指导了评估和执行。在评估方面，我们推出 DeckEdit-Bench，其中包含针对 28 份人工制作的演示文稿设计的 183 项编辑任务；基准在形状级别标注目标对象和需保留对象，因此主要通过确定性规则对预期和非预期的更改进行评分。在执行方面，我们提出 EditPPT，这是一个多智能体框架：它在编辑前解析目标，将每个专用智能体限制为 37 种预定义工具中的一部分，并检查每次编辑是否满足指令且保留了需保留内容；对于失败的编辑，则予以纠正或回滚。在五种骨干模型上，EditPPT 的任务成功率达到 66.7-74.9%，同时保持率超过 97%。即使使用开放权重的 27B 模型且未针对特定任务进行微调，它的任务成功率也接近采用 Sonnet 5 的 Claude Code，同时更好地保留了原始演示文稿。这些结果表明，约束编辑的执行方式与提升模型规模一样，都能提高幻灯片编辑的可靠性。

    MathAdv contributes a broad diagnostic benchmark that separates mathematical knowledge, informal reasoning, formalization, and robustness to equivalent reformulations in theorem proving.     MathAdv 提出一个广泛的诊断性基准，将定理证明中的数学知识、非形式化推理、形式化能力以及对等价改写的稳健性区分开来。它实质性地推进了推理评估；对改写稳健性的考察与组合能力有限相关，但系统组合并非主要研究内容。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Formal theorem proving enables machine-verifiable evaluation of mathematical reasoning, yet existing benchmarks often emphasize aggregate proof accuracy, concentrate on a narrow range of mathematics, and provide limited evidence of robustness to equivalent reformulations. We introduce MathAdv, a diagnostic benchmark spanning 13 domains across undergraduate- and graduate-level mathematics. Alongside Lean 4 theorem proving, MathAdv provides up to three auxiliary tasks: multiple-choice questions that probe mathematical knowledge, fill-in-the-blank problems that isolate informal reasoning, and expert-crafted transformations that test robustness to problem presentation. Our evaluation of contemporary theorem provers yields four findings: formalization remains a major bottleneck; performance varies substantially across mathematical domains; natural-language guidance helps general-purpose LLMs but can hinder proof-specialized models; and mathematically equivalent reformulations expose substantial robustness limitations. Together, these results show how component-wise evaluation can reveal model capabilities and failure modes that aggregate theorem-proving accuracy obscures. The dataset and evaluation scripts are available at https://github.com/margotyjx/MathAdv.git.

    ICON 分解：多变量概念审计揭示神经网络依赖的捷径

    Roshan Prakash Rane, Marco Simnacher, Manuel Pfeuffer, Marc-Andre Schulz, Nys Tjade Siegel, Maximilian Dreyer, Frederik Pahde, Wojciech Samek, Sonja Greven, Kerstin Ritter

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    ICON decomposes representation variance to estimate each concept’s contribution conditional on other concepts and outcomes, distinguishing concepts that drive predictions from those merely encoded. This provides a substantial method for auditing internal representations, while the clinical applications serve as validation rather than contributions to composition, reasoning, or systems.

    ICON 对表征方差进行分解，以估计每个概念在控制其他概念和结果后的贡献，从而区分驱动预测的概念与仅被编码的概念。这为审计内部表征提供了一种重要方法；临床应用用于验证，并非对组合、推理或系统的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Deep neural networks often exploit spurious associations, a failure known as shortcut learning. Before deployment, models should therefore be audited for reliance on concepts such as acquisition artifacts and patient demographics. Current methods, including linear probes and concept activation vectors, measure concept reliance by asking whether each concept is decodable from a layer. We show that this framing is misleading: decodability reflects not only concept reliance but also correlations among concepts and the outcome in the auditing dataset. We reframe shortcut auditing as a decomposition of the variance of intermediary representations with Independent Canonical cONcepts (ICON). ICON quantifies the share of a layer's variance explained by each concept conditional on all other concepts and the outcome, and also reports the variance left unexplained. Because ICON explanations are comparable across layers, their trajectories distinguish concepts that drive predictions from those that are merely encoded in the representations. In simulated data with ground truth, ICON recovers concept importance more accurately than seven baselines. In skin-cancer and neuroimaging applications, it separates learned shortcuts from merely correlated concepts, which we confirm with independent validation checks.

    中文

    深度神经网络常会利用虚假关联，这种失效被称为捷径学习。因此，在部署前应审计模型是否依赖采集伪影、患者人口统计特征等概念。包括线性探针和概念激活向量在内的现有方法，通过询问每个概念能否从某一层解码出来，来衡量模型对概念的依赖程度。我们指出，这种表述会产生误导：可解码性反映的不仅是对概念的依赖，也反映了审计数据集中概念之间以及概念与结果之间的相关性。我们将捷径审计重新表述为使用独立典型概念（ICON）对中间表征的方差进行分解。ICON 会在控制所有其他概念和结果的条件下，量化每个概念解释某层方差的份额，并报告未能解释的方差。由于 ICON 的解释可跨层比较，其变化轨迹能够区分驱动预测的概念与仅编码在表征中的概念。在具有真实值的模拟数据中，ICON 对概念重要性的恢复比七种基线方法更准确。在皮肤癌和神经影像应用中，它能够区分学到的捷径与仅仅相关的概念；独立验证检验证实了这一点。

    ENGLISH

    Large language model (LLM)-based agents have shown strong potential in solving complex tasks through multi-step reasoning, yet they remain vulnerable to execution failures. Accurate failure attribution is therefore critical for improving agent reliability. Existing topology- and spectrum-based methods exploit trajectory structures but often overlook fine-grained semantics, while LLM-based attribution methods capture semantic cues but suffer from long-context degradation over lengthy trajectories. To address these challenges, we propose DuoTrace, a plug-and-play detection filter for LLM-based failure attribution. DuoTrace follows a detect-before-attribute paradigm: it first detects anomalous executions and then supplies focused trajectory evidence to downstream LLM-based attribution methods. For effective VAE-based anomaly detection on agent trajectories, DuoTrace integrates dual-view semantic-structural node representations, a Tree-LSTM-based trajectory encoder, and data augmentation through outcome-verified LLM replay and root-to-node path extraction to handle heterogeneous nodes, hierarchical execution structures, and limited normal execution data. Experiments with six LLM-based attribution baselines show that DuoTrace improves agent-level and step-level attribution accuracy by 11.2% and 7.7%,respectively.

    RecurTrace: Adaptive Latent Reasoning with Loop-Time Memory

    RecurTrace：利用循环时间记忆实现自适应潜在推理

    Yuxiang Wang, Kunyu Feng, Yingda Shen, Haoning Xu, Junyu Wang, Zhizheng Wu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    RecurTrace adds loop-time memory and adaptive halting to improve latent reasoning with compute matched to input difficulty. Its focus on iterative reasoning and computation organization is substantial, while memory is an architectural mechanism rather than an analysis of internal representations or compositional generalization.

    RecurTrace 加入循环时间记忆和自适应停止机制，使潜在推理所用计算量与输入难度相匹配，从而提升推理能力。其对迭代推理和计算组织方式的关注具有实质性贡献；记忆在这里是一种架构机制，而非对内部表示或组合泛化的分析。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Repeating a small block of middle layers increases a language model's effective inference depth without adding parameters or generating extra tokens, and recent work shows that this latent recurrence improves reasoning. However, two design choices limit these gains. Each iteration sees only the previous output and cannot directly access earlier computations. Moreover, a fixed loop count wastes depth on easy inputs while leaving hard ones with too little computation. We introduce RecurTrace, which addresses both limitations using the loop's own trajectory. Specifically, Loop Memory Attention lets each looped layer attend to its own states from previous iterations along the loop-time axis, so the model can revisit earlier computations instead of relying on the latest state alone. A halting head then reads the loop state and predicts whether to continue, with supervision from an oracle that identifies when additional depth still reduces loss. In a controlled MathQA comparison on the same looped backbone, RecurTrace achieves 56.9% accuracy with an average of 2.0 loops, exceeding the best fixed loop depth by 2.2 points at matched compute. By comparison, ACT and PonderNet collapse to one loop, and CALM reaches only 54.1% with 5.6 loops, while the stronger LoopUS-Conf and TaH-Mismatch baselines reach 55.3% at 3.2 loops and 55.7% at 2.1 loops. Finally, RecurTrace improves generation accuracy over same-budget fine-tuned baselines at 0.6B, 1.7B, 4B, and 8B, with the gain growing with model size from 0.6 to 3.4 points.

    中文

    重复使用一小组中间层，可以在不增加参数或生成额外 token 的情况下，提升语言模型的有效推理深度；近期研究表明，这种潜在循环结构能够改善推理能力。然而，两项设计选择限制了这些收益。每次迭代只能看到上一次的输出，无法直接访问更早的计算结果。此外，固定循环次数会在简单输入上浪费深度，却让困难输入得到的计算不足。我们提出 RecurTrace，利用循环自身的轨迹来解决这两项限制。具体而言，Loop Memory Attention 允许每个循环层沿循环时间轴关注其自身先前迭代中的状态，使模型能够重新访问早先的计算结果，而不只是依赖最新状态。随后，停止头读取循环状态并预测是否继续；其监督信号来自一个预言器，该预言器判断增加深度是否仍能降低损失。在使用相同循环骨干网络进行的受控 MathQA 比较中，RecurTrace 的准确率达到 56.9%，平均循环次数为 2.0；在计算量匹配的条件下，它比最佳固定循环深度高 2.2 个百分点。相比之下，ACT 和 PonderNet 坍缩到一次循环，CALM 在 5.6 次循环时仅达到 54.1%；表现更强的 LoopUS-Conf 和 TaH-Mismatch 基线分别在 3.2 次循环时达到 55.3%，在 2.1 次循环时达到 55.7%。最后，在 0.6B、1.7B、4B 和 8B 规模上，RecurTrace 的生成准确率均超过计算预算相同的微调基线，且增益随模型规模增长，从 0.6 个百分点提升到 3.4 个百分点。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    LayerRoute adaptively routes vision-language layers and reuses intermediate action states in robot policies, with empirical gains and structured routing analyses.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies leverage pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) to guide action generation for robot control. VLMs provide hierarchical visual-semantic representations that evolve across layers, from local visual geometry to abstract, language-aligned semantics; different manipulation tasks may therefore require different mixtures of layer representations. Meanwhile, the action module maintains intermediate representations that evolve throughout action computation and may provide useful information for subsequent decisions. However, existing VLA interfaces offer limited flexibility in representation access: VLM information is exposed through fixed layer assignments for each action layer, while intermediate action states are only propagated implicitly through residual streams without explicit reuse. We introduce LayerRoute, an action-conditioned representation routing interface that enables adaptive access to VLM layers and action representations. The Layer Mixture Router dynamically forms mixtures of cached VLM representations, while Action-State Reread reuses earlier action representations. Across diverse simulation and real-world benchmarks, LayerRoute consistently improves StarVLA-$\pi$ and $\pi_{0.5}$, achieving up to 7.2 gains on LIBERO Long with only 0.31% / 3.87% additional parameters. Ablation studies validate the benefit of action-conditioned layer routing, while routing analyses reveal structured allocation patterns across action layers and task settings.

    MemForest: Efficient Agent Memory Management via EventTree Partitioning and Progressive Merging

    MemForest：通过 EventTree 划分与渐进式合并实现高效的智能体记忆管理

    Junxi Wang, Te Sun, Jiayi Zhu, Chen Zhang, Siyuan Li, Xuyang Liu, Zichen Wen, Xiaobing Tu, Jinkui Ren, Xiantao Zhang, Ziqi Yuan, Linfeng Zhang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    MemForest compresses and retrieves persistent agent memories through event partitioning, tree merging, and anchor-guided propagation, with measured storage and speed benefits. Its transferable contribution is to memory organization in agent systems; semantic grouping is incidental to compositional generalization, and the abstract gives no evidence about internal model mechanisms or reasoning.

    MemForest 通过事件划分、树合并和锚点引导的传播来压缩并检索持久化的智能体记忆，并带来经过测量的存储和速度收益。其可迁移贡献在于智能体系统中的记忆组织；语义分组与组合泛化只是偶然相关，摘要也没有提供关于模型内部机制或推理的证据。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Agent memory systems have demonstrated significant potential in long-term dialogue, personalized assistants, and video understanding. However, continuously accumulated memory introduces substantial storage and retrieval costs during inference. To address this issue, we propose \textbf{MemForest}, a general memory compression framework adaptable to various agent memory systems. Specifically, MemForest partitions historical memory into event-centric units by leveraging global semantic similarity and local temporal continuity. For each unit, it constructs a maximum spanning tree, termed an EventTree, and progressively merges redundant memory nodes by selecting high-weight edges, reducing storage overhead. Furthermore, we introduce an anchor-guided propagation retrieval mechanism that retrieves relevant memory nodes from the temporal neighborhoods of key nodes, improving retrieval accuracy. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of MemForest. Under the unimodal Mem0 framework, MemForest retains \textbf{97.1%} of the original performance while compressing \textbf{50%} of historical memory across three benchmarks (LoCoMo, LongMemEval, and PersonaMem), achieving a \textbf{1.89x} retrieval speedup. Under the multimodal M3-Agent framework, it preserves \textbf{99.7%} of the original performance with a \textbf{50%} compression ratio across two benchmarks (M3-Bench-robot and M3-Bench-web), achieving a \textbf{2.24x} retrieval speedup. \textcolor{RoyalBlue}{\textit{Our code is available at [https://github.com/Celina-love-sweet/MemForest.}}](https://github.com/Celina-love-sweet/MemForest.}})

    中文

    智能体记忆系统在长期对话、个性化助手和视频理解方面展现出巨大潜力。然而，持续累积的记忆会在推理时带来显著的存储和检索成本。为解决这一问题，我们提出 \textbf{MemForest}，一种可适配各种智能体记忆系统的通用记忆压缩框架。具体而言，MemForest 利用全局语义相似性和局部时间连续性，将历史记忆划分为以事件为中心的单元。对于每个单元，它都会构建一棵最大生成树，称为 EventTree，并通过选择高权重边逐步合并冗余记忆节点，从而降低存储开销。此外，我们提出一种锚点引导的传播检索机制，从关键节点的时间邻域中检索相关记忆节点，以提高检索准确率。大量实验验证了 MemForest 的有效性。在单模态 Mem0 框架下，MemForest 在三个基准（LoCoMo、LongMemEval 和 PersonaMem）上将历史记忆压缩 \textbf{50%}，同时保留原始性能的 \textbf{97.1%}，并实现 \textbf{1.89x} 的检索加速。在多模态 M3-Agent 框架下，它在两个基准（M3-Bench-robot 和 M3-Bench-web）上以 \textbf{50%} 的压缩率保留原始性能的 \textbf{99.7%}，并实现 \textbf{2.24x} 的检索加速。\textcolor{RoyalBlue}{\textit{我们的代码见 [https://github.com/Celina-love-sweet/MemForest.}}](https://github.com/Celina-love-sweet/MemForest.}})
