    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Real-world hybrid web tasks need both information gathering and page interaction, yet search-based and operation-based agents are developed and evaluated separately. To bridge this gap, we introduce HyWe, a framework that unifies both capabilities within one model and trajectory. Its two modes use dedicated prompts and tool sets to sustain sub-goal execution; explicit switching selects the needed capability, and shared history lets each mode build on the other's findings. To provide demonstrations of these behaviors, we develop HyWeCollector, a fully automatic pipeline that uses task prototypes, four switching patterns, and multi-agent synthesis to produce verified hybrid trajectories. We train HyWe-35B on these demonstrations to unify efficient information gathering and browser interaction in a single 35B web agent. To evaluate hybrid task completion, we introduce HyWeBench: 100 human-written tasks on websites distinct from training, with human-written sub-goal checklists and an outcome-based evaluation pipeline. Hybrid training enables HyWe-35B to achieve 47.0% success on this benchmark, improving on the untrained base model by 19.0 percentage points and outperforming existing search-based and operation-based agents. Even before training, the same base model solves 28.0% of tasks with HyWe, versus 11.0% with all tools under one prompt. Beyond hybrid tasks, HyWe-35B achieves 59.0% and 88.3% success on Online-Mind2Web and WebVoyager, outperforming existing open-source baselines and cutting action cost per successful task by 48.3% and 51.9% compared with Fara-7B.

    中文

    真实世界的混合网页任务既需要收集信息，也需要与页面交互，但基于搜索和基于操作的智能体一直被分别开发和评估。为弥合这一差距，我们提出 HyWe，一个在同一模型和轨迹中统一这两种能力的框架。其两种模式使用专门的提示和工具集来持续执行子目标；通过显式切换选择所需能力，并借助共享历史让每种模式都能利用另一种模式的发现。为提供这些行为的示例，我们开发了 HyWeCollector，这是一个全自动流程，利用任务原型、四种切换模式和多智能体合成来生成经过验证的混合轨迹。我们使用这些示例训练 HyWe-35B，在单个 35B 网页智能体中统一高效的信息收集和浏览器交互。为评估混合任务的完成情况，我们推出 HyWeBench：其中包含 100 项由人工编写、涉及训练中未出现网站的任务，并配有人工编写的子目标清单和基于结果的评估流程。混合训练使 HyWe-35B 在该基准上达到 47.0% 的成功率，比未经训练的基础模型高 19.0 个百分点，并优于现有基于搜索和基于操作的智能体。即使在训练之前，同一个基础模型使用 HyWe 也能解决 28.0% 的任务，而在单个提示中使用全部工具时则为 11.0%。除了混合任务外，HyWe-35B 在 Online-Mind2Web 和 WebVoyager 上分别达到 59.0% 和 88.3% 的成功率，优于现有开源基线；与 Fara-7B 相比，每成功完成一项任务的操作成本分别降低 48.3% 和 51.9%。

    Lingxiao Jing, Zhengbo Jiao, Yichen Xiang, Bofan Zhu, Lingbei Meng, Yan Ni, Haorui Chen, Ran Ran, Zhirong Shen, Yuheng Yang, Chenhang Cui, Yaosong Du, Rui Huang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Recursive Environment Scaling creates harder, objective-preserving agent tasks through inherited changes and composed dependencies, and the resulting trajectories improve fine-tuning performance. Dependency composition offers a substantive but task-specific contribution to compositional generalization, while the main contribution advances agent evaluation and training systems rather than reasoning mechanisms.

    递归环境扩展通过继承改动并组合依赖关系，构建出目标保持不变但难度更高的智能体任务；由此产生的轨迹也能提升微调性能。依赖组合对组合泛化作出了实质性但针对特定任务的贡献，而主要贡献是推进智能体评估和训练系统，而非推理机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    We study environment scaling as a way to increase agent-benchmark difficulty while holding core task objectives fixed. Our framework, Recursive Environment Scaling (RES), transforms existing benchmark environments while preserving their objectives and completion requirements. A proposer changes information access, resource relations, and execution dependencies; execution-grounded checks validate the resulting candidate, and accepted changes are inherited across rounds. This produces related environments for paired evaluation and training-trajectory collection. Experiments on 294 initial tasks from three benchmarks show lower task success for all six evaluation models, with decreases of 57.14--77.14 percentage points on Claw-Eval-Live. With equal trajectory counts and identical optimization settings, fine-tuning on RES trajectories outperforms original-trajectory SFT in all nine model--benchmark comparisons by 7.00--14.61 percentage points. Ablations identify recursive inheritance and dependency composition as important contributors to increased difficulty. Together, these results support environment scaling for both agent evaluation and training.

    中文

    我们研究环境扩展，将其作为在保持核心任务目标不变的同时提高智能体基准难度的一种方法。我们的框架递归环境扩展（RES）会转换现有基准环境，同时保留其目标和完成要求。提议器会改变信息访问方式、资源关系和执行依赖关系；基于执行的检查会验证生成的候选环境，并在后续轮次中继承已接受的改动。由此生成相互关联的环境，用于配对评估和收集训练轨迹。对来自三个基准的 294 个初始任务进行的实验表明，六个评估模型的任务成功率均有所降低；在 Claw-Eval-Live 上，降幅为 57.14--77.14 个百分点。在轨迹数量相同、优化设置一致的情况下，基于 RES 轨迹微调在全部九个模型—基准对比中均优于基于原始轨迹的 SFT，提升幅度为 7.00--14.61 个百分点。消融实验指出，递归继承和依赖组合是提升难度的重要因素。总的来说，这些结果支持将环境扩展用于智能体评估和训练。

    赋能边缘智能体：对 LLM 智能体执行中边缘—云协作的系统分析

    Pengcheng Huang, Zhenghao Liu, Shixin Ren, Shi Yu, Sijia Yao, Yukun Yan, Chaojun Xiao, Maosong Sun

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper benchmarks and analyzes how edge and cloud models collaborate during long-horizon agent execution, including performance, resource use, privacy, and invocation decisions. Agent execution and system organization are a substantial focus, while cloud-invocation decision-making alone offers only an incidental connection to reasoning.

    本文对长时程智能体执行期间边缘模型与云端模型如何协作进行基准评测和分析，涵盖性能、资源使用、隐私及调用决策。智能体执行和系统组织是其重要重点，而云端调用决策与推理的联系只是附带内容。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Edge-cloud collaboration combines the lower inference overhead and greater data locality of edge-side execution with the stronger capabilities of cloud-hosted models. However, as LLM agents increasingly operate in long-horizon scenarios, cloud participation becomes interleaved throughout execution rather than a one-shot decision for each query. Such interleaved participation introduces trajectory-level effects that remain insufficiently understood. To address this gap, we introduce EC2-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating edge-cloud collaboration in long-horizon agent execution. It provides executable digital-workspace agent tasks and a unified evaluation framework covering task performance, resource usage, and privacy exposure. Using this benchmark, we empirically study diverse forms of edge-cloud collaboration. Our study reveals three findings. First, collaboration achieves a favorable balance among task performance, resource usage, and privacy exposure compared with edge-only and cloud-only execution. Second, as edge models become stronger, collaborative execution approaches cloud-only performance, and performance differences across strategies shrink, while privacy exposure remains strongly strategy-dependent. Third, stronger edge capability shifts preferred collaboration from externally controlled cloud participation and direct cloud execution toward more edge-controlled collaboration. Further analyses identify cloud-invocation decision-making and instruction following as important edge-side abilities for effective collaboration. These findings provide a systematic understanding of edge-cloud collaboration in long-horizon agent execution and insights for designing future edge agents that effectively collaborate with cloud models. Code and resources are available at https://github.com/OpenBMB/EC2-Bench.

    中文

    边缘—云协作结合了边缘侧执行较低的推理开销和更强的数据本地性，以及云端模型更强的能力。然而，随着 LLM 智能体越来越多地运行于长时程场景中，云端参与会交织在整个执行过程中，而不再只是针对每个查询的一次性决策。这种交织式参与会产生尚未得到充分理解的轨迹级效应。为填补这一空白，我们推出 EC2-Bench，这是一个用于评估长时程智能体执行中边缘—云协作的基准。它提供可执行的数字工作空间智能体任务，以及涵盖任务性能、资源使用和隐私暴露的统一评估框架。我们利用该基准对多种边缘—云协作形式进行实证研究。研究揭示了三项发现。第一，与仅边缘或仅云端执行相比，协作在任务性能、资源使用和隐私暴露之间实现了较好的平衡。第二，随着边缘模型能力增强，协同执行的表现逐渐接近仅云端执行，不同策略之间的性能差距缩小，但隐私暴露仍在很大程度上取决于策略。第三，更强的边缘能力会使偏好的协作方式从由外部控制的云端参与和直接云端执行，转向由边缘端更多控制的协作。进一步分析发现，云端调用决策和指令遵循是实现有效协作的重要边缘侧能力。这些发现系统地揭示了长时程智能体执行中的边缘—云协作，并为设计能够有效与云端模型协作的未来边缘智能体提供了见解。代码和资源见 https://github.com/OpenBMB/EC2-Bench。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    UniW(A)M combines shared and capability-specific experts across world and world-action model interfaces, with an adaptive router selecting interfaces for execution chunks. Expert reuse gives a partial connection to composition, but the abstract does not claim compositional generalization or a reasoning mechanism; its main contribution is model architecture and routing.

    UniW(A)M 在世界模型和世界-动作模型接口间结合共享专家与特定能力专家，并通过自适应路由器为执行块选择接口。专家复用与组合有一定联系，但摘要并未声称组合泛化或推理机制；其主要贡献是模型架构和路由。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    World models (WMs) and world-action models (WAMs) focus on future world prediction and executable action generation, respectively. Although these models learn shared physical dynamics and interaction semantics from embodied trajectories, they are typically trained in isolation, which restricts knowledge reuse between prediction and control. The central challenge is therefore to develop a unified learning framework that shares these dynamics while preserving the distinct modeling capabilities required by each paradigm. We propose UniW(A)M, a mixture-of-experts world-(action) model built upon diffusion Transformers that unifies action-conditioned world modeling and diverse WAM variants. Shared experts capture common dynamics, while atomic capability experts are reused across interfaces so that each interface keeps its own conditional pathway. At deployment, a plug-in adaptive interface router (PAIR) learns from a small subset of target-task chunk scenarios to select a suitable WAM interface for each execution chunk, balancing task success and execution efficiency while keeping the backbone frozen. We evaluate UniW(A)M on LIBERO, RoboTwin 2.0, and three real-world manipulation tasks, where it achieves 88.3% average real-world success versus 76.7% for the strongest baseline. On WorldArena, it leads action-conditioned world modeling on all three tasks. AC-WM co-training contributes to action generation on every action interface and PAIR raises OOD success from 63.3% to 76.7%.

    中文

    世界模型（WMs）和世界-动作模型（WAMs）分别侧重于未来世界预测和可执行动作生成。尽管这些模型从具身轨迹中学习共享的物理动力学和交互语义，但它们通常彼此独立地训练，这限制了预测与控制之间的知识复用。因此，核心挑战是开发一个统一的学习框架，在共享这些动力学的同时，保留各类模型范式所需的独特建模能力。我们提出 UniW(A)M，这是一种基于扩散 Transformer 构建的混合专家世界（动作）模型，统一了动作条件世界建模和多种 WAM 变体。共享专家捕捉共同动力学，而原子能力专家则在不同接口间复用，使每个接口都保留自己的条件路径。在部署时，插件式自适应接口路由器（PAIR）从目标任务的一小部分分块场景中学习，为每个执行块选择合适的 WAM 接口，在保持骨干网络冻结的同时，兼顾任务成功率和执行效率。我们在 LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0 和三项真实世界操作任务上评估 UniW(A)M，其真实世界平均成功率达到 88.3%，而最强基线为 76.7%。在 WorldArena 上，它在全部三项任务的动作条件世界建模中均领先。AC-WM 联合训练有助于所有动作接口生成动作，而 PAIR 将 OOD 成功率从 63.3% 提高到 76.7%。

    Jeva: System One Models from First Principles

    Jeva：从第一性原理出发构建 System One 模型

    Qi Li, Xinchao Wang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Jeva’s main contribution is a decision-native architecture with permutation-equivariant scoring, null detection, scalable option handling, and reusable option representations. Its structured request-option interactions and cross-request reuse offer substantive but secondary relevance to composition and strong relevance to model-system design; the abstract does not investigate internal representations or reasoning mechanisms.

    Jeva 的主要贡献是决策原生架构，具备排列等变评分、空值检测、可扩展的选项处理和可复用的选项表示。其结构化的请求—选项交互和跨请求复用与组合能力有一定但次要的关联，也与模型系统设计密切相关；摘要没有研究内部表示或推理机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    System one models like Jev enable direct, low-latency decision-making. Yet recent open-source practice of predicting an answer from serialized text does not, by itself, respect the structure of a decision problem. We argue that current designs underemphasize four important structural requirements. (i) null-aware: Models should distinguish answer absence from uncertainty among candidates; (ii) permutation-invariant: Reordering alternatives should not change the decision; (iii) option-scalable: Growing candidate sets should not require redefining the output space; (iv) cacheable: Request-independent computation over recurring alternatives should be reusable across requests. We introduce Jeva, a decision-native architecture that addresses these requirements jointly. A shared encoder independently represents the request and each option, while a compact decision stack refines only the request state against immutable option memory. Symmetric aggregation yields permutation-equivariant probabilities; shared scoring accommodates variable-size candidate sets. A separate coverage estimate distinguishes answer absence from candidate competition, enabling explicit null outcomes. Request-independent option representations and layer projections support reuse across newly assembled sets. These mechanisms unify Choice, Noul, and Score outputs. Across evaluations against Jev and open source models, Jeva combines strong typed-decision performance with near-perfect null detection and no decision flips under any tested permutations. It scales to thousands of candidates and substantially reduces latency through cross-request reuse without changing decisions.

    中文

    像 Jev 这样的 System One 模型能够直接、低延迟地做出决策。然而，近期通过序列化文本预测答案的开源实践本身并不符合决策问题的结构。我们认为，当前设计对四项重要的结构要求重视不足。(i) 空值感知：模型应能区分答案不存在与候选项之间的不确定性；(ii) 排列不变：重新排列选项不应改变决策；(iii) 选项可扩展：候选集合扩大时不应要求重新定义输出空间；(iv) 可缓存：对反复出现的选项进行与请求无关的计算后，应能在不同请求间重复使用。我们提出 Jeva，这是一种能同时满足这些要求的决策原生架构。共享编码器分别表示请求和每个选项，而精简的决策堆栈只根据不可变的选项记忆来精炼请求状态。对称聚合产生满足排列等变性的概率；共享评分机制适用于大小可变的候选集合。单独的覆盖率估计将答案不存在与候选项竞争区分开来，从而支持显式空值结果。与请求无关的选项表示和层投影支持在新组合的选项集合间复用。上述机制统一了 Choice、Noul 和 Score 输出。与 Jev 和开源模型的评估表明，Jeva 在有类型决策任务上表现强劲，几乎能完美检测空值，并且在所有测试过的排列下都不会改变决策。它可以扩展到数千个候选项，并通过跨请求复用显著降低延迟，同时保持决策不变。

    CyberArena：在实时对称攻防对抗中评测 AI 智能体

    Bangya Liu, Jianhong Tu, Yueyang Pan, Hanhong Zhao, Zhe Ye, Hongwei Li, Saastha Vasan, Katherine Lambert, Junmin Zhu, Hao Wang, Jienan Chen, Yunze Xiao, Minglai Yang, Zihan Wang, Hairong Yin, Hao Wang, Zhiwen Fan, Tianneng Shi, Zhun Wang, Wenbo Guo, Chenguang Wang, Dawn Song

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces a dynamic adversarial benchmark and scoring model for evaluating cybersecurity agents, including an automated pipeline for generating environments. It provides a substantial evaluation platform for agent behavior, but does not describe new agent architecture or reasoning mechanisms; strategic play is measured rather than developed.

    本文提出一个动态对抗基准和评分模型，用于评估网络安全智能体，并包含一个自动生成环境的流程。它为智能体行为评估提供了实质性的评估平台，但没有描述新的智能体架构或推理机制；策略对抗能力是被测量的对象，而非本文开发的内容。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    AI agents are demonstrating increasingly strong offensive and defensive cybersecurity capabilities in the real world. Current benchmarks mostly evaluate agents in isolation against static targets. Real cyber operations, however, are dynamic and coupled: security postures constantly change as attackers and defenders adapt to each other in real time. Static benchmarks quickly saturate and miss an agent's ability to attack and defend simultaneously under live pressure. To address this gap, we present CyberArena, a dynamic, symmetric adversarial benchmark built around multi-round attack-and-defense combat. In isolated sandboxes, two agents compete under identical rules, acting concurrently as both attackers and defenders over continuously changing services. This converts static targets into evolving, semi-open challenges, directly testing an agent's speed and precision in discovering, exploiting, and patching vulnerabilities. To sustain the benchmark's longevity, an automated agentic pipeline continuously generates, reviews, and validates new environments. Furthermore, because pairwise contests are notoriously hard to quantify, we introduce a dynamical model that maps match dynamics into unified, multidimensional scores across offensive, defensive, and domain-specific capabilities. Evaluating 12 frontier LLM agents across 40 challenges in 466 matches, CyberArena separates model capabilities where single-agent baselines hit a ceiling. The trajectories read like a fight rather than an exam: defenders patch one hole and miss the next and certify repairs on stale evidence, while capable agents think a move ahead, planting backdoors for later rounds and, in one case, writing their own packet sniffer to watch the opponent. Beyond a benchmark, CyberArena serves as an adaptable, scalable experimental platform for future research on cybersecurity agents.

    中文

    AI 智能体在现实世界中的网络安全攻防能力日益增强。当前基准测试大多是在孤立环境中针对静态目标评估智能体。然而，真实网络行动具有动态性和耦合性：随着攻击者和防御者实时相互适应，安全态势不断变化。静态基准测试很快就会达到饱和，也无法检验智能体在实时压力下同时攻击和防御的能力。为弥补这一不足，我们推出 CyberArena，这是一个围绕多回合攻防对抗构建的动态、对称对抗基准。在隔离沙箱中，两个智能体按照相同规则竞争，在持续变化的服务环境中同时扮演攻击者和防御者。这将静态目标转变为不断演进的半开放挑战，直接检验智能体发现、利用和修补漏洞的速度与精度。为使基准长期有效，一个自动化智能体式流程会持续生成、审查并验证新的环境。此外，由于成对对抗众所周知难以量化，我们提出一个动力学模型，将比赛动态映射为涵盖攻击、防御和特定领域能力的统一多维分数。在 40 项挑战和 466 场比赛中评估 12 个前沿 LLM 智能体时，CyberArena 能够区分模型能力，而单智能体基线已达到上限。这些轨迹读起来像一场战斗，而非一场考试：防御者补上一个漏洞，却漏掉下一个，并依据过时证据认证修复；有能力的智能体则会提前一步思考，在后续回合埋下后门，其中一个甚至编写了自己的数据包嗅探器来监视对手。CyberArena 不仅是一个基准，也是一种灵活、可扩展的实验平台，可用于未来网络安全智能体研究。

When these data are unavailable, we draw on the membership inference literature to identify likely training examples and construct a proxy dataset. We establish two theoretical results on optimal displacement to the decision boundary and reduced proxy-estimation bias. We evaluate genesis steering and membership-based proxy construction on T\"ulu-3-8B, whose fine-tuning data are publicly available, and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct as a control. We find that safety data from T\"ulu-3-8B's training mixture yield stronger steering than external datasets on both models. On T\"ulu-3-8B, membership scores largely agree in identifying training examples, and vectors built from top-ranked examples achieve competitive performance against random subsets of the same size. In contrast, the results on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct hint that a MIA method will only have a positive effect if the mean direction shift with MIA-filtered in-distribution data is much less severe than the direction shift with OoD data.

    In procedural tool-use domains, how much of the gap between base models is procedure rather than capability? The construction, PLVR , takes the reasoning traces of a teacher, Kimi-K3, clusters their segments to locate recurring operations, has a frontier model author one typed primitive per operation, each run by a small frozen model and assembles the program by A* search over a mined rule library, under a reference-action objective. On Retail and LiveMCPBench the program is competitive with the best baseline.     RouteWeaver: Weaving Mode Selection and Execution into Unified LLM Routing

    RouteWeaver：将模式选择与执行编织进统一的 LLM 路由

    Xiaohan Wang, Haozhen Zhang, Qingyuan Liu, Tao Feng, Wenya Wang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    RouteWeaver jointly learns routing mode selection and model execution, with separate credit assignment and progressive exploration; its main contribution is adaptive model routing, a substantial systems advance. Its reasoning tasks are evaluation domains rather than a focus on reasoning mechanisms, and the framework does not investigate internal representations or compositional generalization.

    RouteWeaver 联合学习路由模式选择与模型执行，并采用独立的信用分配和渐进式探索；其主要贡献是自适应模型路由，构成了显著的系统进步。推理任务只是评估领域，而非研究推理机制的重点；该框架也不探究内部表征或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    LLM routing dynamically selects and coordinates heterogeneous language models across diverse tasks. However, existing approaches are largely built around a predefined execution paradigm, such as single-round, multi-round, or agentic routing, which fixes how model calls are organized and limits adaptation to different query needs. We propose RouteWeaver, a unified routing framework that integrates these routing modes within a single LLM policy, jointly learning which mode to use and how to select models within that mode. To jointly optimize mode selection and within-mode execution, we develop COMET-GRPO (COordinated Mode-Execution Training), which decouples the trajectory-level advantage into separate signals for mode selection and within-mode execution, enabling more targeted credit assignment to each decision level. We further introduce progressive exploration, which gradually shifts training from externally assigned modes to autonomous selection, so that the router first learns how to execute each mode before deciding when to use it. We evaluate RouteWeaver across mathematics, coding, knowledge, logical reasoning, and factual recall. RouteWeaver achieves an average accuracy of 61.4%, an 11.03% relative improvement over the strongest baseline, and outperforms all compared baselines in each of the five domains. Ablations show that both COMET-GRPO and progressive exploration are important for adaptive routing; without progressive exploration, the routing policy collapses entirely to single-round execution.

    Advantage Guidance is a policy-training method that uses advantage-conditioned supervised learning and contrastive diffusion guidance to improve long-horizon, sparse-reward RL.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Reinforcement learning (RL) holds the promise of learning a policy that can outperform what is shown in the data. However, in practice, such systems suffer from instability and hyperparameter sensitivity. In contrast, supervised learning provides a stable and scalable training objective, but is fundamentally limited by the quality of the demonstrated behavior. In this paper, we ask whether we can perform policy optimization with something as simple and stable as supervised learning but as performant as RL. Unfortunately, naively training the policy with supervised learning and conditioning on future rewards or advantages typically underperform dedicated RL methods. We introduce a new policy extraction method, Advantage Guidance, that retains the simple supervised learning structure with advantage conditioning while outperforming prior RL methods through effective conditional training and contrastive diffusion guidance during sampling. We show that Advantage Guidance can significantly improve a model's ability to respond to conditional advantage signals, and the contrastive guidance during sampling can use the learned advantage-conditioned policy to target the KL-regularized optimal policy. Empirically, we find that Advantage Guidance significantly outperforms prior state-of-the-art RL methods on 26 long-horizon, sparse reward tasks across datasets with varying degrees of optimality.

    强化学习（RL）有望学得一种策略，其表现优于数据中展示的行为。然而在实践中，这类系统容易出现不稳定并对超参数敏感。相比之下，监督学习提供了稳定且可扩展的训练目标，但从根本上受限于示范行为的质量。在本文中，我们探讨能否以像监督学习一样简单、稳定的方式进行策略优化，同时达到 RL 的性能。遗憾的是，朴素地使用监督学习训练策略，并以未来奖励或优势为条件，通常不如专门的 RL 方法。我们提出一种新的策略提取方法 Advantage Guidance：它保留带优势条件的简单监督学习结构，同时通过有效的条件训练和采样过程中的对比扩散引导，超越以往的 RL 方法。我们表明，Advantage Guidance 能显著提升模型响应条件优势信号的能力；采样过程中的对比引导则可以利用学得的优势条件策略，指向经 KL 正则化的最优策略。实证结果显示，在最优程度各异的数据集上的 26 个长时程、稀疏奖励任务中，Advantage Guidance 显著优于此前最先进的 RL 方法。

    Tabular foundation models enable in-context learning by predicting unseen observations from a labeled support table without task-specific parameter updates. Despite recent advances, most existing approaches rely on dense architectures that apply the same transformations across features and datasets. We introduce OrionMoE-Small-v1.0, a compact tabular foundation model that combines distribution-aware representations with dataset-conditioned sparse mixture-of-experts computation. Built on a dual-axis transformer architecture, OrionMoE-Small selectively activates experts with routing decisions informed by both individual cell representations and the broader dataset context. This design enables adaptive allocation of computation across heterogeneous tabular problems while retaining a shared computational pathway across tasks. The model is pretrained entirely on synthetic classification tasks generated from a structured causal prior and performs downstream prediction without gradient-based adaptation. Experiments across multiple tabular benchmarks demonstrate competitive performance against substantially larger foundation models, with particularly strong results on small-context and high-dimensional datasets. Further analysis reveals favorable relative performance under class imbalance and highlights the importance of feature composition.

    SwarmRSI：通过演进的科学智能体群实现递归自我改进

    Qianru Meng, Xi Zhang, Konstantinos Papakostas, Congfeng Cao, Wenxiang Hu, Tianyi Lu, Xiao Zhang, Lun Zhou, Zaiqiao Meng, Zhaochun Ren, Xiaohui Yan, Yougang Lyu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    SwarmRSI contributes feedback-guided mutation and recombination of hypotheses and program components across scientific agents, enabling reuse and iterative improvement. This strongly advances compositional reuse and agent-system design; experimental research performance gives a partial connection to reasoning, while the abstract offers no insight into internal model representations.

    SwarmRSI 通过在科学智能体之间对假设和程序组件进行反馈引导的变异与重组，支持复用和迭代改进。这对组合式复用和智能体系统设计有显著推动；实验研究表现与推理能力有一定关联，但摘要没有揭示内部模型表示。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Recursive self-improvement (RSI) in scientific research aims to improve agents' research capabilities through their own experimental experience. Scientific agent swarms can combine evidence and implementations from different research directions to guide their agents' subsequent experiments. However, poor experimental results can leave unclear whether to revise a hypothesis or its implementation, while overall program scores can hide components useful to other agents. To address these challenges, we introduce SwarmRSI, a framework that evolves scientific agent swarms for recursive self-improvement. We devise Feedback-Guided Swarm Mutation to refine hypotheses and their implementations using experimental feedback from other agents. We also propose Complementary Swarm Recombination to reuse retained hypotheses and complementary program components across agents, allowing partial results to support new research. Recursive Swarm Evolution integrates both mechanisms into a feedback loop, using new experimental evidence to guide subsequent research. Experiments on OpenProblems, NatureBench and MLE-Bench Lite demonstrate SwarmRSI's state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance. Further evaluations show that accumulated research experience improves performance on held-out tasks. Biologists also reproduce its programs for follow-up biological analyses.

    中文

    科学研究中的递归自我改进（RSI）旨在通过智能体自身的实验经验提升其研究能力。科学智能体群可以整合不同研究方向的证据和实现，以指导其中智能体后续的实验。然而，实验结果不佳时，往往难以判断应修正假设还是其实现；而整体程序评分可能掩盖对其他智能体有用的组件。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 SwarmRSI，这是一个通过演进科学智能体群来实现递归自我改进的框架。我们设计了反馈引导的群体变异机制，利用其他智能体的实验反馈来改进假设及其实现。我们还提出互补群体重组机制，以便在智能体之间复用保留下来的假设和互补程序组件，让部分结果能够支持新的研究。递归群体演进将这两种机制整合进反馈循环，利用新的实验依据指导后续研究。在 OpenProblems、NatureBench 和 MLE-Bench Lite 上的实验表明，SwarmRSI 达到了最先进（SOTA）的性能。进一步评估显示，积累的研究经验能够提升模型在留出任务上的表现。生物学家还复现了其程序，用于后续生物学分析。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    ReaDy retrieves target recurrent-state context for each speculative draft position, with a lightweight reader and low-overhead implementation that improve decoding throughput.     ReaDy 为每个推测草拟位置检索目标模型循环状态中的上下文，并通过轻量级读取器和低开销实现提升解码吞吐量。其类似记忆的状态使用方式和计算设计对系统领域作出了重要贡献；但仅在数学和代码上的基准表现不足以证明其具有推理或组合方面的洞见，而且该工作没有解释内部机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation by drafting multiple tokens per step, yet feature-based drafters rely on target hidden features whose contextual emphasis may not align with the needs of subsequent draft positions. Hybrid linear attention (HLA) models maintain compact recurrent states that accumulate historical associations, offering an efficient source of complementary context for speculative drafting. We introduce ReaDy, the first speculative decoding method, to the best of our knowledge, to leverage HLA recurrent states for position-specific context retrieval during drafting. ReaDy equips each draft position with a learned query to retrieve supplementary context directly from the target's committed recurrent states. A lightweight state reader integrates this context into draft representations through residual updates, while low-rank state reads and fused operators keep additional computation and I/O overhead low. Building on DSpark's parallel backbone and sequential prediction head, ReaDy employs a lightweight two-stage adaptation strategy, with reader capacity, state sources, and residual placement examined through ablation studies. Across seven benchmarks spanning mathematics, code generation, and dialogue, ReaDy achieves an average $3.16\times$ decoding speedup over autoregressive decoding with Qwen3.8-27B on a single NVIDIA B200 GPU. It outperforms DSpark on every benchmark, improving throughput by 7.97% and acceptance length by 8.50% on average. Our code is available at https://github.com/StartLuxLabs/ReaDy.

    推测解码通过每步草拟多个词元来加速自回归生成，但基于特征的草拟器依赖目标模型的隐藏特征，而这些特征对上下文的侧重可能与后续草拟位置的需求不一致。混合线性注意力（HLA）模型维护紧凑的循环状态，用以累积历史关联，为推测式草拟提供高效的补充上下文来源。据我们所知，我们提出的 ReaDy 是首个利用 HLA 循环状态在草拟过程中按位置检索上下文的推测解码方法。ReaDy 为每个草拟位置配备一个学习得到的查询，以直接从目标模型已提交的循环状态中检索补充上下文。轻量级状态读取器通过残差更新将此上下文整合到草拟表示中，而低秩状态读取和融合算子则将额外计算与 I/O 开销控制在较低水平。ReaDy 构建于 DSpark 的并行骨干网络和顺序预测头之上，采用轻量级的两阶段适配策略，并通过消融研究考察读取器容量、状态来源和残差放置位置。在涵盖数学、代码生成和对话的七个基准上，ReaDy 在单块 NVIDIA B200 GPU 上相较于使用 Qwen3.8-27B 的自回归解码，实现了平均$3.16\times$解码加速。它在每个基准上都优于 DSpark，吞吐量平均提升 7.97%，接受长度平均提升 8.50%。我们的代码见 https://github.com/StartLuxLabs/ReaDy。

    Abhinav Kumar, Rediet Abebe, Eugene Bagdasarian, Sahar Abdelnabi

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    SCARCE provides a controlled long-horizon coding environment and taxonomy for studying how agents negotiate shared resources and develop persistent norms. Its main contribution advances evaluation of multi-agent organization and coordination; coding tasks and divide-and-conquer mentions do not establish substantive reasoning or compositional-generalization contributions.

    SCARCE 提供了一个受控的长时程编码环境和分类体系，用于研究智能体如何协商共享资源并形成持久规范。其主要贡献在于推进对多智能体组织与协调的评估；提及编码任务和分而治之并不足以证明其对实质性推理或组合泛化作出了贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    As autonomous agents become widely deployed, coordinating access to shared computing resources and services will become increasingly important. Recent incidents have already revealed unplanned coordination between agents, highlighting the safety implications of these interactions. Yet prior studies of agent negotiation often use stylized games and simulated bargaining, leaving open how these behaviors develop during sustained, long-horizon tasks. We propose SCARCE (Shared Compute ARena for Coding agEnts), a framework in which agents solve sequences of coding tasks under individual deadlines while negotiating access to a shared execution resource. This negotiation determines when and for how long they can inspect programs, compile code, and run tests. We find that agents spontaneously develop informal institutions: persistent rules and commitments grounded in reputation, reciprocity, and precedent. These arrangements, which we call institutional behaviors, carry across tasks and influence resource allocation, with agents sometimes forgoing immediate advantages to honor earlier agreements. We develop a 21-category taxonomy of negotiation strategies and emergent norms and use it to analyze eight models and audit more than 1,500 trajectories across different environmental settings. Among the models tested, newer frontier models exhibit more institutional behaviors than older or lightweight models. Alongside cooperation, we observe exclusionary coalitions and rare divide-and-conquer strategies. SCARCE provides a controlled setting for proactively and systematically auditing how these relationships emerge, shape access to resources, and affect the safety and coordination of multi-agent systems.

    中文

    随着自主智能体得到广泛部署，协调对共享计算资源和服务的访问将变得日益重要。近期事件已经揭示了智能体之间未曾规划的协调，凸显了这些互动带来的安全影响。然而，先前关于智能体协商的研究往往采用风格化博弈和模拟议价，因此在持续的长时程任务中，这些行为如何发展仍不清楚。我们提出 SCARCE（面向编码智能体的共享计算竞技场），这是一个框架，智能体在各自的截止时间约束下完成一系列编码任务，同时协商访问共享执行资源。协商决定它们何时以及可以用多久检查程序、编译代码和运行测试。我们发现，智能体会自发形成非正式制度：以声誉、互惠和先例为基础的持久规则与承诺。这些安排被我们称为制度性行为，会延续到不同任务中并影响资源分配；智能体有时会放弃眼前利益，以遵守先前的约定。我们制定了一个包含 21 个类别的协商策略与涌现规范分类体系，并用它分析了八种模型，审查了不同环境设置下的 1,500 多条轨迹。在受测模型中，较新的前沿模型表现出比旧模型或轻量模型更多的制度性行为。除了合作之外，我们还观察到排他性联盟以及罕见的分而治之策略。SCARCE 提供了一个受控环境，可主动、系统地审查这些关系如何涌现、塑造资源访问并影响多智能体系统的安全与协调。

    Planning Commitment of LLM under Partial Observability

    部分可观测条件下 LLM 的规划承诺

    Cassie Huang, Zhanwei Cao, Yeawon Lee, Nathalia Gomez, Zhuoyi Yang, Ian G. Harris, Tiffany D. Do, Jiayuan Mao, Li Zhang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper characterizes and tunes how LLM planners commit to plans under partial observability, exposing a safety-efficiency trade-off and sensitivity to unreliable priors. This advances agent planning and control, but offers limited insight into general reasoning mechanisms and does not study internal representations or compositional generalization.

    本文刻画并调整 LLM 规划器在部分可观测条件下作出计划承诺的方式，揭示了安全与效率之间的权衡，以及对不可靠先验的敏感性。这推进了智能体规划与控制研究，但对一般推理机制的见解有限，也没有研究内部表征或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    LLM-based planning agents commit to plans of different lengths before interacting with a partially observable environment. Some aggressively commit to a long plan based on assumptions about unobserved states, while others conservatively plan only over what they have observed. Both behaviors emerge implicitly in pre-trained models, whether the LLM outputs a plan directly or generates a PDDL formulation for a classical solver. Aggressive commitment risks costly failures, while conservative commitment risks excessive LLM calls. This choice pits safety against efficiency, a trade-off that has been neither characterized systematically nor made controllable. We investigate aggressive and conservative LLM planners and formalizers on two partially observable domains, where priors are provided as either explicit statistics or common-sense knowledge. Across three LLMs, both strategies reach similar accuracy. Conservative methods achieve fewer failed attempts (safety) at the cost of more API calls (efficiency). Aggressive methods fail more often but replan efficiently only when priors are informative. Interestingly, analysis shows that LLMs treat the provided priors nearly as facts, which risks failure when priors are unreliable. We also explore hybrid strategies with tunable hyperparameters that adjust the balance between safety and efficiency.

    中文

    基于 LLM 的规划智能体在与部分可观测环境交互之前，会承诺执行不同长度的计划。有些智能体会基于对未观测状态的假设，激进地承诺执行长计划；另一些则采取保守策略，只规划已观测到的内容。这两种行为都会隐式地出现在预训练模型中，无论 LLM 是直接输出计划，还是生成供经典求解器使用的 PDDL 表述。激进承诺可能导致代价高昂的失败，而保守承诺则可能导致过多的 LLM 调用。这种选择将安全与效率置于权衡之中，但此前既未得到系统刻画，也无法进行控制。我们在两个部分可观测领域中研究激进和保守的 LLM 规划器及形式化器，其中先验信息以显式统计数据或常识的形式提供。在三个 LLM 上，两种策略的准确率相近。保守方法的失败尝试更少（更安全），代价是 API 调用更多（效率较低）。激进方法失败更多，但只有在先验信息可靠时才能高效地重新规划。有趣的是，分析表明 LLM 几乎将提供的先验当作事实，这使得先验不可靠时存在失败风险。我们还探索了可通过可调超参数来平衡安全与效率的混合策略。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Current heterogeneity-aware training systems for large models balance workloads by assigning unequal numbers of layers across pipeline stages, a strategy aimed at equalizing execution time through a unique pipeline configuration. However, this approach fails to address critical memory constraints and suffers from inherently coarse balancing granularity. In this paper, we propose Heterogeneous Pipeline Parallelism (HPP), a novel approach enabling efficient and fine-grained data balance across heterogeneous pipelines. To address HPP's key challenges, prohibitive search overhead for optimal configurations and high communication overhead from asymmetric All-Reduce, we design the ETH training system. ETH employs a hierarchical workload balance framework that jointly optimizes balance across heterogeneous pipelines and within individual pipeline stages. To mitigate asymmetric communication costs, ETH implements block-wise gradient aggregation. Furthermore, it integrates specialized optimizations that dramatically reduce HPP configuration search overhead. Evaluations demonstrate ETH achieves up to 2x training speedup while reducing configuration generation overhead by up to 56x compared to state-of-the-art systems. The code is available at https://github.com/YuMJie/ETH.

    本文提出一种基于 HTN 的架构，它会推迟任务分解并协调多智能体执行，构成实质性的系统贡献。层级和依赖关系提供了一定的组合结构，但摘要并未证明其在组合泛化或推理机制方面取得进展。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Orchestrating multiple agents on a complex task requires reconciling local subtask execution with global task planning. Dynamic dispatch approaches provide execution flexibility but do not explicitly model subtask hierarchies or dependencies, while predefined workflows impose this structure but fix the decomposition before execution begins. Therefore, we introduce HTN-Orchestrate, a two-layer framework that separates these responsibilities through a hierarchical task network (HTN). The Planner maintains subtask hierarchies and dependencies, deferring decomposition until prerequisite results become available, while local Orchestrators schedule workers to execute each leaf subtask. Results propagate upward under \textbf{AND} semantics, and accumulated findings inform a rebuilt task network when the current decomposition cannot resolve the task. On five benchmarks spanning web research, scientific reasoning, and research workflows, HTN-Orchestrate outperforms ReAct, Agent Team, and DeepSeek Harness using the same base model, achieving 89.73% accuracy on BrowseComp and 73.44% on SUPERChem, exceeding Agent Team by 2.45 and 4.69 percentage points, respectively.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops rational synthesis for multi-agent systems with temporal objectives, combining Nash-Q learning with finite-sample satisfaction guarantees and stability checks. Its main contribution is an algorithmic advance in multi-agent learning and strategy stability, while temporal logic and reward automata provide only limited evidence of compositional generalization or reasoning mechanisms.

    本文为具有时间目标的多智能体系统开发理性综合方法，结合了 Nash-Q 学习、有限样本满足性保证和稳定性检查。其主要贡献是多智能体学习与策略稳定性方面的算法进展；时序逻辑和奖励自动机只能有限地体现组合泛化或推理机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    We study rational synthesis for stochastic multi-agent systems with unknown dynamics, where each agent is equipped with its own probabilistic temporal objective specified using Probabilistic Linear Temporal Logic on Finite Traces ($\mathsf{PLTL}_f}$). We impose solution concepts (e.g., Nash equilibrium, subgame-perfect equilibrium) as constraints on the joint strategy profile, using payoffs derived from each agent's probability of satisfying its temporal objective. In particular, we formulate per-agent rational synthesis as finding a strategy profile -- if one exists -- such that (i) the designated agent's probabilistic temporal constraint is satisfied, and (ii) the profile represents a stable solution under a chosen solution concept. We give conditional convergence guarantees for tabular Nash-Q learning, certify satisfaction with simultaneous finite-sample confidence bounds, and assess strategic stability with approximate best-response checking. Our approach operates in a stochastic \emph{Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning} (MARL) environment, where model-free learning algorithms attempt to attain extremal satisfaction probabilities for temporal objectives automatically compiled into reward automata. Our approach is empirically validated using 8 general-sum concurrent stochastic games.

    The report evaluates a general model across embodied tasks and examines a costly but effective closed-loop pairing of a high-level reasoner with a low-level controller, alongside real-world deployment limits. Its main contribution is evidence about embodied agent systems; benchmark performance and in-context demonstrations alone provide limited evidence about compositional generalization or reasoning mechanisms.

    本报告在多种具身任务上评估通用模型，并考察高层推理器与低层控制器之间成本高昂但有效的闭环配合，同时分析现实世界部署的限制。其主要贡献是关于具身智能体系统的证据；仅凭基准表现和上下文示范，对组合泛化或推理机制只能提供有限证据。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    GPT-6-Astra demonstrates a level of competence in robotic manipulation and navigation that challenges the conventional paradigm of building specialized models for individual tasks and embodiments. In this report, we ask not only how capable GPT-6-Astra is, but what its capabilities imply for the field. First, we probe the limits of standalone GPT-6-Astra. We conduct a large-scale evaluation across 12 representative benchmarks spanning tabletop manipulation, humanoids, mobile platforms, and dexterous hands. Under a unified protocol that allows in-context learning (ICL) from training-set demonstrations and substantially increases the number of execution steps, GPT-6-Astra achieves unprecedented performance (Fig. 1). Future research may focus on improving 1) the generality of ICL 2) cost and execution time, 3) physical-state verification, 4) recovery from irreversible failures, and 5) long-horizon preservation of progress. Second, we study the agentic harness for embodied control. We identify that close-loop coordination between a high-level "System 2" reasoner (i.e., GPT-6-Astra) and a low-level "System 1" controller (e.g., {\pi}0.5) is costly but effective. Third, we examine GPT-6-Astra on real-world deployment. Our experiments on 8 robot configurations reveal substantial gaps: 1) robot demonstrations required for ICL are expensive to collect, and 2) it is implausible to trade longer execution for higher success rates with physical constraints. Fourth, we envision the next generation of embodied benchmarks. We develop a prototype that 1) derives tasks from real-world needs, 2) provides no in-domain demonstrations, and 3) judges agents on a world clock that keeps running while they deliberate. Taken together, our results suggest that GPT-6-Astra has largely crossed the threshold of embodied competence, but not yet that of practical embodied intelligence.

    中文

    GPT-6-Astra 在机器人操作和导航方面展现出的能力，挑战了为单项任务和单种具身形态构建专用模型的传统范式。在本报告中，我们不仅考察 GPT-6-Astra 的能力，还探讨这些能力对该领域意味着什么。首先，我们探查独立运行的 GPT-6-Astra 的能力边界。我们在 12 个代表性基准上进行大规模评估，涵盖桌面操作、人形机器人、移动平台和灵巧手。在统一协议下，允许从训练集示范进行上下文学习（ICL），并显著增加执行步数后，GPT-6-Astra 达到了前所未有的表现（图 1）。未来研究可着重改进：1）ICL 的通用性；2）成本和执行时间；3）物理状态验证；4）从不可逆失败中恢复；以及 5）长时程地保留进展。其次，我们研究用于具身控制的智能体框架。我们发现，高层“System 2”推理器（即 GPT-6-Astra）与低层“System 1”控制器（例如 {\pi}0.5）之间的闭环协调成本高昂但有效。第三，我们考察 GPT-6-Astra 在现实世界中的部署情况。针对 8 种机器人配置的实验揭示了显著差距：1）收集 ICL 所需的机器人示范成本高昂；2）受物理约束，难以通过延长执行时间来换取更高成功率。第四，我们展望下一代具身基准。我们开发了一个原型，它：1）从现实世界需求中提出任务；2）不提供领域内示范；3）依据持续运行的现实时间时钟评判智能体，即使它们正在 deliberation 时钟也不会停止。综合来看，我们的结果表明 GPT-6-Astra 在很大程度上已达到具身能力的门槛，但尚未达到实用具身智能的门槛。

    LLM-Assisted Bi-Approximate CHC Solving

    LLM 辅助的双向近似 CHC 求解

    Baiting Jiang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    HornCraft uses LLM-proposed symbolic witnesses to create certified under-approximations that can be composed and reused in multi-step CHC solving, substantially advancing algorithmic reasoning. Composition is a specific part of that solver mechanism rather than the paper’s broader focus, and LLM assistance alone does not provide insight into model internals or agent systems.

    HornCraft 使用 LLM 提出的符号见证，构造经认证且可在多步 CHC 求解中组合和复用的下近似，显著推进了算法推理。组合是该求解机制的一个具体组成部分，并非论文的整体研究重点；仅有 LLM 辅助并不能带来对模型内部或智能体系统的见解。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Constrained Horn clause (CHC) solvers often struggle to discover deep counterexamples whose derivations may require extensive rule unfolding. Although large language models (LLMs) can propose long-range symbolic relations, prior work on formally checked LLM-assisted verification has mainly focused on generating inductive invariants and concrete traces. We exploit this broader capability through Derivation Power Under-approximations (DPUs). Each DPU is a solver-certified under-approximation of the relation induced by a multi-step CHC derivation. An LLM proposes each DPU with symbolic intermediate-state witnesses that enable SMT validation without introducing additional quantifiers. Validated DPUs can be composed and reused soundly. Building on this mechanism, our LLM-assisted framework HornCraft combines invariant generation for over-approximation with DPU generation for under-approximation in CHC solving. On 260 linear and nonlinear integer-arithmetic CHC-COMP benchmarks left unresolved by a 30-minute Spacer run, HornCraft returns certified verdicts for 228 instances. It certifies 42 instances as unsafe, compared with 22 when DPU construction and reuse are disabled.

    中文

    受约束 Horn 子句（CHC）求解器往往难以发现深层反例，因为推导这些反例可能需要大量展开规则。尽管大型语言模型（LLM）能够提出远距离符号关系，先前经过形式化检查的 LLM 辅助验证工作主要聚焦于生成归纳不变量和具体轨迹。我们通过推导能力下近似（DPU）利用这一更广泛的能力。每个 DPU 都是由多步 CHC 推导所诱导关系的、经求解器认证的下近似。LLM 会提出每个 DPU，并提供符号化的中间状态见证，使其能够通过 SMT 验证而无需引入额外量词。经过验证的 DPU 可以安全地组合和复用。在此机制基础上，我们提出 LLM 辅助框架 HornCraft，它在 CHC 求解中结合用于过近似的不变量生成与用于下近似的 DPU 生成。在 260 个线性与非线性整数算术 CHC-COMP 基准实例上，这些实例均未能通过 30 分钟运行的 Spacer 求解，HornCraft 为其中 228 个实例给出了经认证的判定。在关闭 DPU 构造与复用时，HornCraft 将 42 个实例认证为不安全，而对照数量为 22 个。

    PolyGraph: Plan-Buffered CUDA Graphs for Adaptive Speculative Decoding

    PolyGraph：用于自适应推测解码的计划缓冲 CUDA 图

    Junchao Yang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    PolyGraph introduces a plan buffer that lets custom CUDA kernels adapt their active work shape while replaying a fixed graph, reducing graph-build time and avoiding padded work. This is a substantial systems contribution, though the evidence is a limited prototype on one GPU rather than a general serving system.

    PolyGraph 引入计划缓冲区，使自定义 CUDA 内核在重放固定图时能够调整其活动工作形状，从而缩短建图时间并避免填充工作。这是一项重要的系统贡献，但证据仅来自单块 GPU 上的有限原型，并非通用服务系统。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Adaptive speculative decoding changes the active batch size B and draft length d from one decode step to the next, whereas a CUDA Graph replays a fixed launch configuration. The resulting verification width M = B d forces serving systems to pre-capture many shapes, capture new ones on the serving path, or pad every step to the largest draft. We present PolyGraph, a plan-buffer mechanism for custom Triton kernels that avoids this choice. PolyGraph captures one maximum-grid graph and writes the active shape to GPU memory before each replay. Kernels skip tiles beyond that shape, while graph topology, allocations, layouts, pointers, and launch grids remain fixed; the update transfers only 28 bytes. On one NVIDIA H800, a trace-driven prototype with Qwen2.5-3B dimensions replaces 64 shape-specific graphs with one, matches the warmed baseline in observed step latency (17.7 vs. 17.8 ms P50), and reduces measured pre-serving graph-build time from 3,915 to 93 ms. Fixed-draft controls show that the benefit comes from avoiding padded payload: the P99 difference from MaxPad is negligible at zero padding waste but reaches an 18.7% reduction at 100% waste. Our evidence establishes a bounded work-shape mechanism for custom kernels, not a production serving system, and is limited to synthetic traces on one GPU.

    中文

    自适应推测解码会在相邻解码步骤之间改变活动批次大小 B 和草稿长度 d，而 CUDA 图会重放固定的启动配置。因此，验证宽度 M = B d 迫使服务系统预先捕获许多形状、在服务路径上捕获新形状，或将每一步填充至最大草稿长度。我们提出 PolyGraph，这是一种用于自定义 Triton 内核的计划缓冲机制，可避免这种取舍。PolyGraph 捕获一个最大网格图，并在每次重放之前将活动形状写入 GPU 内存。内核会跳过超出该形状的瓦片，同时图拓扑、分配、布局、指针和启动网格保持固定；每次更新仅传输 28 字节。在一块 NVIDIA H800 上，使用 Qwen2.5-3B 尺寸的跟踪驱动原型将 64 个特定形状的图替换为一个，在观测到的单步延迟上与预热基线相当（P50 为 17.7 毫秒，对比 17.8 毫秒），并将测得的服务前建图时间从 3,915 毫秒降至 93 毫秒。固定草稿长度的对照实验表明，收益来自避免填充负载：当填充浪费为零时，P99 与 MaxPad 的差异可以忽略；当填充浪费为 100% 时，降幅达到 18.7%。我们的证据确立了一种面向自定义内核的有界工作形状机制，而非生产级服务系统；证据范围仅限于单块 GPU 上的合成跟踪。

    SAGE-CP: When Marginal Coverage Hides Route-Conditional Failures in Adaptive VLM Ensembles

    SAGE-CP：当边际覆盖率掩盖自适应 VLM 集成中的路径条件失败

    Mushir Akhtar, M. Tanveer

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    SAGE-CP calibrates adaptive VLM ensemble outputs separately by routing path, establishing finite-sample route-conditional coverage and measuring the reliability and efficiency tradeoffs. This is a substantial contribution to adaptive computation and routing in model systems; its coverage and benchmark results do not directly advance interpretability, composition, or reasoning.

    SAGE-CP 按路由路径分别校准自适应 VLM 集成的输出，建立有限样本的路径条件覆盖率，并衡量可靠性与效率之间的权衡。这是对模型系统中的自适应计算和路由的一项重要贡献；其覆盖率和基准结果并未直接推进可解释性、组合能力或推理。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Adaptive VLM ensembles save computation by stopping early on easy images and escalating harder ones. Although a single conformal threshold can make the final predictor marginally valid, it can still fail severely along individual computational routes. We characterize this failure precisely: if a route has prevalence pi, marginal 1-alpha coverage allows its conditional coverage to fall to max{0, 1-alpha/pi}. To address this mismatch, we learn the router on development data, freeze all routing choices, and calibrate the returned score separately for early exits and escalated inputs. We call this pipeline SAGE-CP. Its calibration step applies Mondrian split conformal prediction to the operational groups created by the router. Under exchangeability, the resulting prediction sets achieve finite-sample coverage within each route. Across 10 benchmarks, 4 frozen VLMs, and 5 aligned splits, both global calibration and SAGE-CP achieve 0.900 marginal coverage at a 0.90 target, but their route behavior differs substantially. SAGE-CP raises mean worst-route coverage from 0.623 to 0.887 and reduces the mean route-coverage gap from 0.324 to 0.025, using the same routed scores and 1.177 source calls per image. The stronger guarantee increases the mean prediction-set size from 1.893 to 2.212; nevertheless, the sets remain smaller than those of the full ensemble (2.486) while requiring 70.6 percent fewer source calls. The route-level reliability persists across 6 fixed query fractions, while finer exit-depth groups demonstrate the need for additional calibration data on rare routes. Across 5 datasets, SAGE-CP also reduces measured batch-one latency by 58.8 to 63.4 percent and gross GPU energy by 55.7 to 57.5 percent relative to full inference. Thus, routing provides computational savings, while route-stratified calibration attaches coverage guarantees to the operational paths created by the router.

    中文

    自适应 VLM 集成通过对简单图像提前停止、对较难图像升级处理来节省计算。尽管单个保形阈值可以使最终预测器在边际上有效，但它仍可能在个别计算路径上严重失效。我们精确刻画了这种失效：若某条路径的出现比例为 pi，边际覆盖率 1-alpha 允许其条件覆盖率降至 max{0, 1-alpha/pi}。为解决这种不匹配，我们在开发数据上学习路由器，冻结所有路由选择，并分别对提前退出和升级处理的输入校准返回分数。我们将这一流程称为 SAGE-CP。其校准步骤对路由器创建的实际运行分组应用 Mondrian 分割保形预测。在可交换性假设下，由此得到的预测集可在每条路径内实现有限样本覆盖率。在 10 个基准、4 个冻结 VLM 和 5 个对齐划分上，全局校准和 SAGE-CP 在目标为 0.90 时都达到 0.900 的边际覆盖率，但路径表现差异显著。使用相同路由分数和每张图像 1.177 次源调用，SAGE-CP 将最差路径的平均覆盖率从 0.623 提高到 0.887，并将平均路径覆盖率差距从 0.324 降至 0.025。更强的保证使平均预测集大小从 1.893 增至 2.212；尽管如此，这些预测集仍小于完整集成的预测集（2.486），同时所需的源调用次数减少了 70.6%。在 6 个固定查询比例下，路径级可靠性依然成立；而更细的退出深度分组则表明，稀有路径需要更多校准数据。在 5 个数据集上，相较完整推理，SAGE-CP 还将实测批次大小为 1 时的延迟降低 58.8% 至 63.4%，将 GPU 总能耗降低 55.7% 至 57.5%。因此，路由能够节省计算，而按路径分层的校准则为路由器创建的实际运行路径附加覆盖率保证。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    PARADE's main contribution is reusable demographic LoRA modules that can be recombined to generalize to unseen attribute combinations, a substantial contribution to compositional architecture. Its survey-simulation application does not provide evidence about model internals or reasoning mechanisms; on-demand module composition gives a more limited systems connection.

    PARADE 的主要贡献是可复用的人口统计 LoRA 模块，这些模块能够重新组合，从而泛化到未见过的属性组合，对可组合架构作出了重要贡献。其调查模拟应用没有提供有关模型内部机制或推理机制的证据；按需组合模块与系统的关联较为有限。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as simulated respondents in computational social science, yet accurately reproducing population-specific heterogeneous response distributions remains challenging. Existing methods such as demographic prompting are sensitive to prompt design and increase inference overhead, while parameter-based methods struggle to reuse demographic information efficiently, limiting generalization to unseen combinations. In this regard, we propose PARADE, a composable PARAmetric DEmographic injection framework that represents each demographic attribute value with a reusable and composable LoRA module. Specifically, PARADE separates task-common survey capability from demographic-specific value shifts via a shared Task LoRA and attribute-level Demographic LoRAs, with composition calibration to reduce parameter interference. At inference time, target population models can be constructed on demand by recombining the relevant modules, including demographic combinations not observed during training. Extensive experiments on the World Values Survey and SocioBench across three backbone models show that PARADE achieves strong population-level distribution alignment while maintaining competitive predictive performance, reducing KL divergence by up to 52.8% relative to the strongest baseline.

    中文

    大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用作计算社会科学中的模拟受访者，但准确复现特定人群的异质性回答分布仍然很有挑战。人口统计提示等现有方法对提示设计敏感，且会增加推理开销；基于参数的方法则难以高效复用人口统计信息，限制了其对未见组合的泛化能力。为此，我们提出 PARADE，即一种可组合的参数化人口统计注入框架，它用可复用、可组合的 LoRA 模块表示每个人口统计属性值。具体而言，PARADE 通过共享的 Task LoRA 和属性级 Demographic LoRAs，将任务共有的调查能力与特定人口统计值带来的偏移分离，并通过组合校准来减少参数干扰。在推理时，可以按需重新组合相关模块来构建目标人群模型，包括训练期间未见过的人口统计属性组合。在 World Values Survey 和 SocioBench 上使用三种骨干模型进行的大量实验表明，PARADE 在保持有竞争力的预测性能的同时，实现了强劲的人群级分布对齐；相较于最强基线，KL 散度最高降低了 52.8%。

    DUET: Decoupled Upper- and Lower-Body Execution for Task-Agnostic Humanoid Loco-Manipulation

    DUET：面向任务无关类人机器人移动操作的上身与下身解耦执行

    Kapalik Khanal, Biswash Khatiwada, Stephen Afrifa, Fan Wu, and Ramesh Bahadur Bist

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    DUET's main contribution is a modular robot-control framework that lets independently trained locomotion and manipulation policies operate together, with locomotion retained when the manipulation policy changes. This provides substantial insight into modular agent systems and a partial connection to composing reusable controllers, but the abstract does not establish broader compositional generalization or model reasoning.

    DUET 的主要贡献是一种模块化机器人控制框架，使独立训练的移动策略和操作策略能够协同工作，并在操作策略改变时保留移动控制能力。这为模块化智能体系统提供了重要见解，也与可复用控制器的组合有一定关联，但摘要并未证明其具有更广泛的组合泛化能力或模型推理能力。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Changing a humanoid robot's manipulation policy should not require retraining the controller that maintains the robot's balance. This study introduces DUET, a decoupled execution framework that enables locomotion and manipulation controllers to operate simultaneously by combining their commands only at the robot interface. A reinforcement-learning locomotion policy controls the 12 leg joints and a waist yaw joint, tracking planar velocity, turning rate, and pelvis height from deep crouching to upright standing on a 23-degree-of-freedom Unitree G1. The 10 arm joints are excluded from the action space, while their positions and velocities are included only as observations, so that any compatible manipulation policy that generates arm-joint targets can control the upper body, and the locomotion policy keeps the lower body stable without requiring shared training or direct coordination. This study demonstrates the modular approach on hardware by pairing the same locomotion checkpoint with two different vision-language-action models, GR00T N1.7 and pi0.5. In simulation evaluation, the locomotion controller kept the robot's lower body stable with no falls while tracking the commanded planar velocity, yaw rate, and pelvis height with errors of 0.186 m/s, 0.142 rad/s, and 0.016 m, respectively. Ablation studies identify the upper-body pose curriculum as the dominant component, and removing this training step reduces episode survival from 20.0 to 7.4 seconds and increases the fall rate to 6.06 per environment minute. Robustness tests show no falls under pushes of up to 1.0 m/s within the trained payload range, and no falls at twice the payload limit for pushes below 0.7 m/s. These results show that a manipulation policy can be exchanged without retraining, restarting, or otherwise touching the layer that keeps the robot upright.

    中文

    更换类人机器人的操作策略，不应要求重新训练维持机器人平衡的控制器。本研究提出 DUET，这是一种解耦执行框架，仅在机器人接口处组合移动控制器和操作控制器的指令，使二者能够同时运行。一个强化学习移动策略控制 12 个腿部关节和一个腰部偏航关节，在 23 自由度的 Unitree G1 上跟踪平面速度、转向速率和骨盆高度，涵盖从深蹲到直立站立的姿态。10 个手臂关节被排除在动作空间之外，其位置和速度仅作为观测输入，因此任何能生成手臂关节目标的兼容操作策略都可以控制上身，而移动策略则无需共享训练或直接协调即可保持下身稳定。本研究通过将同一个移动策略检查点与两个不同的视觉-语言-动作模型 GR00T N1.7 和 pi0.5 配对，在硬件上展示了这种模块化方法。在仿真评估中，移动控制器在跟踪命令指定的平面速度、偏航速率和骨盆高度时，保持机器人下身稳定且没有摔倒；相应误差分别为 0.186 m/s、0.142 rad/s 和 0.016 m。消融研究指出，上身姿态课程是起主导作用的组成部分；移除这一步训练会使单回合存活时间从 20.0 秒降至 7.4 秒，并使每环境分钟的摔倒率升至 6.06 次。鲁棒性测试表明，在训练过的负载范围内，面对最高 1.0 m/s 的推力不会摔倒；负载达到限制的两倍时，面对低于 0.7 m/s 的推力也不会摔倒。这些结果表明，更换操作策略时，无需重新训练、重启，或以其他方式触动保持机器人直立的控制层。

    Latent Multimodal Memory Reasoning

    潜在多模态记忆推理

    Cai Ke, Xinghao Chen, Yuanchen Bei, Yuni Lai, Keyu Chen, Ruizhi Qiao, Siyu An, Junnan Dong, Ruifeng Xu, Xing Sun

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    LMMR uses a shared sparse-autoencoder concept space to organize multimodal memories and a graph encoder to aggregate temporal and cross-modal dependencies for agent responses. This gives a substantial contribution to memory systems and representation structure, with compositional and reasoning relevance through its memory graph, though the abstract does not establish those as the central advance.

    LMMR 使用共享的稀疏自编码器概念空间来组织多模态记忆，并通过图编码器聚合时间依赖关系和跨模态依赖关系，以生成智能体回答。这对记忆系统和表征结构作出了重要贡献，其记忆图也与组合和推理有关，但摘要并未将这些内容确立为核心进展。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Long-term personalized agents are required to reason over distributed history across modalities and evolving dialogue states. While existing flat cross-modal methods compress visual evidence prematurely and struggle with temporally stale observations, they neglect the necessity to unify multimodal and cross-session evidence. Crucially, raw multimodal memories are inherently entangled and heterogeneous, making fine-grained visual grounding and cross-modal reasoning computationally prohibitive. To this end, we present latent multimodal memory reasoning, i.e., LMMR, a novel neuro-symbolic framework that shifts long-term multimodal memory organization into a continuous latent space. Specifically, (i) instead of converting images to text and relying on static retrieval, LMMR maps both textual hidden states and visual patch features into a shared Sparse Autoencoder concept space, establishing sparse activations as common semantic addresses to dynamically construct a turn-level multimodal memory graph. (ii) A graph encoder then aggregates cross-modal and temporal dependencies across the task-specific latent subgraph, injecting the graph readout as a continuous residual rollout into the generation backbone while retaining native visual tokens to preserve fine-grained details. Extensive experiments on nine Mem-Gallery tasks and twelve MemEye settings demonstrate that LMMR significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in capturing complex multimodal dependencies while enabling faithful and grounded responses.

    中文

    长期个性化智能体需要对跨模态分散的历史信息以及不断变化的对话状态进行推理。现有的扁平跨模态方法会过早压缩视觉证据，也难以应对时间上过时的观测，同时忽视了统一多模态证据与跨会话证据的必要性。关键问题在于，原始多模态记忆本身高度纠缠且异质，使细粒度视觉定位和跨模态推理在计算上难以承受。为此，我们提出潜在多模态记忆推理，即 LMMR，这是一种将长期多模态记忆组织转移到连续潜在空间中的新型神经符号框架。具体而言，(i) LMMR 不将图像转换为文本并依赖静态检索，而是将文本隐藏状态和视觉图像块特征映射到共享的稀疏自编码器概念空间，把稀疏激活作为共同的语义地址，以动态构建轮次级多模态记忆图。(ii) 随后，图编码器在任务特定的潜在子图上聚合跨模态和时间依赖关系，将图读出作为连续残差展开注入生成骨干网络，同时保留原生视觉词元以维持细粒度细节。在九项 Mem-Gallery 任务和十二种 MemEye 设置上的大量实验表明，LMMR 在捕捉复杂多模态依赖关系方面显著优于最先进的基线，同时能够生成忠实且有依据的回答。

    Ruochen Zhao, Jiazheng Kang, Gezi Li, Dongying Lin, and Ting Bai

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    EMMA builds event-aligned hierarchical video memory and uses collaborative agents to retrieve evidence across hours of content, substantially advancing memory and retrieval system design. It supports long-video question answering, but the abstract gives no specific reasoning mechanism or compositional generalization contribution; event segmentation alone is incidental to composition.

    EMMA 构建事件对齐的分层视频记忆，并利用协作智能体从数小时的内容中检索证据，对记忆和检索系统设计作出了重要推进。它支持长视频问答，但摘要没有给出具体的推理机制或组合泛化贡献；仅有事件分割与组合的关联较为间接。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Long video understanding requires reasoning over hours of content that far exceed the context window of multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Existing approaches compress video into fixed-length clips, yet events are fragmented and unrelated content is merged, yielding noisy retrieval. To overcome this challenge, we propose EMMA, an Event-driven Multimodal Memory system with Multi-Agent retrieval, which organizes memory around semantic events in three stages: (1) Event segmentation: a dual-stream detector adaptively locates event boundaries by fusing visual semantic drift with spoken transitions, rather than fixed windows. (2) Memory construction: built on the detected events, a three-level hierarchy of raw video, clip-level memory, and event-level memory stores content at progressively higher semantic abstraction. (3) Memory retrieval: a multi-agent framework collaboratively queries this hierarchy through query decomposition, tiered search, evidence validation, and answer generation, narrowing evidence from coarse events to precise clips. Extensive experiments on three challenging benchmarks demonstrate substantial improvements, showing the effectiveness of our event-aligned memory system. Code, prompt templates, and reproduction scripts are available at https://github.com/BAI-LAB/EMMA.

    理解长视频需要对数小时的内容进行推理，而这些内容远超多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）的上下文窗口。现有方法将视频压缩为固定长度片段，但事件会被切碎，无关内容也会被合并，导致检索结果嘈杂。为解决这一挑战，我们提出 EMMA，即一种基于多智能体检索的事件驱动多模态记忆系统，它分三个阶段围绕语义事件组织记忆：(1) 事件分割：双流检测器融合视觉语义变化与语音转折，自适应地定位事件边界，而不是使用固定窗口。(2) 记忆构建：基于检测到的事件，构建由原始视频、片段级记忆和事件级记忆组成的三级层次结构，以逐步提高的语义抽象层级存储内容。(3) 记忆检索：多智能体框架通过查询分解、分层搜索、证据验证和答案生成，协同查询这一层次结构，将证据范围从粗略事件逐步缩小到精确片段。在三个具有挑战性的基准上进行的大量实验表明，性能显著提升，验证了这种事件对齐记忆系统的有效性。代码、提示模板和复现实验脚本见 https://github.com/BAI-LAB/EMMA。

    InJePA: Intention-First Latent Planning with Coupled JEPA World Models for Visual Navigation

    InJePA：基于耦合 JEPA 世界模型的视觉导航意图优先潜在规划

    Siming Zhou, Bowen Ma, Ruiran Du, Pengcheng Zheng, Sheng Zheng, Dongshen Han, Zhijie Li, Wei Dong, Fan Mo, Chaoning Zhang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    InJePA uses predicted latent consequences to guide stepwise intention and action construction for visual navigation, making planning and iterative reasoning its central contribution. Its shared latent space does not by itself reveal internal mechanisms or compositional generalization, while the world-model architecture offers a more limited systems contribution.

    InJePA 利用预测的潜在后果引导视觉导航中意图和动作的逐步构建，因此规划和迭代推理是其核心贡献。共享潜在空间本身并不能揭示内部机制或组合泛化能力，而世界模型架构对系统的贡献相对有限。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Visual navigation requires goal directed planning informed by predictions of environment dynamics. Representative navigation world model methods propose complete action candidates before predicting consequences for selection or search updates. For each candidate, predictions primarily evaluate proposed actions rather than guide its stepwise construction. To this end, we propose InJepa, an intention first planning paradigm centered on latent states. A goal conditioned JEPA proposes latent intentions, and an action conditioned JEPA continually predicts future latent states. Both operate in a shared latent space to align their predictive representations. Within each candidate, predicted consequences feed into the next intention proposal and action inference, forming a closed loop of intention, action, and consequence. This extends the world model's role beyond evaluation to leading candidate construction through latent intentions. We evaluate InJepa through closed loop image goal navigation in Habitat MP3D. The results show effective multistep navigation through intention guided action generation and consequence feedback. Experiments across encoders further support applicability across visual representations. These findings support latent intentions as the central planning object and show that world models can directly guide plan construction through coordinated reasoning about intentions and consequences. Code is available at https://github.com/zhuxun132/InJepa.

    中文

    视觉导航需要由环境动态预测支持的目标导向规划。典型的导航世界模型方法会先提出完整的动作候选，再预测其后果以供选择或更新搜索。对于每个候选，预测主要用于评估已提出的动作，而非引导其逐步构建。为此，我们提出 InJepa，一种以潜在状态为核心的意图优先规划范式。目标条件 JEPA 提出潜在意图，而动作条件 JEPA 则持续预测未来潜在状态。二者在共享潜在空间中运行，以对齐其预测表征。对于每个候选，预测后果会反馈到下一步意图提议和动作推断中，形成由意图、动作和后果构成的闭环。这使世界模型的作用超越评估，通过潜在意图引导候选方案的构建。我们在 Habitat MP3D 中通过闭环图像目标导航评估 InJepa。结果表明，通过意图引导的动作生成和后果反馈，该方法能够有效进行多步导航。跨编码器实验进一步表明，该方法适用于不同视觉表征。这些发现支持将潜在意图作为规划的核心对象，并表明世界模型能够通过对意图和后果进行协同推理，直接引导规划构建。代码见 https://github.com/zhuxun132/InJepa。

    EgoVine: Post-Training with Branching Experience Compiled from Real-World Videos

    EgoVine：利用真实世界视频编译的分支式经验进行后训练

    Qinchuan Cheng, Bowen Lyu, Zhantao Gong, Angela Yao, Cheston Tan, Shijie Li

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    EgoVine trains planners through branching experience, consequence prediction, recovery from failed attempts, and iterative policy updates. This substantially advances planning and learning from alternative action sequences, with long-horizon task compositions as an explicit focus; the abstract does not study internal representations or mechanisms.

    EgoVine 通过分支式经验、后果预测、从失败尝试中恢复以及迭代策略更新来训练规划器。这显著推进了基于替代动作序列进行规划和学习的能力，并明确关注长时程任务组合；摘要没有研究内部表征或机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Real-world egocentric videos capture multi-step household procedures, but their recorded trajectories leave alternative actions and recovery from the learner's own mistakes largely unexplored. We introduce EgoVine, a post-training framework that turns a fixed demonstration set into interactive experience for long-horizon planning. EgoVine operates in executable symbolic environments compiled from real-world video annotations, where an agent must coordinate object manipulations under partial observation and account for delayed consequences. Restoring a decision state allows the learner to explore alternative actions and compare their eventual outcomes. Union jointly trains action generation and consequence prediction in one model, using the same executions to supervise candidate comparison and recovery. Verified repairs add recovery targets from failed attempts, while comparisons among sampled continuations guide policy updates. The updated planner then returns to the environments, with its own decisions and mistakes shaping the next round of experience. On a shared benchmark, EgoVine-1.5B achieves 81.8% success on Main planning tasks and 66.7% on longer task compositions, outperforming all evaluated Flash LLM baselines on both. EgoVine connects real demonstrations to an iterative learning process that trains compact planners on choices and futures beyond the recorded trajectories.

    中文

    真实世界的第一人称视频记录了多步家务流程，但其中记录的轨迹几乎没有探索替代动作，也没有展现学习者从自身错误中恢复的过程。我们提出 EgoVine，这是一种后训练框架，可将固定的演示集转化为用于长时程规划的交互式经验。EgoVine 在根据真实世界视频标注编译而成的可执行符号环境中运行，智能体需要在部分观测下协调物体操作，并考虑延迟后果。恢复到某个决策状态后，学习者便能够探索替代动作，并比较这些动作最终产生的结果。Union 在一个模型中联合训练动作生成和后果预测，并利用相同的执行过程来监督候选方案比较和恢复。经验证的修复方案会为失败尝试提供恢复目标，而对采样得到的后续过程进行比较则用于指导策略更新。更新后的规划器随后重新进入这些环境，其自身的决策和错误会影响下一轮经验。在一个共享基准上，EgoVine-1.5B 在 Main 规划任务上的成功率达到 81.8%，在更长的任务组合上达到 66.7%，两项成绩均超过所有受评估的 Flash LLM 基线。EgoVine 将真实演示与迭代学习过程连接起来，使紧凑型规划器能够学习记录轨迹之外的选择及其后续结果。

    Jingxiang Guo, Haoyu Zhao, Xidong Zhang, Yuhang Zheng, Hao Wu, Chen Gao, Jianshu Zhou, Shuicheng Yan, Weihao Yuan

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    UMI-WM contributes an action-conditioned world model with cross-view information exchange and a faster distilled student for bimanual manipulation. The application context includes coordinated actions, but the abstract does not establish compositional generalization or reasoning as a contribution.

    UMI-WM 对双手操作提出了一种动作条件世界模型，模型通过跨视图信息交换进行协作，并提供了一个速度更快的蒸馏学生模型。应用场景包含协同动作，但摘要并未证明其对组合泛化或推理作出了贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) pairs wrist-camera videos with camera trajectories and gripper openings, providing scalable, robot-free data for learning how bimanual actions change a shared scene. Existing interactive world models, however, typically rely on text or single-camera control and struggle to follow each arm's actions while maintaining consistency between the two wrist views. We introduce UMI-WM, an action-conditioned bimanual world model that jointly generates both wrist views from observation history, per-arm relative camera poses, and gripper widths, with cross-view consistency, action following, and visual fidelity. UMI-WM injects each arm's actions into its own wrist stream, while sparse hub tokens exchange scene information between the two streams. Camera-aware geometry conditioning and camera-guided noise further support per-view motion control and cross-view geometric exchange. We adapt the model for block-causal generation and distill the 30-step Teacher into a Student with four denoising steps. We train UMI-WM on self-collected open-world and in-studio UMI recordings combined with public manipulation data. To evaluate action following, we use an inverse dynamics model (IDM) to recover relative camera poses and gripper widths from generated videos, and introduce Bimanual Action Fidelity (BAF) to measure how closely these recovered actions match the conditioning actions. UMI-WM achieves the best results on all five reference-video fidelity metrics and the best or competitive performance on VBench and WorldArena. The Teacher and Student outperform all compared baselines in action following, while the four-step Student generates paired wrist videos 6.9 times faster than the Teacher.

    中文

    通用操作接口（UMI）将腕部相机视频与相机轨迹和夹爪开合度配对，为学习双手动作如何改变共享场景提供了可扩展的免机器人数据。然而，现有交互式世界模型通常依赖文本或单相机控制，难以跟随每只手臂的动作，同时保持两个腕部视图之间的一致性。我们提出 UMI-WM，这是一种动作条件双手世界模型，能够根据观测历史、每条手臂的相对相机位姿以及夹爪开合度联合生成两个腕部视图，并兼顾跨视图一致性、动作跟随和视觉保真度。UMI-WM 将每只手臂的动作注入其自身的腕部视频流，同时通过稀疏枢纽词元在两条视频流之间交换场景信息。感知相机的几何条件和相机引导噪声进一步支持逐视图运动控制和跨视图几何信息交换。我们调整模型以进行块因果生成，并将 30 步 Teacher 蒸馏为仅需四步去噪的 Student。我们使用自行采集的开放环境和工作室 UMI 记录以及公开操作数据训练 UMI-WM。为评估动作跟随能力，我们使用逆向动力学模型（IDM）从生成视频中恢复相对相机位姿和夹爪开合度，并提出双手动作保真度（BAF），用于衡量恢复的动作与条件动作的匹配程度。UMI-WM 在全部五项参考视频保真度指标上取得最佳结果，并在 VBench 和 WorldArena 上取得最佳或具有竞争力的表现。Teacher 和 Student 在动作跟随方面均优于所有对比基线，而四步 Student 生成成对腕部视频的速度是 Teacher 的 6.9 倍。

    Your Self-Supervised Projection Head Captures Object Co-Occurrence Statistics

    你的自监督投影头捕捉了物体共现统计规律

    Arthur Aubret, Jochen Triesch, C\'eline Teuli\`ere

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper identifies how SSL representations divide semantic categories and object co-occurrences between the backbone and projection head, and shows that controlling co-occurrence changes category-level learning. This is a substantial mechanistic contribution to representation structure; co-occurrence structure is relevant context for composition, but the abstract does not study composing constituents or generalization.

    该论文揭示了 SSL 表征如何在骨干网络和投影头之间分别编码语义类别与物体共现关系，并表明控制共现关系会改变类别级学习过程。这对表征结构的机制研究作出了重要贡献；共现结构与组合有关，但摘要并未研究如何组合组成成分或实现泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) has achieved impressive success in learning semantic visual representations, yet the underlying principles driving this success remain underexplored. In this work, we hypothesize that common SSL pretext tasks implicitly model object co-occurrence statistics, a fundamental cue for visual learning. To test this, we curate three datasets of segmented objects from existing vision benchmarks using a state-of-the-art segmentation model. Through experiments across many SSL models, we reveal a hierarchical encoding of semantic information: while the visual backbone captures object categories, the projection head specializes in encoding co-occurrences between object categories. As a result, the projection head outperforms the backbone in aligning with human judgments of inter-category similarity. Furthermore, by controlling co-occurrence patterns during pre-training, we demonstrate that encoding object co-occurrences can significantly accelerate the emergence of category-level representations. Our findings uncover a previously hidden learning principle in SSL and suggest a path toward designing more effective pretext tasks by explicitly leveraging object co-occurrence structure.

    自监督学习（SSL）在学习语义视觉表征方面取得了令人瞩目的成功，但推动这一成功的底层原理仍未得到充分探索。在本研究中，我们假设常见的 SSL 前置任务隐式建模了物体共现统计规律，而这是视觉学习的一项基本线索。为检验这一假设，我们使用最先进的分割模型，根据现有视觉基准整理了三个分割物体数据集。通过在多种 SSL 模型上的实验，我们揭示了语义信息的层次化编码方式：视觉骨干网络捕捉物体类别，而投影头则专门编码物体类别之间的共现关系。因此，在与人类对类别间相似性的判断进行对齐时，投影头优于骨干网络。此外，通过在预训练期间控制共现模式，我们证明，编码物体共现关系能够显著加快类别级表征的形成。我们的发现揭示了 SSL 中一个此前隐藏的学习原理，并为显式利用物体共现结构来设计更有效的前置任务提供了方向。

    miniTE：诊断并弥合原生 NVFP4 强化学习中的执行差距

    Zhen Li, Mingfa Feng, Yiming Zhang, Yang Yu, Changhai Zhou, Pengxiang Li, Dongkuan Wu, Congkai Xie, Hongxia Yang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper diagnoses cross-engine numerical inconsistency and introduces execution alignment and low-bit kernels to make LLM reinforcement learning more stable and efficient. This is a substantial systems contribution; RL is the setting, but the abstract does not claim insight into reasoning mechanisms or capability development.

    该论文诊断了跨引擎数值不一致问题，并引入执行对齐和低比特内核，使 LLM 强化学习更加稳定高效。这是一项重要的系统贡献；虽然论文以 RL 为应用场景，但摘要没有声称揭示推理机制或能力发展的规律。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Native NVFP4 promises to accelerate reinforcement learning (RL) for large language models (LLMs), but achieving stable learning across separate training and sampling engines remains challenging. We show that matching model weights and numerical formats is insufficient to ensure consistent policy evaluation, highlighting the importance of cross-engine numerical execution. We introduce miniTE, a lightweight framework that combines execution diagnostics, cross-engine numerical alignment, and efficient native W4A4 (4-bit weights and activations) GEMM computation for LLM RL. It improves numerical execution consistency without modifying the RL objective, while reducing implementation overhead to realize the benefits of native low-bit computation. Long-horizon RL experiments on Qwen3-30B-A3B demonstrate stable training and benchmark performance close to BF16, outperforming naive Transformer Engine (TE) NVFP4 in evaluation quality. On single NVIDIA B300 GPU node, the optimized learner reaches 33,540 tokens/s, yielding 1.39x and 1.47x the throughput of BF16 and TE NVFP4, respectively, for complete learner updates. We released the framework, kernels, diagnostics, and training configurations to make native low-bit RL easier.

    原生 NVFP4 有望加速大型语言模型（LLM）的强化学习（RL），但要在独立的训练引擎和采样引擎之间实现稳定学习仍然很有挑战。我们表明，模型权重和数值格式相匹配，并不足以确保策略评估一致，这凸显了跨引擎数值执行的重要性。我们提出 miniTE，这是一个轻量级框架，结合了执行诊断、跨引擎数值对齐以及面向 LLM RL 的高效原生 W4A4（4 位权重和激活）GEMM 计算。该框架无需修改 RL 目标函数即可提高数值执行一致性，同时降低实现开销，从而发挥原生低比特计算的优势。基于 Qwen3-30B-A3B 的长时程 RL 实验表明，该框架能够实现稳定训练，基准测试性能接近 BF16，且评估质量优于直接使用 Transformer Engine（TE）NVFP4 的方案。在单台 NVIDIA B300 GPU 节点上，优化后的学习器吞吐量达到 33,540 tokens/s；就完整学习器更新而言，其吞吐量分别是 BF16 和 TE NVFP4 的 1.39 倍和 1.47 倍。我们已发布该框架、内核、诊断工具和训练配置，以便更轻松地开展原生低比特 RL。

    Factorization-Guided Training and Inference for Diffusion-Drafted Speculative Decoding

    面向扩散模型起草的推测解码的因式分解引导训练与推理

    Jiakun Fan, Min Xiao, Qiang Wang, Neiwen Ling, Zhichao Liu, Zhihao Jia, Dimitrios S. Nikolopoulos, Zijun Wei

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    DScout factorizes speculative-decoding training loss and inference throughput to guide drafter design and configuration, improving inference speed across models and workloads. Its main contribution is an algorithmic advance in inference computation, warranting a strong Systems score; faster decoding alone does not establish progress on reasoning or compositional generalization.

    DScout 对推测解码的训练损失和推理吞吐量进行因式分解，以指导起草器设计和配置，从而提升不同模型和工作负载下的推理速度。其主要贡献是推理计算方面的算法进展，因此系统方面的贡献显著；仅凭解码加速并不能证明推理能力或组合泛化取得了进步。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference through parallel verification of tokens proposed by a drafter. Diffusion drafters further parallelize proposal generation, but greater proposal capacity or higher mean accepted tokens (MAT) need not yield higher throughput. Because verification accepts only a consecutive prefix, early rejections can render later correct predictions ineffective, limiting MAT gains, while even higher MAT may not improve throughput if per-round latency increases. We introduce DScout, which uses two complementary factorizations to guide diffusion drafter training and inference for higher throughput. For training, DScout factorizes position-wise loss into inclusion, weighting, and prediction loss. This guides the design and combination of mixed-horizon training, intra-block unmasking, and acceptance-weighted loss to align supervision with prefix acceptance and improve MAT. For inference, DScout factorizes throughput as the ratio of MAT to per-round latency, guiding target-conditioning depth, drafter depth, and inference block size selection to identify a high-throughput configuration for each workload. Across six benchmarks, DScout achieves $3.84\times$ and $4.14\times$ mean speedups over autoregressive decoding on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B, respectively, improving mean speedup over the state-of-the-art baseline by 9.1% and 7.1%. Across models and concurrency settings, our inference configuration policy provides up to 9.75% additional mean speedup over DScout's fixed configuration.

    中文

    推测解码通过并行验证由起草器提出的词元来加速大型语言模型推理。扩散起草器进一步实现提议生成的并行化，但更大的提议容量或更高的平均接受词元数（MAT）未必会带来更高的吞吐量。由于验证只接受连续前缀，早期拒绝会使后续正确预测失去作用，从而限制 MAT 的提升；即使 MAT 更高，如果每轮延迟增加，也未必能提高吞吐量。我们提出 DScout，利用两种互补的因式分解来指导扩散起草器的训练和推理，以提高吞吐量。在训练方面，DScout 将逐位置损失分解为纳入损失、加权损失和预测损失。这为混合时域训练、块内解掩码和接受加权损失的设计与组合提供指导，使监督与前缀接受对齐并提升 MAT。在推理方面，DScout 将吞吐量分解为 MAT 与每轮延迟之比，并据此指导目标条件深度、起草器深度和推理块大小的选择，从而为每种工作负载找出高吞吐量配置。在六个基准测试中，DScout 在 Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3-8B 上相较于自回归解码取得 $3.84\times$ 和 $4.14\times$ 的平均加速比；与最先进的基线相比，平均加速比提升了 9.1% 和 7.1%。在不同模型和并发设置下，我们的推理配置策略相较于 DScout 的固定配置，平均加速比最高可再提升 9.75%。

    Beyond Prediction: A Component-Level Study of Concept Recovery in In-Context Learning

    超越预测：对上下文学习中概念恢复的组件级研究

    Xufeng Liu, Fang Wan, Yi Liu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces controlled component-level interventions to diagnose what concepts LLMs recover from demonstrations, revealing systematic gaps and transfer across composition forms. This substantially advances analysis of internal concept recovery and compositional learning, while its connection to broader reasoning is secondary and it does not study model systems.

    本文引入受控的组件级干预，用于诊断 LLM 从示例中恢复了哪些概念，并揭示了系统性差距以及跨组合形式的迁移。这显著推进了对内部概念恢复和组合学习的分析；其与更广义推理的联系较为次要，且没有研究模型系统。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    In-context learning (ICL) enables language models to make accurate predictions from demonstrations, but prediction success alone does not reveal the extent to which the underlying concept has been recovered. Existing evaluations typically assess recovery at the level of the whole concept, making it difficult to identify which components are recovered and to separate model limitations from ambiguity in the demonstrations. We introduce a component-level framework for concept recovery that decomposes concepts into their defining components and uses controlled structural interventions to evaluate both component-level and whole-concept recovery under identifiable demonstrations. Across four instruction-tuned LLMs and three composition forms, we find that models often achieve high prediction accuracy despite poor whole-concept recovery, with systematic over-specification of relevant attributes and level constraints. Individual structural components are generally insufficient for whole-concept recovery, whereas jointly specifying complementary components, particularly relevant attributes and their level constraints, substantially improves recovery. However, this improvement is fragile: a single plausible but unnecessary level constraint can substantially disrupt recovery. Finally, joint supervision of recovery and implicit prediction substantially improves recovery while preserving prediction performance, with the learned capability transferring across composition forms. Overall, our component-level analysis provides a more diagnostic view of what models recover from demonstrations than the existing holistic view.

    中文

    上下文学习（ICL）使语言模型能够根据示例做出准确预测，但仅凭预测成功无法揭示底层概念在多大程度上得到了恢复。现有评估通常在完整概念层面衡量恢复情况，因此难以识别哪些组件得到了恢复，也难以区分模型局限与示例中的歧义。我们提出一种概念恢复的组件级框架，将概念分解为其定义性组件，并通过受控的结构干预，在示例可识别的条件下评估组件级和完整概念的恢复情况。我们在四个经过指令微调的 LLM 和三种组合形式上发现，尽管完整概念恢复效果不佳，模型往往仍能取得较高的预测准确率，同时系统性地过度指定相关属性和层级约束。单个结构组件通常不足以恢复完整概念，而共同指定互补组件，尤其是相关属性及其层级约束，则会显著改善恢复效果。不过，这种改善并不稳健：单个看似合理但并非必要的层级约束，就可能显著干扰恢复。最后，对恢复和隐式预测进行联合监督，可以在保持预测性能的同时显著改善恢复效果，而且学到的能力能够迁移到不同的组合形式。总体而言，相较于现有的整体视角，我们的组件级分析能更具诊断性地揭示模型从示例中恢复了什么。
