    PeekKV: The First Content Token Already Knows Which Heads Matter

    PeekKV：第一个内容词元已知哪些注意力头至关重要

    Minyoung Go, Yongjun Park

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    PeekKV studies how attention-head activity shifts between prefill and decode, then uses one decode token to allocate KV-cache memory across head groups and tokens. The head analysis is a useful motivation, but the contribution is cache management rather than mechanistic insight into representations or reasoning.

    PeekKV 研究注意力头的活跃情况如何在预填充阶段和解码阶段之间变化，然后利用一个解码词元在注意力头组和词元之间分配 KV 缓存内存。对注意力头的分析提供了有用的动机，但其贡献在于缓存管理，而非对表征或推理机制的洞察。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    The size of the KV cache grows linearly with context length, making it a major memory bottleneck in LLM serving. Motivated by recent progress in identifying the functional roles of attention heads, a growing body of work compresses the KV cache non-uniformly across heads. Existing methods either fix the important heads via offline profiling or select them using attention signals from the prefill stage. In both cases, however, accuracy fluctuates substantially across workloads. While investigating the cause of this instability, we find that the active heads shift between the prefill and decode stages even within a single input. Along the decode path, by contrast, the activehead composition remains stable across content tokens once format tokens are filtered out. Based on this observation, we propose PeekKV. PeekKV observes a single content token immediately after prefill - a one-token peek - to jointly obtain head-group scores and token-importance scores. Guided by these scores, PeekKV allocates KV cache budgets to head groups in proportion to their group scores and retains only the top-scoring tokens within each budget. PeekKV requires no offline profiling or training and thus applies directly to unseen workloads and new models. Across four public benchmarks, PeekKV achieves the highest accuracy in more than half of the per-model comparisons against state-of-the-art methods, and stays closest to the full-cache accuracy on RULER and LongBench. On Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, PeekKV retains 95.7% of the full-cache accuracy at a 10% memory budget on RULER with 16K contexts and 95.9% at a 1.5% budget on LongBench.

    中文

    KV 缓存的大小随上下文长度线性增长，使其成为 LLM 服务中的主要内存瓶颈。受近期识别注意力头功能角色方面进展的启发，越来越多的研究开始按注意力头以非均匀方式压缩 KV 缓存。现有方法要么通过离线分析固定重要注意力头，要么利用预填充阶段的注意力信号来选择注意力头。然而，这两类方法在不同工作负载上的准确率都会大幅波动。在探究这种不稳定性的原因时，我们发现，即使在同一个输入中，活跃注意力头也会在预填充阶段和解码阶段之间发生变化。相比之下，在解码过程中，滤除格式词元后，活跃注意力头的组成在不同内容词元之间保持稳定。基于这一观察，我们提出 PeekKV。PeekKV 在预填充后立即观察一个内容词元，即进行一次单词元窥探，从而联合获得注意力头组得分和词元重要性得分。在这些得分的引导下，PeekKV 按注意力头组得分的比例为各组分配 KV 缓存预算，并在每个预算内仅保留得分最高的词元。PeekKV 无需离线分析或训练，因此可直接应用于未见过的工作负载和新模型。在四个公开基准上，与最先进方法的逐模型比较中，PeekKV 在超过半数的比较中取得最高准确率，并且在 RULER 和 LongBench 上的准确率最接近完整缓存。在 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 上，面对 16K 上下文，PeekKV 在 RULER 上以 10% 的内存预算保留了完整缓存准确率的 95.7%；在 LongBench 上以 1.5% 的预算保留了 95.9%。

    Kangcong Li, Hangfan Zhang, Shuyue Hu, Shengji Tang, Tao Chen

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    ReTTT’s main contribution is an agent adaptation method that revises lessons from interaction feedback and trains an episode-local adapter, including the reflection policy; task-specific memory and multi-step agent behavior are central, but the abstract does not study internal representations or compositional generalization.

    ReTTT 的主要贡献是一种智能体适应方法：它根据交互反馈修订经验教训，并训练仅在当前回合内使用的适配器，其中也包括反思策略。任务专属记忆和多步智能体行为是核心内容，但摘要没有研究内部表征或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    LLM agents accumulate valuable task-specific information through their actions, observations, and environmental feedback during multi-turn task execution. When effectively used, this information can help agents refine subsequent decisions and improve task performance. However, the learning value of an interaction depends on its context and subsequent feedback, making it challenging to extract reliable, actionable lessons and revise them as the task unfolds. In this paper, we introduce ReTTT, which enables experience-driven self-adaptation through test-time training on lessons constructed and continually revised within an episode. ReTTT lets the agent reflect on interaction feedback, maintain the resulting lessons in an explicit memory, and learn from them by updating an episode-local LoRA adapter while keeping the backbone frozen. The adapted model then performs both subsequent actions and reflection, coupling policy adaptation with the construction of future learning experience. We evaluate ReTTT on ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and SWE-bench Lite using two model families. ReTTT outperforms trajectory-based test-time training across all six model--benchmark settings, improving task success by up to 12.14 percentage points. A frozen-reflection comparison further shows a 7.14-point benefit from adapting the reflection policy, while trajectory analysis illustrates how adapted reflection derives more task-specific guidance from failed attempts. These findings suggest that learning to reflect on its own behavior can boost agents' performance on long-horizon tasks.

    中文

    LLM 智能体在执行多轮任务时，会通过自身行动、观察以及环境反馈积累有价值的任务专属信息。有效利用这些信息，可以帮助智能体改进后续决策并提升任务表现。然而，一次交互的学习价值取决于其上下文和后续反馈，因此很难提取可靠、可执行的经验教训，并随着任务进展不断修订。本文提出 ReTTT，通过对在单个任务回合中构建并持续修订的经验教训进行测试时训练，实现基于经验的自适应。ReTTT 让智能体反思交互反馈，将由此得到的经验教训保存在显式记忆中，并在保持骨干网络冻结的同时更新仅在当前回合内使用的 LoRA 适配器，从而从这些经验中学习。适配后的模型随后既执行后续行动，也进行反思，使策略适应与未来学习经验的构建相互结合。我们使用两个模型系列，在 ALFWorld、ScienceWorld 和 SWE-bench Lite 上评估 ReTTT。在全部六种模型与基准组合中，ReTTT 的表现均优于基于轨迹的测试时训练，任务成功率最高提升 12.14 个百分点。与反思策略冻结的对照实验进一步显示，调整反思策略可带来 7.14 个百分点的收益；轨迹分析则展示了适配后的反思如何从失败尝试中提炼出更具任务针对性的指导。这些发现表明，学习反思自身行为能够提升智能体在长时程任务中的表现。

    LatLM: Line-Parallel Language Models with Deferred Commitment

    LatLM：具有延迟承诺机制的并行行语言模型

    Shaorong Zhang, Shiyuan Li, Longxuan Yu, Greg Ver Steeg

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    LatLM introduces adaptive deferred commitment for parallel decoding and reports improved accuracy with fewer rounds when dependencies vary. This advances reasoning through dependency-aware decoding and systems through adaptive computation; composition is incidental to parallel text generation, and the abstract does not study internal representations or mechanisms.

    LatLM 为并行解码引入自适应延迟承诺机制，并报告了在依赖关系各异时以更少轮数提高准确率的结果。这通过依赖关系感知解码推进了推理能力，也通过自适应计算推进了系统设计；组合性只是并行文本生成中的附带特点，摘要没有研究内部表征或机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Line-parallel language models advance multiple lines concurrently for substantial speedups. However, frameworks like the Line-Coupled Language Model (LCLM) enforce a fixed commitment schedule across lines. Because dependencies vary within text, a fixed schedule cannot hold back a line whose prerequisites remain uncomputed, forcing premature commitments and cascading reasoning errors. To address this limitation, we introduce the Lattice Language Model (LatLM), making commitment schedules an adaptive decoding-time choice. Text occupies a 2D lattice where eligible frontier tokens are scored each round; a policy commits confident candidates while deferring unready ones for extended context. One forward pass supervises entire sampled trajectories via 2D causal masking, while an append-only cache retains exact states. At 482M parameters, we establish two findings. (1) LatLM matches a data- and capacity-matched autoregressive model on held-out text when decoded sequentially, while its adaptive parallel decoder achieves near-autoregressive accuracy on independent-line tasks using 25--41% as many decoding rounds. (2) When cross-line dependencies cause LCLM's fixed schedule to fail, deferred commitment substantially improves accuracy while retaining parallelism where dependencies permit. On mixed dependency chains, LatLM achieves 96.5% accuracy versus LCLM's 78.5%, using fewer than half the decoding rounds of the autoregressive baseline.

    中文

    并行行语言模型能够同时推进多行内容，从而大幅加快生成速度。然而，诸如行耦合语言模型（LCLM）之类的框架会对各行强制采用固定的承诺计划。由于文本中的依赖关系各不相同，固定计划无法暂缓尚未计算出前置条件的行，迫使模型过早作出承诺，并引发连锁推理错误。为解决这一局限，我们提出格点语言模型（LatLM），使承诺计划成为解码时自适应选择的内容。文本置于二维格点中，每轮都会对符合条件的前沿词元进行评分；策略会提交置信度高的候选词元，同时将尚未准备好的词元延后，以等待更长的上下文。通过二维因果掩码，一次前向传播即可监督完整的采样轨迹，同时仅追加缓存可保留精确状态。在 482M 参数规模下，我们得到两项发现。（1）顺序解码时，LatLM 在留出文本上的表现与数据量和模型容量匹配的自回归模型相当；其自适应并行解码器在独立行任务上达到接近自回归模型的准确率，所需解码轮数仅为其 25--41%。（2）当跨行依赖导致 LCLM 的固定计划失效时，延迟承诺能在依赖关系允许的地方保留并行性的同时，显著提升准确率。在混合依赖链上，LatLM 的准确率为 96.5%，LCLM 为 78.5%，而 LatLM 所需解码轮数不到自回归基线的一半。

    ENGLISH

    Robotic rearrangement tasks require planning sequences of actions that fulfill high-level specifications while also being geometrically feasible. Symbolic abstractions make the combinatorial structure of rearrangement tasks tractable, but they usually do not fully capture the geometric constraints that determine which actions a robot can actually realize. These constraints are hard to express in the symbolic model. We propose REAP (Rearrangement with Elicited Action Preconditions), a framework in which a relational graph neural network heuristic is learned over a simple symbolic abstraction. A motion planner serves as a supervisor that elicits the hidden geometric preconditions of the problem during training. Deployed with greedy best-first search, the learned heuristic generalizes out-of-distribution along object count, plan length, and object arrangement, and can be trained jointly on several domains. Compared to classical heuristic search and learning-based baselines, REAP solves more problems, requires roughly an order of magnitude fewer motion-planner queries than comparable methods, and the action it ranks first is geometrically feasible in 94% of sampled states, against 22% for a random choice.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Although reinforcement learning (RL) effectively trains Vision-Language Model (VLM) agents, the mechanisms behind these capability gains are poorly understood. Across four diverse agent environments, we investigate whether the task-success gains from multi-turn RL are accompanied by improved grounded visual question answering about the environment. To assess this, we design environment-specific grounded VQA tasks that reveal improvements in grounded visual understanding. Representational probing shows that vision-encoder probe accuracy remains relatively stable, while LLM-layer probe accuracy improves. Attention analysis further reveals that LLM layers pay more attention to visual tokens during RL training. To test whether increased attention to visual tokens contributes to VQA gains, we introduce a lightweight plug-and-play intervention using a fixed attention bias. Without updating model parameters or computing gradients, this intervention partially restores VQA gains on the untrained model. These results reveal better utilization of visual information as a key mechanism behind the gains from RL.

    Lei Tian, Chunzheng Zhu, Kai Wu, Yifan Zhang, Haihua Yang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    PACE analyzes visual-token redundancy and introduces adaptive compression and Pareto-based token budgeting for more efficient native multimodal models. This is a substantial contribution to efficient computation, while its token analysis does not explain internal concepts or mechanisms, and the reported performance gains do not address composition or reasoning.

    PACE 分析视觉词元冗余，并提出自适应压缩和基于帕累托的词元预算分配方法，以提高原生多模态模型的效率。这对高效计算做出了重要贡献；其词元分析并未解释内部概念或机制，报告的性能提升也没有涉及组合性或推理。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Native multimodal large language models (native MLLMs) jointly encode visual and linguistic sequences within a unified autoregressive Transformer, emerging as a promising paradigm for multimodal understanding. Unlike conventional ViT-based MLLMs relying on external vision encoders, ViT-free native MLLMs tokenize pixel patches directly, potentially suffering severe visual token redundancy. A pilot study confirms this: unlike ViT-based models that degrade under compression, ViT-free MLLMs tolerate aggressive compression with near-lossless or even improved performance. Yet existing compression methods target ViT-based settings, leaving native MLLMs, which stand to gain the most, unexplored. To close this gap, we introduce an analysis pipeline centered on token discriminability and cross-dimensional heterogeneous redundancy, revealing that (i) redundancy is distributed independently and heterogeneously along height and width axes, and (ii) early-layer visual tokens are indiscriminable and uniformly redundant. Guided by these findings, we propose PACE (Pareto-Adaptive Compression for Efficient Native MLLMs), the first visual token compression framework tailored for native MLLMs with Multimodal-RoPE. Leveraging dimensional decoupling of positional encoding, PACE decomposes attention into two orthogonal spatial saliency estimates along height and width, gated by a positional attention signal, yielding direction-aware importance with negligible overhead. It further casts token budget allocation as Pareto optimization over performance preservation, inference efficiency, and spatial coverage, jointly identifying optimal compression depths and retention ratios. Experiments show PACE maintains near-lossless performance at only 25%-50% visual token retention, even improving several benchmarks, while delivering over 2x FLOPs reduction.

    原生多模态大语言模型（原生 MLLM）在统一的自回归 Transformer 中联合编码视觉和语言序列，正逐渐成为多模态理解的一种有前景范式。与依赖外部视觉编码器的传统 ViT 架构 MLLM 不同，不使用 ViT 的原生 MLLM 直接对像素块进行词元化，可能存在严重的视觉词元冗余。初步研究证实了这一点：与压缩后性能下降的 ViT 架构模型不同，不使用 ViT 的 MLLM 能够承受激进压缩，且性能几乎无损，甚至有所提升。然而，现有压缩方法针对的是 ViT 架构，尚未探索最有望从中受益的原生 MLLM。为弥补这一空缺，我们提出一套以词元可区分性和跨维异质冗余为核心的分析流程，发现：（i）冗余沿高度轴和宽度轴独立且异质地分布；（ii）早期层的视觉词元无法区分，且冗余均匀。在这些发现的指导下，我们提出 PACE（帕累托自适应压缩），这是首个专为配备 Multimodal-RoPE 的原生 MLLM 设计的视觉词元压缩框架。PACE 利用位置编码的维度解耦，将注意力分解为沿高度和宽度方向的两个正交空间显著性估计，并由位置信号进行门控，从而以极低开销获得方向感知的重要性。此外，它将词元预算分配建模为在性能保持、推理效率和空间覆盖率之间进行帕累托优化，并联合确定最佳压缩深度和保留比例。实验表明，PACE 仅保留 25%-50% 的视觉词元即可维持近乎无损的性能，在多个基准上甚至有所提升，同时将 FLOPs 降低 2 倍以上。

    When a robot possesses more degrees of freedom than a task requires, multiple trajectories can achieve the same objective using distinct motion styles. Compositional robot control aims to preserve a selected style while simultaneously executing an independent task command, effectively balancing these potentially competing objectives. In this paper, we present CODES, a framework for compositional robot control that discovers a coherent style repertoire from diverse recordings and composes it with independent commands. First, motion retargeting maps the recordings to motions executable by the target robot; next, weakly supervised consensus encoding and density-based clustering identify styles within and across recordings without a prescribed count; finally, reinforcement learning trains a policy to compose the discovered styles with independent commands. We evaluate CODES on a Unitree Go2 quadruped across two simulators and physical hardware. Compared to baselines, CODES significantly improves kinematic coherence. Furthermore, our controller successfully tracks velocity commands that generalize beyond the support of the recorded data, exhibiting robust and distinguishable style characteristics during both cross-simulator and real-world hardware deployments.     TWIN-MoE: Two-stage Intra-Expert Imputation Network for Incomplete Multimodal Learning

    TWIN-MoE：用于不完整多模态学习的两阶段专家内插补网络

    Liang Nathan Zheng, Jiyuan Liu, Wenhao Liang, Wei Emma Zhang, Weitong Chen, Lin Yue

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    TWIN analyzes expert-conditioned representation neighborhoods and uses them to bound and improve missing-modality imputation in MoE models. This is a substantial algorithmic contribution to conditional computation and multimodal model systems; its representation analysis serves imputation rather than interpretability, composition, or reasoning.

    TWIN 分析以专家为条件的表征邻域，并利用该分析界定和改进 MoE 模型中的缺失模态插补。这是对条件计算和多模态模型系统的重要算法贡献；其表征分析服务于插补，而非可解释性、组合性或推理。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Recent Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) approaches address missing modalities either by routing each missingness pattern to a dedicated expert, which scales poorly as the number of modalities grows, or by imputing the missing modality from representations contributed by multiple experts, which requires a costly retrieval mechanism. We show that routing induces expert-conditioned representation neighborhoods and derive an imputation-error bound controlled by their local feature dispersion. When these expert-conditioned neighborhoods are more compact than the global representation space, intra-expert aggregation admits a tighter worst-case reconstruction bound than unconstrained global aggregation. Guided by this analysis, we propose TWIN, a two-stage intra-expert imputation framework. Pre-imputation generates a context-conditioned estimate in the encoder embedding space and radially soft-clips it using modality-specific statistics maintained in an observed FIFO queue, this ensures that the pre-imputed modality stays in empirically calibrated region of the target modality space. Post-imputation refines the missing representation after MoE by aggregating expert-conditioned observed representations within the same sample. Across four missing-modality benchmarks under natural, random, and asymmetric dropout protocols, TWIN achieves state-of-the-art performance while using substantially fewer parameters than competing MoE-based imputation methods.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    DKA derives attention from stochastic state dynamics, with theory for bounded evidence, abstention, and safe token discarding while preserving standard attention’s computational cost.     Standard self-attention compares tokens by similarity but does not account for how much of a past state survives to the present. We introduce Dynamical Kernel Attention (DKA), which derives attention from robust estimation of a latent state evolving under stochastic dynamics. As a past state decays toward equilibrium under the dynamics, the information it carries about the present vanishes, bounding the total evidence a head can draw. Unlike recency biases, DKA can abstain when relevant evidence is weak and guarantees a bounded error when old tokens are discarded. DKA preserves the parallel structure and computational cost of standard attention. We present the model and its theory; empirical evaluation is deferred to a subsequent version.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Internal signatures could support monitoring, adaptive computation, and mechanistic analysis, but benchmark prompts can be separable without any shared computational distinction. We treat the \textbf{task} as the unit of inference probes hold out complete tasks, labels are permuted across tasks, and the best layer and stream are reselected for every permutation. Raw probes recover an eight-versus-eight-subject MMLU partition in all five models (macro-F1 $0.78$--$0.81$), but prompt text predicts it nearly as well: under an identical probe configuration, the activation advantage is only $0.017$--$0.070$ macro-F1 and is not significant. Additionally, two released base-training trajectories show no common direction. These pooled layerwise measures recover the task label but identify no transferable knowledge/reasoning signature at the tested sensitivity, which cannot exclude moderate effects.     The Window Is in the Reasoning: When LLM Agents Decide to Follow Prompt Injections

    窗口就在推理过程中：LLM 智能体何时决定遵从提示注入

    Haoxuan Jia, Yang Liu, Bin Chong, Yingguang Yang, Yancheng Chen, Jiayu Liang, Qian Li, Hanning Lu, Kefu Xu, Hao Zheng, Chongyang Zhang, Yulin Huang, Jianshen Zhang, Yongzhi Qi, Yunuo Lin, Hao Peng

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper uses branching rollouts to show that prompt-injection decisions form gradually during agent reasoning, and that thinking changes susceptibility across models; it also evaluates monitors and repeated-run labels. This provides strong empirical insight into reasoning behavior, with a secondary systems connection through agent monitoring; it does not investigate internal representations or compositional generalization.

    本文通过分支式 rollout 表明，提示注入决策会在智能体推理过程中逐步形成，且思考对不同模型的易受攻击程度产生不同影响；论文还评估了监测器和重复运行标签。这为推理行为提供了有力的实证洞见，并通过智能体监测与系统研究有次要关联；它不研究内部表征或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    LLM agents that read untrusted content can be hijacked by prompt injections. Runtime monitors that try to catch a hijack before the agent acts, and benchmarks that score each task with a single run, share an assumption: whether an agent follows an injection is settled when the injection is read. We test this assumption with branching rollouts that replay an episode exactly up to the step at which the agent reads an injection and then resample the rest of the episode many times, splitting the outcome variance into a part fixed at read time and a part decided afterwards. Across four AgentDojo suites, a Qwen3 agent without thinking is largely decided at read time (0.91 of the outcome variance lies between states); with thinking on, this share drops to 0.62 (95% CI of the drop [-0.38, -0.22]), in the same direction for three attack templates and two success labels. How much is fixed at read time is a property of the model that the same measurement reveals, and thinking lowers the attack success rate of Qwen3 but raises it for two other models. Resampling from reasoning prefixes shows that the decision forms gradually as the agent reasons. Zero-shot chain-of-thought monitors built on cheaper models miss much of what is already decided, whereas stronger monitors, and a lookahead monitor that judges simulated next actions, come close to what the prefix determines. Finally, single-run labels of thinking agents disagree with a rerun up to 35% of the time, so benchmarks need repeated runs per task.

    中文

    读取不可信内容的 LLM 智能体可能遭到提示注入劫持。试图在智能体采取行动前捕捉劫持的运行时监测器，以及每项任务只运行一次并据此评分的基准，共享一个假设：智能体是否遵从注入，在读到注入时就已确定。我们通过分支式 rollout 检验这一假设：将一次 episode 精确重放到智能体读到注入的那一步，然后多次重新采样该 episode 的其余部分，从而把结果方差拆分为读入时已确定的部分和此后才决定的部分。在四个 AgentDojo 套件中，不启用思考的 Qwen3 智能体，其结果基本在读入时就已确定（0.91 的结果方差来自状态间差异）；启用思考后，这一比例降至 0.62（下降幅度的 95% CI 为 [-0.38, -0.22]），三个攻击模板和两种成功标签也都呈现相同方向的变化。同一测量还能揭示读入时已有多少结果被确定是模型本身的属性；思考降低了 Qwen3 的攻击成功率，却提高了另外两个模型的攻击成功率。从推理前缀重新采样表明，随着智能体推理，决策会逐步形成。基于较廉价模型构建的零样本思维链监测器会漏掉许多已经确定的内容，而更强的监测器以及判断模拟后续动作的前瞻监测器，其判断结果接近由前缀所决定的结果。最后，思考型智能体的单次运行标签与重新运行的结果最多有 35% 不一致，因此基准需要对每项任务重复运行多次。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper’s main contribution is RoundtableReview, a multi-agent review workflow with specialized roles, deliberation, and voting that improves automated paper review.     本文的主要贡献是 RoundtableReview：一种具有专业角色、审议和投票流程的多智能体评审工作流，可改进自动化论文评审。其智能体协调构成重要的系统贡献；语义槽位和讨论仅与组合性和推理略有关系，论文并未研究这些领域中的机制或能力。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    As automated research is increasingly adopted for writing papers, automated review has become a critical link between paper generation and quality control. However, existing methods largely rely on single-model feedback or simple review aggregation, failing to explicitly model expert responsibilities or collective deliberation in actual peer reviews, which limits effective cross-examination and reliable decision-making. Therefore, we formulate paper review as a computational modeling problem of peer review mechanisms and propose RoundtableReview, a deliberative multi-agent framework for enhancing automated research. RoundtableReview structures each paper into eight semantic slots and coordinates six academic and industry reviewers with complementary perspectives, retrieval sources, and specialized responsibilities. Through independent assessment, cross-examination, roundtable deliberation, dynamically weighted voting, and chair synthesis, the framework generates evidence-based and traceable feedback. Experiments on two automated research backbones show that the method improves paper quality in both backbones and outperforms baselines in automatic and human evaluations with fewer comments.

    LogicVal:A Logic-Formalized Benchmark for Constraint Satisfaction in Text-to-Image Generation

    LogicVal：用于文本到图像生成约束满足的逻辑形式化基准

    Savitha Sam Abraham, Marjan Alirezaie, Hossein Rahnama

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces a logic-formalized benchmark for evaluating whether text-to-image models satisfy individual and composed constraints, and documents sharp performance drops on multiple simultaneous constraints. This directly advances evaluation of compositional generalization; logical reasoning is relevant to the benchmark, but the contribution does not study models’ reasoning mechanisms or improve their reasoning capabilities.

    本文提出一个逻辑形式化基准，用于评估文本到图像模型是否满足单个约束及组合约束，并记录了模型在同时满足多个约束时性能大幅下降。这直接推动了组合泛化评估；逻辑推理与该基准相关，但本文的贡献并未研究模型的推理机制，也未提升其推理能力。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Text-to-Image (T2I) generative models have made significant progress in producing high-fidelity images from natural-language prompts. Alongside this progress, numerous benchmarks have been developed to evaluate capabilities such as attribute binding, numeracy, spatial reasoning, and commonsense reasoning. In this work, we propose a new perspective on T2I evaluation by casting it as a constraint-satisfaction problem. We introduce a logical framework that formally specifies the benchmark domain, including objects, attributes, and relations, alongside the constraints that generated images must satisfy. We evaluated four state-of-the-art T2I models across 9 classes of constraints ranging from a single-object-attribute to multi-object relationships constraints involving logical operators ($\forall, \exists, count, \rightarrow$). Our results reveal a substantial gap between single-object and complex conditional multi-object relationship constraint classes, with the best-performing model achieving 98% accuracy on the former and just 53% on the latter. We assess compositional generalisation, finding that the best-performing model`s accuracy drops from 84% on single-constraint prompts to 20% when satisfying multiple constraints simultaneously. Identifying unsatisfiable constraints is also challenging, with the best model correctly recognizing only 23% of such prompts. Building on this framework, we introduce \textbf{LogicVal}, an evaluation methodology that combines neural visual detection with logical reasoning to assess constraint satisfaction in generated images. On CLEVR, LogicVal achieves ROC-AUC scores ranging from 0.88 to 0.98, indicating strong alignment with human judgments. These findings underscore the value of logic-based evaluation for characterizing T2I model capabilities and limitations.

    随机路由与强化融合的协同：面向多模型推理

    Selim Furkan Tekin, Ling Liu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops uncertainty-aware routing and sequential fusion policies for selecting and combining models, with benchmark gains and reduced policy collapse. Multi-step reasoning is part of the setting, but the contribution centers on routing and system organization rather than reasoning mechanisms or compositional generalization.

    本文开发了具备不确定性感知能力的路由策略和序贯融合策略，用于选择和组合模型，并取得基准性能提升且减少策略坍缩。多步推理是研究场景的一部分，但贡献核心是路由和系统组织，而非推理机制或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    This paper studies dynamic model routing under uncertainty in multimodal settings, where a system must select and potentially compose multiple models to answer a query. Standard reinforcement learning approaches for routing often suffer from premature convergence to suboptimal models due to noisy rewards and insufficient exploration. We propose a unified vision-language framework (VL-Scout) for efficient multimodal and multi-step reasoning with turn-based reinforcement fusion. First, VL-Scout combines Bayesian priors, policy gradient optimization, and sequential decision-making to enable structured exploration and adaptive inference. A context-dependent Dirichlet belief model allows for epistemic uncertainty over model quality and is updated online based on observed rewards and context-specific evidence, enabling Thompson-style exploration while serving as a prior for regularization. Second, a routing policy is trained via a KL-regularized REINFORCE objective by maximizing a reward-weighted evidence lower bound, where the policy acts as an amortized posterior, and the Dirichlet belief serves as a prior. Third, we introduce a fusion policy trained with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) or Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), which operates over intermediate model rationales and selects between two actions: CONTINUE or ANSWER, terminating with a generated output. We evaluate VL-Scout on four representative multi-modal benchmarks (MMMU, MMMU-Pro, OKVQA, and RealWorldQA), compared against 11 representative routing and policy optimization baselines. Our method provides consistent performance improvements while reducing premature policy collapse. These results highlight the importance of integrating uncertainty-aware priors with both amortized policy learning and sequential fusion for robust and efficient model selection in discrete action spaces

    中文

    本文研究多模态场景下的不确定性动态模型路由：系统必须选择并可能组合多个模型来回答查询。标准的路由强化学习方法常因奖励噪声和探索不足而过早收敛到次优模型。我们提出统一的视觉语言框架 VL-Scout，通过轮次式强化融合实现高效的多模态、多步推理。首先，VL-Scout 将贝叶斯先验、策略梯度优化和序贯决策相结合，以实现结构化探索和自适应推断。依赖上下文的 Dirichlet 信念模型能够表示模型质量的认知不确定性，并根据观测到的奖励和上下文特定证据在线更新，从而支持 Thompson 式探索，同时充当正则化先验。其次，通过最大化奖励加权的证据下界，使用 KL 正则化的 REINFORCE 目标训练路由策略；其中策略充当摊销后验，而 Dirichlet 信念充当先验。第三，我们引入一种通过组相对策略优化（GRPO）或可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）训练的融合策略。该策略处理模型的中间推理依据，并从两个动作中选择：CONTINUE 或 ANSWER，最终生成输出。我们在四个具有代表性的多模态基准（MMMU、MMMU-Pro、OKVQA 和 RealWorldQA）上评估 VL-Scout，并与 11 个具有代表性的路由和策略优化基线进行比较。我们的方法持续提升性能，同时减少策略过早坍缩。这些结果凸显出，将具备不确定性感知能力的先验与摊销策略学习及序贯融合结合起来，对于离散动作空间中稳健而高效的模型选择十分重要。

    ENGLISH

    Context-to-LoRA methods encode documents as low-rank parameter updates, allowing language models to answer without retaining the source text in their decoding context. How reliably do these updates preserve facts and support their use under different instructions? Controlled diagnosis of existing context-to-LoRA methods separates fact discrimination, target retention, and response adaptation. Competing sources influence answers, while target-only construction and memory-state optimization improve recovery at fixed update size. Recovering facts also does not ensure that answers follow response instructions. We introduce Cache2LoRA, which uses each query to aggregate evidence from a reusable frozen document cache before generating LoRA updates. Trainable encoding operates only on the query and memory-token suffix, and multi-style supervision teaches both evidence preservation and answer expression. Across 17 tasks, Cache2LoRA improves on existing context-to-LoRA methods and achieves macro F1 of 0.663, approaching full-context in-context learning at 0.671. For 32K documents and 256-token outputs at batch size 16, its decoding throughput is 5.9$\times$ that of full-context ICL. At matched memory size, generated LoRA preserves answer accuracy more reliably than the learned-KV variant under long, diverse intervening text and combines more effectively with retained document KV, yielding higher hybrid F1 and EM.

    Sign language production (SLP) aims to synthesize expressive signing motion from written text. Modeling signing motion presents two key temporal challenges. First, fine-grained hand articulations demand higher temporal resolution than relatively slower body movements. Second, signing events unfold over variable durations, calling for adaptive temporal scheduling during generation. To address these challenges, we first introduce a Multi-Rate Vector Quantizer (MRVQ), an articulation-decoupled motion tokenizer that represents the body and both hands as separate discrete streams at distinct temporal resolutions. Building on this representation, we propose BLANC (BLock-wise Adaptive diffusioN with Articulatory Clock), a gloss-free SLP framework that generates variable-duration motion blocks causally while denoising tokens in parallel within each block. At its core, a Latent Articulatory Clock (LAC) learns temporal structure from multi-scale motion-derived partitions to predict block durations and sequence termination during generation. We further introduce inference-time body-conditioned hand refinement to improve coordination across articulators. Extensive experiments on PHOENIX-2014T and CSL-Daily demonstrate that BLANC achieves state-of-the-art performance in sign language production.

    手语生成（SLP）旨在根据书面文本合成富有表现力的手语动作。对手语动作进行建模面临两个关键的时间挑战。首先，精细的手部动作比相对较慢的身体动作需要更高的时间分辨率。其次，手语事件持续时间各不相同，因此生成过程中需要自适应时间调度。为应对这些挑战，我们首先提出多速率向量量化器（MRVQ），这是一种将关节动作解耦的动作分词器，可在不同的时间分辨率下将身体和双手表示为独立的离散流。在此表示的基础上，我们提出 BLANC（带有关节动作时钟的分块自适应扩散），这是一种无需手语词素的 SLP 框架，能够因果地生成持续时间可变的动作块，并在每个块内并行对 token 进行去噪。其核心是潜在关节动作时钟（LAC），它从多尺度、由动作派生的分区中学习时间结构，以在生成过程中预测动作块持续时间和序列终止时机。我们还提出推理时以身体为条件的手部细化方法，以改善不同关节动作部位之间的协调。在 PHOENIX-2014T 和 CSL-Daily 上进行的大量实验表明，BLANC 在手语生成方面达到了最先进的性能。

    Matthias Beylich, Kirsten I. Tempest, Tobias Selz, George C. Craig

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Intermediate decoding probes latent states across model depth and reveals how processor blocks progressively refine weather forecasts across spatial scales, a substantial interpretability contribution.     中间解码探查模型不同深度的潜在状态，并揭示处理器块如何逐步在不同空间尺度上细化天气预报，这对可解释性作出了实质性贡献。物理一致性和预报准确性属于特定应用领域的发现；摘要没有表明其推进了组合能力、推理或系统设计。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    AI weather prediction models are often regarded as black boxes. Despite their impressive skill, there is little understanding of how the input data is processed during inference to produce the forecast. This limitation arises from the use of high-dimensional latent representations in which individual dimensions are no longer directly interpretable in physical terms. To gain insight into how forecasts are constructed, we propose the method of intermediate decoding for AI weather models and apply it to GraphCast, Aurora and ArchesWeather. In this approach, latent states from intermediate depths are decoded back into meteorological fields. To do this, we use the decoder that has been trained to output the forecast at the end of processing. Since latent states at different depths do not share a consistent basis, we train affine transformations that align intermediate latent states with the decoder's expected input space. Applying this framework to the three models yields the following results. First, the skill of forecasts at intermediate stages of processing improves gradually through the processor layers. Second, bypassing all processor blocks shows that the encoder-decoder pair is not an identity mapping returning the input, but instead plays a significant role in the forecast construction. Third, by examining increments of individual processor blocks across model depth, we show that all three models progressively refine the forecast from coarse to finer spatial scales. Finally, we assess the physical consistency of the intermediate decoding forecasts and find that large scales remain physically balanced throughout processing, while small scales become more balanced with each additional processor block.

    AI 天气预测模型常被视为黑箱。尽管它们预测能力出色，但人们对推理过程中如何处理输入数据以生成预报知之甚少。这一局限源于模型使用了高维潜在表示，其中的单个维度已无法直接从物理角度解释。为深入了解预报的构建过程，我们提出一种适用于 AI 天气模型的中间解码方法，并将其应用于 GraphCast、Aurora 和 ArchesWeather。在这种方法中，我们将模型不同中间深度的潜在状态解码回气象场。为此，我们使用经过训练、用于在处理结束时输出预报的解码器。由于不同深度的潜在状态不共享一致的基底，我们训练仿射变换，将中间潜在状态对齐到解码器预期的输入空间。将这一框架应用于这三个模型后，我们得到以下结果。第一，预报在处理各中间阶段的准确性会随着处理器层的推进而逐步提高。第二，绕过所有处理器块后可以看到，编码器—解码器并非将输入原样返回的恒等映射，而是在预报构建过程中发挥着重要作用。第三，通过考察不同模型深度上各处理器块产生的增量，我们表明，这三个模型都逐步将预报从较粗的空间尺度细化到较精细的尺度。最后，我们评估了中间解码预报的物理一致性，发现大尺度在整个处理过程中始终保持物理平衡，而小尺度则随着每增加一个处理器块而变得更加平衡。

    Zhiyang Wang, Zhishang Luo, Yusu Wang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper analyzes when repeated reuse of a learned local update rule supports graph-size generalization and introduces a parameter-efficient controller, with theoretical conditions and experiments. This strongly advances compositional reuse and adaptive computation; its focus on iterative task solving offers partial relevance to reasoning, but it does not study reasoning mechanisms directly.

    本文分析了重复复用已学习局部更新规则在何种情况下能够支持图规模泛化，并提出一种参数高效的控制器，同时给出理论条件和实验结果。这显著推进了组合复用和自适应计算；其对迭代任务求解的关注与推理有一定关联，但并未直接研究推理机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Generalizing from small graphs to larger ones can require computation beyond the depth of a neural model used during training. We study target tasks that admit a common local iterative computation and whose effective dependency radius grows with graph size. The central idea is to learn a local update rule through GNN pretraining, then repeatedly apply the same learned processor beyond the training depth to extend information reach on larger graphs without retraining. Calling such parameter-shared architecture a \emph{looped GNN}, we categorize six schemes for looped GNNs to separate the effects of depth extension, fine-tuning, and freeze-and-steer adaptation. Our analysis establishes fixed-depth information limits and sufficient conditions under which accurate iterative reuse overcomes them. To improve beyond unadapted reuse, we introduce \emph{Loop-Freeze-Steer} (LFS), which freezes the pretrained processor and learns a small controller to steer its repeated application, using much fewer trainable parameters than full fine-tuning. Our finite-sample analysis gives sufficient conditions for adaptation to improve performance on larger graphs. Experiments on synthetic tasks and chip placement evaluate depth extension and adaptation, highlighting LFS's accuracy--trainable-parameter trade-off for size generalization.

    从小图泛化到更大的图，可能需要超出训练时神经模型深度的计算。我们研究能够采用共同局部迭代计算、且有效依赖半径随图规模增长的目标任务。核心思路是通过 GNN 预训练学习局部更新规则，然后在训练深度之外反复应用同一个已学习的处理器，从而在无需重新训练的情况下扩大其在更大图上的信息传播范围。我们将这种参数共享架构称为\emph{循环 GNN}，并对循环 GNN 的六种方案进行分类，以区分深度扩展、微调以及冻结并引导式适配的作用。我们的分析确立了固定深度的信息限制，并给出了在何种充分条件下，准确的迭代复用能够克服这些限制。为超越未经适配的复用，我们提出\emph{循环—冻结—引导}（LFS）方法：冻结预训练处理器，并学习一个小型控制器来引导其重复应用；与完整微调相比，该方法需要训练的参数少得多。我们的有限样本分析给出了适配能够提升更大图上性能的充分条件。在合成任务和芯片布局任务上的实验评估了深度扩展与适配，并展示了 LFS 在规模泛化中的准确率与可训练参数之间的权衡。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Variable roles describe recurring behaviors such as accumulation, traversal, and retaining the best candidate encountered. We use Sajaniemi's independently defined taxonomy to study which role distinctions can be recovered from large language models, how sparse autoencoders (SAEs) retain those distinctions, and whether associated directions support control of generation. We introduce static annotation rules for all eleven roles and a corpus of 126,926 natural-code files across five languages. Across five model-SAE systems, residual probes outperform individual SAE features and tested lexical baselines, with modest losses after neutral target renaming. Combining SAE features closes much of the single-feature gap, but probes on SAE reconstructions are less sensitive to role-changing edits reviewed by LLMs. High paired ranking accuracy coexists with frequent false positives at fixed thresholds. During generation, interventions often change role annotations at the cost of correctness; changes accompanied by passing tests show no clear aggregate advantage over random controls. The benchmark separates role-related recoverability, SAE fidelity, and correctness-preserving control through matched prediction, source edits, and generation interventions.

    变量角色描述了累加、遍历以及保留迄今遇到的最佳候选项等反复出现的行为。我们采用 Sajaniemi 独立定义的分类体系，研究大型语言模型能够恢复哪些角色差异、稀疏自编码器（SAE）如何保留这些差异，以及相关方向是否支持对生成过程的控制。我们为全部十一个角色引入静态标注规则，并构建了一个包含五种语言中 126,926 个自然代码文件的数据集。在五个模型—SAE 系统中，残差探针的表现优于单个 SAE 特征和所测试的词汇基线；对目标进行中性重命名后，性能仅小幅下降。组合 SAE 特征弥补了单特征的大部分差距，但针对 SAE 重建结果训练的探针对经 LLM 审核、会改变角色的编辑不那么敏感。较高的配对排序准确率与固定阈值下频繁出现的假阳性并存。在生成过程中，干预往往会改变角色标注，但代价是正确性下降；伴随测试通过的变化，相比随机对照并未显示出明确的整体优势。该基准通过匹配预测、源代码编辑和生成干预，分别评估与角色相关的可恢复性、SAE 保真度以及保持正确性的控制能力。

    A Conditional No-Hair Theorem for Transformers: How Language Models Forget Their Prompt

    Transformer 的条件无毛定理：语言模型如何遗忘提示

    Shuyang Xiang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper characterizes prompt information decay in transformers, proves a conditional bound, and supports a dilution-and-relay mechanism with experiments and a solvable model. This substantially advances understanding of internal information flow and model memory, while the abstract does not address compositional generalization or reasoning capability.

    本文刻画了 Transformer 中提示信息的衰减，证明了一个条件界，并通过实验和可解模型支持稀释与接力机制。这显著推进了对内部信息流和模型记忆的理解；摘要没有涉及组合泛化或推理能力。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    We ask how much an autoregressive transformer retains of its prompt after generating $t$ tokens. Consider two different prompts followed by the same continuation text, so that any difference in their hidden states comes from the prompt alone, and we find that the distance between their hidden states decays approximately as a power law $t^{-\alpha}$, where $\alpha=1$ is the rate at which a fixed prompt's share of uniform attention shrinks and smaller values mean longer memory. Trained models forget fast ($\alpha\approx0.55$--$0.7$), untrained ones slowly ($\alpha\approx0.2$--$0.5$). We prove that this offset is $O\big(P(\log t)^{L-1}/t\big)$ for a prompt of length $P$ and depth $L$. The bound holds for finite-depth pre-LN softmax transformers with bounded attention logits, under one additional condition: the pre-norm activations stay away from zero. The mechanism is geometric: the prompt's direct influence is diluted as the context grows, and \emph{relay} --- continuation tokens passing on what earlier tokens read from the prompt --- can only add logarithmic factors. This is what we call the \emph{conditional no-hair theorem}: given the text generated so far, the prompt's influence on the next token vanishes as $t$ grows, so any property of the prompt that survives, such as its language, must be carried by the text itself. An exactly solvable linear relay model shows that the bound cannot be improved and reproduces the rise of the local exponent towards $1$ seen in untrained networks. Cancelling the dilution with a logit bias stops the decay early in training and reverses it after, so dilution is necessary for the forgetting we measure; untrained networks and the solvable model show it is also sufficient.

    中文

    我们研究自回归 Transformer 在生成 $t$ 个 token 后还保留多少提示信息。考虑两个不同的提示，后接相同的续写文本，因此它们隐藏状态中的任何差异都仅来自提示；我们发现，这些隐藏状态之间的距离近似按幂律 $t^{-\alpha}$ 衰减，其中 $\alpha=1$ 表示固定提示在均匀注意力中所占份额的缩减速率，数值越小意味着记忆时间越长。训练过的模型遗忘得很快（$\alpha\approx0.55$--$0.7$），未经训练的模型则遗忘得较慢（$\alpha\approx0.2$--$0.5$）。我们证明，对于长度为 $O\big(P(\log t)^{L-1}/t\big)$、深度为 $P$ 的提示，这一偏移量为 $L$。该界适用于有限深度的 pre-LN softmax Transformer，要求注意力 logit 有界，并额外满足一个条件：pre-norm 激活远离零。其机制是几何性的：随着上下文增大，提示的直接影响被稀释；而\emph{接力}——续写 token 传递先前 token 从提示中读取的信息——最多只能带来对数因子。这就是我们所说的\emph{条件无毛定理}：给定迄今生成的文本，提示对下一个 token 的影响会随着 $t$ 增大而消失，因此任何得以保留的提示属性（例如提示所用的语言）都必须由文本本身承载。一个可精确求解的线性接力模型表明该界无法改进，并复现了未经训练网络中局部指数向 $1$ 上升的现象。用 logit 偏置抵消稀释效应，会在训练早期阻止衰减、在训练后期逆转衰减，因此稀释是我们测得的遗忘现象的必要条件；未经训练的网络和可解模型则表明它也是充分条件。

    Guangya Hao, Yiting Duan, Longyan Tan, Yunbo Long, Hao Wu, Ge Zheng, Alexandra Brintrup, Zhuokai Zhao

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    ESRL uses a population of perturbed policies to generate self-supervision for continual test-time learning and reports gains on reasoning tasks and reduced forgetting. This substantially advances reasoning-related training, while the policy population is a supporting learning design rather than a main contribution about agent organization or model internals.

    ESRL 利用一组经过扰动的策略生成自监督信号，以实现持续测试时学习，并报告了推理任务上的性能提升和遗忘减少。这显著推进了与推理相关的训练；策略群体是支撑学习的设计，而不是关于智能体组织或模型内部机制的主要贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language models increasingly operate in open-ended environments, where they are expected to continually adapt to evolving tasks and distributions, often without access to external supervision. Existing continual learning approaches rely on external supervision, such as labeled data, demonstrations, or reward signals, which can be costly or unavailable in practice. Test-time adaptation removes this dependence by learning from self-generated supervision, but existing methods derive that supervision from the single policy being updated, so once the policy drifts, its own learning signal drifts with it, leading to policy collapse, degraded reasoning, and catastrophic forgetting. In this paper, we propose \textbf{Evolution Strategy Reinforcement Learning (ESRL)}, a continual test-time learning framework that draws its self-generated supervision from a population of policies instead of the single policy being trained. ESRL perturbs an anchor policy in parameter space to form a population of nearby policies, samples one trajectory from each, and aggregates their answers into label-free group-relative learning signals for the central student. The anchor is held fixed within each block and refreshed from the student at block boundaries, so the population stays centered on a stable yet current policy and continues to supply diverse and reliable supervision as the student moves. In single-task test-time adaptation across mathematical reasoning, general knowledge, and medical domains, ESRL improves average accuracy by up to 31.7% relative to the base model and 16.6% relative to the strongest test-time adaptation baseline. Notably, ESRL substantially reduces catastrophic forgetting and achieves the strongest final performance in continual learning.

    中文

    大型语言模型越来越多地运行于开放式环境中，人们期望它们能够持续适应不断变化的任务和数据分布，而且往往无法获得外部监督。现有持续学习方法依赖外部监督，例如带标签的数据、示范或奖励信号，而这些在实践中可能成本高昂或无法获取。测试时适配通过从自生成监督中学习，消除了这种依赖；但现有方法从正在更新的单个策略中获取监督，因此策略一旦发生漂移，其学习信号也会随之漂移，从而导致策略崩溃、推理能力下降和灾难性遗忘。本文提出\textbf{进化策略强化学习（ESRL）}，这是一种持续测试时学习框架，它从一组策略而非正在训练的单个策略中获取自生成监督。ESRL 在参数空间中扰动一个锚定策略，形成一组相近的策略；从每个策略中采样一条轨迹，并将它们的答案聚合为无标签、相对组内表现的学习信号，供中心学生模型使用。锚定策略在每个区块内保持固定，并在区块边界处根据学生模型刷新，因此该策略群始终以一个稳定但与当前状态相符的策略为中心，随着学生模型变化持续提供多样且可靠的监督。在数学推理、常识知识和医疗领域的单任务测试时适配中，相较于基础模型，ESRL 的平均准确率最高提升 31.7%；相较于最强的测试时适配基线，最高提升 16.6%。值得注意的是，ESRL 大幅减少了灾难性遗忘，并在持续学习中取得最高的最终性能。

    Hyunwoo Ryu, Eric Ming Chen, Max Wilcoxson, Vincent Sitzmann

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Mirror learns inverse dynamics through environment interaction and self-improvement, advancing how an embodied agent converts visual plans into actions. This is a strong agent-system contribution; planning is relevant to reasoning, but the abstract centers on plan execution rather than reasoning mechanisms.

    Mirror 通过与环境交互和自我改进来学习逆动力学，推进了具身智能体将视觉计划转化为动作的能力。这是对智能体系统的重大贡献；规划与推理相关，但摘要聚焦于计划执行，而非推理机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Video generative models are an emerging tool for embodied agents: they can serve as scalable visual planners, generating videos that depict how to complete previously unseen tasks. However, executing these plans typically requires a video-to-action or "inverse dynamics" model trained on large, human-collected video-action datasets, severely limiting scalability. We introduce Mirror, a self-supervised approach that learns video-to-action mappings through environment interactions, without prior action data or hand-crafted rewards. Mirror learns by attempting to follow a visual plan by executing its best guess of the underlying actions in the environment. Mirror then trains on the resulting video-action pairs, incrementally self-improving and following the visual planner more closely. Across Atari, OGBench, and DeepMind Control, Mirror outperforms leading learning-from-observation methods with learned video plans, and achieves near-expert performance with oracle plans. On Minecraft BASALT, it outperforms methods with access to expert actions or hand-engineered task knowledge. In Minecraft survival, it is the first method to acquire an iron pickaxe through self-improvement alone, without rewards or expert action labels. In the offline setting, with expert action labels but no environment interaction, it sets a new state of the art in obtaining diamonds. Our results suggest that advances in video models can translate into increasingly capable agents without a corresponding need for hand-crafted rewards or large collections of expert action data.

    BSIT decouples child-node sampling from parent states to broaden trajectory exploration and improve inference-time search under sparse rewards.     Tree-based samplers offer a compelling alternative for scalable inference-time search, bypassing the per-step reward and gradient dependencies that introduce systematic bias into SMC-style frameworks. Despite this advantage, contemporary tree samplers fail to achieve broad exploration. Their reliance on learned, DDPM-like transitions inherently couples neighbor states in a trajectory, thereby restricting child-parent feature divergence in the tree sampler. Consequently, these samplers suffer from restricted coverage of the target marginal distribution, severely hindering the exploration critical for efficient search under sparse reward. To overcome these limitations, we introduce a simple yet effective Bootstrap Stochastic Interpolant Tree (BSIT) sampler that decouples child node generation from explicit parent dependencies. By expanding the degrees of freedom during child node sampling, BSIT encourages diverse trajectory rollouts and unlocks broader path-space diversity-the exact catalyst needed for efficient exploration. Crucially, we show that BSIT's improved exploration accelerates convergence to the target distribution while achieving broader distributional coverage than samplers that rely on DDPM-like transitions for child-node generation, all without incurring additional function evaluations or reward feedback, thereby providing a highly efficient basis for rare target search. Extensive experiments across diverse search settings, including rare-species discovery and target-aligned molecule generation tasks, demonstrate BSIT's superior search efficiency over the baselines.

    Mohammad Hossein Amani, Leonardo Bocchieri, Maxime Peyrard, Cl\'ement Hongler, Robert West

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper derives an estimator that propagates policy gradients through generated history and uses a control variate to reduce variance, addressing credit assignment in sequential reasoning and decision tasks. Its main contribution is an algorithmic advance for training policies, not a study of internal representations or composition.

    本文推导出一种能够通过生成历史传播策略梯度、并利用控制变量降低方差的估计器，以解决序列推理和决策任务中的信用分配问题。其主要贡献是策略训练算法的改进，而非对内部表示或组合能力的研究。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Policy gradients for autoregressive sequence models differentiate each token's log-probability while holding the conditioning history fixed. This discards information about how earlier decisions shape later conditional distributions, creating a credit-assignment bottleneck when rewards are sparse. We introduce History-Reparameterized (HR) policy gradients, which replace the frozen prefix in the score function with a differentiable reparameterized or relaxed history, allowing gradients of downstream log-probabilities to propagate backward through the generated trajectory. The resulting history-pathwise term is generally biased when added directly, so we derive Optimal HR (OHR), a centered control-variate estimator with a closed-form coefficient that minimizes the trace of the gradient variance at the population level. The variance reduction is governed by temporal structure in the policy dynamics: random or weakly structured policies provide little benefit, while policies with learned sequential dependencies yield informative history-pathwise corrections. For discrete tokens, the choice of relaxation is crucial: embedding-level relaxation yields substantial variance reduction that grows with horizon, whereas straight-through Gumbel-Softmax yields essentially none in our diagnostics. We validate the method on a Gaussian linear Markov model, a sparse-reward T-maze with a recurrent policy, and an autoregressive Transformer model for small Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP) instances.

    SURE-Act 利用反事实行动结果训练控制器，使其决定使用工具的智能体应当行动、收集信息还是请求介入，从而推动了智能体决策系统的发展。基准测试上的提升与不确定性下的推理相关，但摘要对一般推理机制或组合能力的阐述有限。

    ENGLISH

    Tool-using LLM agents repeatedly face decision points under uncertainty, choosing between autonomous action, additional information gathering, and human escalation. These decisions require balancing task success against interaction cost and the risk of irreversible errors. Learning to make these trade-offs is challenging because existing interaction trajectories record only the outcomes of actions taken, leaving the consequences of alternative actions unobserved. To address this gap, we construct a counterfactual dataset containing 3,115 action outcomes from 1,036 decision points in ToolSandbox. At each decision point, we execute each legal action and evaluate its downstream outcomes based on task completion, interaction cost, and irreversible errors. Using this dataset, we train SURE-Act, a controller that selects actions for a frozen backbone agent at inference time. Our experiments show that learning to rank alternative actions improves offline action-selection utility by 0.0309 over a regression-only baseline. We further show that adding SURE-Act enables end-to-end gains of up to 0.0575 in ToolSandbox's Overall Score with the Qwen3-4B agent. Moreover, SURE-Act outperforms adapted decision rules from SAGE-Agent and Calibrate-Then-Act by 0.1506 and 0.1438, respectively. This work establishes the first counterfactual dataset for ToolSandbox and provides actionable insights into decision-making under uncertainty for tool-using agents.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

This is a substantial contribution to agent-system design; planning and iterative repair are related, but reasoning and composition are not the paper’s central focus.

    ENGLISH

    A coding agent combines a large language model (LLM) with a harness that plans, edits, and executes code. We study Cortex, a supervisory layer for pre-execution governance, requirement tracking, and iterative validation and repair. We formalize requirement closure on a finite lattice. For a fixed requirement set and a sound, monotone validation rule with persistent evidence, exhaustive iteration reaches the least fixed point with no more strict increases than there are requirements. Fair consequence scheduling reaches the same closure. A separate stochastic model bounds expected completion time under a uniform positive-progress assumption. These results depend on their stated assumptions; artifact repair, fallible validation, and finite execution budgets do not satisfy them automatically. We define Gauntlet's trajectory-similarity and build-gated scores, attack-success estimators, Wilson intervals, and case-cluster bootstrap summaries. Effective-feedback accounting counts newly certified requirements, rather than estimating their information value or utility. The five evaluation families support raw-versus-governed comparisons. We report retained benchmark observations, including rescoring of existing artifacts; constructed outcomes are excluded. Unequal observation sets and incomplete provenance prevent causal claims about governance or measured long-horizon scaling.

    SPIDES: Information-Flow Control for Browser Agents

    SPIDES：浏览器智能体的信息流控制

    Egor Zverev, Juhee Kim, Leon Trampert, Boris K\"opf, Aashish Kolluri, Shruti Tople, Santiago Zanella-B\'eguelin

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    SPIDES contributes an information-flow control design that gates browser-agent actions using propagated confidentiality and integrity labels, with a benchmark evaluation. This substantially advances agent security and action organization, but does not study model reasoning or internal mechanisms.

    SPIDES 提出了一种信息流控制设计，利用传播得到的机密性和完整性标签来管控浏览器智能体的操作，并对其进行了基准测试评估。这显著推动了智能体安全和行动组织方面的发展，但没有研究模型推理或内部机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Browser agents automate complex workflows by reading and acting on arbitrary page content, but this flexibility exposes them to prompt injection attacks and unintended data exfiltration. Recent work argues that LLM-driven browser agents erode traditional web security boundaries such as the Same-Origin Policy (SOP) by acting across origins with the user's authority and no built-in isolation. We argue that restoring SOP is neither sufficient (a same-origin public sink can leak private data) nor necessary (legitimate tasks require authorized cross-origin flows) for protecting the security of users. We propose SPIDES, which instead enforces information-flow control by gating primitive browser actions such as typing, clicking and navigating on labels propagated from element-level HTML confidentiality and integrity annotations. Untrusted and confidential content is masked from the agent's context, while policies block unauthorized flows, providing security guarantees against both prompt injection and data exfiltration that hold independently of the model driving the agent. To evaluate SPIDES and baseline defenses under a common threat model, we build MicroNet, a closed ecosystem of 28 interlinked websites with element-level ground-truth labels and paired benign/adversarial tasks. SPIDES achieves 0% attack success rate by design while retaining high task completion rate and autonomy. Our findings demonstrate that information-flow control is an effective technique to extend web security to browser agents, gaining on autonomy and utility against state-of-the-art baselines. The source code and data are openly accessible at https://github.com/microsoft/SPIDES.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    Search-augmented language models increasingly serve as long-horizon research agents, yet most open training methods assume a fixed user goal throughout search. We study mid-response steering, where users redirect a model during ongoing reasoning or retrieval. We identify answer-target anchoring, a failure mode in which fixed-query search agents retrieve evidence for the updated request but still answer an earlier question. We introduce SteerSearch, an RL framework that trains on interactive search trajectories with injected interventions to enable context-preserving target reassignment, and SteerSearch-Bench, a benchmark adapted from multi-hop QA datasets. We also investigate Contrastive Context Reward (CCR), an auxiliary signal for aligning post-intervention reasoning with the updated goal. Without CCR, SteerSearch improves average steering accuracy over Search-R1 from 11.1% to 31.3% on Qwen2.5-3B and from 36.6% to 44.6% on Qwen3-4B, while preserving standard single-query performance.     Inducing Fourier Geometry: A Smoothness Prior Imposes Approximate Translation Equivariance in Multimodal Stellar Embeddings

    诱导傅里叶几何：平滑先验在多模态恒星嵌入中施加近似平移等变性

    Ilay Kamai, Alex M. Bronstein, Hagai B. Perets

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper shows that a smoothness prior induces Fourier-like geometry and approximate translation equivariance in multimodal representations, with empirical evidence across stellar surveys and downstream benefits. This is a substantial contribution to representation geometry, while the application and performance gains do not establish contributions to composition, reasoning, or model systems.

    本文表明，平滑先验能够诱导类傅里叶几何和近似平移等变性，并在多个恒星巡天数据上提供了实证支持，也带来下游收益。这是对表征几何的重要贡献；应用场景和性能提升并不能证明其在组合能力、推理或模型系统方面有所贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Learned representations often contain geometric structure induced by symmetries in the underlying data. We ask whether a known continuous parameter space can instead be used to \emph{induce} such structure when the corresponding symmetry is only approximate. We introduce a graph-Laplacian smoothness prior that encourages representations to vary smoothly over a physical parameter space without specifying a representation geometry; in the continuum limit it selects Laplacian eigenfunctions and therefore predicts the Fourier-like geometry associated with translation symmetry. On multimodal stellar representations spanning six astronomical surveys, the prior induces Toeplitz Gram structure and sinusoidal modes along stellar parameters, including in modalities whose native representations lack this geometry, while modality-specific residuals preserve structure outside the imposed coordinates. Of the exact-symmetry predictions, stationarity in a recoverable warped coordinate survives; diagnostics assuming exact quantization or asymptotic rates do not. The prior also improves downstream linear-probe performance and label efficiency, suggesting a general strategy: where a meaningful continuous parameter space exists, its local geometry can serve as a data-informed prior.

    学习得到的表征往往包含由底层数据对称性所诱导的几何结构。我们探究：当相应对称性只是近似成立时，能否利用已知的连续参数空间来“诱导”这种结构。我们提出一种图拉普拉斯平滑先验，鼓励表征沿物理参数空间平滑变化，而不预先指定表征几何；在连续极限下，该先验会选择拉普拉斯特征函数，从而预测与平移对称性相关的类傅里叶几何。在涵盖六项天文巡天的多模态恒星表征上，该先验沿恒星参数诱导出 Toeplitz Gram 结构和正弦模式；即使某些模态的原生表征并不具备这种几何结构，也能实现这一点，同时模态特定的残差会保留强加坐标之外的结构。在精确对称性预测中，可恢复的扭曲坐标中的平稳性依然成立；而假设精确量化或渐近速率的诊断则不成立。该先验还能提升下游线性探针的表现和标签效率，提示了一种通用策略：只要存在有意义的连续参数空间，其局部几何就可以作为一种由数据提供信息的先验。

On tau2-bench it scores highest with weak users for both models, by a small margin for Qwen3.5-4B.

    Multi-agent LLM systems exchange messages before acting through tools, but message delivery, signing authority, and tool-side enforcement are separate trust boundaries. We represent them as communication, authorization, and execution structures, and use the authority cut to characterize the smallest independently compromised signer coalition that can construct a policy-valid false-claim proof under stated assumptions. Controlled paired hidden-state studies reveal four distinctions. First, no fixed-message routing contrast across four models meets the prespecified large-effect criterion; when relays rewrite messages, executed false-state action rates vary by model and route configuration. Second, presented source-identity cues do not uniformly increase protected-action selection across three models. Third, on invalid-proof cases, Nemotron and Llama request protected actions in 52.1% and 54.2% of trials, respectively, yet a deterministic tool gate commits none: request-level and commitment-level safety readouts diverge. Finally, a separate single-model authorization check shows that a false claim with a policy-valid compromised-signer proof can pass the gate, since proof validity is not factual truth. These findings motivate evaluating delivered information, qualified authorization, model proposals, and committed actions separately.

    RATION：迈向面向 AI 智能体的定量风险访问控制

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    RATION proposes and evaluates an agent access-control framework that tracks accumulated task risks and adjusts enforcement to preserve utility, a substantial contribution to agent systems. Complex task execution is context rather than a study of reasoning mechanisms, and the abstract offers no substantive connection to interpretability or compositional generalization.

    RATION 提出并评估了一种智能体访问控制框架，它追踪累积的任务风险并调整执行策略，以保持效用，对智能体系统作出了重要贡献。复杂任务执行只是背景，并非对推理机制的研究；摘要也未实质涉及可解释性或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    AI agents increasingly interact with external environments to complete complex user tasks. These interactions can lead to unexpected behavior and expose agents to security threats such as indirect prompt injection. Current agent security systems largely protect agents by restricting their actions, which can result in a substantial security-utility trade-off for complex, open-ended tasks. To address this, we propose a quantitative risk-based approach to access control for AI agents that regulates measurable risks accumulated during task execution. As a concrete realization of this approach, we introduce RATION, a security framework that tracks measurable risks associated with agent actions and enforces quantitative constraints throughout execution. RATION first constructs a task-specific policy by combining explicit constraints derived from the user request with implicit risks calibrated from historical executions of similar tasks. During task execution, RATION continuously tracks the accumulated risks and applies different enforcement strategies depending on the type of risk. Extensive experiments on four security benchmarks show that RATION provides strong security while maintaining high task utility across diverse models and environments.

    AI 智能体日益频繁地与外部环境交互，以完成复杂的用户任务。这些交互可能导致意外行为，使智能体面临间接提示注入等安全威胁。当前的智能体安全系统主要通过限制智能体的行动来保护它们；对于复杂、开放式任务，这可能造成显著的安全性与效用之间的权衡。为解决这一问题，我们提出一种面向 AI 智能体的定量风险访问控制方法，对任务执行期间累积的可测量风险进行管理。作为该方法的具体实现，我们提出 RATION，这是一种安全框架，用于追踪与智能体行动相关的可测量风险，并在整个执行过程中强制实施定量约束。RATION 首先将用户请求中推导出的显式约束，与根据类似任务历史执行记录校准的隐式风险相结合，构建任务专属策略。在任务执行期间，RATION 持续追踪累积风险，并根据风险类型采用不同的执行策略。在四个安全基准上的大量实验表明，RATION 在不同模型和环境中均能提供强安全性，同时保持较高的任务效用。

    FlashRT-PAI: Fast Kernels Are Not Fast Pipelines for Physical AI Inference

    FlashRT-PAI：快速内核不等于快速流水线——面向物理 AI 推理

    Liang Su, David Chen, Jason Li, Kevin Guo, Teresa Lv

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    FLASHRT-PAI contributes pipeline co-design mechanisms for faster physical-AI inference, including kernel fusion, cross-decision state reuse, and persistent-state snapshots, with substantial measured speedups. Its focus is systems organization and computation; application success rates do not establish reasoning or interpretability contributions.

    FLASHRT-PAI 提出了用于加速物理 AI 推理的流水线协同设计机制，包括内核融合、跨决策状态复用和持久状态快照，并取得了显著的实测加速效果。其重点在于系统组织与计算；应用成功率并不能证明其对推理或可解释性作出了贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Vision-language-action (VLA), video-action (VA), and world action models (WAMs) form the backbone of modern physical AI systems, yet their real-time single-batch inference remains a defining bottleneck. Latency is dominated not by individual kernel computation, but by system-level overhead: thousands of short kernel launches, intermediate data movement across operator boundaries, and redundant recomputation across consecutive decisions. General-purpose graph compilers cannot address these costs, as they optimize individual calls in isolation and lack visibility into cross-call state semantics and global pipeline structure. We present FLASHRT-PAI, a low-latency inference engine built around model-hardware pipeline co-design rather than isolated kernel optimization. FLASHRT-PAI combines three core mechanisms: deep kernel fusion with launch overlap eliminates inter-operator boundaries and launch gaps; an execution contract formalizes the pipeline's stage DAG, update rates, and named buffers to enable cross-decision state reuse and selective refresh; and execution-state capsules enable fast snapshot, restore, and fork of persistent pipeline state. The system also supports drop-in acceleration of unmodified PyTorch models via parity- and latency-gated kernel replacement. Evaluation covers six policies on RTX 5090 and four on Jetson AGX Thor. At matched 16-bit precision, FLASHRT-PAI is 1.3-3.7x faster than official compiled paths. Combining pipeline co-design with reduced precision delivers 3.38-12.66x speedup over official eager implementations. In LIBERO-10, four-bit pi0.5 achieves 94.04% success on Thor and 93.32% on RTX 5090, compared with 92.4% for the measured official FP16 reference. FLASHRT-PAI is open source, distributed via Hugging Face Kernel Hub, and its opt-in pi0.5 kernels have been adopted into the LeRobot framework.

    中文

    视觉-语言-动作（VLA）、视频-动作（VA）和世界动作模型（WAM）构成了现代物理 AI 系统的骨干，但其实时单批次推理仍是一个关键瓶颈。延迟的主要来源并非单个内核的计算，而是系统级开销：数千次短内核启动、跨算子边界的中间数据传输，以及连续决策之间的冗余重计算。通用图编译器无法解决这些开销，因为它们孤立地优化单次调用，无法了解跨调用的状态语义和全局流水线结构。我们提出 FLASHRT-PAI，这是一种围绕模型与硬件流水线协同设计构建的低延迟推理引擎，而非仅优化孤立内核。FLASHRT-PAI 结合了三种核心机制：深度内核融合与启动重叠消除算子间边界和启动间隙；执行契约形式化描述流水线的阶段 DAG、更新速率和命名缓冲区，以支持跨决策状态复用和选择性刷新；执行状态胶囊则支持对持久流水线状态进行快速快照、恢复和分叉。该系统还支持通过受数值一致性和延迟门控的内核替换，为未经修改的 PyTorch 模型提供即插即用的加速。评估涵盖 RTX 5090 上的六种策略和 Jetson AGX Thor 上的四种策略。在精度均为 16 位的情况下，FLASHRT-PAI 比官方编译路径快 1.3-3.7 倍。将流水线协同设计与低精度结合后，相较官方 eager 实现可获得 3.38-12.66 倍的加速。在 LIBERO-10 上，四位 pi0.5 在 Thor 上的成功率为 94.04%，在 RTX 5090 上为 93.32%，而实测的官方 FP16 参考结果为 92.4%。FLASHRT-PAI 采用开源方式发布，通过 Hugging Face Kernel Hub 分发，其可选用的 pi0.5 内核已被 LeRobot 框架采用。

    Koi: Evidence-Guided, Self-Calibrating Planning for Multi-Cloud, Heterogeneous LLM Inference Fleets

    Koi：面向多云异构 LLM 推理集群的证据引导、自校准规划

    Mankeerat Sidhu, Gangmuk Lim, Hetarth Chopra, Maximillian Eisenberg, Quan Hao Ng, Aryan Gosaliya, Shu Liu, Luka Govedi\v{c}, Jiaxin Shan, Hongkuan Zhou, Vikram Sharma Mailthody, P. Brighten Godfrey, Ion Stoica

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Koi combines an LLM hierarchy with deterministic planning tools and a causal deployment playbook to optimize heterogeneous inference fleets, achieving better goodput and cost. Planning and composing job configurations provide partial reasoning and compositional insight, while the main contribution is a model-serving system; the causal graph concerns deployment behavior, not internal model mechanisms.

    Koi 将 LLM 层级、确定性规划工具和因果部署方案手册结合起来，以优化异构推理集群，从而提升良好吞吐量并降低成本。规划并组合各作业配置体现了一定的推理和组合能力，但其主要贡献是模型服务系统；因果图描述的是部署行为，而非模型内部机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Deploying a large language model (LLM) requires choosing the right accelerator, parallelization strategy, engine configuration, and replica count amongst ~140 other variables across clouds, regions, and markets. These decisions are intertwined, and the best cluster-wide plan continually changes as jobs contend for shared capacity on shifting workloads. We present Koi, a self-calibrating cluster planner for heterogeneous, multi-cloud fleets. Koi uses a Recursive Language Model (RLM) hierarchy to propose hypotheses and reason over deployment while deterministic components predict serving behavior, score candidates, and control placement. It represents inference behavior as a fixed causal graph linking decisions (e.g., accelerator, parallelism), runtime mediators (e.g., KV-cache pressure, communication overhead), and outcomes (e.g., latency, throughput). Each deployment strengthens or weakens scoped causal relationships, building a comprehensive playbook for inference that the planner employs to guide future decisions. Job-wise configurations are composed into cluster-wide plans and evaluated against serving objectives, resource constraints, SLO risks, and cost. Across benchmarks, Koi achieves 1.18x greater goodput than the strongest baseline while reducing $/token by 20% in a real heterogeneous cluster. Ablations isolate the contribution of Koi's architecture: a pure language model attains a composite score of 35.3, the same model equipped with Koi's deterministic tools reaches 51.6, and the full Koi planner reaches 70.8.

    中文

    部署大型语言模型（LLM）需要在云、区域和市场之间，从约 140 个其他变量中选择合适的加速器、并行化策略、引擎配置和副本数量。这些决策彼此交织；随着作业在不断变化的工作负载中争用共享容量，最佳的集群级方案也会持续变化。我们提出 Koi，这是一种面向异构多云集群的自校准集群规划器。Koi 使用递归语言模型（RLM）层级提出假设并推理部署方案，同时由确定性组件预测服务行为、评估候选方案并控制放置。它将推理行为表示为固定因果图，连接决策（例如加速器、并行度）、运行时中介因素（例如 KV 缓存压力、通信开销）和结果（例如延迟、吞吐量）。每次部署都会增强或削弱特定范围内的因果关系，从而构建全面的推理方案手册，供规划器指导后续决策。各作业的配置被组合为集群级方案，并根据服务目标、资源约束、SLO 风险和成本进行评估。在各项基准测试中，Koi 的良好吞吐量比最强基线高 1.18 倍，并在真实异构集群中将每个 token 的成本降低 20%。消融实验区分了 Koi 架构各部分的贡献：纯语言模型的综合得分为 35.3；同一模型配备 Koi 的确定性工具后得分达到 51.6；完整的 Koi 规划器则达到 70.8。

    FlashMap: Flow Map Speculative Decoding

    FlashMap：流映射推测解码

    Jeff Shen, Zhejian Zhou, Ryan Lee, Jonathan May, Shirley Ho

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    FlashMap proposes a one-pass flow drafter that models dependencies among proposed tokens, improving speculative decoding speed while preserving lossless output. Inter-token composition is a substantive but supporting feature; the main contribution advances inference computation and efficiency.

    FlashMap 提出了一种单次计算的流草稿模型，能够建模所提议 token 之间的依赖关系，在保持无损输出的同时提高推测解码速度。token 间组合是一项重要但辅助性的特性；其主要贡献在于推进推理计算效率。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Speculative decoding accelerates large language model (LLM) inference by using a lightweight drafter to propose a block of tokens that the target model verifies in one parallel pass. Autoregressive drafters generate this block one token at a time, whereas block diffusion drafters such as DFlash generate it in one pass, making drafting faster. However, these diffusion drafters predict each token independently, ignoring dependencies between tokens in the block. We introduce FlashMap, a continuous flow drafter that conditions a flow map language model on the target model's hidden states and generates the whole block in one forward pass while capturing inter-token dependencies. On Qwen3-8B, FlashMap is faster than a matched DFlash baseline on every benchmark, with 7% higher average speedup and up to 6.1x lossless acceleration.

    中文

    推测解码通过使用轻量级草稿模型提出一组 token，再由目标模型通过一次并行计算进行验证，从而加速大型语言模型（LLM）推理。自回归草稿模型逐个生成这组 token，而 DFlash 等块扩散草稿模型则一次性生成，因此草稿生成更快。然而，这些扩散草稿模型独立预测每个 token，忽略了块内 token 之间的依赖关系。我们提出 FlashMap，这是一种连续流草稿模型，它以目标模型的隐藏状态为条件输入流映射语言模型，并在一次前向计算中生成整个块，同时捕捉 token 间的依赖关系。在 Qwen3-8B 上，FlashMap 在每项基准测试中都比匹配的 DFlash 基线更快，平均加速比高出 7%，无损加速最高可达 6.1 倍。

    Train Locally, Learn Together: Distributed Multi-Agent Training via ADMM

    本地训练，共同学习：通过 ADMM 进行分布式多智能体训练

    Yiwei Chen, Changsheng Wang, Yicheng Lang, Qing Qu, Alfred O. Hero, Sijia Liu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper formulates collaborative multi-agent training as consensus optimization and contributes a decentralized ADMM training framework with local updates and inter-agent communication. Its reasoning-task evaluation is relevant but secondary, and role specialization alone does not establish compositional generalization.

    本文将协作式多智能体训练形式化为一致性优化问题，并提出一种去中心化 ADMM 训练框架，通过本地更新和智能体间通信完成训练。其推理任务评估具有一定相关性，但属于次要内容；仅凭角色专业化不足以证明组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Multi-agent systems (MAS) can outperform individual language-model agents by combining specialized roles, diverse reasoning processes, and collaborative decision-making. However, collaborative MAS training is typically centralized, requiring a common trainer to aggregate role-local trajectories and learning signals and maintain model and optimization states. This motivates a distributed multi-agent learning paradigm in which agents improve system-level capabilities through role-local learning and decentralized communication, paving the way toward scalable, resilient, and self-organizing MAS. To this end, we introduce, to the best of our knowledge, the first optimization-grounded framework for distributed MAS training based on consensus alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM). We formulate collaborative MAS learning as a consensus-constrained finite-sum optimization problem, naturally lending itself to distributed optimization via ADMM. The proposed approach alternates role-local learning with inter-agent consensus using distributed communication protocols such as ring all-reduce, enabling joint optimization while keeping each agent's data and training state local. We evaluate our framework on distributed safety alignment and general reasoning tasks. Under compromised-agent settings, ADMM can reduce HarmBench attack success rate (ASR) by up to 26.4%, while achieving reasoning gains comparable to centralized training. These results show that distributed MAS training retains the benefits of centralized joint optimization without requiring a centralized trainer.

    中文

    多智能体系统（MAS）可以通过结合专业化角色、多样的推理过程和协同决策，胜过单个语言模型智能体。然而，协作式 MAS 训练通常采用集中式方式，需要一个共同的训练器汇总各角色本地的轨迹和学习信号，并维护模型与优化状态。这促使人们探索分布式多智能体学习范式，让智能体通过角色本地学习和去中心化通信提升系统级能力，从而为可扩展、有韧性和自组织的 MAS 铺平道路。为此，据我们所知，我们首次提出一种以优化理论为基础、基于一致性交替方向乘子法（ADMM）的分布式 MAS 训练框架。我们将协作式 MAS 学习建模为带一致性约束的有限和优化问题，该问题自然适用于通过 ADMM 进行分布式优化。所提出的方法交替进行角色本地学习与智能体间一致性协调，并采用 ring all-reduce 等分布式通信协议，从而实现联合优化，同时使每个智能体的数据和训练状态保持本地化。我们在分布式安全对齐和一般推理任务上评估了该框架。在智能体受损的设置下，ADMM 可将 HarmBench 攻击成功率（ASR）最高降低 26.4%，同时取得与集中式训练相当的推理提升。这些结果表明，分布式 MAS 训练无需集中式训练器，也能保留集中式联合优化的优势。

    IF-MAP: Influence-Function-Inspired Agent Prioritization in Multi-Agent Systems

    IF-MAP：受影响函数启发的多智能体系统智能体优先级排序

    Jie Mao, Pingchen Lu, Zikun Qu, Jiahang Sun, Xiangyi Wang, Zhiwei Shang, Zhiyong Wang, Guojun Xiong, Zhongxiang Dai

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    IF-MAP estimates which agents are promising to improve from controlled prompt perturbations and uses those priorities to allocate optimization or upgrades more efficiently. It makes a substantial contribution to agent-system organization, while code generation and mathematical reasoning are evaluation contexts rather than advances in reasoning or composition.

    IF-MAP 根据受控提示扰动估计哪些智能体最值得改进，并利用这些优先级更高效地分配优化或升级资源。它对智能体系统组织作出了重要贡献；代码生成和数学推理是评估场景，并非对推理或组合能力的推进。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Improving every agent in an LLM-based multi-agent system can be prohibitively costly, making it important to identify which agent should be prioritized to achieve the greatest system-level gain with limited resources. Failure attribution can inform this decision, but an agent's responsibility for failures does not directly reveal the system-level gains achievable by improving it. We therefore introduce IF-MAP, an influence-function-inspired method for identifying agents with high potential for system-level improvement. For each agent, IF-MAP measures end-to-end loss changes under controlled semantic prompt perturbations, fits a regularized local response model in a low-dimensional prompt-embedding subspace, and uses the estimated response norm as a priority score. This black-box procedure requires no access to model parameters or gradients and produces agent priorities that can guide subsequent improvement effort. We evaluate IF-MAP across six multi-agent workflows spanning code generation, question answering, and mathematical reasoning, using the same priorities for prompt optimization and model upgrades. Optimizing the selected agents' prompts achieves a macro-average gain of 3.81 percentage points, compared with 1.85 for uniform agent selection. Across five target models, upgrading the selected agents yields macro-average gains of 7.62-16.42 percentage points, compared with 3.81-8.62 for uniform agent selection. Despite its probing overhead, IF-MAP reduces Qwen3-8B and DeepSeek-V3.2 token use by 74.2% and 35.2%, respectively, relative to optimizing every agent, and reduces target-model tokens by 63.6-64.9% relative to upgrading every agent. These results support the use of IF-MAP to identify promising agents and direct improvement effort toward greater end-to-end performance gains.

    中文

    改进基于 LLM 的多智能体系统中的每个智能体可能成本过高，因此，在资源有限的情况下，找出应优先改进哪个智能体，以获得最大的系统级收益，十分重要。失败归因可以为这一决策提供参考，但智能体对失败负有责任，并不能直接说明改进它能带来多少系统级收益。因此，我们提出 IF-MAP，这是一种受影响函数启发的方法，用于识别具有较大系统级改进潜力的智能体。对于每个智能体，IF-MAP 衡量受控语义提示扰动下端到端损失的变化，在低维提示嵌入子空间中拟合正则化局部响应模型，并将估计的响应范数用作优先级评分。这种黑盒流程无需访问模型参数或梯度，并生成可指导后续改进工作的智能体优先级。我们在六种多智能体工作流上评估 IF-MAP，涵盖代码生成、问答和数学推理；提示优化和模型升级均使用相同的优先级。优化所选智能体的提示，宏平均提升 3.81 个百分点，而均匀选择智能体的提升为 1.85 个百分点。在五种目标模型上，升级所选智能体的宏平均提升为 7.62-16.42 个百分点，而均匀选择的提升为 3.81-8.62 个百分点。尽管存在探测开销，相较于优化每个智能体，IF-MAP 将 Qwen3-8B 和 DeepSeek-V3.2 的 token 用量分别降低了 74.2% 和 35.2%；相较于升级每个智能体，则将目标模型的 token 用量降低了 63.6-64.9%。这些结果支持使用 IF-MAP 识别有前景的智能体，并将改进工作导向更大的端到端性能提升。

    LLT 构建能够引出验证和回溯等行为的音频推理轨迹，随后使用 SFT 和 DPO 提升基准测试表现。这为推理能力的发展作出了重要贡献，但摘要没有提供关于内部机制、组合泛化或系统组织方式的证据。

    We introduce Long Listening Thoughts (LLT), a framework for constructing post-training datasets that improves audio reasoning by pairing deliberate perceptual grounding with explicit cognitive behaviors. Through a four-stage pipeline, LLT (1) builds multi-aspect dense audio descriptions spanning semantic, acoustic, and temporal information, (2) generates more challenging questions, (3) synthesizes incorrect reasoning traces, and (4) extends short reasoning traces into long ones via a thought-continuation strategy that elicits cognitive behaviors such as verification and backtracking.
