Existing evaluations typically measure this burden by counting questions, treating necessary and avoidable questions equally. We propose an evaluation protocol that distinguishes how often agents ask from how well they ask. An interruption budget limits the number of questions, while a user-attention cost charges extra for questions that are hard to read or not worth asking, as rated by a human-validated LLM judge. Beyond question counts, this cost captures perceived effort: on conversation pairs with the same number of questions, human annotators agreed with the cost on which conversation required more effort 75% of the time. Across eight LLMs and four customer-service domains, limiting agents to one to three questions reduces user-attention cost by 36-73% while keeping 86-94% of the task reward they earn with unlimited questions. At the same budget, reviewing each question against the memory of users' earlier answers cuts attention cost by another 13% with little reward loss and yields more valuable questions. Models also differ sharply in how well they ask: at the same user-attention cost, the most efficient models gain more than twice as much reward from their questions as the others. These results show that asking less and asking better are distinct goals, and that evaluations of proactive agents should measure both.

    中文

    LLM 智能体可以提出澄清问题来完成任务，但回答每个问题都会占用用户的时间和精力。现有评估通常通过统计问题数量来衡量这种负担，将必要问题和可避免的问题一视同仁。我们提出一种评估方案，区分智能体提问的频率与提问的质量。中断预算限制问题数量；用户注意力成本则针对难以阅读或不值得提出的问题额外计费，评分由经过人工验证的 LLM 评审器给出。除问题数量之外，该成本还反映感知到的努力程度：对于问题数量相同的对话对，人工标注者有 75% 的时间与成本评估一致，认为其中一段对话需要付出更多精力。在八种 LLM 和四个客户服务领域中，将智能体的问题限制为一至三个，可使用户注意力成本降低 36–73%，同时保留其在不限提问次数时所获任务奖励的 86–94%。在相同预算下，根据用户先前回答的记忆逐一审查问题，可在任务奖励损失很小的情况下再将注意力成本降低 13%，并产生更有价值的问题。不同模型的提问能力也有显著差异：在相同用户注意力成本下，效率最高的模型从其问题中获得的奖励是其他模型的两倍以上。这些结果表明，少问问题与问好问题是不同的目标，对主动式智能体的评估应同时衡量两者。

    Transformers as Adaptive Kernel Learners across Tasks for In-Context Learning

    Transformer 作为跨任务的自适应核学习器，用于上下文学习

    Zhaiming Shen, Alexander Cloninger, Rongjie Lai, Wenjing Liao

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops theory and simulations showing how trained attention implements adaptive anisotropic kernel estimators for in-context regression, offering a mechanistic account of prediction through query–context interactions. This directly informs model mechanisms, while its regression setup and ICL framing provide only limited evidence about compositional generalization, reasoning, or system organization.

    本文通过理论分析和模拟表明，经过训练的注意力机制如何为上下文回归实现自适应各向异性核估计量，并从机制层面解释查询与上下文之间的交互如何产生预测。这直接增进了对模型机制的理解；但其回归设置和 ICL 框架对于组合泛化、推理或系统组织方式只能提供有限证据。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Transformers have emerged as a dominant architecture in modern machine learning, with in-context learning (ICL) enabling models to adapt to new tasks by conditioning on prompts, without any parameter updates. To understand the attention mechanism in transformer blocks, a growing line of theoretical work interprets ICL through the lens of classical statistical estimators. Recent works have established a connection between the attention mechanism and kernel methods, while the kernel function is usually assumed to be fixed. In practice, the query and key matrices in the attention mechanism are trained, which allows the attention mechanism to serve as an adaptive kernel method. In this work, we demonstrate that transformers can act as adaptive anisotropic kernel learners. Specifically, we study ICL for low-rank linear and multi-index nonlinear regressions, and conduct numerical simulations to show that the learned attention scores closely resemble the oracle kernels for these function classes. We then develop a general framework to analyze the generalization error of ICL by connecting transformers to the oracle kernel estimator for each function class. Our theory gives an explicit and constructive implementation of the oracle kernel estimators for these function classes using a wide and shallow transformer architecture, illustrating how the prediction is carried out by the interaction between the query token and the context tokens. Our work complements existing studies by providing numerical and theoretical evidence of how the attention mechanism adapts to anisotropic kernels in both linear and nonlinear settings.

    中文

    Transformer 已成为现代机器学习中的主流架构，上下文学习（ICL）使模型能够通过以提示为条件适应新任务，而无需更新任何参数。为理解 Transformer 块中的注意力机制，越来越多的理论研究从经典统计估计量的角度解释 ICL。近期研究已揭示注意力机制与核方法之间的联系，但通常假设核函数是固定的。实际上，注意力机制中的查询矩阵和键矩阵经过训练，因此注意力机制可以充当自适应核方法。在本研究中，我们证明 Transformer 可以充当自适应各向异性核学习器。具体而言，我们研究低秩线性回归和多指标非线性回归中的 ICL，并通过数值模拟表明，学习得到的注意力分数与这些函数类别的预言机核高度相似。随后，我们建立一个通用框架，通过将 Transformer 与各函数类别对应的预言机核估计量联系起来，分析 ICL 的泛化误差。我们的理论给出了利用宽而浅的 Transformer 架构实现这些函数类别预言机核估计量的明确、构造性方法，并说明预测如何通过查询词元与上下文词元之间的交互完成。我们的工作补充了现有研究，为注意力机制在非线性和线性场景中如何适应各向异性核提供了数值和理论证据。

    Do 3D Large Language Models Really Use 3D Evidence?

    3D 大型语言模型真的会使用 3D 证据吗？

    Yifei Zhao, Fanyu Zhao, Han Zhang, Yixuan Lin, Yuyang Hou, Bin Wu, Ruike Cao, Li Xiao, Yinsheng Li

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces a benchmark for evidence-grounded 3D-LLM responses and an obligation-aware post-training method that substantially improves performance on ambiguity, missing evidence, and false-presupposition cases. This advances evaluation and training of grounded reasoning, while model post-training alone offers little evidence about internal mechanisms, compositional generalization, or system architecture.

    本文提出了一个评估 3D-LLM 回答是否以证据为依据的基准，以及一种具备义务感知能力的后训练方法；该方法显著提升了模型在歧义、证据缺失和错误预设情形下的表现。这推动了扎根式推理的评估与训练，但仅凭模型后训练不足以证明其对内部机制、组合泛化或系统架构有所贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Recent 3D Large Language Models (3D-LLMs) have shown strong performance on scene question answering with extensive post-training. Yet, existing benchmarks rarely evaluate how 3D-LLMs respond to referential ambiguity, insufficient scene evidence, or false presuppositions, obscuring whether their responses are grounded in 3D evidence. In this work, we introduce UNICORNS, a benchmark for evaluating the reliability of 3D-LLM responses across four evidence conditions. UNICORNS contains 11,387 questions across 557 ScanNet scans, covering eight challenge categories alongside answerable controls. A response passes only if it satisfies the required response behavior and contains no scene claim unsupported by the available evidence. Evaluation of six open-sourced 3D-LLMs reveals a pronounced performance gap: even the strongest zero-shot model achieves 61.22% accuracy on answerable controls, but only 40.94% across the eight challenge categories. To address this gap, we further propose HORN, an obligation-aware post-training method combining group-relative task rewards, leaf-conditioned obligation rewards, and supervised control replay. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HORN reaches $75.1 \pm 1.0\%$ across the challenge categories and $77.2 \pm 0.8\%$ overall, outperforming all baselines without degrading answerable-control accuracy. Our findings enable a systematic evaluation and improvement of evidence-grounded 3D reasoning for 3D-LLMs (code: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/unicorns-6B38/).

    中文

    近期的 3D 大型语言模型（3D-LLM）经过大量后训练，在场景问答方面表现出色。然而，现有基准很少评估 3D-LLM 对指称歧义、场景证据不足或错误预设的响应，因此无法明确判断其回答是否以 3D 证据为依据。本研究提出 UNICORNS，这是一个用于评估 3D-LLM 在四种证据条件下回答可靠性的基准。UNICORNS 包含针对 557 个 ScanNet 扫描场景的 11,387 个问题，涵盖八类挑战以及可回答的对照题。回答只有在满足所要求的响应行为，且不包含任何缺乏现有证据支持的场景断言时，才算通过。对六种开源 3D-LLM 的评估显示存在明显的性能差距：即使是表现最强的零样本模型，在可回答的对照题上的准确率也达到 61.22%，但在八类挑战上的准确率仅为 40.94%。为弥补这一差距，我们进一步提出 HORN，一种具备义务感知能力的后训练方法，结合了组相对任务奖励、叶节点条件化义务奖励和监督式对照回放。大量实验表明，HORN 在各挑战类别上达到$75.1 \pm 1.0\%$，整体达到$77.2 \pm 0.8\%$，表现优于所有基线，同时不降低可回答对照题上的准确率。我们的研究为系统评估和改进 3D-LLM 的证据扎根型 3D 推理提供了基础（代码：https://anonymous.4open.science/r/unicorns-6B38/）。

    Hippo: Training-Free Agent Self-Evolution via Hippocampal Replay

    Hippo：通过海马回放实现无需训练的智能体自我进化

    Yutong Song, Jiang Wu, Yuxuan Ren, Tony Qin, Baoyuan Wang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Hippo compares agent attempts to refine, merge, and update persistent guidance, with experiments showing memory-based adaptation across tasks. This is a substantial contribution to agent memory systems; learning reusable decisions gives a limited compositional connection, but the abstract does not establish compositional generalization or advance reasoning mechanisms.

    Hippo 通过比较智能体的尝试来改进、合并和更新持久指导，并以跨任务实验展示基于记忆的适应效果。这对智能体记忆系统作出了重要贡献；学习可复用决策与组合有一定关联，但摘要并未证实组合泛化，也没有推进推理机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Motivated by recursive self-improvement (RSI), we study how LLM agents can learn through external memory without updating model parameters. Extracting useful experience from a single attempt is difficult: flawed reasoning can produce success, while poor execution can obscure a sound strategy. Preserving its value over time is also difficult: our accumulation baseline without consolidation initially improves but eventually performs below a no-memory baseline. Our key idea is to compare attempts at the same task to identify reusable decisions and refine when they apply. We introduce Hippo, a memory framework inspired by selective hippocampal encoding and replay that learns from these comparisons when shortcomings are diagnosed. It compares the resulting experience with existing memory to merge overlaps and resolve conflicts through explicit applicability conditions. This allows prior guidance to be revised without storing every lesson as a separate entry. Experiments on SWE-bench Verified, WebArena, and Mind2Web show performance gains in all three settings and substantially fewer retained experiences than the accumulation baseline. The gains extend across the evaluated base models of varying capabilities, indicating that memory-based adaptation remains useful even for highly capable models.

    中文

    受递归自我改进（RSI）启发，我们研究 LLM 智能体如何在不更新模型参数的情况下通过外部记忆学习。从单次尝试中提取有用经验并不容易：有缺陷的推理可能仍然成功，而糟糕的执行也可能掩盖有效策略。长期保留经验的价值同样困难：我们提出的不经整合的累积基线起初有所改进，但最终表现低于无记忆基线。我们的核心思路是比较针对同一任务的多次尝试，以识别可复用的决策，并改进其适用条件。我们提出 Hippo，这是一种受海马体选择性编码与回放启发的记忆框架，可在诊断出不足后从这些比较中学习。它会将所得经验与现有记忆进行比较，合并重叠内容，并通过明确的适用条件解决冲突。因此，无需将每条经验都作为独立条目存储，也能修订既有指导。SWE-bench Verified、WebArena 和 Mind2Web 上的实验表明，Hippo 在这三种设置中均提升了性能，保留的经验数量也远少于累积基线。对于所评估的不同能力水平的基础模型，这些提升均能保持，说明即使是能力很强的模型也能受益于基于记忆的适应。

    Sizhe Tang, Zuyuan Zhang, Zeyu Fang, Tian Lan

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    MELD jointly adapts coordinator and scientist policies for multi-agent scientific discovery, with theoretical analysis of coordination and regret and strong benchmark results. Its hierarchy and co-evolving agents substantially advance agent organization, while research planning offers partial reasoning relevance; the abstract does not show a central contribution to internal representations or compositional generalization.

    MELD 联合调整用于多智能体科学发现的协调者策略和科学家策略，并对协调与遗憾进行理论分析，且取得了出色的基准测试结果。其层级结构和共同进化的智能体显著推进了智能体组织方式；研究规划也与推理部分相关，但摘要并未表明其核心贡献涉及内部表征或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Multi-agent scientific discovery with large language models raises a coupled learning problem: research assignments determine both which experiments are pursued and the experiences from which agents adapt. We introduce MELD, a unified hierarchical test-time training framework that jointly adapts a team-level Coordinator policy and agent-level individual Scientist policies within a single discovery process. The Coordinator generates a joint portfolio of search branches and research directives over a shared derivation tree, while Scientists develop hypotheses and execution plans implemented by a shared frozen Executor. Both levels receive alternating GRPO-style parameter updates under a shared smooth best-of-budget objective, allowing team organization and individual research behavior to co-evolve in a recursive self-improvement loop. Our analysis establishes objective alignment for the hierarchy, characterizes conditions for coordination gains over independent parallel discovery and the first-order benefit of private adaptation, and derives a finite-budget regret bound for adapted models. On 22 MLGym and MLE-bench tasks, MELD is best on 20 of them and achieves the highest aggregate normalized scores on MLGym, using a 4B backbone for coordination and research. Most baselines use proprietary Scientists, and all systems share one frozen Executor.

    Measuring Empowerment from Offline Data for Intrinsically Motivated Exploration

    从离线数据测量赋能度，以实现内在动机驱动的探索

    Ishir Garg, Vivek Myers, Qiyang Li, Catherine Ji, Benjamin Eysenbach, Sergey Levine

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops an estimator of agent empowerment from offline trajectories and shows it can improve online exploration, making exploration algorithm design its central contribution. This substantially advances agent systems, while it does not investigate reasoning or compositional generalization.

    本文开发了一个从离线轨迹估计智能体赋能度的方法，并展示它能够改进在线探索，因此其核心贡献是探索算法设计。这显著推进了智能体系统，但没有研究推理或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large, unlabeled datasets of prior experience have become increasingly available for agentic tasks in domains such as robotics and coding. A common recipe for these tasks is to train a policy using the prior data, and then further improve it with online rollouts. But while much work has studied how to use both the offline and online data for policy extraction, far less work has been done to understand how the prior data can be used to efficiently \textit{explore} during the online learning phase. Previous work has attempted to formalize this idea by defining the \textit{empowerment}, a measure of how many future states an agent can realize; states with higher empowerment require more exploration as there are more futures to explore. However, existing methods for estimating empowerment require online policy rollouts in the environment. We propose the first method for estimating empowerment from unlabeled prior data, without any environment interaction. By jointly learning an empowerment-maximizing policy together with its discounted state-occupancy measure, our estimator can be trained on unlabeled trajectories generated from any unknown policy. We demonstrate that our empowerment estimator qualitatively gives intuitive empowerment measures and show that the pretrained estimator can be used to improve exploration in the online goal-conditioned reinforcement learning setting. Code is available at \url{https://github.com/ishirgarg/offline-empowerment}.

    中文

    面向机器人和编程等领域的智能体任务，大规模无标签既往经验数据集正日益普及。这类任务的一种常见做法是利用既往数据训练策略，然后通过在线轨迹进一步改进。但尽管已有大量研究探讨如何同时利用离线和在线数据提取策略，对于如何在在线学习阶段利用既往数据高效地\textit{探索}，研究仍然少得多。先前研究曾通过定义\textit{赋能度}来形式化这一想法；赋能度衡量智能体能够实现多少种未来状态，赋能度较高的状态需要更多探索，因为有更多未来状态可供探索。然而，现有赋能度估计方法都需要在环境中进行在线策略轨迹采样。我们提出首个从无标签既往数据估计赋能度的方法，无需与环境交互。通过联合学习最大化赋能度的策略及其折扣状态占用度量，我们的估计器可以在由任意未知策略生成的无标签轨迹上训练。我们展示该赋能度估计器在定性上能够给出直观的赋能度度量，并证明预训练估计器可用于改进在线目标条件强化学习中的探索。代码见\url{https://github.com/ishirgarg/offline-empowerment}。

    Write Once, Check Many: Reusable Ledgers for Post-Hoc Policy Compliance Auditing of Agent Trajectories

    一次写入，多次核查：用于事后审计智能体轨迹是否符合策略的可复用台账

    Ashwin Nagarajan, Gursimran Panesar, Alicia Yang, Mona T. Diab, Virginia Smith, Aashiq Muhamed

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper’s main contribution is a reusable ledger framework that reduces the cost of checking agent trajectories against later policies. Its agent-auditing and reusable-record design offer a substantial systems contribution; policies combining multiple facts are an evaluation setting, not evidence of compositional generalization or reasoning mechanisms.

    本文的主要贡献是提出一种可复用台账框架，降低依据后续策略核查智能体轨迹的成本。其智能体审计与可复用记录设计对系统作出了重要贡献；结合多个事实的策略只是评估设置，并不能证明组合泛化或推理机制方面的进展。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Auditing LLM agents against policies is critical to ensure safety but requires rereading long trajectories once per policy. Can we instead record each trajectory once and reuse that record for policies not known in advance? We propose write once, check many, a framework in which a writer model converts each agent trajectory into a policy-independent ledger of the agent's actions and outcomes. A reader then checks each new policy against the ledger alone, without access to the original trajectory. On 900 trajectories from SHADE-Arena, $\tau$-bench, and $\tau^2$-bench, we show that a 12B reader of narrative ledgers can either match or in fact achieve higher AUC than the same 12B model reading full trajectories. On SHADE-Arena policies that combine several facts, our approach outperforms a 31B model reading the trajectory (.777 vs. .713 AUC). When checking eight SHADE-Arena policies separately, ledgers use about $5\times$ fewer tokens, including the cost of writing them. A deeper analysis shows that rule-based extraction performs better on some single-action policies, and ledgers can miss evidence in long tool outputs and message contents. Our results suggest that reusable, policy-independent records can make retrospective agent auditing more efficient and effective, and highlight important considerations in ledger design.

    依据策略审计 LLM 智能体对于确保安全至关重要，但每审计一项策略就需要重新阅读冗长的轨迹。我们能否只记录每条轨迹一次，并在之后复用该记录来审计事先未知的策略？我们提出“一次写入，多次核查”框架：写入模型将每条智能体轨迹转换为一份与策略无关的台账，记录智能体的行动和结果。随后，读取模型仅依据该台账核查每项新策略，无需访问原始轨迹。在来自 SHADE-Arena、$\tau$-bench 和$\tau^2$-bench 的 900 条轨迹上，我们表明，读取叙述式台账的 12B 模型，其 AUC 可以达到甚至超过同一 12B 模型读取完整轨迹时的表现。对于 SHADE-Arena 中结合多个事实的策略，我们的方法优于读取轨迹的 31B 模型（AUC 为 .777 对 .713）。分别核查八项 SHADE-Arena 策略时，台账使用的词元数约少$5\times$，其中已计入写入台账的成本。更深入的分析表明，基于规则的提取在某些单一行动策略上表现更好，而台账可能会漏掉长工具输出和消息内容中的证据。我们的结果表明，可复用且与策略无关的记录可以让智能体的回溯审计更高效、更有效，并揭示了台账设计中的重要考量。

    TideKV: Delayed KV Eviction via Layer-Wise Chunked Prefill for Memory-Efficient Long-Context LLM Inference

    TideKV：通过逐层分块预填充延迟淘汰 KV，以实现长上下文 LLM 推理的内存效率

    Yu Wang, Zhu Wang, Ning Hu, Yifan Guo, Xiu Ma, Bin Guo, Zhiwen Yu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    TideKV introduces a layer-wise delayed-eviction schedule that reduces peak memory during long-context inference while preserving cache utility. This is a substantial systems contribution on computation and memory organization, but the abstract does not indicate contributions to interpretability, composition, or reasoning.

    TideKV 提出逐层延迟淘汰调度，在保持缓存效用的同时降低长上下文推理的峰值内存。这是关于计算与内存组织的重要系统贡献，但摘要没有表明其对可解释性、组合或推理作出了贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Long-context large language model (LLM) inference is important for modern intelligent applications but remains constrained by peak memory during prompt prefill. Existing KV cache compression reduces decoding memory but typically requires full-prompt prefill to preserve global context, retaining a high construction peak. Online chunk-level eviction lowers memory earlier but selects before each layer has observed the complete prompt, potentially degrading cache construction and decoding. We present TideKV, an on-GPU cache-construction architecture using layer-major delayed eviction. TideKV processes all prompt chunks within each Transformer layer, retains full-prompt KV only for the active layer, and evicts at layer end. This schedule preserves full-prompt-aware selection while reducing activation and temporary memory. Experiments across multiple computing platforms show that TideKV preserves the inference quality and final cache size of the evaluated compression methods. At 64K on A100, it reduces the construction-time transient footprint by 83.89%. On RTX 4090, it increases time to first token by only 1.06% at 64K and enables 128K prefill. TideKV also completes 128K on Jetson, whereas matched post-prefill compression runs out of memory on both resource-constrained platforms. These results show that delayed layer-end eviction substantially expands feasible context lengths without sacrificing cache utility.

    中文

    长上下文大型语言模型（LLM）推理对于现代智能应用十分重要，但提示预填充期间的峰值内存仍是限制因素。现有 KV 缓存压缩方法能够减少解码内存，但为保留全局上下文，通常需要对完整提示进行预填充，因此构建缓存时仍会达到较高的峰值。在线分块级淘汰能更早降低内存占用，但在每一层尚未读取完整提示前就进行选择，可能损害缓存构建和解码效果。我们提出 TideKV，这是一种采用逐层延迟淘汰的 GPU 上缓存构建架构。TideKV 在每个 Transformer 层内处理所有提示块，仅为当前层保留完整提示的 KV，并在层结束时淘汰。这一调度方式保留了基于完整提示进行选择的能力，同时减少激活值和临时内存。跨多个计算平台的实验表明，TideKV 保持了所评估压缩方法的推理质量和最终缓存大小。在 A100 上处理 64K 上下文时，它将构建期间的瞬时内存占用降低了 83.89%。在 RTX 4090 上，处理 64K 上下文时首词元生成时间仅增加 1.06%，并且支持 128K 预填充。在 Jetson 上，TideKV 也能完成 128K 上下文处理，而匹配的预填充后压缩方法在这两个资源受限的平台上都会耗尽内存。这些结果表明，延迟到层末进行淘汰，可以在不牺牲缓存效用的情况下大幅扩展可处理的上下文长度。

    TopoCompile: Molecular Generation with Exact Global Count Constraints

    TopoCompile：具有精确全局计数约束的分子生成

    Xiang Wu, Rong-Hua Li, Quanqing Xu, Kangfei Zhao, Guoren Wang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    TopoCompile combines component-tree generation with dynamic programming to guarantee exact additive count constraints across component combinations at inference time. This is a substantial compositional generation method, though its contribution is focused on molecular generation; the Transformer and compiler do not provide a broader model-systems contribution.

    TopoCompile 将组件树生成与动态规划相结合，从而在推理时保证跨组件组合的精确可加计数约束。这是一种重要的组合式生成方法，不过其贡献集中于分子生成；Transformer 和编译器并未带来更广泛的模型系统贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Molecular generation designs novel molecules with desired structures and properties. Global count constraints specify molecular size, elemental composition, and ring content without prescribing detailed structure. Property-conditioned generators steer generation toward such targets but do not guarantee exact satisfaction. We introduce TopoCompile, which combines an autoregressive component-tree generator with a dynamic-programming compiler for supported component-additive integer counts. TopoCompile represents molecules as trees of intact ring systems and individual atoms, making each supported count additive over components. At each step, an autoregressive Transformer scores component and attachment actions, while the compiler masks actions with no target-satisfying completion. Within the fixed component vocabulary and typed attachment rules, constrained decoding guarantees exact equality for supported non-negative, component-additive integer counts. Applied at inference time, these checks let the same trained generator support different targets and count combinations without retraining. Across four benchmarks, TopoCompile achieves 100% Exact-valid yield for Common and Rare four-count target groups; the strongest baseline within each dataset reaches 44.9% or less on Rare targets. In unconditional generation, it achieves the highest validity or valid-unique-novel (V.U.N.) among the compared methods across all four benchmark datasets.

    中文

    分子生成旨在设计具有所需结构和性质的新分子。全局计数约束规定分子大小、元素组成和环含量，而不指定详细结构。性质条件生成器会引导生成过程趋向此类目标，但无法保证精确满足约束。我们提出 TopoCompile，它将自回归组件树生成器与动态规划编译器相结合，用于处理受支持的组件可加整数计数。TopoCompile 将分子表示为完整环系和单个原子构成的树，使每种受支持的计数都能按组件相加。在每一步中，自回归 Transformer 对组件和连接操作进行评分，而编译器会屏蔽那些无法完成并满足目标的操作。在固定的组件词汇表和类型化连接规则范围内，受约束解码可保证受支持的非负组件可加整数计数精确相等。在推理时应用这些检查后，同一个训练好的生成器无需重新训练，即可支持不同目标和计数组合。在四个基准测试中，对于 Common 和 Rare 两类四计数目标组，TopoCompile 的精确有效生成率均达到 100%；在每个数据集中，最强基线在 Rare 目标上的这一指标至多为 44.9%。在无条件生成中，在全部四个基准数据集上，与所比较的方法相比，TopoCompile 的有效率或有效、唯一且新颖（V.U.N.）比例最高。

    Kerui Chen, Jinglu Wang, Yun Wang, Xinjiang Wang and Yan Lu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Video-EMem develops reusable memory and separate writer/reader workflows for long-video agents, with feedback-driven workflow evolution and measurable efficiency gains. Its query generalization is incidental to memory design, without a substantive study of compositional reasoning or internal representations.

    Video-EMem 为长视频智能体开发了可复用记忆以及彼此分离的写入者和读取者工作流程，并通过反馈驱动工作流程演化，取得了可量化的效率提升。查询泛化只是记忆设计的次要方面，并未实质研究组合式推理或内部表征。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Long videos often exceed the context capacity of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), while agentic search repeats costly video processing and grounding for each query. Reusable memory can amortize this cost, but must preserve information for questions unknown during construction. We propose Video-EMem, an evolvable video memory harness built on time-anchored perceptual observations. This representation combines compact free-form text with sparse images to preserve semantic content and complementary visual details across temporal scales, supporting temporal navigation without a fixed semantic schema. A Writer encodes each video once by consolidating overlapping multiscale observations, and a Reader retrieves and organizes evidence solely from the resulting memory. With the underlying models frozen, we evolve their workflows and operators using distinct feedback: query-independent source fidelity and coverage for the Writer, and QA failures in evidence localization and utilization for the Reader. Experiments support this separation for generalization beyond development queries, with our evolution strategy improving average accuracy by 7.2% over the unevolved harness. While reducing storage by about 99.86% on average relative to raw videos, Video-EMem improves Qwen3-VL-30B by an average of 2.6% across three long-video QA benchmarks over direct input of 2,048 frames. Using the same o3 answer model as the state-of-the-art agentic method, it improves average accuracy by 2.5% with lower per-query latency.

    中文

    长视频往往超出多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的上下文容量，而智能体式搜索会针对每个查询重复执行成本高昂的视频处理和定位。可复用记忆能够分摊这项成本，但必须保留构建时尚未知的问题所需的信息。我们提出 Video-EMem，这是一种基于时间锚定感知观察的可演化视频记忆框架。该表示将紧凑的自由文本与稀疏图像结合起来，在不同时间尺度上保留语义内容和互补的视觉细节，并且无需固定语义模式即可支持时间导航。Writer 通过整合相互重叠的多尺度观察，为每段视频编码一次；Reader 则仅从生成的记忆中检索和组织证据。在底层模型保持冻结的情况下，我们使用不同反馈来演化其工作流程和操作符：对 Writer 使用与查询无关的源内容保真度和覆盖度，对 Reader 使用证据定位和利用方面的问答失败案例。实验结果支持这种划分有助于泛化到开发阶段查询之外；与未经演化的框架相比，我们的演化策略使平均准确率提高了 7.2%。与原始视频相比，Video-EMem 平均减少约 99.86% 的存储空间；在三个长视频问答基准上，相较于直接输入 2,048 帧，它使 Qwen3-VL-30B 的平均表现提升 2.6%。使用与当前最先进智能体方法相同的 o3 答案模型时，它将平均准确率提高 2.5%，且每次查询的延迟更低。

    When Code Becomes an LLM Call: An Empirical Study of Call-Site Contracts in Agentic Systems

    当代码变成 LLM 调用：对智能体系统中调用点契约的实证研究

    Shihao Weng, Longtian Wang, Yang Feng, Mingfei Cheng, Jia Liu, Chao Shen, He Ye, Federica Sarro, Xiaofei Xie

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The study measures whether agentic software enforces contracts around LLM calls and identifies recurring runtime gaps, including a fix that prevents observed failures. This is a substantial contribution to agent system design and reliability; LLM use itself does not provide evidence about model mechanisms, composition, or reasoning.

    这项研究衡量智能体软件是否落实 LLM 调用周围的契约，并识别出反复出现的运行时缺口，其中包括一种能够阻止已观察到故障的修复方法。这对智能体系统设计和可靠性作出了重要贡献；使用 LLM 本身并不能证明其研究了模型机制、组合性或推理。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Software quality has long rested on specifications that state what code must do, and on testing and verification that check that the code does it. Agentic systems change this foundation: they replace parts of their logic, such as choosing the next tool, judging whether an action is allowed, or writing code to run, with calls to a large language model (LLM). The program still relies on what this logic must guarantee, but the model's behavior is not fixed by code, varies across runs, and can be steered by its input. The guarantee must therefore come from the program around each LLM call site, as a contract of pre-conditions, prompt constraints, and post-conditions. We present an empirical study of these contracts in 496 LLM call sites of 40 popular open-source agentic systems (13.4 MLOC, four languages). Using a multi-agent pipeline validated by 17,428 human judgments, we trace where every model output flows, derive an expected contract for each call site without access to its code, and compare it with the contract that the code implements. We find that 48% of LLM outputs reach control flow or execution, and 73% of these never reach a person. Programs enforce 78% of their constraints in code, but in the prompt, 67% of the constraints are only requested from the model. Although 82% of call sites are checked before and after the call, 63% of the expected constraints are unmet and only 5.3% of call sites satisfy their whole contract; ten recurring patterns explain 99% of the gaps. 38 mechanisms behind these gaps trigger at runtime, and a small code fix that enforces the expected constraint stops all 38. Our results show that the presence of checks says little about their adequacy, and we derive implications for agent developers, framework maintainers, and researchers.

    中文

    长期以来，软件质量依赖于说明代码必须完成什么的规范，以及用于检查代码是否做到这一点的测试和验证。智能体系统改变了这一基础：它们将部分逻辑（例如选择下一个工具、判断某项操作是否获准，或编写待执行代码）替换为对大语言模型（LLM）的调用。程序仍然依赖这些逻辑提供必要保证，但模型行为并非由代码固定，会随运行而变化，也能受到输入引导。因此，保证必须来自每个 LLM 调用点周围的程序，并以包含前置条件、提示约束和后置条件的契约形式体现。我们对 40 个流行开源智能体系统中的 496 个 LLM 调用点开展了实证研究（13.4 MLOC，四种语言）。我们使用经 17,428 条人工判断验证的多智能体流程，追踪每个模型输出的流向，在无法查看代码的情况下推导每个调用点的预期契约，并将其与代码实际实现的契约进行比较。我们发现，48% 的 LLM 输出会进入控制流或执行环节，而其中 73% 从未到达任何人手中。程序通过代码强制执行了 78% 的约束，但在提示中，67% 的约束仅仅是向模型提出要求。尽管 82% 的调用点在调用前后都经过检查，预期约束中仍有 63% 未得到满足，且只有 5.3% 的调用点完整满足其契约；十种反复出现的模式解释了 99% 的差距。这些差距背后的 38 种机制会在运行时触发，而一个用于强制执行预期约束的小型代码修复即可阻止全部 38 种机制。我们的结果表明，存在检查并不能说明检查是否充分，并据此为智能体开发者、框架维护者和研究人员提出启示。

    表征具有轨迹：刻画神经网络中的时间表征动态

    Shivaprasad B. Gowda, Sparsh Mittal

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The empirical study tracks representation geometry during training and identifies collapse trajectories linked to representational capacity, offering transferable insight into how neural representations evolve. It does not study composition, reasoning mechanisms, or model and agent system organization.

    这项实证研究追踪训练期间的表征几何，并识别出与表征能力相关的坍塌轨迹，为理解神经表征如何演化提供了可迁移的见解。它没有研究组合性、推理机制，也没有研究模型和智能体系统的组织方式。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Recent work has shown that deep neural networks exhibit an implicit low-rank simplicity bias. In this paper, we investigate the questions that naturally arise from this observation. What are the temporal consequences of low-rank simplicity bias during optimization? How does representation geometry evolve throughout optimization rather than only at convergence? Do different neural architectures exhibit distinct geometric optimization behaviors? To answer these questions, we conduct a large-scale empirical study tracking representational geometry throughout training. We find that neural networks follow three recurring geometric trajectories: persistent high-rank, collapse-and-recovery, and persistent low-rank. We further identify Destructive Representation Collapse (DRC) as a pathological regime in which representations collapse to rank-one and fail to recover, leading to a sustained loss of representational capacity. While collapse-and-recovery is consistently associated with successful optimization in controlled settings, experiments on real-world models show that the relationship between geometric trajectories and optimization outcomes is configuration dependent. Overall, our findings suggest that representation geometry evolves dynamically during training and provide a new perspective on how deep neural networks learn.

    中文

    近期研究表明，深度神经网络具有隐式的低秩简洁性偏置。本文探讨由这一观察自然引出的若干问题：低秩简洁性偏置在优化过程中会带来怎样的时间演变？表征几何在整个优化过程中如何变化，而非仅在收敛时如何？不同神经网络架构是否呈现不同的几何优化行为？为回答这些问题，我们开展了一项大规模实证研究，追踪训练过程中的表征几何。我们发现，神经网络会遵循三种反复出现的几何轨迹：持续高秩、坍塌后恢复，以及持续低秩。我们进一步识别出破坏性表征坍塌（DRC）这一病理状态：表征坍塌至秩一且无法恢复，导致表征能力持续丧失。虽然在受控设置中，坍塌后恢复始终与成功优化相关，但真实模型上的实验表明，几何轨迹与优化结果之间的关系取决于具体配置。总体而言，我们的发现表明，表征几何会在训练过程中动态演变，并为理解深度神经网络如何学习提供了新的视角。

    Yujia Yang, Quan Yuan, Jiawei Fan, Yang Li, Tiange Fu, Xiaoyuan Fu, Guiyang Luo, Jinglin Li

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper proposes scene-conditioned dynamic layer routing to reduce VLA inference compute while preserving driving performance. Its adaptive computation is a substantial systems contribution; explainability and driving capability are evaluated, but the abstract gives no mechanistic insight into representations or reasoning.

    本文提出场景条件动态层路由，在维持驾驶性能的同时降低 VLA 推理计算量。其自适应计算构成了重要的系统贡献；文章评估了解释能力和驾驶能力，但摘要没有提供关于表征或推理的机制性见解。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models offer a promising paradigm for autonomous driving. However, the massive parameter scale of VLAs strains onboard computational resources during real-time inference. This directly increases energy consumption and limits vehicle battery range, making it critical to minimize computational overhead without compromising driving capability and explainability. Current research on efficient VLA-based driving focuses on sequential adaptation (\textit{e.g.}, Chain-of-Thought and token adjustment), leaving structural adaptation underexplored despite parameter redundancy across dynamic driving scenes. To address this gap, we propose Scene-Adaptive VLA, an efficient framework leveraging dynamic layer routing to adjust active parameters based on real-time scenes. Inspired by the temporal continuity of scenes and model predictive uncertainty, our approach characterizes model-perceived scene complexity via frame-level temporal scene variations and decision deviations. To uncover latent scene-to-parameter correspondences, we encode this characterization into scene-aware tokens, alongside two specialized queries. A budget-conditioned layer routing mechanism evaluates these refined queries to allocate a budget that determines the active parameter ratio and subsequently selects appropriate layer combinations. The entire framework is optimized end-to-end. Extensive evaluations on the Bench2Drive benchmark show that when adapted to a state-of-the-art VLA model, our approach significantly reduces inference-time computational overhead by 53.5\% with negligible degradation in driving and language capabilities. Code is available at https:github.com/yang-luvu/Scene-Adaptive-VLA.

    中文

    视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型为自动驾驶提供了一种前景广阔的范式。然而，VLA 的庞大参数规模给实时推理中的车载计算资源带来了压力。这会直接增加能耗并缩短车辆续航，因此，在不损害驾驶能力和可解释性的前提下降低计算开销至关重要。目前基于 VLA 的高效驾驶研究侧重于序列适配（ extit{例如}，思维链和 token 调整），尽管动态驾驶场景间存在参数冗余，结构适配仍未得到充分探索。为弥补这一空白，我们提出 Scene-Adaptive VLA，这是一种利用动态层路由、根据实时场景调整激活参数的高效框架。受场景时间连续性和模型预测不确定性的启发，我们通过帧级时间场景变化和决策偏差来刻画模型感知到的场景复杂度。为揭示潜在的场景与参数对应关系，我们将这一刻画编码为场景感知 token，并结合两个专用查询。预算条件层路由机制评估这些细化后的查询，分配决定激活参数比例的预算，随后选择适当的层组合。整个框架采用端到端优化。在 Bench2Drive 基准上的大量评估表明，将我们的方法应用于当前最先进的 VLA 模型时，推理时计算开销显著降低 53.5\\%，而驾驶和语言能力仅有可忽略的下降。代码见 https:github.com/yang-luvu/Scene-Adaptive-VLA。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    RareCipherFT trains translation models to copy rare-term translations from in-context examples, with probes supporting that learning mechanism and improved term recall. This advances reusable context-based transfer, while reasoning is secondary and the abstract does not investigate internal representations or model-system design.

    RareCipherFT 训练翻译模型从上下文示例中复制稀有术语译文，探测实验支持其学习机制，并显示术语召回率得到提升。这推进了基于上下文的可复用迁移；推理只是次要内容，摘要也未研究内部表征或模型系统设计。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Fine-tuning LLMs with in-context examples (IC-Train) lets translation models adapt to new parallel data at deployment, but it is unclear whether they actually learn the translations of rare terms from those examples. We formalize this capability as in-context term learning (ICTL). We show that standard IC-Train develops this capability only weakly, and propose RareCipherFT, which strengthens it without any lexical resources. RareCipherFT pairs each training target with in-context examples that share a rare term with it. It then replaces that term with a character-shuffled cipher in both the context and the reference, so the term can only be recovered by copying from context. The ciphered fraction of training data is annealed to preserve translation quality. Across seven translation directions between English and Tamil, Assamese, Mizo, Nepali and Hausa, and four models from 1B to 7B parameters, RareCipherFT raises term recall over standard IC-Train by 5-15 absolute points without lowering COMET. Probes using synonyms, nonce words and controls for shared surface context show that these gains come from linking source terms to their in-context translations rather than from shortcuts.

    中文

    使用上下文示例对 LLM 进行微调（IC-Train），能使翻译模型在部署时适应新的平行数据，但这些模型是否确实能从示例中学会稀有术语的译法，尚不明确。我们将这种能力形式化为上下文术语学习（ICTL）。我们表明，标准 IC-Train 对该能力的培养较弱，并提出 RareCipherFT，在不使用任何词汇资源的情况下增强该能力。RareCipherFT 将每个训练目标与含有相同稀有术语的上下文示例配对。随后，它在上下文和参考译文中都将该术语替换为字符打乱的密码形式，使模型只能通过从上下文中复制来还原该术语。训练数据中加密部分所占的比例会逐渐退火，以保留翻译质量。在英语与泰米尔语、阿萨姆语、米佐语、尼泊尔语和豪萨语之间的七个翻译方向上，以及从 1B 到 7B 参数规模的四个模型上，相较于标准 IC-Train，RareCipherFT 将术语召回率提高了 5–15 个绝对百分点，同时未降低 COMET。使用同义词、无意义词以及共享表面上下文控制的探测实验表明，这些提升源于模型将源术语与上下文中的译文关联起来，而不是利用捷径。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    TCMScience contributes an agent architecture with typed execution, permissions, provenance checks, and claim-support contracts, showing through ablations that governance changes which findings can be released; this is a substantial systems contribution. Its domain-specific discovery workflows and evidence handling touch structured composition and inference, but the abstract does not establish broader advances in compositional generalization or reasoning mechanisms.

    TCMScience 提出了一种智能体架构，具备类型化执行、权限控制、来源溯源核查和主张支持契约，并通过消融实验表明治理会改变哪些发现可以发布；这是一项重要的系统贡献。它面向特定领域的发现工作流和证据处理涉及结构化组合与推断，但摘要并未证明其在更广泛的组合泛化或推理机制方面取得进展。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) research connects classical texts, medicinal entities, molecular assays, computational predictions, and clinical studies. An autonomous research agent must preserve the inferential boundaries between these evidence types while coordinating analysis across heterogeneous resources. We introduce TCMScience, a scientific knowledge-discovery agent that separates language-model proposals from execution and release authority. Its architecture combines a trusted kernel, a scientific compiler, and claim-support contracts: plans are compiled into typed operations, execution is bounded by explicit permissions, and candidate findings are checked against source provenance, study design, and claim scope before release. The full capability registry contains 117 public-source connectors with 444 typed operations across 29 domains and 150 native tools across 12 domains; the TCM data hub catalogs 136 databases, 76 dataset specifications, and 84,294 formula-source records. These resources support model-independent workflows through browser and local execution interfaces. In a network-pharmacology analysis of Gegen Qinlian Tang, replacing the whole-proteome background with the assayed-protein background changed the number of significant pathways from 66 to zero; incorporating inactive screening records identified nine pathways, including drug-metabolism signals retained as mechanistic hypotheses. A governance ablation over 121 constructed erroneous outputs spanning 26 classes released 121 errors without governance, 57 with the domain layer, seven with the kernel, and zero with both layers. All 10 compliant controls were retained. These results establish complementary control of known failure modes and show how explicit evidence contracts change the conclusions an agent is permitted to report.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    SELM contributes skill retrieval, updating, and lifecycle management to help agents reuse experience across tasks. This is a strong systems contribution; its multi-skill framing offers a limited connection to composition, but the abstract does not describe compositional reasoning or generalization.

    SELM 提出技能检索、更新和生命周期管理机制，帮助智能体跨任务复用经验。这是一项有力的系统贡献；其多技能框架与组合有有限关联，但摘要并未描述组合推理或泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly use skills as a lightweight way to acquire task-specific knowledge. Recent work enables skills to evolve from task trajectories. However, these methods often lack systematic management of evolved skills, making it difficult for agents to reuse and accumulate skills across domains, thus limiting performance on subsequent tasks.To reliably accumulate, reuse, and maintain useful skills across tasks, we present SELM (Self-Evolving Library Management), a framework that formulates skill evolution as library-level management. SELM jointly manages skill retrieval, updating, and lifecycle by maintaining skill confidence and utility signals. It introduces utility-aware retrieval to select useful skills, a Map-Reduce framework to generate targeted updates from task-specific experience, and lifecycle controls to retain or remove skills based on their effectiveness. These mechanisms enable the skill library to continuously accumulate useful experience while preserving and pruning skills across tasks, improving agent performance on complex tasks across diverse domains. We evaluate SELM on four agent benchmarks covering diverse tasks and execution environments, and SELM consistently outperforms in most settings.

    大型语言模型（LLM）智能体日益采用技能作为一种轻量方式来获取特定任务知识。近期工作使技能能够从任务轨迹中演化。然而，这些方法往往缺乏对演化后技能的系统管理，使智能体难以跨领域复用并积累技能，从而限制了其在后续任务中的表现。为可靠地跨任务积累、复用和维护有用技能，我们提出 SELM（自进化库管理），这是一个将技能演化建模为库级管理的框架。SELM 通过维护技能置信度和效用信号，联合管理技能检索、更新和生命周期。它引入效用感知检索以选择有用技能，采用 Map-Reduce 框架根据特定任务经验生成有针对性的更新，并通过生命周期控制依据技能效果保留或移除技能。这些机制使技能库能够持续积累有用经验，同时跨任务保留和裁剪技能，从而提升智能体在多样领域复杂任务上的表现。我们在涵盖多种任务和执行环境的四个智能体基准上评估 SELM；在大多数设置中，SELM 均持续取得更好表现。

    Yuhua Zheng, Xueyi Chen, Xinze Zou, Xin Li, Haoji Hu, Huan Wang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces a unified benchmark and a layered agent for generating and optimizing kernels across edge backends, with empirical gains in optimization success. Its main contribution advances model and agent systems; reusable IR and optimization decisions provide only incidental links to composition and reasoning, and it does not study internal model mechanisms.

    本文提出统一基准和分层智能体，用于在多种边缘后端上生成和优化内核，并在优化成功率上取得了实证提升。其主要贡献推进了模型与智能体系统；可复用 IR 和优化决策仅与组合和推理有所关联，且本文未研究模型内部机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Recent works show that LLMs can generate kernels with strong performance on server GPUs. Edge deployment presents distinct challenges because the hardware is heterogeneous, the software stacks are fragmented, and the resource budgets are tight. LLM kernel generation across diverse edge backends has yet to be studied systematically. We introduce EdgeKernelBench, which combines a unified IR deployment framework with a hierarchical benchmark for edge workloads. The unified IR captures reusable computation, scheduling, and memory decisions and connects to each target backend through a compiler interface. The benchmark spans progressively larger program scopes, from individual operators to compact model graphs, across representative edge application domains. We instantiate the design with TVM as a reference compiler and validate it across heterogeneous edge backends. With a single generation attempt, the best model achieves 64.5% Correct@1 but only 25.5% Fast@1.0. This gap shows that functional correctness does not consistently translate into performance gains. We therefore introduce the Layered Edge Kernel Agent (LEKA), which organizes optimization through a layered IR. On the agent evaluation subset, LEKA achieves 43.5% Fast@1.0, compared with 13.0% for direct generation and 26.1% for Claude Code. LEKA and Claude Code use the same base model and optimization budget. Together, EdgeKernelBench and LEKA support unified evaluation and layered optimization of kernels generated by LLMs across edge backends.

    中文

    近期研究表明，LLM 能够为服务器 GPU 生成性能出色的内核。边缘部署则面临不同挑战：硬件异构、软件栈碎片化，且资源预算有限。此前尚未对 LLM 在多种边缘后端上的内核生成进行系统研究。我们提出 EdgeKernelBench，它将统一 IR 部署框架与面向边缘工作负载的分层基准相结合。统一 IR 捕捉可复用的计算、调度和内存决策，并通过编译器接口连接各个目标后端。该基准覆盖逐步扩大的程序范围，从单个算子到紧凑模型图，并涵盖具有代表性的边缘应用领域。我们以 TVM 作为参考编译器实例化这一设计，并在异构边缘后端上进行验证。仅进行一次生成时，最佳模型的 Correct@1 达到 64.5%，但 Fast@1.0 仅为 25.5%。这一差距表明，功能正确并不总能转化为性能提升。因此，我们提出分层边缘内核智能体（LEKA），通过分层 IR 组织优化。在智能体评估子集上，LEKA 的 Fast@1.0 达到 43.5%，而直接生成和 Claude Code 分别为 13.0% 和 26.1%。LEKA 与 Claude Code 使用相同的基础模型和优化预算。总之，EdgeKernelBench 与 LEKA 支持对 LLM 在各类边缘后端生成的内核进行统一评估和分层优化。

    The study tests whether decision-model controllers improve an agent’s stop, verify, and strategy-change decisions, finding that Jev raises cost without improving success. This gives focused empirical insight into agent control and coordination, with a limited connection to reasoning through decision signals but no study of how reasoning capabilities are formed.

    这项研究检验决策模型控制器能否改善智能体对停止、核验和策略变更的决策，结果发现 Jev 增加成本却未提升成功率。这为智能体控制与协调提供了有针对性的实证见解，并通过决策信号与推理有一定关联，但没有研究推理能力如何形成。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Agent scaffolds increasingly delegate small decisions (whether to stop, verify, or change approach) to cheaper models. We ask whether a typed decision model, Jev 1.13, consulted only at deterministic decision points, makes a Claude Sonnet 5.5 terminal agent cheaper without making it worse. In a pre-specified study on Terminal-Bench 2.1, we hold one agent loop fixed and vary only the controller: none, deterministic rules, a small LLM (Claude Haiku 5.5) answering the same questions, Jev, and a placebo that samples Jev's development-phase choice frequencies at the same moments. On 21 held-out tasks (315 trials), Jev raised cost per attempt by 19% (geometric-mean ratio 1.19, 95% CI 1.02-1.36) at an identical pass rate (73.0% vs. 73.0%). Jev was cheaper than the small-LLM controller (ratio 0.81) but 22% more expensive than the placebo, and no pass-rate difference between arms was detectable. Offline, Jev ranked finish requests better than the alternatives (AUROC 0.78 vs. 0.62 for rules and 0.60 for the small LLM) but was poorly calibrated: its mean probability that a run was complete was 0.50 when 87% of those runs passed, so it asked the agent to verify work that was already correct. No controller ever chose to abandon a run. Informative decision signals did not become useful interventions; we discuss what that would require.

    Knowledge Diversion: A Novel Paradigm for Pre-training Decomposable Image Generation Models

    知识分流：用于预训练可分解图像生成模型的新范式

    Yucheng Xie, Fu Feng, Ruixiao Shi, Jing Wang, Xin Geng, Yong Rui

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    KDiv structures generative knowledge into shared and condition-specific units that can be selectively recombined, offering substantial insight into reusable composition and conditional routing. Its focus on decomposable model organization is relevant to systems, while internal representation analysis and reasoning are not central contributions.

    KDiv 将生成知识组织为共享单元和特定条件单元，使其能够被选择性重组，从而深入揭示了可复用组合与条件路由。其重点在于可分解的模型组织，与系统研究相关；内部表征分析和推理并非核心贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large-scale pre-trained models have become foundational to modern machine learning, yet conventional pre-training objectives primarily optimize source-domain performance without explicitly considering downstream requirements. Consequently, transferable and task-specific knowledge remains entangled within a shared parameter space, limiting selective knowledge reuse and efficient downstream adaptation. This limitation is particularly consequential for image-generation models, which must accommodate diverse conditions and domains. To address this challenge, we introduce Knowledge Diversion (KDiv), a condition-aware pre-training paradigm for learning inherently decomposable generative models. Before pre-training, KDiv factorizes randomly initialized weights into rank-one Knowledge Units, which are organized into learngenes and tailors. During pre-training, continuous condition-aware routing consolidates knowledge shared across conditions in learngenes while directing condition-dependent variations to tailors. This structured organization enables learngenes to capture transferable generative priors and tailors to develop condition-specific expertise, allowing the resulting model to be selectively recombined for diverse downstream conditions. Extensive experiments across class-, text-, and image-conditioned generation demonstrate that KDiv consistently matches or surpasses dense baselines at comparable pre-training cost and achieves the strongest average downstream performance with a trainable parameter budget comparable to low-rank adaptation methods.

We find only localized gains for particular question types and tight run-time context budgets, with no consistent advantage over strong raw-history RAG baselines. Oracle retrieval shows that some systems fail to preserve answer-supporting information during explicit memory construction, while others preserve it but fail to retrieve it effectively, despite construction costs reaching hours per conversation.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    Evaluating the reasoning of AI systems often relies on human-written reasoning chains as references, yet the logical support for their individual steps is rarely verified. Although prior neuro-symbolic approaches have formalized and checked reasoning, their reported evaluations do not systematically assess whether step conclusions in human-written reference derivations are entailed by their cited premise sets or investigate the sources of failures in those references. To address these limitations, we present a novel reference-centred assessment method for human-written derivations that combines entailment checking against cited premise sets, full-premise rechecking, and failure attribution to examine the reliability of these derivations and their formal representations. We evaluate it on P-FOLIO, using a large language model (LLM) to translate step conclusions into first-order logic (FOL) and the Z3 SMT solver to check entailment. Of 386 derivations examined, 202 (52.3%) meet all our checking criteria, meaning that every translated step is entailed by its stated support and the required target is established under the available FOL representations. Among 230 steps not entailed by their stated support, 191 become entailed when checked against the complete original premises, indicating that most initial failures reflect incomplete or mismatched support rather than unsupported claims. Manual analysis of the remaining 39 cases identifies 21 human reasoning errors, 11 FOL translation errors, and 7 dataset annotation errors. A separate manual audit of 50 randomly sampled steps that passed the entailment checks found 46 faithful FOL translations (92%). These findings suggest that disagreement with a human-written reasoning reference may originate in the reference or its formal representation rather than in the AI system being evaluated.

    中文

    评估 AI 系统的推理能力时，通常依赖人工撰写的推理链作为参考，但其中各个步骤是否得到逻辑支持却很少经过验证。尽管以往的神经符号方法已将推理形式化并加以检查，其报告的评估并未系统考察人工撰写的参考推导中，步骤结论是否能由所引用的前提集合推出，也未调查这些参考答案中失效的来源。为解决这些局限，我们提出一种面向参考答案的新评估方法，用于检查人工撰写的推导。该方法结合针对所引用前提集合的蕴含检查、完整前提复核和失效归因，以考察这些推导及其形式化表示的可靠性。我们在 P-FOLIO 上进行评估，使用大型语言模型（LLM）将步骤结论转换为一阶逻辑（FOL），并使用 Z3 SMT 求解器检查蕴含。在所检查的 386 个推导中，202 个（52.3%）满足所有检查标准，也就是说，在现有 FOL 表示下，每个转换后的步骤都能由其所述支持推出，且所需目标得以确立。在 230 个无法由其所述支持推出的步骤中，有 191 个在依据完整原始前提进行检查时变为可推出，这表明大多数初始失败反映的是支持信息不完整或不匹配，而非主张缺乏依据。对剩余 39 个案例的人工分析发现了 21 个人类推理错误、11 个 FOL 转换错误和 7 个数据集标注错误。对随机抽取的 50 个通过蕴含检查的步骤另行进行人工审计后发现，其中 46 个的 FOL 转换忠实准确（92%）。这些发现表明，与人工撰写的推理参考答案不一致，可能源于参考答案本身或其形式化表示，而非正在接受评估的 AI 系统。

TNDMs learn a map from subsets of the training data to the outcome of training on those subsets, allowing them to represent interactions among several training units. In factual-association fine-tuning, a single TNDM-CP raises held-out $\mathrm{R}^2$ from $0.579$ to $0.668$ over the linear datamodel. These results demonstrate that compact low-rank models improve prediction when training data effects depend on combinations of training groups.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Discrete diffusion language models (dLLMs) offer an attractive alternative to autoregressive generation by updating multiple tokens in parallel, but their inference efficiency is still limited by the cost of safely committing tentative predictions. In particular, speculative decoding for dLLMs is challenging because speculative tokens within the same diffusion block may depend on one another, making aggressive acceptance prone to error propagation and strict verification computationally expensive. We present PV-Decoding, a confidence-driven speculative decoding framework with progressive verification for block diffusion inference. PV-Decoding partitions masked positions into directly decoded tokens, speculative tokens, and unresolved tokens using two confidence thresholds, and then verifies speculative tokens with progressively stronger policies, including single-batch, dual-batch, and multi-batch verification. This design exposes a practical accuracy--efficiency trade-off: weaker verification minimizes overhead, whereas stronger verification improves acceptance precision and robustness. Experiments on three diffusion language models across GSM8K, MBPP, and HumanEval show that PV-Decoding reduces sequential model forward passes (MFPs) by 8%--37% relative to confidence-based decoding, while keeping the largest observed accuracy drop to 1.3%. On Dream-7B-Instruct/GSM8K, PV-Decoding (1-batch) and PV-Decoding (2-batch) improve throughput by 7.0%--13.6% under the same hardware budget, whereas PV-Decoding (multi-batch) is slower under the current runtime. These results suggest that confidence-guided speculation with structured verification is a practical path toward efficient and reliable dLLM inference.

    Independently developed AI models accumulate diverse and complementary capabilities, but a growing model collection does not automatically realize Collective AI. Addressing this gap requires understanding model capabilities with limited evaluation, organizing complementary models to collaborate on diverse tasks, and executing model calls efficiently under resource constraints. We present a systematic approach to pursuing Collective Model Intelligence through three connected components. First, Model Eval constructs evidence-based capability profiles by combining query-level performance estimation with cross-domain prediction, reducing the need for exhaustive evaluation. Second, Mio (Models in One) organizes complementary model candidates and supports task-conditioned, cost-aware selection and collaboration as task requirements evolve. Third, Mos (Model Serving OS) separates model selection from execution and provides endpoint scheduling and shared model deployment and distribution. Experiments show lower capability-estimation errors under limited evaluation. Across nine public benchmarks, Mio 1.0 Lite achieves the highest average score and lowest average cost among compared methods, with per-request costs 73.7-97.5% lower than those of the best-scoring alternatives. A prewarmed shared cache accelerates model-file retrieval by up to 23.3 times. This work lays a foundation for Collective Model Intelligence by characterizing and coordinating the diverse capabilities of an expanding model universe.

    独立开发的 AI 模型积累了多样且互补的能力，但模型集合不断扩大，并不会自动实现集体 AI。要弥合这一差距，需要在评估有限的情况下了解模型能力，组织互补模型以协作处理多样任务，并在资源约束下高效执行模型调用。我们提出一种由三个相互关联的组成部分构成的系统方法，以实现集体模型智能。首先，Model Eval 将查询级性能估计与跨领域预测相结合，构建以证据为依据的能力画像，减少穷尽式评估的需求。其次，Mio（Models in One）组织互补的候选模型，并支持根据任务条件和成本进行选择与协作，以适应不断变化的任务要求。第三，Mos（Model Serving OS）将模型选择与执行分离，并提供端点调度以及共享模型的部署和分发。实验表明，在评估有限的情况下，能力估计误差更低。在九个公开基准测试中，Mio 1.0 Lite 在所比较的方法中取得最高的平均分和最低的平均成本，每次请求的成本比得分最高的替代方案低73.7%至97.5%。预热后的共享缓存将模型文件检索速度最高提升至原来的23.3倍。这项工作通过表征并协调不断扩大的模型群体中的多样能力，为集体模型智能奠定了基础。

    我们对 VLM token 剪枝的评估是否正确？超越准确率和 token 数量

    Geng Li, Guohao Chen, Shilin Shan, Jianfei Yang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces evaluation metrics that test whether visual token pruning preserves useful evidence and produces actual end-to-end speedups, a substantial contribution to evaluating efficient model computation. Its use of visual tokens does not investigate internal representations, and the benchmarks do not target composition or reasoning.

    本文提出评估指标，用于检验视觉 token 剪枝是否保留了有用证据，以及是否带来实际的端到端加速，对高效模型计算的评估作出了实质贡献。虽然涉及视觉 token，但本文并未研究内部表征；这些基准也不针对组合或推理。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Visual token pruning aims to reduce inference cost while preserving the capabilities of the original VLM. Yet existing evaluations rely on aggregate task accuracy and retained token count as proxies for pruning quality and actual efficiency. We reveal two limitations: 1) Aggregate accuracy can obscure whether a pruning method truly identifies critical visual tokens; many examples remain solvable under arbitrary token removal and models can exploit textual shortcuts when visual evidence is degraded. 2) Retained token count is an unreliable proxy for efficiency, as identical token budgets can incur different end-to-end costs depending on where and how pruning is performed. Consequently, comparisons based on aggregate accuracy and retained token counts fail to recover the global performance-efficiency Pareto frontier across methods. We introduce PAA-Bench, a plug-and-play evaluation framework for existing benchmarks, to evaluate whether pruning succeeds through meaningful token selection and whether this success translates into real speedup. To determine when token choice actually matters, we propose Random-Pass@k to measure how often an example remains correct under random pruning, enabling comprehensive evaluation across different levels of selection difficulty. To compare efficiency fairly, we introduce Preservation-Constrained Speedup (PCS) to report the maximum end-to-end speedup each method achieves under a shared preservation target. Experiments across 8 methods, 3 VLM backbones, and 9 benchmarks show that stronger token compression does not necessarily yield greater speedup, method differences widen on examples where token selection matters, and efficiency rankings change with the preservation target.

    中文

    视觉 token 剪枝旨在降低推理成本，同时保留原始 VLM 的能力。然而，现有评估将任务总体准确率和保留的 token 数量作为剪枝质量及实际效率的替代指标。我们揭示了两项局限：1）总体准确率可能掩盖剪枝方法是否真正识别出关键视觉 token；许多样例即使任意移除 token 仍可解答，而当视觉证据受损时，模型还可能利用文本捷径。2）保留的 token 数量不是可靠的效率替代指标，因为即使 token 预算相同，剪枝的位置和方式不同也会导致端到端成本不同。因此，基于总体准确率和保留 token 数量的比较，无法还原不同方法之间整体的性能—效率帕累托前沿。我们提出 PAA-Bench，这是一个可直接用于现有基准的评估框架，用来评估剪枝是否通过有意义的 token 选择取得成效，以及这种成效是否转化为实际加速。为了确定 token 选择何时真正重要，我们提出 Random-Pass@k，用于衡量随机剪枝下样例仍能答对的频率，从而能够针对不同的选择难度等级进行全面评估。为了公平比较效率，我们提出 Preservation-Constrained Speedup（PCS），报告每种方法在共同的保留目标下所能达到的最大端到端加速比。对8种方法、3种 VLM 主干模型和9个基准测试进行的实验表明，更强的 token 压缩未必带来更高的加速比；在 token 选择确实重要的样例上，方法间差异会扩大；效率排名也会随保留目标而改变。

    Computer-aided retrosynthesis has advanced through single-step prediction, tree search and route scoring, but complex targets still require judgement over the whole route, where stereochemistry, functional-group compatibility, cost and greenness interact. Here we present \textbf{\mbox{ReTRACE}} (\textbf{RE}trosynthesis with \textbf{T}ool-orchestrated \textbf{R}easoning \textbf{A}nd \textbf{C}ontext-aware \textbf{E}vidence), an agent that places a large language model (LLM) in a chemistry harness that integrates molecular tools, complementary single-step prediction engines, a purchasable starting-material library, a route memory and a multi-criterion route evaluator. Routes are judged by a new metric that combines programmatic checks with adversarial LLM review, and its verdicts are compared with a synthetic chemist's. The agent learns continually from evaluator feedback during search, diagnosing weak routes and backtracking to revise them. With Claude Opus 4.8, at least one of the top 10 routes proposed by ReTRACE passed the audit for 87.4\%, 95.0\% and 86.7\% of targets on the three benchmarks. Two prospective wet-lab syntheses show that ReTRACE route proposals can be converted into executable procedures after expert revision.

    CorrFlow：自校正流匹配

    Hangwei Zhang, Nathan Rouill\'e, Chuanxia Zheng

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    CorrFlow adds a lightweight refiner that reuses hidden states to correct iterative flow predictions, with theoretical analysis and evidence of improved sampling under matched compute. Hidden-state reuse is not an analysis of learned representations, and iterative generation here does not directly address reasoning or composition.

    CorrFlow 增加了一个轻量级精化器，重用隐藏状态来校正迭代流预测；理论分析和匹配计算量下的证据表明，它能改善采样。重用隐藏状态并不等于分析学习到的表征，而这里的迭代生成也没有直接涉及推理或组合。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Flow-matching models generate samples through iterative velocity predictions, but typically do not revisit these predictions using the intermediate representations that produced them. We introduce CorrFlow, a self-correcting flow-matching framework that reuses this information through a lightweight refiner. Under rectified-flow interpolation, the error of the one-step clean prediction equals the realized velocity residual scaled by the noise level. Motivated by this identity, the refiner learns to predict residual corrections from the base model's clean prediction, conditioning, noise level and hidden states from the same forward pass. The correction is added to the base velocity before each sampling update, so subsequent predictions are made from the corrected state. This requires no additional base-model evaluations and only one lightweight refiner evaluation per step. Our theoretical analyses establish conditions under which feature reuse outperforms raw-input affine predictors and refiner training achieves greater residual-risk reduction than continued base-model training under a matched training compute budget. Experiments on class-conditional image generation, text-to-video generation and image-to-video generation show consistent improvements over the corresponding base models, including gains in visual quality and physical consistency. Project Page: https://fogradio.github.io/corrflow-project

    中文

    流匹配模型通过迭代预测速度生成样本，但通常不会利用产生这些预测的中间表征来重新审视预测结果。我们提出 CorrFlow，这是一种自校正流匹配框架，通过轻量级精化器重用这些信息。在整流流插值下，单步干净预测的误差等于实际速度残差乘以噪声水平。受这一恒等关系启发，精化器学习根据基础模型的干净预测、条件、噪声水平以及同一次前向传播中的隐藏状态，预测残差校正量。每次采样更新之前，校正量都会加到基础模型预测的速度上，因此后续预测会基于校正后的状态生成。这不需要额外调用基础模型，每步只需运行一次轻量级精化器。我们的理论分析确立了相应条件：在这些条件下，特征重用优于原始输入仿射预测器；并且在匹配训练计算预算时，精化器训练比继续训练基础模型能更大幅度地降低残差风险。在类别条件图像生成、文本到视频生成和图像到视频生成上的实验表明，相较于对应的基础模型，CorrFlow 均能持续带来改进，包括提升视觉质量和物理一致性。项目页面：https://fogradio.github.io/corrflow-project

    SeongJun Jeong, Junghyun Kim, Gi-Cheon Kang, Byoung-Tak Zhang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    DialogMem introduces a benchmark and controlled diagnostics that isolate dialogue grounding, retrieval, and localization bottlenecks in embodied memory.     DialogMem 提出了一个基准和受控诊断，用于隔离具身记忆中对话关联、检索和定位方面的瓶颈。这实质性地推进了记忆与智能体评估；而 QA 和导航是任务输出，并非对推理或组合机制的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Embodied agents in human-centered environments require memory that integrates what they observe with what humans tell them over time. However, existing embodied memories are built primarily from visual experience, leaving open how dialogue with humans can be grounded in the objects encountered throughout that experience. We introduce DialogMem, a two-phase benchmark in which agents build memory from time-aligned streams of posed RGB-D observations and dialogue, and later use it for instance-level object navigation and question answering (QA). DialogMem provides 142 episodes across 27 real-world 3D scenes, with 14,193 QA pairs and 11,890 navigation instructions. We evaluate nine memory representations within a unified framework of memory formation, evidence retrieval, and reasoning for task outputs. In experiments, appending dialogue to visual memory at evaluation time substantially improves QA but yields negligible navigation gains, suggesting that relevant dialogue is present in memory but not grounded to specific objects. Controlled diagnostics show that navigation improves with link quality but falls short of ground-truth object-level memory even under perfect linking. Retrieving the correct object entry and recovering its spatial location remain further bottlenecks. These results identify three bottlenecks for dialogue-grounded embodied memory: grounding and organizing dialogue at object-level entries during formation, retrieving the correct entry, and localizing it accurately.

    以人为中心的环境中的具身智能体需要整合其长期观察到的信息与人们告诉它们的信息。然而，现有具身记忆主要基于视觉经验，因此，如何将与人的对话关联到这些经验中遇到的物体，仍有待探索。我们提出 DialogMem，这是一个分为两个阶段的基准：智能体先根据时间对齐的位姿 RGB-D 观测流和对话流构建记忆，之后再利用记忆进行实例级物体导航和问答（QA）。DialogMem 包含27个真实世界 3D 场景中的142个情节，以及14,193组 QA 问答和11,890条导航指令。我们在统一框架中评估九种记忆表示，该框架涵盖记忆形成、证据检索和面向任务输出的推理。实验中，在评估时将对话添加到视觉记忆中，能显著改善 QA，但对导航的提升微乎其微；这表明相关对话虽已存在于记忆中，却没有与特定物体建立关联。受控诊断表明，导航性能会随链接质量提高，但即使链接完美，也仍达不到物体级真实值记忆的水平。检索正确的物体条目和恢复其空间位置仍是进一步的瓶颈。这些结果指出了以对话为依据的具身记忆所面临的三个瓶颈：在记忆形成时将对话关联并组织到物体级条目中、检索正确条目，以及准确定位物体。

    无需共享奖励即可合作：通过互惠式 Q 增强实现

    Francesco Morri, Adel Abusitta, Quentin Cappart, Margarida Carvalho

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Reciprocal Q-Augmentation uses an opponent model to shape agents’ cooperative and defective policies, with experiments showing improved cooperation in general-sum games. This advances multi-agent learning and coordination, while its Q-function augmentation is not an account of internal model mechanisms or compositional generalization.

    互惠式 Q 增强利用对手模型来调整智能体的合作与背叛策略，实验表明它能提升总和博弈中的合作水平。这推进了多智能体学习与协调；其 Q 函数增强并非对内部模型机制或组合泛化的阐释。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    General-sum games are more challenging than fully cooperative or adversarial settings because agents may deceive or exploit one another. Achieving high social welfare requires sustained cooperation, while a single defection can drive agents toward a welfare suboptimal Nash equilibrium. Moreover, assuming access to other agents' rewards or internal states is often unrealistic and implicitly introduces additional cooperation into the setting. To address this issue, we introduce \textit{Reciprocal Q-Augmentation} (RQA), a method that uses a latent-variable opponent model to augment the Q-function with estimates of how one's actions affects other agents. RQA allows agents to learn both cooperative and defective policies using only their own Q-function. We show that, in social dilemmas, agents that all follow the cooperative policy of RQA learn to cooperate faster and reach higher levels of cooperation than fully cooperative algorithms. Moreover, a single RQA agent that switches appropriately between its cooperative and defecting policies can induce cooperation in agents trained with standard RL algorithms, which would otherwise end up defecting. We evaluate our approach on the Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma, Iterated Traveler's Dilemma, Iterated Stag Hunt, and \texttt{CleanUp-Lite}. Our experiments show that the algorithms implementing RQA outperforms fully cooperative methods with shared rewards and enables cooperation with algorithms that otherwise fail to reach high social welfare.

    与完全合作或对抗性场景相比，总和博弈更具挑战性，因为智能体可能欺骗或利用彼此。实现较高的社会福利需要持续合作，而一次背叛就可能使智能体走向社会福利次优的纳什均衡。此外，假定可以访问其他智能体的奖励或内部状态往往不切实际，而且会在设定中隐含地引入额外合作。为解决这一问题，我们提出\textit{互惠式 Q 增强}（RQA），这是一种利用潜变量对手模型来增强 Q 函数的方法，其中加入了对自身行动如何影响其他智能体的估计。RQA 使智能体仅凭自身的 Q 函数就能学习合作和背叛策略。我们表明，在社会困境中，全部采用 RQA 合作策略的智能体，比完全合作算法学会合作更快，并达到更高的合作水平。此外，单个 RQA 智能体若能在合作与背叛策略之间适时切换，就可以促使使用标准 RL 算法训练的智能体合作；这些智能体原本会走向背叛。我们在重复囚徒困境、重复旅行者困境、重复猎鹿博弈和 \texttt{CleanUp-Lite} 上评估了该方法。实验表明，实现 RQA 的算法优于使用共享奖励的完全合作方法，并能促成那些原本无法实现较高社会福利的算法进行合作。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    PatternBench evaluates whether LLMs actually perform intended code optimizations that survive compiler optimization, using AST-based faithfulness analysis alongside runtime results.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Existing evaluations of LLM-based code optimization primarily measure end-to-end speedup, obscuring whether a model actually performs the intended optimization. For compiled languages, this is especially problematic: observed gains may reflect transformations already recoverable by modern optimizing compilers rather than optimization behavior attributable to the model itself. We present PatternBench, a benchmark for studying compiler-transcendent optimization, i.e., performance improvements that remain after aggressive compiler optimization. PatternBench targets residual optimization opportunities across seven classes of transformations and pairs runtime evaluation with an AST-based optimization faithfulness analysis that verifies whether the intended optimization is realized in the generated program. Experiments with frontier, open-weight, and fine-tuned models show that runtime speedup alone provides an incomplete account of optimization capability. Optimization faithfulness is strongly associated with realized speedup, and fine-tuning improves both faithfulness and optimization effectiveness. These results suggest that evaluation of LLM-based code optimization should measure not only performance outcomes, but also whether the target transformation was successfully executed.

    RPL lets an RL policy compose search primitives into programs with state and control flow, while program mutation expands exploration beyond sampled trajectories; experiments show gains on multi-hop and corpus-level tasks.     RPL 使 RL 策略能够将搜索原语组合成带有状态和控制流的程序，而程序变异则将探索范围扩展到采样轨迹之外；实验显示其在多跳任务和语料库级任务上取得了提升。程序组合是一项重要的算法贡献，学到的搜索行为也推进了推理和智能体系统的发展，但摘要没有研究内部表征。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Retrieval-augmented language models increasingly use multi-step search to solve knowledge-intensive tasks, yet existing systems typically expose retrieval through fixed pipelines or collections of atomic tools. We introduce Retrieval Program Learning (RPL), a programmable search framework that allows a policy to compose search primitives into executable programs with local state and control flow. This enables adaptive search that can retrieve broadly, process intermediate results, and selectively construct model context without tying retrieval breadth to context consumption. However, the resulting flexibility creates a difficult exploration problem: useful programs may require several coordinated decisions, while reinforcement learning often supplies only sparse feedback. To address this challenge, we propose program mutation, a grammar-constrained and execution-verified procedure that generates local variants of suboptimal programs sampled during RL, converts them into training trajectories, and distills them back into the policy. We evaluate RPL on open-domain question answering and corpus-level reasoning tasks, comparing it with a range of retrieval and reasoning baselines. RPL consistently improves open-domain QA performance across model sizes and in- and out-of-domain benchmarks, with particularly large gains on multi-hop tasks. Notably, a 4B model trained with RPL outperforms all 8B model baselines. On corpus-level reasoning, RPL achieves the highest answer F1 and document-coverage F1 for both model sizes while substantially reducing context consumption and retrieval turns. Our results show that programmable search expands the retrieval strategies that agents can learn, while program mutation provides an effective mechanism for exploring useful program structures beyond direct on-policy sampling.

    中文

    检索增强语言模型越来越多地使用多步搜索来解决知识密集型任务，但现有系统通常通过固定流水线或一组原子工具来提供检索能力。我们提出检索程序学习（RPL），这是一种可编程搜索框架，允许策略将搜索原语组合成带有局部状态和控制流的可执行程序。这使自适应搜索成为可能：系统可以广泛检索、处理中间结果，并有选择地构造模型上下文，而无需将检索范围绑定到上下文消耗量。然而，这种灵活性也带来了棘手的探索问题：有用的程序可能需要多个协调决策，而强化学习通常只能提供稀疏反馈。为应对这一挑战，我们提出程序变异，这是一种受语法约束且经执行验证的流程，可为强化学习过程中采样到的次优程序生成局部变体，将其转换为训练轨迹，并再将其蒸馏回策略中。我们在开放域问答和语料库级推理任务上评估 RPL，并将其与多种检索和推理基线进行比较。RPL 在不同模型规模以及域内和域外基准上持续提升开放域 QA 性能，在多跳任务上的提升尤为显著。值得注意的是，经过 RPL 训练的 4B 模型表现超过了所有 8B 模型基线。在语料库级推理方面，RPL 在两种模型规模下均取得最高的答案 F1 和文档覆盖率 F1，同时大幅减少上下文消耗和检索轮数。我们的结果表明，可编程搜索拓展了智能体能够学习的检索策略，而程序变异则提供了一种有效机制，使智能体能够探索超出直接按策略采样范围的有用程序结构。

    ENGLISH

    Can one sentence manipulate an agent's belief by targeting a single implicit warrant linking evidence to a conclusion? In this paper, we introduce the one-relation attack (ORA), a novel cognitive attack on this inferential relation. ORA localizes a critical implicit warrant and performs a one-relation intervention using a single source-grounded sentence that qualifies this warrant and steers the agent toward an incorrect belief. Across eighteen models on biomedical inference and vulnerability detection, best-of-$10 attacks overturn initially correct answers at mean rates of 54.9% for proprietary and 80.0% for open-weight models. Attacks also transfer without victim feedback, and paired controls support the roles of targeting and qualification. Moreover, successful sentences can pass source-support checks and evade identification, and multi-agent debate raises team error from 50.0% to 59.5% in our balanced stress test. These findings establish implicit warrants as a cognitive attack surface for manipulating agents' beliefs.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Reinforcement learning with general utilities optimizes nonlinear functionals of policy-induced occupancy measures. We develop a natural actor-critic method for concave RLGU objectives admitting an exact variational dual representation, with explicit constructions for a broad class of separable occupancy utilities. Rather than estimating the occupancy measure and then forming the policy-gradient pseudo-reward, our method learns this pseudo-reward directly as a function of the state-action pair using a neural critic. The critic is trained by projected stochastic updates, while multilevel Monte Carlo combines outputs across training horizons to control its bias at logarithmic expected cost. Our analysis separates conditional actor bias from estimator second moments and accounts explicitly for dual optimization, critic approximation, and neural linearization errors. Under policy-transfer, dual-stability, and local critic-regularity conditions, the method achieves $\widetilde{O}(T^{-1/2})$ global convergence above policy, critic-class, and finite-width approximation errors using $\widetilde{O}(T)$ expected environment transitions and reference samples. For a fixed critic representation, this yields $\widetilde{O}(\epsilon^{-2})$ sampling complexity above the approximation floor, covering infinite state-action spaces and occupancy utilities beyond fixed finite vectors of returns.

    具有一般效用的强化学习优化由策略诱导的占用度量的非线性泛函。我们为具有精确变分对偶表示的凹 RLGU 目标开发了一种自然演员-评论家方法，并为一大类可分离占用效用给出了明确构造。我们的方法不先估计占用度量再构造策略梯度伪奖励，而是使用神经评论家直接将该伪奖励学习为状态-动作对的函数。评论家通过投影随机更新进行训练，而多层级蒙特卡洛则结合不同训练时域的输出，以对数级期望成本控制偏差。我们的分析将条件演员偏差与估计量二阶矩分开，并明确考虑对偶优化、评论家近似和神经线性化误差。在策略迁移、对偶稳定性和局部评论家正则性条件下，该方法实现了超过策略、评论家类别和有限宽度近似误差的 $\widetilde{O}(T^{-1/2})$全局收敛，所需环境转移和参考样本的期望数量为 $\widetilde{O}(T)$。对于固定的评论家表示，这给出了高于近似误差下限的 $\widetilde{O}(\epsilon^{-2})$采样复杂度，适用于无限状态-动作空间，以及超出固定有限回报向量范围的占用效用。

    Peer Pressure：面向代码安全的攻击者与防御者群体执行验证式协同进化

    Khushbu Pahwa, Yubin Ge, Daniele Bonadiman, Xiaofei Ma, Yi Zhang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces execution-verified co-evolution with peer-relative policy optimization for adaptive code-security agents, showing transfer to unseen settings; its main contribution is agent training and evaluation.     该论文提出一种执行验证式协同进化方法，并采用同行相对策略优化训练自适应代码安全智能体，展示了其向未见设置的迁移能力；主要贡献在于智能体训练和评估。代码任务涉及多步执行，但摘要并未聚焦于推理机制；同行相对比较本身也不能证明组合泛化或可解释性。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    LLM code agents increasingly ship code with little oversight, yet defenders trained on static vulnerability datasets fall behind adapting adversaries. We co-train attacker and defender instead, and let execution decide every reward: an attacker (Red) edits a real repository and earns nothing unless its patch applies, builds, passes the tests, completes its development task and reproduces a real exploit in an isolated container, whose path also labels the entry point, the critical operation and the trace between them. Peer-Relative Policy Optimization (PRPO) makes both sides populations of LoRA adapters over one frozen base and credits each against same-role peers that faced an identical condition, placing the population inside the policy-gradient baseline rather than the opponent pool, with a tournament preserving diversity. Matching cancels the condition's difficulty: at equal coverage it is worth 2.3 points of balanced accuracy over a baseline computed on other conditions, and it matches a within-policy control at half the verifier spend. PRPO's 7B diff reviewer reaches 64.8% balanced accuracy on four unseen applications in three untrained languages, 5.5 points above supervised security fine-tuning and 4.4 above a frozen frontier reviewer (Claude Opus 4.8), which it leads by 15.8 on the application it trains on. Its 9B repository agent recovers 23 of 172 held-out VulnGym advisories, against 10 after supervised fine-tuning and 7 for the same backbone untrained under the same scaffold, and locates 17 of 43 reachable entry points against 13 for mini-swe-agent with GLM-5.2. Run unchanged on jailbreak defense, the same algorithm matches or exceeds WildGuard's static F1 at equal corpus and model size. Under a judge distinct from its training oracle it cuts attack success from 36.0% to 4.6%, against WildGuard's 8.9%.

    LLM 代码智能体越来越多地在缺少监督的情况下交付代码，而在静态漏洞数据集上训练的防御者难以跟上不断适应的对手。我们改为共同训练攻击者和防御者，并让执行结果决定每一项奖励：攻击者（Red）编辑真实代码库，只有当其补丁能够应用、构建成功、通过测试、完成开发任务，并在隔离容器中复现真实漏洞利用时才能获得奖励；容器中的利用路径还会标注入口点、关键操作以及两者之间的轨迹。同行相对策略优化（PRPO）将双方都构建为同一个冻结基础模型上的 LoRA 适配器群体，并根据每个适配器与面对相同条件的同角色同行进行比较来给予奖励；该方法将群体纳入策略梯度基线，而非对手池，并通过锦标赛保持多样性。匹配操作抵消了条件难度的影响：在覆盖率相同的情况下，相较于在其他条件上计算的基线，平衡准确率提高 2.3 个百分点；验证器开销减半时，表现则与策略内对照相当。PRPO 的 7B 差异审查器在四个未见过的应用和三种未训练过的语言上达到 64.8% 的平衡准确率，比有监督安全微调高 5.5 个百分点，比冻结的前沿审查器（Claude Opus 4.8）高 4.4 个百分点；在其训练所针对的应用上，该模型领先 15.8 个百分点。其 9B 代码库智能体在留出的 VulnGym 通报中找回 172 条中的 23 条，而有监督微调后为 10 条，在相同框架下未训练的同一骨干模型为 7 条；它还定位了 43 个可达入口点中的 17 个，而使用 GLM-5.2 的 mini-swe-agent 定位了 13 个。在越狱防御任务上原样运行时，该算法在语料库规模和模型规模相同的条件下，静态 F1 与 WildGuard 相当或更高。在评判模型与训练预言器不同时，该方法将攻击成功率从 36.0% 降至 4.6%，而 WildGuard 为 8.9%。
