    Boyi Liu, Yite Wang, Xinyu Lian, Fan Shu, Sida Li, Feng Yan, Mingjia Zhang, Yuxiong He, Zhewei Yao

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper builds and evaluates an asynchronous RL framework for long-horizon software engineering agents, with model-system coordination and training infrastructure as its main contribution. Its relevance to reasoning is limited to training problem-solving agents; it reports no specific reasoning mechanism, while the systems design offers transferable insight beyond application performance.

    该论文构建并评估了一个用于长时程软件工程智能体的异步 RL 框架，模型与系统协调及训练基础设施是其主要贡献。它与推理的关联仅限于训练问题求解智能体；论文没有报告具体的推理机制，而其系统设计提供了超越应用性能层面的可迁移见解。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Long-horizon agent training, including software engineering, is advancing rapidly, but the recipe and infrastructure needed for a strong reinforcement-learning baseline remain difficult to reproduce. This makes gains from new algorithms or data hard to distinguish from improvements to an under-tuned baseline. We present Arctic-SWE, a fully asynchronous RL framework that establishes such a baseline through model-system co-design, using overfitting on a small task pool as the testbed. This testbed exposes failures that early reward gains conceal and guides the integration of established components: gated reward, importance-weight control, aligned training and inference engines, and consistent state across policy updates. No single component is new, yet together they form the missing foundation. On raw R2E-Gym data, without new algorithms or data work, Arctic-SWE trains Qwen3.5-4B to 62.0% pass@1 on SWE-bench Verified. This is comparable to concurrent FrogNano (61.5%), which relies on online task synthesis, after about one-sixth as many training rollouts. Building on this foundation, we further filter and refine R2E-Gym, SWE-rebench V2, and Scale-SWE. With this curated subset, the 4B model improves from 47.4%/25.0%/37.9% to 65.0%/38.3%/59.7% on SWE-bench Verified/Pro-v1/Pro-v2, and the recipe also improves Qwen3.5-9B from 56.2%/31.9%/48.8% to 65.7%/39.6%/70.2% on Verified/Pro-v1/Pro-v2. Controlled comparisons show that both curation and test strengthening improve held-out performance, although stronger tests reduce apparent training-task mastery. Arctic-SWE provides a documented starting point for studying better algorithms, data and environments for asynchronous agent RL.

    中文

    长时程智能体训练（包括软件工程领域）正在快速发展，但构建强强化学习基线所需的方案和基础设施仍然难以复现。因此，新算法或新数据带来的收益难以与调优不足的基线所造成的差异区分开来。我们推出 Arctic-SWE，这是一种完全异步的 RL 框架，通过模型与系统协同设计建立此类基线，并以在小型任务池上过拟合作为测试平台。该测试平台能揭示早期奖励提升所掩盖的失败，并指导对成熟组件进行整合：门控奖励、重要性权重控制、训练与推理引擎对齐，以及策略更新期间保持状态一致。没有任何单个组件是新的，但将它们结合起来构成了缺失的基础。在原始 R2E-Gym 数据上，无需新算法或数据处理工作，Arctic-SWE 即可将 Qwen3.5-4B 训练至在 SWE-bench Verified 上达到 62.0% 的 pass@1。这与同期的 FrogNano（61.5%）相当；FrogNano 依赖在线任务合成，而 Arctic-SWE 使用的训练 rollout 约为其六分之一。在此基础上，我们进一步筛选并精炼 R2E-Gym、SWE-rebench V2 和 Scale-SWE。使用这一精选子集后，4B 模型在 SWE-bench Verified/Pro-v1/Pro-v2 上的成绩从 47.4%/25.0%/37.9% 提升至 65.0%/38.3%/59.7%；该方案还将 Qwen3.5-9B 在 Verified/Pro-v1/Pro-v2 上的成绩从 56.2%/31.9%/48.8% 提升至 65.7%/39.6%/70.2%。受控比较表明，数据筛选和测试强化都能提升留出表现，尽管更强的测试会降低表面上的训练任务掌握程度。Arctic-SWE 为研究异步智能体 RL 的更优算法、数据和环境提供了有文档记录的起点。

    What Can't Jev Decide? Probing the Limits of One-Pass Decision Models

    Jev 无法决定什么？探查单次前向决策模型的局限

    Wang Yang, Xinpeng Li, Yanyan Zhang, Chuang Ma, Shouren Wang, Jianzhe Wei, Liqin Ye, Xiaoran Cai, Mohsen Hariri, Vipin Chaudhary, Xiaotian Han

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper characterizes when one-pass decision models fail, linking errors to repeated state updates, interference, and the need for intermediate reasoning. This gives substantial evidence about reasoning limits and some insight into agent-loop use, but it does not investigate internal mechanisms or compositional generalization.

    论文刻画了单次前向决策模型何时会失败，并将错误与重复状态更新、干扰以及对中间推理的需求联系起来。这为理解推理能力的局限提供了大量证据，也对智能体循环中的应用有所启示，但没有研究内部机制或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Jev and its open replicas choose among the options a caller supplies with a single forward pass, fast enough to decide inside an agent loop. We ask what such a model cannot decide, and find a simple limit: Jev cannot make a decision that an LLM makes only by writing out intermediate steps. On a benchmark that varies one factor at a time, Jev finds and selects records without error up to 20k tokens and 64 options, but once the answer depends on two or more updates of one user, accuracy falls, to 53-80% at sixteen updates, because similar records interfere. Given a stale summary of the state, Jev follows it. On real decision items graded by how many thinking tokens a reference LLM needs, Jev answers 97.5% of the items that one forward pass of that LLM solves, but only 74% of the others. Jev also does not know its limit: its confidence flags the errors it makes itself but not those it inherits from a stale input, and neither an explicit nor a trained hand-off option catches the latter. The open models we evaluate share these limits. Checking the state such models rely on requires a model that reasons.

    中文

    Jev 及其开源复现版本通过一次前向传播，从调用方提供的选项中作出选择，速度足以在智能体循环中完成决策。我们探究这类模型无法决定什么，并发现一个简单的局限：对于只有通过写出中间步骤才能作出决策的大语言模型，Jev 无法作出同样的决策。在一个每次只改变一个因素的基准测试中，Jev 能够无误地查找并选择记录，直至 20k 个词元和 64 个选项；但一旦答案取决于对同一用户进行两次或更多次更新，准确率便会下降，在更新 16 次时降至 53–80%，原因是相似记录彼此干扰。给定一份过时的状态摘要时，Jev 会依照它行事。在一组真实决策题目上，按照参考大语言模型所需的思考词元数对题目分级，Jev 能答对参考模型通过一次前向传播解决的题目中的 97.5%，但对其余题目只能答对 74%。Jev 也不了解自身的局限：它的置信度能标出自身造成的错误，却无法标出从过时输入继承的错误；无论是显式还是经训练得到的移交选项，都无法捕捉后者。我们评估的开源模型也有相同局限。要检查这类模型所依赖的状态，需要一个能够推理的模型。

    Over-Defense in Coding Agents Begins at Silent Forks

    编码智能体的过度防御始于静默分岔点

    Hanjun Luo, Xuecheng Liu, Xiucheng Zhang, Zhuoning Xu, Yingbin Jin, Yankai Chen, Xue Liu, Hanan Salam

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    ForkDPO uses behavioral divergence at silent forks to improve coding-agent training, with gains in proportionate behavior. This substantially advances agent training and task execution, while reasoning is a secondary connection and the abstract offers no evidence about internal mechanisms or compositional generalization.

    ForkDPO 利用静默分岔点上的行为分歧改进编码智能体训练，并提升了行为的合乎比例程度。这项工作显著推进了智能体训练和任务执行；推理是次要关联，而摘要没有提供关于内部机制或组合泛化的证据。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Language models behind coding agents are post-trained with outcome rewards, and recent methods concentrate credit on the turns that decide the outcome. We find that defensive actions beyond what a task requires escape both. They begin at silent forks, the turns where every next action leads to the same outcome. Such actions leave the success rate unchanged, and frontier models take the disproportionate branch there in up to 91% of decisive actions under implicit budgets. The most direct fix, a checker in the trajectory reward, reaches these forks only through fully proportionate trajectories, leaving 74% of GRPO groups with identical rewards and behavior unchanged. This motivates a rethink of where learning signals belong, namely where behavior diverges, which a behavioral checker can locate and the outcome cannot. Our method, ForkDPO, contrasts a proportionate and a disproportionate action at the same prefix, at silent forks on both sides of the required behavior. On a test set of unseen repositories, it lowers a 4B model's disproportionate behavior from 70.3% to 58.9%, against 67.7% for DPO at randomly chosen turns, establishing behavioral divergence as a learning signal for how agents act beyond whether they finish. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/Astarojth/silent-forks.

    中文

    编码智能体背后的语言模型通过结果奖励进行后训练，近期方法会将功劳集中归于决定结果的轮次。我们发现，超出任务所需程度的防御性操作避开了这两类方法。它们始于静默分岔点，即每个后续动作都会导向相同结果的轮次。这类操作不会改变成功率，而在隐式预算下，前沿模型在多达 91% 的关键动作中会在此处选择不成比例的分支。最直接的修正方法是在轨迹奖励中加入检查器，但它只有通过完全合乎比例的轨迹才能触及这些分岔点，因此 74% 的 GRPO 组得到相同奖励，行为也不会改变。这促使我们重新思考学习信号应放在哪里：应放在行为出现分歧之处；行为检查器能够定位这些位置，而结果本身无法做到。我们的方法 ForkDPO 在同一前缀处对比合乎比例与不成比例的动作，并在所需行为两侧的静默分岔点上进行这种对比。在一个包含未见过的代码库的测试集上，它将一个 4B 模型的不成比例行为从 70.3% 降至 58.9%；而在随机选取的轮次上应用 DPO 时，该比例为 67.7%。这表明行为分歧可以作为学习信号，用于指导智能体的行为，而不仅仅是判断它们是否完成任务。代码已公开发布于 https://github.com/Astarojth/silent-forks。

    CasePlay: Self-Play Reinforcement Learning from Case Reports for Medical Reasoning

    CasePlay：利用病例报告进行自我博弈强化学习以提升医学推理

    Hao Wang, Zihan Wang, Kai Wu, Jian Yao, Yiwen Ye, Yongcan Luo, Dapeng Wu, Jiale Chen, Haihua Yang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    CasePlay develops self-play reinforcement learning to create reasoning-intensive medical training questions, with gains across clinical reasoning benchmarks. Its knowledge-point conditioning structures question generation, but the abstract does not establish a broader contribution to compositional generalization, model internals, or agent systems.

    CasePlay 通过自我博弈强化学习生成注重推理的医学训练问题，并在多个临床推理基准上取得提升。它通过知识点条件机制来构造问题，但摘要没有证明其对组合泛化、模型内部机制或智能体系统有更广泛的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Reinforcement learning (RL) is a promising way to improve the clinical reasoning abilities of large language models (LLMs), but current pipelines often rely on expert-labeled questions or costly synthetic-data generation. Meanwhile, the medical literature offers a wealth of high-quality unlabeled documents, including clinical case reports that trace the full clinical course from initial presentation to final treatment decisions. We study whether document-grounded self-play can convert these reports into effective RL training signals. We identify two challenges that limit existing self-play methods in this setting: knowledge-point fixation}, where the proposer repeatedly asks about a narrow set of salient clues in a source report, and difficulty-quality mismatch, where appropriately difficult questions may still be poorly formed or shallow, limiting their value for reasoner training. To address these challenges, we propose CasePlay, a self-play framework with two key components: (a) a Knowledge-Conditioned Proposer, which anchors question generation to case-specific knowledge points so that questions draw on a broader range of evidence from the source report; and (b) a Rubric-Judge Reasoner, which augments answer-accuracy feedback with rubric-based quality feedback on clue integration, reasoning depth, and option quality, guiding the proposer toward reasoning-intensive questions that better support reasoner training. Extensive experiments across seven medically related benchmarks demonstrate that CasePlay outperforms existing self-play baselines and improves the SFT warm-start model by 3.1 points on average, highlighted by a 6.3-point gain on LiveClin. This approach offers an effective path toward continually improving medical reasoning ability through self-play RL.

    中文

    强化学习（RL）是提升大语言模型（LLM）临床推理能力的一种有前景的方法，但当前流程往往依赖专家标注的问题或成本高昂的合成数据生成。与此同时，医学文献中有大量高质量的未标注文档，包括记录从初诊到最终治疗决策全过程的临床病例报告。我们研究以文档为依据的自我博弈能否将这些报告转化为有效的 RL 训练信号。我们发现，现有自我博弈方法在这一情境下受到两项挑战的限制：知识点固着，即提问者反复围绕源报告中一小部分显著线索提问；以及难度—质量不匹配，即使问题难度恰当，也可能构造不佳或流于浅显，从而降低其用于推理器训练的价值。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 CasePlay，这是一种包含两个关键组件的自我博弈框架：（a）知识条件提问者，它将问题生成锚定于病例特有的知识点，使问题能够依据源报告中范围更广的证据；（b）评分规准裁判推理器，它在答案准确性反馈之外，加入针对线索整合、推理深度和选项质量的评分规准式质量反馈，引导提问者提出更注重推理的问题，从而更好地支持推理器训练。在七个医学相关基准上的大量实验表明，CasePlay 优于现有自我博弈基线，并使 SFT 热启动模型的平均得分提高 3.1 分，其中 LiveClin 上的提升尤为突出，达到 6.3 分。这一方法为通过自我博弈 RL 持续提升医学推理能力提供了有效途径。

    CoworkEnv 合成可执行环境和示范，用于训练会使用工具的智能体，并通过实验考察 SFT 和 RL 的训练动态。其主要贡献推进了智能体训练和任务执行；工作流约束和多轮协作是相关背景，但摘要并未研究组合泛化或内部机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    AI coworkers must coordinate tools, communicate across turns, and act on changing workspace state while respecting workflow constraints. Constructing training experience for these capabilities requires coherent requests, service records, tool interfaces, and grading checks. We present CoworkEnv, a capability-guided framework for synthesizing executable training environments for AI coworkers. Workflow requirements guide task construction, and programmatic validation with feedback repair checks generated specifications and grading behavior. Teacher executions yield curated demonstrations for supervised fine-tuning (SFT), while student interactions provide rollouts and rewards for reinforcement learning (RL). Using these resources, we train compact PocketWorker models. For Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, SFT raises the mean score from 46.6 to 64.1 on Claw-Eval, including a 31.9-point gain on Multi-turn tasks. An SFT-only extension to ClawMark demonstrates applicability across coworker benchmarks. We further compare RL training dynamics across configurations that vary reward processing and credit assignment. Improving training rewards provide preliminary evidence that the constructed environments support policy optimization.

    中文

    AI 协作助手必须协调工具、跨轮次沟通，并在遵守工作流约束的同时应对不断变化的工作区状态。为这些能力构建训练经验，需要连贯的请求、服务记录、工具接口和评分检查。我们提出 CoworkEnv，这是一个能力引导框架，用于为 AI 协作助手合成可执行的训练环境。工作流要求指导任务构建，并通过带反馈修复的程序化验证来检查生成的规范和评分行为。教师执行过程产生经过筛选的监督微调（SFT）示范，而学生交互则为强化学习（RL）提供轨迹和奖励。我们利用这些资源训练了小型 PocketWorker 模型。对于 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct，SFT 将其在 Claw-Eval 上的平均得分从 46.6 提高至 64.1，其中多轮任务提升了 31.9 分。仅使用 SFT 扩展到 ClawMark 的实验表明，该方法适用于多个协作助手基准。我们还比较了不同奖励处理和信用分配配置下的 RL 训练动态。训练奖励的提升为这些构建的环境能够支持策略优化提供了初步证据。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    DeGMatch selects reasoning trajectories for capability-specific post-training by removing dominant population structure from candidate gradients, improving selection across domains and models. This is a substantial contribution to reasoning capability development; gradient analysis is a selection technique, not a study of internal representations, composition, or model systems.

    DeGMatch 通过从候选梯度中移除占主导地位的总体结构，为特定能力的后训练选择推理轨迹，并提升了跨领域和跨模型的数据选择效果。这对推理能力发展作出了实质性贡献；梯度分析是一种数据选择技术，并非对内部表示、组合性或模型系统的研究。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Reasoning post-training on long trajectories has substantially improved the reasoning capabilities of large language models, but scaling such training to large datasets is increasingly expensive. We study target-aware reasoning data selection, where a small reference set specifies a target capability and guides the selection of training trajectories for specialization. We find that existing target-aware methods can exhibit limited target discrimination on long reasoning trajectories, while dominant population-level structure in candidate gradients can obscure finer target-dependent variation during gradient matching. To address these limitations, we introduce Deconfounded Gradient Matching (DeGMatch), which first constructs a target-relevance gate and then reranks candidates using model-specific gradients. DeGMatch centers gradients using the candidate-population mean and removes leading principal directions before target matching, reducing the influence of dominant population-level structure and improving target discrimination. Across mathematics, science, and code, DeGMatch outperforms strong heuristic, target-aware, and reasoning-specific data selection baselines, while remaining effective across selection budgets, model families, and scales. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/CHLee0801/degmatch.

    中文

    基于长轨迹的推理后训练显著提升了大语言模型的推理能力，但将这种训练扩展到大型数据集的成本日益高昂。我们研究目标感知推理数据选择：由一个小型参考集指定目标能力，并据此指导训练轨迹的选择，以实现专门化。我们发现，现有目标感知方法在长推理轨迹上的目标区分能力可能有限；而在梯度匹配过程中，候选梯度中占主导地位的总体结构可能会掩盖更细微的目标依赖变化。为解决这些局限，我们提出去混杂梯度匹配（DeGMatch），先构建目标相关性门控，再利用特定于模型的梯度重新排序候选项。DeGMatch 使用候选总体均值对梯度进行中心化，并在目标匹配之前移除主导的主成分方向，从而降低总体主导结构的影响并提升目标区分能力。在数学、科学和代码领域，DeGMatch 均优于强大的启发式、目标感知和推理专用数据选择基线，并且在不同选择预算、模型系列和规模下都保持有效。我们的代码已公开发布于 https://github.com/CHLee0801/degmatch。

    Edward Gu, Ali Payani, Kevin Ellis

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    PRECOCIAL searches for synthetic data-generating programs that improve pretraining, and reports that optimized curricula transfer across domains and help on reasoning tasks. The program search and cross-domain transfer make composition and generalization a substantial contribution; reasoning improvement is an evaluated downstream result, while using an LLM and transformer in the search is only incidental to systems.

    PRECOCIAL 搜索能够改进预训练的合成数据生成程序，并报告优化后的课程可以跨领域迁移且有助于推理任务。程序搜索和跨领域迁移使组合与泛化成为一项重要贡献；推理能力的提升是经过评估的下游结果，而在搜索过程中使用大语言模型和 Transformer 仅与系统方向有附带关联。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Fully synthetic pretraining data generated by symbolic programs can bootstrap downstream training on naturalistic tasks, such as language modeling, but the generating programs have so far been designed by hand. We introduce PRECOCIAL, a method for automatically optimizing programs that generate synthetic pretraining data. Starting from an initial generator program, an LLM iteratively rewrites the program, and each rewrite is scored by pretraining a randomly-initialized transformer on its data and fine-tuning it on the downstream task. Because every score requires training, PRECOCIAL keeps a single network for the entire search, continuing its pretraining for each accepted program instead of training a new network per candidate, making it significantly more efficient. On four language and code datasets, at a fixed fine-tuning budget, optimized programs reach lower perplexity than hand-designed curricula, published procedural generators, random program mutation and the program the LLM writes in the first iteration of the search, and reach the same perplexity as the hand-designed curricula with 9-33% fewer fine-tuning steps. PRECOCIAL also ends with lower perplexity than FunSearch and AlphaEvolve, which train a new network for every candidate, at the same number of evaluations and a lower cost. We also observe that an optimized program generator from one domain transfers to datasets in other domains. Additionally, optimized programs allow for better downstream performance on four different reasoning and problem-solving tasks.

    中文

    由符号程序生成的全合成预训练数据可以为自然场景任务（如语言建模）的下游训练提供启动，但迄今为止，生成程序都是手工设计的。我们提出 PRECOCIAL，这是一种自动优化合成预训练数据生成程序的方法。该方法从一个初始生成程序开始，由大语言模型迭代改写程序，并通过在其生成的数据上对随机初始化的 Transformer 进行预训练，再在下游任务上微调，来评估每次改写。由于每次评分都需要训练，PRECOCIAL 在整个搜索过程中只保留一个网络；每当程序被接受，就继续对该网络进行预训练，而不是为每个候选程序训练一个新网络，从而显著提高效率。在四个语言和代码数据集上，在微调预算固定的情况下，优化后的程序比手工设计的课程、已发表的程序化生成器、随机程序变异以及大语言模型在搜索首轮编写的程序都能达到更低的困惑度；与手工设计的课程相比，它们只需 9–33% 更少的微调步骤就能达到相同困惑度。PRECOCIAL 的最终困惑度也低于 FunSearch 和 AlphaEvolve；后两者为每个候选程序训练一个新网络，而 PRECOCIAL 在评估次数相同且成本更低的情况下取得了这一结果。我们还观察到，一个领域中优化得到的程序生成器可以迁移到其他领域的数据集。此外，优化后的程序还能提升四种不同推理和问题求解任务的下游表现。

    Certified Sparse Attention via Perturbed Retrieval

    通过扰动检索实现经认证的稀疏注意力

    Runguo Li

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper’s main contribution is a certified sparse-attention algorithm with adaptive stopping, error guarantees, and improved efficiency for long-context decoding. It substantially advances model computation, but the abstract does not describe internal representation, compositional generalization, or reasoning contributions.

    本文的主要贡献是一种带自适应停止和误差保证的认证稀疏注意力算法，可提高长上下文解码的效率。它显著推进了模型计算，但摘要未描述内部表征、组合泛化或推理方面的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Sparse attention speeds up long-context decoding by reading few keys of the KV cache, but existing methods do not control the error of a query, and on real KV caches their errors have heavy tails. We show that perturbing the score of every key with an independent Exp(1) variable turns threshold retrieval into sampling keys with probability proportional to their attention weights. Lowering the threshold along a geometric grid gives nested samples, a Horvitz--Thompson estimate of the output at every level, and confidence bounds that hold simultaneously over all levels, so each head stops at the first level whose certificate meets the target error $\varepsilon$. With fresh perturbations at every decoding step, each certificate fails with probability at most $\delta$ during generation. At a suitable threshold, the estimator reads $O(\varepsilon^{-2}\log(1/\delta))$ values regardless of the context length, and no adaptive method reads fewer, up to constants. A 4-bit scan with deterministic bounds, shared across a grouped-query-attention group, generates the candidates exactly but reads every key. On three LLMs and ten settings at 16K--128K tokens, no certificate is violated, and at equal keys read our 90th-percentile error is 4.6--7.9$\times$ lower than that of the best of 15 baseline families. At equal bytes, the best baselines have 0.6--1.6 times our 90th-percentile error and at least 4.9 times our largest. End to end, our method stays within one point of dense attention on tasks and within 0.1\% in PG-19 perplexity, and the strongest baselines at equal bytes score as well. On CPU, decoding steps at 32K--128K tokens run 1.1--1.4$\times$ faster than dense attention on the same 16-bit cache.

    中文

    稀疏注意力通过仅读取 KV 缓存中的少量键来加速长上下文解码，但现有方法无法控制查询误差，而且在真实 KV 缓存上的误差具有重尾分布。我们证明，用相互独立的 Exp(1) 随机变量扰动每个键的分数，可将阈值检索转化为按与注意力权重成比例的概率对键进行采样。沿几何网格降低阈值可得到嵌套样本、每个层级的输出 Horvitz--Thompson 估计，以及对所有层级同时成立的置信界，因此每个注意力头会在其证书首次达到目标误差时停止$\varepsilon$。在生成过程中，每个解码步骤都使用新的扰动时，每个证书失效的概率至多为$\delta$。在合适的阈值下，无论上下文长度如何，估计器读取$O(\varepsilon^{-2}\log(1/\delta))$个值；在常数因子范围内，没有自适应方法读取的值更少。采用确定性界限的 4 位扫描在分组查询注意力组内共享，能够精确生成候选项，但会读取每个键。在 3 个 LLM 和 10 种设置下，序列长度为 16K--128K token 时，没有违反任何证书；在读取键数相同的条件下，我们的 90 百分位误差比 15 类基线中表现最佳者低 4.6--7.9$\times$。在字节数相同的条件下，最佳基线的 90 百分位误差为我们方法的 0.6--1.6 倍，最大误差至少为我们的 4.9 倍。从端到端表现看，我们的方法在各项任务上的得分与稠密注意力相差不超过 1 分，PG-19 困惑度差异在 0.1\% 以内；在字节数相同的条件下，最强基线的得分也相当。在 CPU 上，对于 32K--128K token 的解码步骤，相较于使用相同 16 位缓存的稠密注意力，速度提升 1.1--1.4$\times$倍。

    The paper proposes block-level recursive parameter sharing and analyzes how sharing granularity affects local refinement and depth-wise differentiation, with representation analyses.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Recursive Transformers depend not only on how many parameters are shared, but also on how shared parameters are organized across depth. Existing static schemes adopt two extreme reuse topologies: layer-wise repetition, where each layer is reused independently, and global cyclic reuse, where the entire stack is repeatedly applied as a single shared function. We argue that sharing granularity is an important factor in recursive parameter sharing. This study proposes Block Recursive Transformers (BRT), which partition layers into contiguous blocks and recursively reuse each block before moving to the next. This intermediate topology enables local refinement within blocks while preserving depth-wise transitions, without adding routing modules, auxiliary states, or extra training objectives. Across decoder-only models up to 1.7B parameters, with additional encoder-decoder and encoder-only studies, BRT improves validation negative log-likelihood and downstream accuracy over static recursive sharing baselines. Ablations and representation analyses further show that intermediate block granularity better balances local refinement and depth-wise differentiation. Project website: https://aim-skku.github.io/BRT/

    中文

    递归 Transformer 不仅取决于共享了多少参数，也取决于共享参数如何沿深度方向组织。现有静态方案采用两种极端的复用拓扑：逐层重复，即独立复用每一层；以及全局循环复用，即将整个堆栈作为单个共享函数反复应用。我们认为，共享粒度是递归参数共享中的一个重要因素。本研究提出块递归 Transformer（BRT），将层划分为连续的块，并在进入下一块之前递归复用每个块。这种中间拓扑使块内能够进行局部细化，同时保留深度方向的转换，且无需添加路由模块、辅助状态或额外训练目标。在参数量最高达 1.7B 的纯解码器模型上，以及额外的编码器-解码器和纯编码器研究中，与静态递归共享基线相比，BRT 提高了验证集负对数似然表现和下游准确率。消融实验和表征分析进一步表明，中间的块粒度能更好地平衡局部细化与深度方向的区分。项目网站：https://aim-skku.github.io/BRT/

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    UtoMe uses aligned observation uncertainty to guide token merging, improving the compute–accuracy trade-off in weather forecasting. Its transferable contribution is adaptive allocation of model computation; the weather application itself does not establish a connection to interpretability, composition, or reasoning.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Weather transformers process dense reanalysis fields whose reliability varies across variables, locations, and weather regimes. Token merging can reduce computation, but feature similarity alone does not account for this heterogeneous input uncertainty. We introduce UtoMe, an observation-uncertainty-guided token merging framework that combines dynamics saliency with ensemble data assimilation spread as a relative input-reliability proxy. The resulting importance score protects selected tokens as anchors and calibrates bipartite matching between the remaining tokens. Three variants use external uncertainty at both training and inference, during training only, or neither stage. In ERA5 72-hour forecasting at two spatial resolutions, UtoMe improves Overall error over train-time ToMe at matched token budgets. At $1.40625^\circ$ and 50% token reduction, UtoMe-E lowers Overall error from 67.32 to 53.00 at the same 0.55x encoder FLOPs. Small reductions remain close to the full-token baseline; larger reductions incur measurable accuracy losses. Component ablations and spatial uncertainty controls support combining dynamics with aligned uncertainty when allocating a weather transformer's token budget.

    中文

    Tieyuan Chen, Huabin Liu, Yingtao Zhang, Shijie Li, Tengyu Pan, Weiyao Lin, Jianguo Li

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    UpLoop introduces layer-wise recurrence and hidden-wise gates to upcycle pretrained LLMs, reporting improved benchmark accuracy as loop count increases. This is a substantial contribution to model computation design, while benchmark gains alone provide only an incidental connection to reasoning.

    UpLoop 引入逐层循环和逐隐藏维度门控，以升级预训练 LLM，并报告了随着循环次数增加，基准准确率得到提升。这是对模型计算设计的一项重要贡献，而单凭基准结果的提升与推理能力仅有附带联系。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Looped large language models trade parameter storage for recurrent computation, but most are trained from scratch. In practice, pretraining with looped depth is expensive, making post-training upcycling of a pretrained non-looped LLM an attractive alternative. We introduce \textbf{UpLoop}, a post-training recipe based on \emph{layer-wise} recurrence. Instead of looping a whole model or a middle block, UpLoop loops each selected layer locally, preserving the pretrained depth hierarchy and avoiding feature-space mismatch. To make loop execution useful, we add hidden-wise gates on the attention and MLP residual branches, so later loops act as progressive refinements rather than redundant rewrites. Empirically, UpLoop breaks the commonly observed saturation at two loops ($R=2$) in prior looped models. Starting from Qwen3-4B Base and applying SFT, UpLoop improves the average accuracy across 20 benchmarks by 6.17\% at $R=3$. We use $R=3$ as the main setting for the best accuracy--cost trade-off, while both native and extrapolated $R=4$ yield further gains.

    中文

    循环式大型语言模型以循环计算换取参数存储量的减少，但大多数模型都是从头开始训练的。实际上，采用循环深度进行预训练的代价很高，因此对预训练的非循环 LLM 进行后训练升级是一种有吸引力的替代方案。我们提出 \textbf{UpLoop}，一种基于\emph{逐层}循环的后训练方案。UpLoop 不循环整个模型或中间块，而是在每个选定层内进行局部循环，从而保留预训练模型的深度层级结构并避免特征空间不匹配。为了让循环执行发挥作用，我们在注意力和 MLP 残差分支上添加逐隐藏维度门控，使后续循环成为渐进式细化，而不是冗余重写。实验表明，UpLoop 打破了先前循环模型中常见的在两次循环时达到饱和的现象（$R=2$）。以 Qwen3-4B Base 为起点并应用 SFT 后，UpLoop 在$R=3$时将 20 个基准上的平均准确率提高了 6.17\%。我们采用$R=3$作为主要设置，以取得最佳准确率与成本权衡；而原生和外推的$R=4$也都带来了进一步提升。

    ReTrace: Visual Backtracking for Efficient Multimodal Large Language Models

    ReTrace：通过视觉回溯提高多模态大型语言模型的效率

    Guangzong Si, Dong Wang, Yifan Yu, Miao Liu, Panwang Pan, Wentao Zhu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    ReTrace identifies visual backtracking, where tokens with low early saliency are later used to retrieve context, and uses that finding to design a reversible token-compression method. This provides partial insight into inference behavior and reasoning, while its main contribution is efficient computation and KV-cache use; the attention analysis is not a broad study of representations or mechanisms.

    ReTrace 发现了视觉回溯现象，即早期显著性较低的令牌之后会被用于检索上下文，并据此设计了一种可逆令牌压缩方法。这为理解推理行为提供了部分洞见，其主要贡献则是提高计算和 KV 缓存的效率；注意力分析并非对表征或机制的广泛研究。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) encode images into dense visual token sequences, creating substantial attention and KV-cache overhead. Existing visual token compression methods reduce this cost by pruning low-saliency tokens in shallow layers, but this practice couples temporary computational deactivation with irreversible information deletion. We show that this coupling breaks an intrinsic inference pattern in MLLMs. Through layer-wise attention analysis, we identify \textbf{Visual Backtracking}: visual pivots remain spatially stable, yet in middle layers they actively retrieve context from tokens that appeared unimportant earlier. Thus, early low-saliency tokens can be inactive for computation while still being useful for later reasoning. Motivated by this finding, we propose \textbf{ReTrace}, a backtracking-aware compression framework that introduces a dormant token state. ReTrace caches non-pivot tokens outside expensive layer-wise computation, restores them during the backtracking window, and prunes only after their information has been absorbed. Experiments on Qwen2.5-VL and InternVL3 demonstrate nearly 90\% reductions in FLOPs and KV cache, a 2.83$\times$ prefilling speedup, and strong performance retention across complex vision-language benchmarks.

    中文

    多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）将图像编码为密集的视觉令牌序列，造成显著的注意力和 KV 缓存开销。现有视觉令牌压缩方法通过在浅层剪除显著性较低的令牌来降低成本，但这种做法将暂时停用计算与不可逆的信息删除捆绑在一起。我们发现，这种捆绑会破坏 MLLM 中一种内在的推理模式。通过逐层注意力分析，我们识别出\textbf{视觉回溯}：视觉枢轴在空间位置上保持稳定，但在中间层会主动从先前看似不重要的令牌中检索上下文。因此，早期显著性较低的令牌可以暂不参与计算，却仍对后续推理有用。受此发现启发，我们提出\textbf{ReTrace}，一种具备回溯感知能力的压缩框架，引入休眠令牌状态。ReTrace 将非枢轴令牌缓存在高开销的逐层计算之外，在回溯窗口期间恢复这些令牌，并仅在其信息被吸收后才剪除它们。在 Qwen2.5-VL 和 InternVL3 上的实验表明，FLOPs 和 KV 缓存减少近 90\%，预填充速度提升 2.83$\times$倍，同时在复杂视觉语言基准上保持了较强的性能。

    Conjugate Compilation: Self-Improving Agentic Co-Compilation for Speculative Decoding

    共轭编译：用于推测解码的自我改进式智能体协同编译

    Annabelle Sujun Tang, Rohan Mahapatra, Christopher Priebe, Hanyang Xu, Manya Ghobadi, Christopher Rossbach, Hadi Esmaeilzadeh

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper contributes a joint compiler and agentic search system that uses execution feedback to optimize speculative decoding, with measured serving speedups. Its cross-model layout composition and MCTS exploration are incidental to the central systems contribution, without substantive compositional-generalization or reasoning insight.

    本文贡献了一套联合编译器与智能体搜索系统，利用执行反馈优化推测解码，并测得了服务速度提升。跨模型布局组合和 MCTS 探索只是核心系统贡献的附带部分，并未实质性推进组合泛化或推理能力。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    As LLM adoption surges, scaling model serving requires unlocking stranded GPU capacity alongside deploying more GPUs. Speculative decoding brings two models into the serving process: a small draft model proposes tokens that a larger target model verifies. Yet compiling these models individually leaves their shared execution outside the compiler's optimization boundary. We introduce CONJUGATE COMPILATION, which reframes speculative decoding as a cross-model compilation problem and jointly optimizes the draft and target models within their shared execution rather than treating each in isolation. Our key insight is that cross-model compilation should be informed by the measured performance of the co-located shared execution it produces: an optimization that improves a kernel in isolation need not improve the models when they execute together. To expand cross-model opportunities, we devise operand layouts that interleave blocks from both models within common tiles, co-locating GEMM and non-GEMM work while preserving their mathematics. We realize CONJUGATE COMPILATION through a self-improving agentic search system in which an LLM edits cross-model optimization plans using the compiler and GPU execution as its environment. Each proposed plan is compiled and evaluated through its co-located shared execution, whose measured score, together with kernel-level verdicts and compiler feedback, informs subsequent proposals, while Monte Carlo tree search accumulates rewards to guide exploration. Across six single-GPU speculative-decoding configurations on NVIDIA B300 and RTX 5090 GPUs, CONJUGATE COMPILATION achieves a geometric-mean per-round speedup of 1.37x over conventional execution. Interleaved kernels raise this speedup to 1.45x, reaching 1.59x in the best case. CONJUGATE COMPILATION also improves GPU utilization on average by 1.46x on RTX 5090 and 1.50x on B300.

    中文

    随着 LLM 的应用迅速增长，要扩大模型服务规模，除了部署更多 GPU，还需要释放闲置的 GPU 容量。推测解码将两个模型引入服务流程：小型草稿模型提出令牌，再由较大的目标模型进行验证。然而，分别编译这两个模型，会使它们的共享执行过程留在编译器优化范围之外。我们提出共轭编译，将推测解码重新定义为跨模型编译问题，并在草稿模型和目标模型的共享执行过程中对二者进行联合优化，而非将其孤立处理。我们的核心洞见是，跨模型编译应以其所产生的共置共享执行的实测性能为依据：单独优化某个内核后性能有所改善，并不意味着模型协同执行时也会有所改善。为了拓展跨模型优化机会，我们设计了操作数布局，在公共瓦片中交错排列两个模型的块，使 GEMM 和非 GEMM 工作共置，同时保持其数学性质。我们通过一个自我改进的智能体搜索系统实现共轭编译：LLM 在以编译器和 GPU 执行为环境的过程中编辑跨模型优化方案。每个提议的方案都会经过编译，并通过共置共享执行进行评估；实测分数以及内核级判定和编译器反馈会为后续方案提供依据，同时蒙特卡洛树搜索累积奖励以引导探索。在 NVIDIA B300 和 RTX 5090 GPU 上的六种单 GPU 推测解码配置中，与常规执行相比，共轭编译实现了 1.37x 的几何平均每轮加速比。交错内核将加速比提高至 1.45x，最佳情况下达到 1.59x。共轭编译还使 RTX 5090 和 B300 上的平均 GPU 利用率分别提高了 1.46x 和 1.50x。

    Latent World Models Should Plan with Distances Along the Latent Manifold

    潜在世界模型应沿潜在流形上的距离进行规划

    Zunzhi You, Linwei Tao, Siyu Xu, Yunke Wang, Chang Xu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper identifies misleading ambient-space costs in latent world-model planning and proposes graph-based manifold distances that improve planning success. This provides substantive evidence about latent representation geometry, but does not investigate internal mechanisms; the main advance is in planning and problem solving, while graph distances alone do not establish compositional generalization or a broader memory or agent-system contribution.

    本文指出了潜在世界模型规划中环境空间代价会产生误导的问题，并提出基于图的流形距离来提高规划成功率。这为潜在表征几何提供了实质性证据，但未研究内部机制；主要进展在于规划和问题求解，单凭图距离并不能证明组合泛化，也未带来更广泛的记忆或智能体系统贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Latent world models such as LeWM plan by searching for an action sequence whose predicted terminal latent is closest to the goal latent under an ambient norm, such as the Euclidean distance. Planning with such a cost assumes that proximity in the ambient latent space reflects proximity to the goal in the environment. Studying LeWM, we find that this assumption holds only in a small neighborhood around the goal, whereas farther away the L2 cost forms spurious low-cost basins that trap the planner. Yet neighborhood-based embeddings show that the latents retain the underlying physical state. We therefore hypothesize that the latents lie near a curved, low-dimensional manifold, and that the terminal cost should measure the distance along this latent manifold rather than through the ambient space. To estimate this manifold distance, we propose the Neighborhood Graph Cost (NGC), which computes shortest-path distances on a mutual nearest-neighbor graph constructed over training latents. NGC changes only the terminal cost and requires no retraining. This single change improves the planning success rate of LeWM across all four benchmark tasks and nearly solves TwoRoom and Reacher: even at the farthest goal offsets tested, NGC reaches 95% and 100% success, whereas the L2 cost falls to 27% and 81%. These results support the manifold hypothesis and our argument that latent world models should plan with distances along the latent manifold.

    中文

    诸如 LeWM 的潜在世界模型通过搜索动作序列来进行规划，使预测的终止潜变量在欧几里得距离等环境范数下最接近目标潜变量。采用这种代价进行规划，意味着假设环境潜在空间中的接近程度能反映环境中与目标的接近程度。我们研究 LeWM 后发现，这一假设只在目标附近的小范围内成立；距离目标较远时，L2 代价会形成虚假的低代价盆地，使规划器陷入其中。然而，基于邻域的嵌入表明，潜变量保留了底层物理状态。因此，我们假设这些潜变量位于弯曲的低维流形附近，而终止代价应衡量沿该潜在流形的距离，而非穿过环境空间的距离。为估计这种流形距离，我们提出邻域图代价（NGC），在根据训练潜变量构建的互为最近邻图上计算最短路径距离。NGC 只改变终止代价，无需重新训练。这一项改动提高了 LeWM 在全部四个基准任务上的规划成功率，并几乎解决了 TwoRoom 和 Reacher：即使在测试的最远目标偏移处，NGC 仍分别达到 95% 和 100% 的成功率，而 L2 代价则降至 27% 和 81%。这些结果支持流形假设，也支持我们的主张：潜在世界模型应沿潜在流形上的距离进行规划。

    The paper uses targeted head ablations and activation replacements across model families to identify attention heads that causally affect language choice, a substantial mechanistic contribution. It does not study composition, reasoning, or model and agent systems.

    ENGLISH

    Large language models sometimes reply in an unexpected language, a failure known as language confusion. We ablate individual attention heads in 12 model checkpoints spanning seven model series, using FLORES-200 continuations in five languages and Language Confusion Benchmark (LCB) chat replies. In ten models, zeroing one head causes substantially more departures from the expected language than zeroing any other head in its layer; its LCB pass-rate drop persists, though reduced, under mean ablation. Seven heads move 8.0 to 51.5 percent of all FLORES continuations out of the prompt's language, versus at most 1.4 percent for other same-layer heads; the other three mainly affect explicitly requested languages. These seven heads matter less in base models given plain text. In two models, replacing the values a head reads at the requested-language name with another language's mean makes replies fail and shifts some into that language, unlike a random change of equal size. Replacing a head's output with another language's mean redirects 84 to 99 percent of scored non-English monolingual LCB replies into that language in five models. Yet the requested language's mean improves crosslingual replies beyond every control head only in the two Gemma models, whose baselines are low. Code and results are available in the public repository at https://github.com/christian-hoang-04/anonymous-release.

    大型语言模型有时会用意料之外的语言作答，这种故障称为语言混乱。我们在涵盖七个模型系列的 12 个模型检查点上消融了单个注意力头，使用五种语言的 FLORES-200 续写和语言混乱基准（LCB）聊天回复。在十个模型中，将一个注意力头置零，比将同层任何其他注意力头置零更显著地增加了偏离预期语言的情况；即使采用均值消融，其 LCB 通过率的下降仍然存在，只是程度有所减轻。七个注意力头会使全部 FLORES 续写中有 8.0 至 51.5 个百分点偏离提示所用语言，而同层其他注意力头造成的比例至多为 1.4%；另外三个主要影响明确要求使用的语言。在只给定纯文本时，这七个头在基础模型中的作用较小。在两个模型中，将某个头在读取所请求语言名称时所读到的值替换为另一种语言的均值，会导致回复失败，并使部分回复转向该语言；等幅度的随机改动则不会产生这种效果。在五个模型中，将某个头的输出替换为另一种语言的均值，会使评分过的非英语单语 LCB 回复中有 84% 至 99% 转为该语言。然而，只有在基线表现较低的两个 Gemma 模型中，所请求语言的均值才会使跨语言回复的表现优于每一个控制头。代码和结果可在公开仓库中获取：https://github.com/christian-hoang-04/anonymous-release。

    Beyond the Teacher: Understanding and Preserving Distillation Overshoot in Agentic On-Policy Distillation

    超越教师：理解并保留智能体在线策略蒸馏中的蒸馏过冲

    Jike Zhong, Ming Li, Yuxiang Lai, Xi Xiao, Sheng Zhang, Ritwick Chaudhry, Tianle Chen, Jingyu Xie, Zheda Mai, Shao-Yuan Lo, Konstantinos Psounis, Yuanyuan Lei

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper explains how on-policy distillation repairs weak decisions while eroding successful ones, then proposes a method to preserve gains in multi-turn agent tasks, advancing training for problem-solving capabilities. Its agentic setting gives Systems a partial connection, but the contribution focuses on distillation rather than agent architecture or organization.

    本文解释了在线策略蒸馏如何修正薄弱决策，同时削弱成功决策，并提出一种在多轮智能体任务中保留收益的方法，从而推进问题求解能力的训练。其智能体场景与系统领域有一定联系，但贡献聚焦于蒸馏，而非智能体架构或组织方式。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    On-policy distillation (OPD) trains agents on their own trajectories using supervision from a stronger teacher. We uncover a counterintuitive phenomenon in multi-turn agentic tasks: a smaller, initially weaker student can substantially outperform its teacher during training, only to regress as distillation continues. We term this phenomenon distillation overshoot. Through decision- and task-level analyses, we trace overshoot to two competing effects of OPD: repairing weak student decisions and eroding successful student choices that the teacher disfavors. Early in training, repair outpaces erosion, allowing the student to combine the teacher's corrections with its own strengths and surpass the teacher. As training continues, erosion overtakes repair, causing these gains to vanish. Motivated by this finding, we propose Success-Preserving On-Policy Distillation (SPOD), which selectively masks conflicting teacher supervision on successful student choices and introduces a soft probability floor to counteract their erosion, while retaining teacher guidance elsewhere. SPOD requires only binary episode success and model probabilities already available during OPD. Across two model families and three agentic benchmarks, SPOD consistently outperforms ordinary OPD and evaluated variants, improving final success by up to 15.2 percentage points and surpassing the teacher by up to 20.0 points. Moreover, SPOD's final checkpoints outperform even ordinary OPD's best intermediate checkpoints in all six settings, demonstrating that beyond-teacher gains can be not only preserved but further extended. Code: https://github.com/Jike338/SPOD

    中文

    在线策略蒸馏（OPD）利用更强教师模型的监督，在智能体自身的轨迹上训练智能体。我们在多轮智能体任务中发现了一种反直觉现象：一个起初较弱、规模较小的学生模型在训练期间可以大幅超越教师模型，但随着蒸馏继续进行，表现又会退化。我们将这一现象称为蒸馏过冲。通过决策层面和任务层面的分析，我们将过冲归因于 OPD 的两种相互竞争的作用：修正学生模型较弱的决策，以及削弱教师模型不认可的学生模型成功选择。训练初期，修正作用强于削弱作用，使学生模型能够将教师的纠正与自身优势结合起来并超越教师。随着训练继续，削弱作用会超过修正作用，导致这些收益消失。受此发现启发，我们提出成功保留型在线策略蒸馏（SPOD）：它会选择性地屏蔽教师对学生成功选择的冲突监督，并引入软概率下限以抵消这些选择受到的削弱，同时在其他地方保留教师指导。SPOD 只需要二元的回合成功信号和 OPD 中已有的模型概率。在两个模型系列的三个智能体基准上，SPOD 的表现始终优于普通 OPD 和所评估的变体，最终成功率最多提高 15.2 个百分点，并最多超越教师 20.0 个百分点。此外，在全部六种设置中，SPOD 的最终检查点都优于普通 OPD 最佳的中间检查点，表明不仅能够保留超越教师的收益，还能进一步扩大这些收益。代码：https://github.com/Jike338/SPOD

    The paper’s main contribution is a model–harness co-evolution framework that selects and adapts models alongside agent execution scaffolds.     本文的主要贡献是一种模型—执行框架协同演进框架，可在选择和适配模型的同时演进智能体执行脚手架。其历史继承机制和智能体组织方式与系统领域密切相关；应用任务和 SFT 轨迹并未体现对可解释性、组合泛化或推理机制的实质性贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Model--harness co-evolution has emerged as a prominent paradigm for recursive self-improving (RSI) agents, jointly evolving their execution scaffolds and intrinsic capabilities. We study the persistent yet often overlooked brain--body mismatch problem in this paradigm, where an evolving harness (body) demands behaviors its model (brain) has not learned or restricts capabilities it already possesses. We introduce CoEvo-RSI, a RSI framework that advances model--harness co-evolution through agent-driven, bidirectional historical inheritance. Drawing on a shared evolutionary archive and execution feedback, a meta-agent coordinates harness development from historical designs with model checkpoint selection or merging and subsequent adaptation under the selected harness, aligning inherited capabilities with evolving execution requirements to reduce brain--body mismatch. Using only supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on its own rejection-sampled trajectories, CoEvo-RSI makes Qwen3.5-9B competitive with larger models across diverse vertical applications, including multi-agent failure attribution, role-aware text-to-SQL, and smart-home instruction following. It surpasses DeepSeek-V4-Pro on TraceElephant (+14.16 agent accuracy) and GLM-5.3 on HomeBench VM (+4.90 success rate), underscoring the need for brain--body alignment and the potential of bidirectional historical inheritance to advance agent co-evolution.

    模型—执行框架协同演进已成为递归自我改进（RSI）智能体的一种重要范式，它使智能体的执行脚手架与内在能力共同演进。我们研究这一范式中持续存在却常被忽视的脑—身不匹配问题：不断演进的执行框架（身体）要求模型（大脑）执行其尚未学会的行为，或限制其已经具备的能力。我们提出 CoEvo-RSI，这是一种通过智能体驱动的双向历史继承推进模型—执行框架协同演进的 RSI 框架。元智能体利用共享的演化档案和执行反馈，协调基于历史设计的执行框架开发、模型检查点选择或合并，以及在选定执行框架下的后续适配，使继承的能力与不断变化的执行要求相匹配，从而减少脑—身不匹配。CoEvo-RSI 仅使用基于自身拒绝采样轨迹的监督微调（SFT），便使 Qwen3.5-9B 在多个垂直应用领域达到与更大型模型相当的竞争力，包括多智能体故障归因、角色感知型 text-to-SQL，以及智能家居指令遵循。它在 TraceElephant 上超过 DeepSeek-V4-Pro（智能体准确率高 14.16），在 HomeBench VM 上超过 GLM-5.3（成功率高 4.90），凸显了脑—身对齐的必要性，也展现了双向历史继承推进智能体协同演进的潜力。

    DAGLoop: Aligning Method Design with Experimental Feedback in Automated AI Research

    DAGLoop：在自动化 AI 研究中使方法设计与实验反馈相契合

    Dengyuxing Wang, Yonggang Zhang, Qianshu Cai, Huajiang Zheng, Jun Song, Yangqiu Song, and Yike Guo

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    DAGLoop uses targeted ablations, dependency graphs, and structured research memory to help research agents evaluate and revise method designs, a substantial contribution to agent systems and experimentation. Its design-decision dependencies are only incidental to compositional generalization, and it does not study model internals.

    DAGLoop 利用有针对性的消融、依赖图和结构化研究记忆，帮助研究智能体评估并修改方法设计，对智能体系统和实验方法作出了实质性贡献。其设计决策间的依赖关系与组合泛化仅有附带关联，且该工作并未研究模型内部机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Automated AI research agents aim to improve machine learning methods by iteratively proposing, implementing, and evaluating candidate methods. Existing work uses the outcome of each evaluation to determine how the next candidate should be revised for performance improvement. However, a candidate often combines multiple design decisions, and its overall outcome alone does not reveal which decisions produced their expected effects, whether their required conditions were satisfied, or which decisions should be retained or revised. Inspired by ablation studies in the machine learning community, we propose DAGLoop to test the expected effect of a design decision by comparing implementations with and without that decision while preserving the other decisions it requires. Specifically, DAGLoop translates each design decision's rationale into a testable expectation and pairs it with a targeted experiment, forming an experimental specification for assessing the expected effect under its required conditions. Using these specifications, we formulate ablation planning as the construction of a directed acyclic graph (DAG) from the candidate method's design: nodes associate decisions with tests, and edges encode dependencies. The DAG specifies which decisions each experiment must retain and supports joint tests when an expected effect requires several decisions to act together. Outcomes are recorded with the tested decisions, expectations, and conditions to form structured research memory. This memory guides the agent in retaining experimentally supported decisions, revising unsupported ones, and planning further experiments when the evidence is unresolved. Experiments on dozens of research tasks demonstrate substantial performance improvements achieved by DAGLoop across diverse executable research settings. Code and evaluation scripts are available at https://github.com/deng34567/DAGLoop.

    中文

    自动化 AI 研究智能体旨在通过反复提出、实现和评估候选方法来改进机器学习方法。现有工作利用每次评估的结果，决定如何修改下一个候选方案以提升性能。然而，候选方案往往结合了多个设计决策，仅凭整体结果无法看出哪些决策产生了预期效果、其所需条件是否得到满足，或哪些决策应予保留或修改。受机器学习领域消融研究的启发，我们提出 DAGLoop：通过比较包含和不包含某项设计决策的实现，同时保留该决策所依赖的其他决策，来检验该决策的预期效果。具体而言，DAGLoop 将每项设计决策的依据转化为可检验的预期，并为其配套一项有针对性的实验，从而形成实验规范，用于在所需条件下评估预期效果。基于这些规范，我们将消融规划表述为根据候选方法的设计构建有向无环图（DAG）：节点将决策与测试关联起来，边则表示依赖关系。DAG 规定每项实验必须保留哪些决策，并支持在预期效果需要多项决策共同发挥作用时进行联合测试。实验结果会与所测试的决策、预期和条件一并记录，形成结构化研究记忆。这种记忆帮助智能体保留得到实验支持的决策、修改缺乏支持的决策，并在证据尚无定论时规划进一步实验。在数十项研究任务上的实验表明，DAGLoop 在多种可执行研究场景中显著提升了性能。代码和评估脚本见 https://github.com/deng34567/DAGLoop。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    CSPO 自适应校准策略优化中的序列级裁剪，并给出了误覆盖率以及目标函数和梯度误差的界，同时在推理基准上进行了实验。其贡献推进了推理模型的训练；而策略优化与智能体系统仅有附带关联。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Reinforcement learning improves the reasoning capability of large language models through verifiable rewards for mathematical and coding tasks. In token-level methods such as GRPO, clipping acts on individual token ratios while the reward and advantage apply to a complete response. Recent sequence-level methods align these units but still use fixed clipping bands, whose tail probabilities change as the score distribution evolves. We propose Conformal Prediction-Enabled Sequence-level Policy Optimization (CSPO), which adaptively calibrates sequence-level clipping bounds using recent training statistics. The resulting band targets a specified marginal tail budget and adapts to policy drift; calibration conditional on response length requires additional assumptions. We bound the probability that a fresh score falls outside the band by the target miscoverage level plus explicit CDF discrepancy and drift terms. Under additional moment conditions, this bound also controls the objective and gradient error relative to the unclipped GSPO power surrogate. Experiments with the Qwen3-1.7B series show improvements over GSPO on difficult mathematical reasoning benchmarks and ALFWorld, with clipping endpoints that adapt during training.

    Pre-Query Retention with Bounded Bit and Word Retrieval

    预查询保留：有界比特与字检索

    Pranav Singh, Prashant Singh

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper characterizes how much pre-query memory is needed under bounded retrieval and gives encoders and matching bounds. Its memory and dialogue-agent setting is a systems connection, but the central contribution is formal retention capacity rather than agent reasoning or internal model mechanisms; query combinations are not a substantive compositional-generalization contribution.

    本文刻画了有界检索条件下预查询所需的记忆量，并给出了编码器和相应的界。其记忆与对话智能体场景与系统领域相关，但核心贡献是对记忆容量的形式化分析，而非智能体推理或模型内部机制；查询组合也未构成实质性的组合泛化贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    An agent can retain information before receiving a future question and later retrieve evidence from an archive. Evaluating this arrangement requires accounting for both retained information and the width of each retrieval response. Decision-tree capacity bounds describe individual sets of distinguishable records, but a memory writer must encode every possible record before the query is known. We study fixed-length retention beside an immutable binary archive, with a worst-case limit on raw bit or word reads. We characterize feasible one-bit-read memory cells and construct encoders that partition the complete record space. Supporting pairwise exclusive disjunction and conjunction with one bit read is equivalent to supporting every Boolean query. For multiple reads, we combine explicit encoders with decision-tree counting and an entropy converse. The word-read bounds differ by at most two retained bits when the read budget is at most half the archive length. Under an explicit condition on word width and archive length, raw-word caching attains the exact optimum among all writers. A related condition preserves this optimum under positive average error. Exhaustive checks validate the implementations. In a matched dialogue-agent study, a categorical sufficient statistic preserves source decisions with less storage and lower decoding latency than the universal encoder. A catalogue-specific index reduces private state further and requires additional shared storage. The results characterize how response width and future query structure determine retention requirements.

    智能体可以在收到未来问题之前保留信息，之后再从档案中检索证据。评估这种安排时，既要考虑保留的信息量，也要考虑每次检索响应的宽度。决策树容量界描述的是各组可区分记录，但记忆写入器必须在查询尚未知晓时编码所有可能的记录。我们研究了与不可变二进制档案并存的定长信息保留，并对原始比特或字的读取次数施加最坏情况限制。我们刻画了可行的单比特读取记忆单元，并构造了将完整记录空间划分为若干部分的编码器。用一次比特读取支持成对异或和合取，等价于支持所有布尔查询。对于多次读取，我们将显式编码器与决策树计数和熵反证法结合起来。当读取预算不超过档案长度的一半时，字读取界之间最多相差两个保留比特。在字宽度和档案长度满足明确条件时，原始字缓存可在所有写入器中达到精确最优。相关条件还能保证在正的平均错误率下仍达到这一最优值。穷举检查验证了这些实现。在一项匹配对话智能体研究中，与通用编码器相比，类别型充分统计量以更少的存储和更低的解码延迟保留了来源决策。特定目录的索引进一步减少了私有状态，但需要额外的共享存储。结果刻画了响应宽度和未来查询结构如何决定信息保留需求。

    Deep Fusion Memory: A Chunk-Level Parametric Memory for Large Language Models

    Deep Fusion Memory：面向大型语言模型的块级参数化记忆

    Rubin Wei, Siyuan Sun, Hao Sun, Yuliang Liu, Xiang Shi, Jiarui Wang, Junming Zhang, Zhouhan Lin

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    DFM introduces chunk-level parametric memory predicted from context and fused into model hidden states, with reduced construction cost and gains on QA and adaptation. This is a substantial memory architecture contribution, but the abstract offers no analysis of internal representations or reasoning mechanisms; QA performance alone does not establish those connections.

    DFM 提出一种块级参数化记忆：根据上下文预测记忆并将其融合到模型隐藏状态中，同时降低构建成本，并在 QA 和适配任务上取得提升。这是一项重要的记忆架构贡献，但摘要没有分析内部表征或推理机制；仅有 QA 性能并不能证明与这些方面存在关联。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language models need effective ways to acquire and use external knowledge beyond what they retain from pretraining. Continued pretraining risks catastrophic forgetting, while retrieval at inference time can add substantial overhead. External parametric memory avoids online retrieval, but constructing its training data requires extensive offline search, and output-level interpolation provides only shallow fusion. We introduce Deep Fusion Memory (DFM), a parametric memory architecture that reduces this construction workload and incorporates learned memory into intermediate hidden states. A causal memory predictor learns to generate memory from the preceding context, using retrieved chunk embeddings from the corpus as supervision. The predicted memory is shared across tokens within each chunk and fused into their hidden states through gated cross-attention. Memory prediction and fusion are trained end to end with the backbone frozen, and inference requires no explicit retrieval. Compared with existing parametric memory approaches, which often construct token-level memory targets, DFM requires $32\times$ fewer retrieval queries and $2048\times$ fewer retrieved items to construct its training data. Across six QA tasks, DFM performs better over the strongest baseline by 12.71% on Mistral-7B-v0.3 and 11.19% on Qwen3-8B-Base. Beyond QA, domain adaptation yields average gains of 6.51 and 4.38 points over Qwen3-4B-Base and Qwen3-8B-Base, respectively.

    中文

    大型语言模型需要有效的方法来获取和使用预训练所保留知识之外的外部知识。继续预训练有灾难性遗忘的风险，而推理时检索可能带来显著开销。外部参数化记忆无需在线检索，但构建其训练数据需要大量离线搜索，且输出层插值只能实现浅层融合。我们提出 Deep Fusion Memory（DFM），这是一种参数化记忆架构，能够减少构建工作量，并将学习到的记忆融入中间隐藏状态。因果记忆预测器通过前序上下文学习生成记忆，并以从语料库检索到的块嵌入作为监督信号。预测出的记忆在每个块内的 token 之间共享，并通过门控交叉注意力融合到这些 token 的隐藏状态中。记忆预测与融合在骨干模型冻结的情况下进行端到端训练，推理时无需显式检索。与通常构建 token 级记忆目标的现有参数化记忆方法相比，DFM 构建训练数据所需的检索查询减少了 $32\times$ 项，所需检索条目减少了 $2048\times$ 项。在六项 QA 任务上，DFM 的表现比最强基线在 Mistral-7B-v0.3 上高 12.71%，在 Qwen3-8B-Base 上高 11.19%。除 QA 外，领域适配相较于 Qwen3-4B-Base 和 Qwen3-8B-Base，平均分别提升 6.51 和 4.38 分。

    Explore or Confirm? LLM Agents Misallocate Measurements Under Noise

    探索还是确认？LLM 智能体在噪声下错误分配测量预算

    Abdul Karim, Matt Keon

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper measures how language-model agents allocate a fixed experimental budget between exploration and confirmation, identifies distinct failure modes, and evaluates interventions in a new benchmark. This strongly advances agent decision-making and empirical reasoning evaluation; its agents have no tools or persistent memory, so system-design contributions are limited to the benchmark and training environment.

    本文测量语言模型智能体如何在探索与确认之间分配固定实验预算，识别不同的失败模式，并在新基准上评估干预措施。这项工作有力推进了智能体决策和经验性推理评估；其智能体没有工具或持久记忆，因此系统设计方面的贡献主要限于基准和训练环境。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    As model reasoning gets cheaper, the physical experiment becomes the slow and costly step in discovery. Each experiment returns a noisy reading: a high value can mean a good candidate or a lucky draw. With a fixed budget, an AI agent must keep choosing between exploring a new candidate and confirming a promising one by re-testing it. We measure that choice in Wellocate, a simulated assay campaign with known true values. It is built on a generated landscape and on two real protein datasets, GB1 and PhoQ, scrambled so no model can answer from memory. We test five language models as minimal agents, with no tools and no memory beyond the history in each prompt. They misallocate in both directions. Three over-confirm, spending most of the budget re-testing. On the generated landscape one under-confirms, trusting single readings, and there every model ends with a worse final pick than a basic scripted strategy. Each failure has its own cause. The over-confirmers run short of new candidates worth trying: a list of untried candidates cuts their re-testing and, on real protein data, makes two of them pick much better. A running summary of their readings or a description of the landscape changes it by at most five percentage points. For the under-confirmer, re-testing its top candidates in a final round, replayed on its own campaigns, recovers only about a quarter of what it loses by picking the wrong candidate. This suggests confirmation has to run through the whole campaign. We release Wellocate as a benchmark and reinforcement-learning environment with frozen splits and scripted baselines. With it, anyone can measure how an agent splits its budget before trusting it with real experiments, and train agents to split it better. Code, data and the environment are available at https://github.com/Xstendyl/wellocate.

    中文

    随着模型推理成本降低，物理实验成为发现过程中耗时且昂贵的环节。每次实验都会返回带噪读数：高值可能意味着候选对象优良，也可能只是一次幸运抽样。在预算固定的情况下，AI 智能体必须不断在探索新候选对象和通过重新测试来确认有希望的对象之间作出选择。我们在 Wellocate 中测量这种选择；这是一个具有已知真实值的模拟测定实验流程。它基于生成的景观和两个真实蛋白质数据集 GB1 与 PhoQ，并对数据进行打乱，使模型无法凭记忆作答。我们将五种语言模型作为最简智能体进行测试，不提供工具，也不提供提示中历史记录以外的记忆。它们在两个方向上都会错误分配预算。三个模型过度确认，将大部分预算用于重复测试。在生成的景观上，一个模型确认不足，轻信单次读数；在该景观上，每个模型最终选出的对象都不如一种基础脚本策略。每种失败都有其自身原因。过度确认的模型会耗尽值得尝试的新候选对象：提供一份尚未尝试的候选对象列表，可减少它们的重复测试；在真实蛋白质数据上，这让其中两个模型的选择显著改善。提供读数的持续摘要或景观描述，带来的变化至多为五个百分点。对于确认不足的模型，在最终轮次重新测试其排名靠前的候选对象，并在其自身实验流程上重放这一做法，只能挽回因选错候选对象而损失的约四分之一。这表明，确认过程必须贯穿整个实验流程。我们发布 Wellocate，将其作为具有固定数据划分和脚本基线的基准与强化学习环境。借助它，任何人都可以在让智能体负责真实实验之前，测量其如何分配预算，并训练智能体改进预算分配。代码、数据和环境见 https://github.com/Xstendyl/wellocate。

    Compile Once, Run Cheap: Frozen, Portable Skills for Embodied Agents, and What Recursive Self-Improvement Adds

    编译一次，低成本运行：具身智能体的冻结式可移植技能，以及递归自我改进的作用

    Jingwen Bai, Guochao Bai, Canbo Zhang, Shuangqi Li, Minchao Hu, Weichun Huang, Shuang Liu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper studies compiling manipulation skills offline, improving them through inherited repair, and reusing frozen skills across layouts and executor models. This offers a substantial method for agent skill creation and reuse (Systems 4); task-solving and iterative repair connect partially to reasoning (3), while compositional generalization is not a central contribution (2) and internal model mechanisms are not studied (1).

    本文研究离线编译操作技能、通过继承式修复改进技能，以及在不同布局和执行模型间复用冻结技能。这为智能体技能的创建与复用（系统 4）提供了重要方法；任务求解和迭代修复与推理部分相关（3），而组合泛化并非核心贡献（2），也未研究模型内部机制（1）。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Embodied AI lacks the data-rich pretraining that gave language models their agents and skills, so new manipulation capability costs demonstrations per task or a frontier model in every episode. We study a third route: a strong general model acts only as an offline author that writes, runs, diagnoses and repairs a manipulation skill in simulation until it passes an exam on layouts drawn after freezing; the frozen skill then runs as code alone or under a cheap caller that reads only its description. We call this skill-level recursive self-improvement Skill-RSI and specify a compile protocol (isolated, audited author; hidden validation layouts; no-feedback and inherit-only controls; tamper-evident ledger) and a reuse protocol that runs the identical files with executors from another model family. On 7 RoboTwin 2.0 tasks with cluttered tables, Claude Code compiled 4 tasks into 7 frozen skills, 5 from a first draft needing only qualification, at USD 4.29-8.22 of author cost each (USD 55 per skill counting the 13 failed campaigns). The other three tasks did not compile in 18 campaigns, including five with GPT-6 and a pre-registered 150-layout run: on the hardest task every campaign scored 78-95 of 100 but had 3-16 safety aborts, failing the gate of 95% success with zero aborts; a 100-episode exam bounds an abort rate only to 3.6%. On hidden layouts, repair that inherits the previous version beat from-scratch rewriting in 8 of 8 controlled campaigns (sign test p = 0.004); an inherit-only lineage attributes most of the gap to inheritance, with development feedback adding a little (3 of 3, p = 0.125). Write-once campaigns found no detectable first-draft effect of practice (minimum detectable effect 14 points). The frozen skills kept 148/150 successes on new layouts with no model and 147/150 with a DeepSeek-flash caller at USD 0.00028-0.00054 per episode; no direct-control baseline was run.

    中文

    具身 AI 缺乏曾为语言模型带来智能体和技能的数据丰富型预训练，因此获取新的操作能力需要为每项任务提供示范，或在每个回合都使用前沿模型。我们研究第三条路径：强通用模型只作为离线编写者，在仿真中编写、运行、诊断和修复操作技能，直至该技能通过在冻结后抽取的布局上进行的考试；随后，冻结的技能仅作为代码运行，或交由一个只读取其描述的低成本调用模型执行。我们将这种技能级递归自我改进称为 Skill-RSI，并规定了一套编译流程（隔离且经过审计的编写者、隐藏验证布局、无反馈和仅继承对照、可防篡改日志），以及一套复用流程，用来自另一模型家族的执行器运行完全相同的文件。在 7 项桌面杂乱的 RoboTwin 2.0 任务上，Claude Code 将 4 项任务编译成 7 个冻结技能，其中 5 个来自只需资格认定的首稿；每个技能的编写成本为 4.29–8.22 美元（将 13 次失败尝试计入后，每个技能为 55 美元）。另外三项任务在 18 次尝试中未能编译成功，其中包括 5 次使用 GPT-6 的尝试，以及一次预注册的 150 布局运行：在最难的任务上，每次尝试得分均为 78–95 分（满分 100），但发生了 3–16 次安全中止，未达到“成功率 95% 且零中止”的门槛；一场 100 回合考试只能将中止率的上限限定为 3.6%。在隐藏布局上，继承前一版本进行修复，在 8/8 次受控尝试中胜过从头改写（符号检验 p = 0.004）；仅继承的迭代谱系表明，大部分差距来自继承，而开发反馈只带来少量增益（3/3，p = 0.125）。一次性编写的尝试未发现练习对首稿有可检测的影响（最小可检测效应为 14 分）。在新布局上，这些冻结技能在无需模型的情况下成功 148/150 次，在使用 DeepSeek-flash 调用模型的情况下成功 147/150 次，每回合成本为 0.00028–0.00054 美元；未运行直接控制基线。

    Trackable Skill Library Lifecycle Management for Agentic Reinforcement Learning

    面向智能体强化学习的可追踪技能库生命周期管理

    Xi Zhu, Yuanlin Duan, Changyi Yang, Kai Mei, Riyang Bao, Shichao Zhu, Dimitris N. Metaxas

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    TrackRL uses randomized within-group contrasts to estimate each skill's causal utility and the model's mastery, then manages skill admission, retention, and retirement during agentic RL. This substantially advances training for long-horizon problem solving and agent skill-library organization; reusable skills suggest composition, but the abstract does not show a central contribution to compositional representations or generalization.

    TrackRL 使用组内随机对比来估计每项技能的因果效用和模型掌握度，随后在智能体 RL 过程中管理技能的纳入、保留和退役。这显著推动了长时程问题求解训练和智能体技能库组织；可复用技能虽暗示了组合性，但摘要未表明其对组合表征或泛化作出了核心贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Skill-augmented agentic RL has emerged as an effective approach to improving LLM agents on long-horizon tasks. Despite this progress, individual skills may follow distinct trajectories as the policy evolves, with some becoming redundant after the model internalizes their capabilities, others remaining valuable as external scaffolding, and still others turning harmful. However, existing skill library systems fail to identify each skill's true contribution due to free-riding among co-retrieved skills, difficulty confounding across tasks, and the absence of skill-specific counterfactual evidence, which prevents reliable skill lifecycle management. We propose TrackRL, an agentic RL framework where skill tracking drives skill library full lifecycle management. Specifically, within each GRPO group, we turn grouped sampling into online randomized controlled experiments. Independent random injection and within-group contrasts on the same task isolate each skill's true contribution, and reliability-weighted aggregation accumulates evidence across groups. As evidence accumulates, we continuously track skill utility, which measures the skill's causal contribution as external scaffolding, and model mastery, which reflects how far the corresponding capability has been internalized. Along this line, we formulate skill lifecycle management as an evidence-gated state-transition process that governs each skill from generation and admission through protected incubation to retention, retirement, or removal, while a soft capacity bound controls library growth. Experiments show that TrackRL outperforms recent skill-augmented RL baselines in both library-assisted and skill-free evaluation, with further analyses revealing how skill value shifts during policy learning and how evidence-driven state transitions shape skill library evolution. Our code is available at https://github.com/xizhu1022/TrackRL.

    中文

    技能增强的智能体 RL 已成为提升 LLM 智能体长时程任务表现的有效方法。尽管取得了这些进展，随着策略演进，个别技能可能沿着不同轨迹变化：有些技能在模型内化其能力后变得冗余，有些仍可作为有价值的外部支架，还有些则会产生负面作用。然而，现有技能库系统无法识别每项技能的真实贡献，原因包括共同检索的技能之间存在搭便车现象、不同任务间的难度混杂，以及缺乏针对特定技能的反事实证据；这些问题阻碍了可靠的技能生命周期管理。我们提出 TrackRL，这是一种通过技能追踪驱动技能库全生命周期管理的智能体 RL 框架。具体而言，在每个 GRPO 组内，我们将分组采样转化为在线随机对照实验。对同一任务进行独立随机注入和组内对比，以隔离每项技能的真实贡献；再通过可靠性加权聚合跨组累积证据。随着证据不断积累，我们持续追踪技能效用（衡量该技能作为外部支架所产生的因果贡献）和模型掌握度（反映相应能力已被内化到何种程度）。沿着这一思路，我们将技能生命周期管理表述为一种由证据门控的状态转移过程，管理每项技能从生成和纳入、受保护的孵化阶段，到保留、退役或移除；同时通过软容量上限控制库的增长。实验表明，TrackRL 在库辅助评估和无技能评估中均优于近期的技能增强 RL 基线；进一步分析揭示了技能价值如何随策略学习而变化，以及证据驱动的状态转移如何塑造技能库的演进。我们的代码见 https://github.com/xizhu1022/TrackRL。

    Many Repairs, One Direction: Steering Code Models Toward Safer Cryptographic API Use

    多种修复，一个方向：引导代码模型更安全地使用密码学 API

    Tianhe Lu, Sakuna Harinda Jayasundara, Eric Spero, Ewan Tempero, Robert Biddle, Giovanni Russello

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper analyzes the geometry of internal representations for cryptographic API repairs and uses a shared activation direction to improve secure code generation, offering substantial transferable insight into representations and interventions. The shared direction across repair categories is only an incidental connection to composition, and steering activations alone offers limited systems insight.

    论文分析密码学 API 修复的内部表征几何结构，并利用共享激活方向改进安全代码生成，为表征和干预提供了有实质意义、可迁移的见解。跨修复类别的共享方向只是与组合性偶然相关，而仅靠激活引导提供的系统洞见有限。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Cryptographic API misuse in large language model-generated code can compromise software security. While many existing approaches improve code security by modifying model parameters or inputs, how representation changes associated with different cryptographic API repairs can support a shared intervention for safer code generation remains underexplored. To investigate this, we construct 48,000 matched program pairs across four programming languages and ten cryptographic API misuse categories. Each pair changes a specified API decision while preserving the programming task. Subtracting the misuse program's internal representation from its secure counterpart's gives a repair vector. Across five models, comparisons of mean repair vectors reveal stronger organization by misuse category than by language. These category-specific patterns also support a shared intervention. We introduce CrypSteer, which extracts a shared direction by normalizing repair differences and selecting a principal component aligned with repairs across misuse categories. With model weights fixed, adding one shared direction per model to its internal activations during generation improves aggregate target security rates by 5.28--15.00 percentage points over unsteered generation across languages and misuse categories. These findings connect the shared structure of cryptographic repair representations to a reusable intervention for safer code generation.

    中文

    大型语言模型生成的代码若误用密码学 API，可能危及软件安全。尽管许多现有方法通过修改模型参数或输入来提高代码安全性，但与不同密码学 API 修复相关的表征变化如何支持一种通用干预，从而生成更安全的代码，仍未得到充分研究。为探究这一问题，我们构建了 48,000 对匹配程序，涵盖四种编程语言和十类密码学 API 误用。每对程序都改变一个指定的 API 决策，同时保留编程任务不变。用安全版本的内部表征减去误用版本的内部表征，可得到一个修复向量。在五个模型上，对平均修复向量的比较显示，其组织结构更多地由误用类别而非语言决定。这些类别特定的模式也支持一种通用干预。我们提出 CrypSteer：通过归一化修复差异，并选取与各误用类别修复方向对齐的主成分，提取一个共享方向。在模型权重固定的情况下，生成过程中将每个模型的一个共享方向加入其内部激活，使跨语言和误用类别的总体目标安全率比未引导生成提高 5.28–15.00 个百分点。这些发现将密码学修复表征的共享结构与一种可复用的安全代码生成干预联系起来。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    TIRE contributes a scalable, knowledge-driven pipeline that instantiates physics problems from reusable formulas and uses execution-grounded answers for training; the reported gains support its value for developing physics reasoning. Formula reuse gives it a substantive but secondary connection to compositional learning, while no internal-mechanism or model-system contribution is described.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Advancing physics reasoning in large language models requires scalable training data that connect physical laws, concrete problem scenarios, and verifiable numerical answers. Expert-designed problems offer top-down control over physical laws, conditions, and scenarios, but require costly human effort. LLM-based synthesis from texts scales efficiently, but model-generated answers and assessments leave supervision vulnerable to hallucinations. We introduce TIRE, a framework for Top-Down Formula Instantiation with Reliable Execution that brings knowledge-driven problem construction to large-scale data generation. Top-down instantiation uses reusable physical formulas and their applicability conditions to control the physical relations and numerical configurations of generated problems. Reliable execution establishes reference answers before problem generation, providing a common numerical foundation for problem construction and teacher distillation. Together, these mechanisms combine control over problem content with execution-grounded supervision for both supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning. Using TIRE, we construct TIRE-19k, spanning nine subfields of physics. Across 3 backbone LLMs and 4 benchmarks, TIRE-19k outperforms 5 representative datasets with equal amounts of SFT data, exceeding the strongest baseline by 2.86 percentage points on average. Further GRPO raises Qwen3-8B's average accuracy by 1.52 percentage points over its TIRE-19k SFT checkpoint. These results demonstrate the value of generating physics training data from explicit physical knowledge with reliable execution.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces a state-conditioned, directed low-rank spatial operator with a local diffusion branch and frequency reweighting to improve traffic forecasting efficiency. Its adaptive computation and memory-efficient architecture provide a substantial systems contribution, while forecasting accuracy and the claimed interpretability of graph mixing do not establish model-mechanism insight.

    论文提出状态条件化的有向低秩空间算子，并结合局部扩散分支和频率重加权，以提高交通预测效率。其自适应计算和节省内存的架构构成了实质性的系统贡献；而预测准确率和图混合的可解释性主张并不能证明其对模型机制有深入洞见。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Traffic forecasting models based on spectral graph convolution offer an interpretable account of how information is mixed between sensors, but they rely on an eigendecomposition of the graph Laplacian. It costs cubic time, is fixed by the road network, and provides a symmetric operator that cannot represent the directed propagation of traffic congestion. Attention-based spatio-temporal transformers remove these limitations but generate a dense sensor-by-sensor attention map at each layer and time step, so memory, rather than accuracy, becomes the binding constraint on large networks. We introduce the spectral adaptive graph transformer, whose spatial operator is learned rather than derived from the Laplacian, directed rather than symmetric, and conditioned on the current traffic state rather than a static state, at a cost linear in the number of sensors. A sparse road graph diffusion branch provides the strictly local propagation that a low-rank operator cannot express, and a zero-initialized gate learns the balance between the two. Before spatial mixing, a unit-mean-gain frequency-bin attention module reweights each sensor's short-term periodicities according to its identity and current context. Across six public benchmarks spanning 170 to 1843 sensors, evaluated over three random seeds, the proposed model attains the lowest error of any single end-to-end model on one benchmark and remains competitive with the strongest current attention models on the others, while using about a quarter of their memory and training about twice as fast.

    中文

    基于谱图卷积的交通预测模型能够以可解释的方式说明传感器间如何混合信息，但它们依赖图拉普拉斯矩阵的特征分解。该计算耗时为立方级，受道路网络固定约束，并且得到的对称算子无法表示交通拥堵的定向传播。基于注意力的时空 Transformer 消除了这些限制，但会在每层、每个时间步生成密集的传感器两两注意力图，因此在大型网络上，真正的瓶颈变成了内存而非准确率。我们提出谱自适应图 Transformer，其空间算子通过学习得到而非从拉普拉斯矩阵推导，是有向而非对称的，并以当前交通状态而非静态状态为条件，计算成本随传感器数量线性增长。稀疏道路图扩散分支提供低秩算子无法表达的严格局部传播，而零初始化门控则学习两者之间的平衡。在空间混合之前，单位均值增益的频段注意力模块会根据每个传感器的身份和当前上下文，对其短期周期性成分重新加权。在涵盖 170 至 1843 个传感器的六个公开基准上，并采用三个随机种子进行评估时，所提模型在一个基准上取得单一端到端模型中的最低误差，在其他基准上也与当前最强注意力模型具有竞争力，同时内存用量约为它们的四分之一，训练速度约快一倍。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper proposes paired twin-world GRPO training to reduce information leakage through agent actions while preserving task success, and proves a bound on observer inference.     论文提出成对的双世界 GRPO 训练，在保持任务成功的同时减少通过智能体动作造成的信息泄露，并证明了关于观察者推断能力的界限。这是对智能体行为和隐私训练的一项实质性贡献，但摘要没有聚焦于更广泛的系统架构或记忆。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    LLM agents search, shop and send messages for their users, and every action is seen by some party. Existing privacy training rewards agents for not mentioning protected items, yet an observer can infer a private fact from what the agent does. Since an observer learns a fact only if its view changes with the fact, we propose \methodfull (\method), which trains on twin worlds that differ only in the private fact. A frozen distinguisher scores each observer's view by its log-likelihood ratio for the true world, and paired GRPO trains the agent on task success minus this ratio. We prove that this objective controls the Bayes success of every observer on every channel. On shopping and messaging tasks \method removes the leakage that disclosure judges and query-level rewards miss, while the agent still completes its tasks.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops and evaluates algorithms for choosing and reconfiguring optical interconnect topologies in AI clusters, with convergence and regret guarantees. Its main contribution is a substantial advance in AI systems infrastructure, but it does not address model-internal mechanisms, compositional generalization, or reasoning.

    本文开发并评估了用于选择和重新配置 AI 集群中光互连拓扑的算法，并给出了收敛性和遗憾保证。其主要贡献是对 AI 系统基础设施的重大推进，但没有涉及模型内部机制、组合泛化或推理。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Optical Circuit Switches (OCS) make inter-pod wiring in AI clusters programmable, posing design questions on wiring choice, symmetry departure, and reconfigurations. We present a unified information-geometric framework to address these issues.A wiring is a point in a probability simplex over circuits within a degree polytope. Departure from a symmetric Fat-Tree prior $\mathbf{q}$ is measured by $\DKL(\cdot \,\|\, \mathbf{q})$. The cost $U$ is the smoothed DAG critical-path length, whose gradient equals path marginals of a Gibbs distribution via forward--backward recursion.For free energy $F_{\beta_1} = U + \beta_1^{-1} \DKL(\cdot \,\|\, \mathbf{q})$, we prove well-posedness, monotonic dependence on $\beta_1$, adaptation bounds via Jeffreys divergence, and a symmetry principle for static optimality. An entropic proximal-gradient method updates multiplicatively with a $|V|$-dim dual KL projection, achieving linear convergence.For time-varying traffic, a threshold policy yields regret $O(\sqrt{\Gamma C V_1 T})$ against the switching-free optimum. Traffic changes are detected by a multinomial GLR--CUSUM detector with non-asymptotic false-alarm bounds. Multi-job generalized-mean fairness aligns with $\alpha$-fairness ($\alpha \ge 2$). Experiments on pipeline, data, and MoE workloads validate the framework against integer programming.

    中文

    光电路交换机（OCS）使 AI 集群中的机间连线可编程，由此带来有关连线选择、对称性偏离和重新配置的设计问题。我们提出一个统一的信息几何框架来解决这些问题。连线是度多面体内各电路所构成概率单纯形上的一个点。偏离对称 Fat-Tree 先验 $\mathbf{q}$ 的程度由 $\DKL(\cdot \,\|\, \mathbf{q})$ 衡量。代价 $U$ 是平滑后的 DAG 关键路径长度，其梯度通过前向--后向递归等于 Gibbs 分布下的路径边缘概率。对于自由能 $F_{\beta_1} = U + \beta_1^{-1} \DKL(\cdot \,\|\, \mathbf{q})$，我们证明了适定性、对 $\beta_1$ 的单调依赖性、基于 Jeffreys 散度的自适应界，以及静态最优性的对称性原理。熵近端梯度方法通过一个 $|V|$ 维双 KL 投影进行乘法更新，并实现线性收敛。对于时变流量，一种阈值策略相对于无切换最优解实现遗憾 $O(\sqrt{\Gamma C V_1 T})$。使用具有非渐近误报界的多项式 GLR--CUSUM 检测器检测流量变化。多作业广义均值公平性与 $\alpha$-公平性（$\alpha \ge 2$）相一致。在流水线、数据和 MoE 工作负载上的实验验证了该框架，并将其与整数规划进行了比较。

We argue that reliable memory requires governance over both state formation and query-time influence. We introduce PLACE, a factorized governance layer that adds write-side state certification and read-side authorization to a memory backend. A factorial evaluation on Mem0 with Qwen2.5-3B and Qwen2.5-7B isolates the contribution of each mechanism. This paper is composed of two parts: in the first, we show that existing vision and language representations are linearly unalignable. This misalignment is an inherent property of the data and hence expected to persist regardless of either scale or the alignment's complexity.     Recent test-time scaling methods improve model performance by increasing inference-time compute. One practical form of this is parallel scaling, where a model samples multiple independent reasoning streams and aggregates their answers using methods like voting, reranking, or verification. While effective, this approach leaves the streams uncoordinated, and a discovery made in one rollout cannot influence any other. Multi-Sequence Verifiers jointly score candidate answers after generation, but the reasoning streams remain independent during inference. ParScale takes a step toward model-internal parallel scaling by learning to aggregate multiple forward passes, but its streams still do not exchange information while processing a sequence. We introduce BatchParScale, an attention mechanism that allows parallel streams to exchange information through a small set of communication positions. We evaluate BatchParScale on a new Parallel Needle-in-a-Haystack retrieval benchmark and in pretraining, fine-tuning, and cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning. Across these settings, BatchParScale outperforms ParScale on language-model loss and remains competitive on coordination-sensitive MARL tasks. Masked pretraining runs beat an unmasked single-sequence baseline despite local sequence corruption, and LoRA fine-tuning shows the mechanism can be added to a pretrained Transformer. At the same time, fact retrieval performance for pretrained and finetuned BatchParScale models remains unclear.

    近期的测试时扩展方法通过增加推理时计算量来提升模型性能。一种实用形式是并行扩展：模型采样多个相互独立的推理流，再通过投票、重排序或验证等方法汇总答案。尽管这种方法有效，但各推理流彼此不协调，一次生成过程中发现的信息无法影响其他生成过程。多序列验证器会在生成后联合评估候选答案，但推理过程中各推理流仍然相互独立。ParScale 通过学习聚合多次前向传播，朝着模型内部的并行扩展迈进一步，但其推理流在处理序列时仍不会交换信息。我们提出 BatchParScale，这是一种注意力机制，允许并行流通过少量通信位置交换信息。我们在一个新的 Parallel Needle-in-a-Haystack 检索基准，以及预训练、微调和合作式多智能体强化学习中评估 BatchParScale。在这些设置中，BatchParScale 的语言模型损失优于 ParScale，在对协调能力敏感的 MARL 任务上也保持了竞争力。尽管存在局部序列损坏，掩码预训练仍优于未掩码的单序列基线；LoRA 微调则表明，该机制可以添加到预训练 Transformer 中。与此同时，预训练和微调后的 BatchParScale 模型在事实检索任务上的表现仍不明确。

    Sijia Luo, Mengjie Gao, Yuxiao He, Mengshu Sun, Cuiping Li, Hong Chen, Jing Zhang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    EG-GRPO uses evidence annotations to assign step-level process rewards and state-conditioned advantages for training deep search agents, improving credit assignment on search benchmarks. This is a strong contribution to training reasoning and problem-solving; agent use is the application context, with no substantive systems mechanism described.

    EG-GRPO 利用证据标注，为训练深度搜索智能体分配逐步过程奖励和以状态为条件的优势，从而改善搜索基准上的信用分配。这对推理与问题求解训练作出了重要贡献；智能体是其应用场景，文中没有描述实质性的系统机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    LLM-based search agents demonstrate strong capabilities in long-horizon information seeking and reasoning, typically trained via reinforcement learning. However, existing approaches predominantly rely on trajectory-level outcome rewards, providing limited supervision for complex search and reasoning processes. Although step-level credit assignment offers a promising solution, obtaining reliable and task-grounded supervision for open-ended search remains challenging. In this paper, we propose Evidence-Guided Group Relative Policy Optimization (EG-GRPO), a framework that derives step-level supervision from the evidence annotations available in synthetic deep search data. EG-GRPO identifies the first supporting citation for each required evidence claim and uses the newly acquired evidence to construct step-level process rewards. By representing the accumulated evidence as an evolving knowledge state, EG-GRPO further performs state-conditioned relative advantage estimation and combines the resulting step-level signal with the standard trajectory-level outcome advantage. Experiments on five challenging deep search benchmarks show that EG-GRPO generally outperforms standard GRPO and existing reward-enhanced and step-level RL baselines across different model scales. These results demonstrate that task-grounded evidence annotations can provide effective process supervision for credit assignment in deep search RL.
