    Wei Gao, Cheng Tian, Duan Yang, Jianqing Yin

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper evaluates whether production-scale addressed-memory writes support knowledge composition and reasoning, finding that retrieved atoms do not compose and proposing behavioral metrics for coverage, synergy, and distortion. This provides substantial evidence about memory and compositional reasoning limits, while its retrieval-versus-given-intermediate analysis informs reasoning; it does not investigate internal neural representations.

    本文评估生产规模的定址记忆写入能否支持知识复合与推理，发现检索到的原子无法组合，并提出用于衡量覆盖率、协同效应和失真的行为指标。这为记忆和组合推理的局限提供了重要证据；对比检索中间实体与直接给出中间实体的分析也为推理研究提供了参考，但本文没有考察神经网络内部表征。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Deterministic hash-addressed conditional memory permits local post-hoc knowledge injection. Extending arXiv:2610.21553's bounded-feasibility audit rejecting under-specified generality claims with repaired probes and training-dose/capacity axes, we give, to our knowledge, the first production-scale write-content verdict. We test 124M-7B self-trained/publicly pretrained beds, Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-FP8 (176.95B; 320,001,536 FP8 rows), and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash. Write coverage requires a sufficiently trained backbone prior, full-width readout, trainable gates; undertrained-bed intervention confirms a threshold, not a slope. At fixed budget, coverage falls from 98% (50 facts) to 12.7% (1,000); table size is not binding. Two-hop composition does not exceed the independent single-hop baseline (26% observed vs 25% expected; 15% lexical-distortion floor). Synergy remains absent across dose/load in two independent bed families. A 28-percentage-point in-context gap (given vs recalled intermediates) localizes failure to retrieval-for-reasoning, not gate access. Writes are independently retrievable, precisely addressable, reversible atoms, not composable into reasoning. A layered protocol, the first, to our knowledge, to cover compositionality in behavioral memory evaluation, separates baseline, synergy and distortion floor. Any addressed/key-value memory must report coverage, synergy ratio and distortion rate before deployment claims. Composition must be system-orchestrated; multi-constraint queries should explicitly chain written atoms. In-context controls show given intermediate entities are exploited at twice the implicit rate. Production load fits exponential interference ($R^2=0.98$); its mechanism, between budget dilution and write interference, remains open. All numbers are recomputed from archived raw logs/JSON; a fresh 52-target production rerun gives 52/52, exactly matching archived baselines.

    Where and Why Search-Augmented LLMs Fail When Reasoning over Rapidly Evolving Knowledge

    搜索增强 LLM 在对快速演变知识进行推理时何处失效以及为何失效

    Tianyi Hu, Bhavyajeet Singh, Niket Tandon, Akhil Arora

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    TREK diagnoses failures in reasoning over evolving knowledge and introduces benchmarks showing that conflicting evidence often defeats models after retrieval has succeeded. This substantially advances reasoning evaluation, while retrieval-stage attribution offers a limited systems connection without a contribution to memory or agent architecture.

    TREK 用于诊断模型在演变知识推理中的失效，并引入基准表明，即使检索已成功，冲突证据仍常使模型受挫。这显著推进了推理评估；对检索阶段的归因与系统有有限关联，但论文并未对记忆或智能体架构作出贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    As the world changes, new information is published while older records remain online. This complicates reasoning for large language models (LLMs), which must retrieve evidence and resolve conflicts to determine which information remains valid. Existing evaluations treat information seeking as a black box, revealing little about where and why LLMs fail. To address this gap, we introduce TREK, a suite of three components: TREKTRACE is a plug-and-play framework that attributes failures to specific stages of retrieval and reasoning. We apply it to TREKBENCH-WILD, a meta-benchmark of real-world questions that require complex reasoning over rapidly evolving knowledge. Surprisingly, the main bottleneck is post-retrieval reasoning rather than retrieval: frontier models are often misled by conflicting evidence even after retrieving all the information needed to answer. To study this bottleneck, we build TREKBENCH-CTRL, a controlled benchmark with distractors spanning temporality, relevance, and trustworthiness, and show that benchmarks dominated by outdated distractors substantially underestimate task difficulty. Together, TREK provides a testbed for diagnosing and improving reasoning over rapidly evolving knowledge.

    中文

    随着世界变化，新信息不断发布，旧记录仍留存于网上。这使大型语言模型（LLM）的推理变得复杂，因为它们必须检索证据并解决冲突，才能判断哪些信息仍然有效。现有评估将信息搜寻视为黑箱，难以揭示 LLM 在何处以及为何失效。为弥补这一缺口，我们提出 TREK，它由三个部分组成：TREKTRACE 是一个即插即用框架，可将失效归因于检索与推理的具体阶段。我们将它应用于 TREKBENCH-WILD，这是一个真实世界问题元基准，要求围绕快速演变的知识进行复杂推理。令人意外的是，主要瓶颈在于检索后的推理，而非检索：即使已检索到回答所需的全部信息，前沿模型仍常被相互冲突的证据误导。为研究这一瓶颈，我们构建了 TREKBENCH-CTRL，这是一个受控基准，包含涉及时效性、相关性和可信度的干扰项；我们表明，以过时干扰项为主的基准会大幅低估任务难度。总之，TREK 提供了一个测试平台，用于诊断并改进对快速演变知识的推理。

    Where Groups Split: A Probe Prior for Nonzero Within-Group Variance in RL Post-Training

    群组在何处分化：面向 RL 后训练中组内非零方差的探针先验

    Jonah Ellison, Mateo Ruiz, Owen Pell, Tomas Duncun, Hanae Fujita, Ingrid Solberg, Caleb Nguyen

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Aperture uses a short training probe to estimate which prompts will yield informative, nonzero-advantage GRPO groups, improving reasoning accuracy on mathematical and logical tasks. Its main contribution advances training and sampling for reasoning; the unchanged GRPO update and lack of internal-mechanism or system-design claims keep other connections low.

    Aperture 利用短时训练探针，估计哪些提示能够产生信息量较高、优势非零的 GRPO 分组，从而提升数学和逻辑任务上的推理准确率。其主要贡献是推进推理训练与采样；GRPO 更新本身保持不变，且论文没有提出内部机制或系统设计方面的主张，因此与其他方向的关联较弱。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Group relative policy optimization learns from a prompt only when the rewards in the sampled group disagree. With a binary verifier, a group that is entirely correct or entirely incorrect has within-group variance zero and a zero advantage. Uniform sampling continues to spend rollouts on prompts that are unanimous now and stay unanimous as training goes on. Pass rate is a weak forecast of that future. Two prompts at the same pass rate can move apart: one into the range where a finite group splits, and one toward a ceiling where the group becomes unanimous again. Aperture estimates the later pass rate from a short probe. A small subset of the pool is trained with the same recipe, every prompt is scored on the base model and on the probe model, and the two pass rates are plugged into the probability that a group of the training size is all wrong or split. The resulting weight is a static prior. It can be used alone or multiplied by an online scheduler, and the GRPO update is left as it is. On mathematical and logical reasoning with 1.7B and 4B models, the prior improves greedy accuracy over uniform GRPO and raises the fraction of groups with a nonzero advantage. The same prior still helps when it is combined with dynamic sampling or with selective rollouts.

    中文

    组相对策略优化只有在采样组内奖励不一致时，才能从一个提示中学习。对于二元验证器，若一个组的结果全对或全错，其组内方差为零，优势也为零。均匀采样会继续把生成次数花在当前结果一致、且随着训练推进仍将保持一致的提示上。通过率无法很好地预测这种未来走势。两个通过率相同的提示可能朝不同方向变化：一个进入有限大小组会出现分化的区间，另一个则趋向通过率上限，使组内结果再次一致。Aperture 通过短探针估计后续通过率。对池中的一个小子集按相同方案进行训练，然后分别用基础模型和探针模型为每个提示评分，并将两个通过率代入训练组规模下组内全错或出现分化的概率。由此得到的权重是一个静态先验。它可以单独使用，也可以与在线调度器相乘，GRPO 更新则保持不变。在使用 1.7B 和 4B 模型进行数学与逻辑推理时，该先验相比均匀 GRPO 提高了贪心准确率，并提升了具有非零优势的组所占比例。与动态采样或选择性生成结合使用时，该先验同样有效。

    Karthik Viswanathan, Plamen Dimitrov, Stefano Rocca, Sarayu Sirikonda

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper derives formal bounds and characterizations of the number of attention heads needed to represent Boolean functions, offering theoretical insight into transformer expressivity relevant to mechanistic interpretability. It also studies compositional model capacity only indirectly; formalized AI-assisted theorem proving is a research method rather than a contribution to reasoning systems.

    本文推导了表示布尔函数所需注意力头数的形式化界限与刻画，为与机械可解释性相关的 Transformer 表达能力提供了理论见解。本文也间接研究了组合模型容量；形式化的 AI 辅助定理证明是一种研究方法，而非对推理系统的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Multi-head attention is a central component of the transformer architecture, yet how its expressivity depends on the number of heads remains poorly understood. We study a one-layer, attention-only transformer with additive positional embeddings and define the head complexity $H^\ast(f)$ of a Boolean function $f$ as the minimum number of attention heads required to represent it. We derive an exact linear-fractional normal form for head complexity, prove a general threshold-degree lower bound, and give an explicit ten-bit function for which this bound is strict. For symmetric Boolean functions, we independently show that head complexity equals the number of times the function changes value between consecutive Hamming-weight levels, even when positional embeddings are allowed. This agrees with the concurrent characterization of Hsu and Xu (arXiv:2608.04243) in a model without positional embeddings. The symmetric lower bound combines our general threshold-degree bound with the classical result of Aspnes et al. (1994). These results were discovered and formalized by a frontier model through conjecture generation, theorem proving, and machine verification, while human researchers asked the high-level questions and reviewed the generated theorems. We make the Lean formalization and research traces publicly available to support agent-assisted theorem proving and formal verification in mechanistic interpretability. This work provides a proof of concept for using the capabilities of frontier models, grounded by formal verification, to develop an understanding of transformer architectures.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper addresses failures in teacher-guided reasoning and contributes a context-structuring method plus gradient-based reweighting to improve distillation. The dependency graph has a compositional flavor, but the abstract does not establish a broader advance in compositional generalization; internal mechanisms and model-system design are incidental.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Teacher takeover in on-policy distillation (OPD) can produce incorrect responses even when the student and teacher independently answer the same problem correctly, a failure we quantify using Collaboration Failure Rate (CFR). To address it, we propose Contextual Digest for On-Policy Distillation (CD-OPD). CD-OPD structures the earlier context of teacher guidance through a teacher-generated dependency graph, curating the required problem conditions and preceding reasoning as node summaries alongside the unchanged guidance in a Contextual Digest before student continuation. We further develop online meta-reweighting, which compares Digest segment gradients with a task gradient from independent student responses to improve student-only performance, favoring updates predicted to reduce task loss. Across eight benchmarks, CD-OPD improves average accuracy by 1.32--7.05 percentage points over representative existing OPD methods. It also reduces CFR by 27.4\%--56.4\% relative to existing takeover-based OPD methods.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    MemDerive introduces a diagnostic benchmark that traces agent memory failures through derivation states and tests updates as events evolve, giving substantial insight into memory-system design.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Long-running agents rely on memory of their past interactions for task state, such as what has been completed and which conditions still hold. Such state is usually a derived state. No record states it, and it must be computed by rules from multiple records of an evolving history. Existing memory benchmarks score only the final answer, with no reference for the intermediate states behind it. A wrong answer therefore cannot be traced to the state that was missed, and a state that silently became outdated goes undetected. We present MemDerive, a diagnostic benchmark for agent memory over evolving data. It specifies each scenario symbolically, derives exact gold answers with Datalog, records the gold derivation DAG and the supporting events of every query, and renders the history in natural language with fictional entities and distractors. Its 10 scenarios contain 4,692 events and 1,503 queries whose difficulty varies along access, evolution, and composition. On this ground truth, MemDerive evaluates answer reliability, diagnoses failures by probing the nodes of the gold derivation DAG, and tracks whether answers stay correct as events arrive. Our evaluation of four memory systems reveals failures that final-answer benchmarks hide. On derived state, every memory system falls behind simple BM25 retrieval, although the same answer model reaches 96.01% when given the supporting events. Most failures are ungathered, as a system holds the missing intermediate state but does not retrieve it for the question that needs it. Memory systems also rarely propagate implicit changes, which no new record states. These results suggest three principles for memory design. Gather inputs along the derivation, store rules with their versions, and maintain derived states through recorded dependencies.

    Mayank Darbari, Chiman Salavati, Liang Wu, Dawei Wang, Jiong Zhang, Kelly Wan, Krishna Chakka, and Liangjie Hong

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    This agenda defines self-rewriting systems and endogenous drift, argues that joint monitoring is needed for causal attribution, and proposes research problems for evolving agent infrastructure.     本文提出自我重写系统和内生漂移的概念，论证联合监控对于因果归因的必要性，并为不断演变的智能体基础设施提出研究问题。记忆和轨迹议题属于系统层面的问题，而组合与推理仅与所提出的数据挖掘议程间接相关。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Classical data mining treats data as generated outside the learner. Emerging AI-native infrastructure invalidates this assumption: as agents observe system state, act, update retrieval stores and models, and promote new artifacts into the serving path, their own decisions reshape the future logs, traces, corpora, and evaluation records used for later training and release. We call this new research object a self-rewriting system and the resulting system-induced distribution shift endogenous drift. Our central, falsifiable claim is that cross-surface causes are not identifiable in general from marginal per-surface monitoring: different coupled failures can produce the same individual signals while differing in their joint behavior, requiring joint analysis for reliable attribution. This agenda comprises four foundational research problems: fusing heterogeneous drift signals into calibrated gating and attribution (C1); mining agent traces whose activity alphabet evolves (C2); maintaining knowledge fabrics through online reindexing, faithfulness, and compression decisions (C3); and safely promoting concurrent learning streams through one shared evaluation gate (C4). These remain fragmented across concept drift, performative prediction, process mining, streaming retrieval-augmented generation, and MLOps, without a unified data-mining agenda. We outline public benchmarks and evaluation criteria, using AI-native telecom only as a motivating exemplar with analogues in finance, software CI/CD, and clinical decision support.

    经典数据挖掘认为数据是在学习者之外生成的。新兴的 AI 原生基础设施使这一假设不再成立：智能体观察系统状态、采取行动、更新检索存储和模型，并将新产物纳入服务路径时，它们自身的决策会重塑未来的日志、轨迹、语料库和评估记录，而这些材料将用于后续训练和发布。我们将这一新的研究对象称为自我重写系统，并将由此产生的系统诱发分布偏移称为内生漂移。我们的核心可证伪主张是：一般而言，无法仅凭各表面的边际监控来识别跨表面成因；不同的耦合故障可能产生相同的单独信号，却有不同的联合行为，因此需要联合分析才能可靠归因。这一研究议程包含四个基础问题：将异质漂移信号融合为经过校准的门控和归因（C1）；挖掘活动字母表不断演变的智能体轨迹（C2）；通过在线重索引、忠实度和压缩决策来维护知识网络（C3）；以及通过一个共享评估门安全地推进并发学习流（C4）。这些问题分散在概念漂移、表演性预测、流程挖掘、流式检索增强生成和 MLOps 等领域，尚无统一的数据挖掘议程。我们概述了公共基准和评估标准，并仅以 AI 原生电信作为启发性示例；金融、软件 CI/CD 和临床决策支持领域也有类似场景。

    MoM separates latent and lexical memory pathways, routes corrections by token-level uncertainty, and supports factual updates without retraining, offering substantive insight into model memory and computation.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language models store substantial factual knowledge in their parameters, yet this knowledge is difficult to control, update, and reliably elicit at inference time. Existing memory-augmented approaches typically rely on a single auxiliary mechanism, such as retrieval, parameter updates, or neural memory, and therefore apply the same form of correction to tokens with very different knowledge demands. We propose Mixture-of-Memories (MoM), a memory-augmented language modeling framework that separates routed neural memory from writable factual memory. MoM combines a frozen base LM with two neural memory experts: a latent memory that provides low-latency hidden-state corrections and a lexical memory that provides a token-space knowledge pathway. A lightweight Budget Router sets per-token mixture weights from uncertainty and disagreement features, replacing the fixed interpolation of prior memory modules. For post-hoc updates, an external explicit memory stays outside the router, because a router trained before facts are written learns to down-weight it; new facts are appended without retraining any component and used only when an answer-level gate accepts the retrieved fact. In this work, we cast stepwise verification as a natural language inference task: the problem and partial solution prefix form the premise, while the next reasoning step serves as the hypothesis to be classified as entailed or non-entailed. This formulation enables error localisation at individual reasoning steps and direct comparison of encoder classification, decoder classification, and decoder verdict generation across model scales and annotation budgets. Across five reasoning datasets, a 0.15B encoder classifier outperforms most generative verifiers with up to 4B parameters.     Syed Usama Khalid Bukhari, Syed Safwan Khalid, Muhammad Aamir

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper adds cache-based text replies to an LLM decision model and evaluates calibration, decision accuracy, and latency; its main contribution is a model-system design for reusing computation. Decision tasks connect to reasoning, but the abstract reports no specific advance in reasoning mechanisms or capability development.

    本文为 LLM 决策模型加入基于缓存的文本回复，并评估校准度、决策准确率和延迟；其主要贡献是通过复用计算实现模型系统设计。决策任务与推理有关，但摘要没有报告推理机制或能力发展方面的具体进展。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Decision models return probabilities over supplied options, but a deployed agent may also need to reply in words. The present study introduces System X, a large language model (LLM) decision model that adds a text-reply option to the LLM-as-Jev readout. When this option wins, or confidence is low, the same model continues from the decision's key-value (KV) cache, avoiding a repeated prompt prefill. Qwen3-0.6B has been fine-tuned with LoRA on Reason-9k and Bitext reply rows. JevBench accuracy shows no statistically significant change (55.4% to 54.5%, p=0.87), while expected calibration error falls from 0.292 to 0.169. Held-out Bitext routing accuracy reaches 98.3%. Cache reuse saves 15-37% of latency on an Apple M4 Pro, with token-identical replies in the FP32 demonstration cases. Scoring options on copies of the prompt cache matches full-sequence scoring to within 1.4e-6 in probability. Adding dialogue, industry and complaint data (System X+) improves support-task results but lowers IFEval accuracy from 55.5% to 45.0%. System X v4 uses Qwen3-1.7B, rebalanced data and teacher-rewritten reply targets. Against its base LLM, JevBench accuracy rises from 55.0% to 61.0% (p=0.04), with no statistically significant IFEval change (p=0.71). A matched latency test on unadapted Qwen3-1.7B saves 17-39%. One LLM judge prefers v4 replies to an unadapted 1.7B second call (31 to 11 pairs, p=0.003); the other's preference is not significant. These reply comparisons also differ in prompts and generation limits. State conflicts and unsupported reply details remain failure modes. Further studies with several seeds, human raters and real support data are recommended.

    中文

    决策模型会返回针对给定选项的概率，但已部署的智能体可能还需要用文字回复。本研究介绍系统 X，这是一种大型语言模型（LLM）决策模型，在 LLM-as-Jev 读出中增加了文本回复选项。当该选项胜出或置信度较低时，同一模型从决策所用的键值（KV）缓存继续生成，从而避免重复预填充提示。Qwen3-0.6B 已通过 LoRA 在 Reason-9k 和 Bitext 回复样本上进行微调。JevBench 准确率没有显著变化（55.4% 到 54.5%，p=0.87），而期望校准误差从 0.292 降至 0.169。留出的 Bitext 路由准确率达到 98.3%。在 Apple M4 Pro 上，缓存复用使延迟降低 15-37%，且在 FP32 演示案例中生成的回复与原输出逐词元一致。在提示缓存副本上为选项评分，与完整序列评分的概率差异不超过 1.4e-6。加入对话、行业和投诉数据（系统 X+）提升了支持任务结果，但使 IFEval 准确率从 55.5% 降至 45.0%。系统 X v4 使用 Qwen3-1.7B、重新平衡的数据和由教师改写的回复目标。与其基础 LLM 相比，JevBench 准确率从 55.0% 升至 61.0%（p=0.04），而 IFEval 没有显著变化（p=0.71）。对未适配 Qwen3-1.7B 进行匹配延迟测试，延迟降低了 17-39%。一位 LLM 评审更偏好 v4 回复，而非未适配模型的第二次 1.7B 调用（31 对 11 组，p=0.003）；另一位评审的偏好则不显著。这些回复比较使用的提示和生成限制也不同。状态冲突和缺乏依据的回复细节仍是失败模式。建议使用多个随机种子、人工评审和真实支持数据开展进一步研究。

    A failure of Imagination: VLMs fail to use visual representations for text, but self-distillation can help

    想象力的失效：VLM 无法将视觉表征用于文本，但自蒸馏可以有所帮助

    Shashwat Singh, He He, Tal Linzen

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper probes whether vision-language alignment changes text representations and introduces self-distillation that transfers visual structure into text embeddings, improving shape-counting on text inputs. Its representation analysis supports a strong MechInterp connection, while cross-modal transfer and improved structured counting offer partial insight into compositionality and reasoning; multimodal model use alone does not advance Systems.

    本文探究视觉语言对齐是否会改变文本表征，并提出自蒸馏方法，将视觉结构迁移到文本嵌入中，从而提升文本输入下的形状计数表现。其表征分析与机制可解释性密切相关，而跨模态迁移和结构化计数表现的提升，则为组合性和推理提供了部分启示；仅仅使用多模态模型并未推动系统研究。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Vision-language (VL) models are typically built by fine-tuning a language model to attend to visual features in service of a Visual Question-Answering objective. We ask whether this alignment changes how language models represent text---especially on tasks where visualization would help, like geometry questions posed in words. We distinguish weak multimodality (the model can answer questions about an input image) from strong multimodality (the model's text representations themselves become vision-aligned, improving performance on text-only tasks with latent visual structure). To test for strong multimodality, we construct a task of shape-counting problems with paired equivalent text and image specifications. This task is trivial when the image is provided, but requires visualization when specified in text as line coordinates. We compare instruction-tuned Qwen-2.5 and Mistral models against their vision-aligned counterparts on the text variant of the task. We find that the multimodal models do no better in this setting, despite strong performance on the image version of the task. Probing experiments corroborate this: vision-aligned decoder embeddings carry no more visual structure than their text-only counterparts. Finally, we provide an optimization objective that distills in-context visual embeddings into text embeddings. This alignment induces gains on the text variant of the task without explicit task supervision, even on samples more complex than seen during alignment. This suggests that VQA-style alignment leaves available cross-modal transfer untapped.

    中文

    视觉语言（VL）模型通常通过微调语言模型，使其关注视觉特征，以服务于视觉问答目标。我们探究这种对齐是否会改变语言模型对文本的表征——尤其是在可视化有助益的任务中，例如以文字描述的几何问题。我们区分弱多模态（模型能够回答有关输入图像的问题）与强多模态（模型的文本表征本身与视觉对齐，从而提升其在具有潜在视觉结构的纯文本任务上的表现）。为检验强多模态性，我们构建了一项形状计数任务，其中包含成对等价的文本和图像描述。提供图像时，这项任务很简单；若以直线坐标的形式用文本描述，则需要进行可视化。我们在该任务的文本版本上，将经过指令微调的 Qwen-2.5 和 Mistral 模型与其视觉对齐版本进行比较。我们发现，尽管多模态模型在图像版本任务上的表现很强，但在这一设定中并没有更好。探针实验也证实了这一点：视觉对齐的解码器嵌入所携带的视觉结构并不比纯文本模型对应的嵌入更多。最后，我们提出一种优化目标，将上下文中的视觉嵌入蒸馏到文本嵌入中。这种对齐无需明确的任务监督，就能提升模型在任务文本版本上的表现，即使样本比对齐过程中见过的更复杂也如此。这表明，VQA 式对齐并未充分利用现有的跨模态迁移能力。

    P(Yes): 15$\times$ Improvements via Test-Time Scaling of Decision Models

    P(是)：15$\times$决策模型的测试时扩展带来的提升

    Lev Stambler

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces training-free test-time search over decision-model answers, substantially improving exact correctness on logic puzzles. This advances reasoning and adaptive inference, while answer editing alone offers only limited evidence of compositional generalization and no internal-mechanism insight.

    论文提出了一种无需训练、在测试时对决策模型答案进行搜索的方法，显著提升了逻辑谜题的完全正确率。这推动了推理和自适应推理的发展，但仅靠编辑答案，只能有限地证明组合泛化能力，也无法洞察模型内部机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Decision models answer typed questions, such as multiple-choice or yes/no questions, with a probability for each option. We add test-time search to frozen decision models, with no training: we show the model a complete proposed answer, read off its probability of saying "Yes" to the proposal's correctness, and search for answers that it rates higher. The search is done either by editing one answer at a time or by joint optimization, which changes several answers at once. Search raises accuracy for every model and test set we tried, and the gains are largest for exact correctness on logic puzzles, where every answer in a task must be right. On 128 such puzzles, it takes Qwen3.8-27B from 2 to 30 exactly correct puzzles ($15\times$) and its per-blank accuracy from 27.8% to 48.5%. On a shared set of 47 puzzles, searching over each model's own Yes/No score raises the per-blank accuracy of StartLux Instant, Perplexity Decider, Clef, and JEV, which we reach only through its public API, by 4.0 to 13.0 percentage points, and raises the number of puzzles they get exactly correct, out of 47 and averaged over three search seeds, from 10 to 35, 9 to 26, 2 to 11, and 9 to 31.7 respectively.

    中文

    决策模型回答类型化问题，例如多项选择题或是非题，并为每个选项给出一个概率。我们在冻结的决策模型上加入测试时搜索，无需训练：我们向模型展示一个完整的候选答案，读取它对该候选答案正确性回答“是”的概率，并搜索它评分更高的答案。搜索通过逐次编辑一个答案，或通过联合优化来完成；后者会一次修改多个答案。我们尝试的每个模型和测试集上，搜索都提高了准确率；对于逻辑谜题中的完全正确率，提升最大，因为这类任务要求所有答案都正确。在 128 道此类谜题上，搜索使 Qwen3.8-27B 完全答对的谜题数从 2 道增至 30 道（$15\times$），并使其每个空格的准确率从 27.8% 提高到 48.5%。在一组共同的 47 道谜题上，针对每个模型自身的是/否评分进行搜索，使 StartLux Instant、Perplexity Decider、Clef 和 JEV（我们只能通过其公共 API 使用）的每空准确率提高了 4.0 至 13.0 个百分点；按三个搜索随机种子取平均后，它们在 47 道谜题中完全答对的数量分别从 10 道增至 35 道、从 9 道增至 26 道、从 2 道增至 11 道，以及从 9 道增至 31.7 道。

    Where Are Language-Specific Features Represented in Multilingual LLMs? Everywhere

    多语言大语言模型中的语言特定特征在哪里表征？无处不在

    Mikaela Martins and Jonathan Dunn

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper’s main contribution is a representation analysis showing that language identity remains recoverable across all layers of a multilingual LLM, with an additional finding of Spanish bias on ambiguous strings. This is strong evidence about representation geometry and localization, but it does not study composition, reasoning, or system design.

    本文的主要贡献是表征分析，表明在多语言大语言模型的所有层中都能恢复语言身份；此外还发现，模型对含糊字符串存在西班牙语偏向。这为表征几何结构和特征定位提供了有力证据，但并未研究组合、推理或系统设计。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Previous work has argued that multilingual LLMs encode language-specific features most strongly in their initial and final layers, implying that intermediate layers support language-agnostic representations. This paper reconsiders this finding by performing four different experiments: three that undertake a fine-grained analysis of representations of Portuguese and Spanish, two closely related languages, and one large-scale language identification experiment that covers over 200 languages. The results of these experiments challenge the strict separation between language-specific and language-agnostic layers in multilingual LLMs, using Llama 3.2 1B as a test case. By analyzing and manipulating contextual sentence embeddings, we demonstrate that language identity remains strongly recoverable throughout the model rather than being restricted to initial and final layers. Moreover, we find that the model tends to classify ambiguous strings as closer to Spanish than to Portuguese, revealing a skew in model behavior that differs from human judgments.

    中文

    以往研究认为，多语言大语言模型在初始层和末尾层最强烈地编码语言特定特征，这意味着中间层支持与语言无关的表征。本文通过四项不同的实验重新审视这一发现：其中三项对葡萄牙语和西班牙语（两种密切相关的语言）的表征进行细粒度分析，另一项则开展覆盖 200 多种语言的大规模语言识别实验。以 Llama 3.2 1B 为测试对象，这些实验结果对多语言大语言模型中语言特定层与语言无关层之间严格分离的观点提出了质疑。通过分析和操控上下文句子嵌入，我们表明，语言身份在整个模型中始终可以被强烈地恢复，而非仅限于初始层和末尾层。此外，我们发现模型倾向于将含糊字符串判定为更接近西班牙语而非葡萄牙语，这揭示了模型行为中的偏向，与人类判断不同。

    Bud ContextCompact 2.0: Context Compaction for Agent Success and Accuracy with Small Language Models and Constrained Context Windows

    Bud ContextCompact 2.0：通过小型语言模型和受限上下文窗口实现智能体的成功与准确性

    Jithin VG, Ditto PS

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper evaluates a concrete agent-runtime method for compacting history and shows when it improves recall and task completion under constrained context budgets, a substantial contribution to agent memory management. Its effects on task success are incidental to reasoning mechanisms, and it does not study internal representations or compositional generalization.

    本文评估了一种具体的智能体运行时历史压缩方法，并展示了它在受限上下文预算下何时能够改善回忆和任务完成表现，这对智能体记忆管理做出了重要贡献。它对任务成功率的影响只是附带涉及推理机制，而且没有研究内部表征或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Agents that work for many turns outgrow the context window of the model that serves them, and on small language models (SLMs) and constrained inference systems that window is small. Context compaction replaces older turns with a summary so a session can continue, but it is lossy, costs a model call, and can help or hurt depending on when it runs. We describe Bud ContextCompact 2.0, the compaction built into the Bud agent runtime, and evaluate it in two settings. On recall questions over recorded agent sessions, compaction to a 16K budget raised a 1.2B-parameter model's accuracy to 0.335, from 0.247 with truncation and 0.176 with its full 32K history (p < 0.001), and raised a 9B model from 0.515 (truncation) to 0.577 (p = 0.04). On 100 SWE-bench Verified tasks run end to end by a 27B reasoning model on a 49K-token window (556 graded sessions), compaction raised the resolve rate on long sessions from 41% to 53% (+12.3 points, 95% CI +1.6 to +23.0, McNemar p = 0.043), left short sessions unchanged, and used 13% fewer tokens per solved task at equal total cost. The main failure without compaction was not the history overflowing but a reasoning turn exhausting the room the history left. The gain has limits: it vanished under a 45-minute session budget, because each summary took a median of 161 s, and in a threshold study it appeared only when compaction triggered early enough to leave room. An 8B model submitted after about ten turns at 5-8K tokens and never needed compaction. We argue that the accuracy results transfer across hardware, including CPU inference, for an equivalent model and window, while the time cost scales with the hardware and must be budgeted for.

    中文

    运行多个轮次的智能体会超出其所用模型的上下文窗口；对于小型语言模型（SLM）和受限推理系统而言，这个窗口尤其小。上下文压缩会用摘要替换较早的轮次，使会话得以继续，但这种做法有损信息、需要调用模型，而且效果会因执行时机而变好或变差。我们介绍 Bud ContextCompact 2.0，即集成在 Bud 智能体运行时中的压缩机制，并在两种设定下对其进行评估。在对记录的智能体会话进行回忆问答时，将上下文压缩至 16K 预算后，一个拥有 1.2B 参数的模型准确率达到 0.335；相比之下，截断时为 0.247，保留完整 32K 历史时为 0.176（p < 0.001）；一个 9B 模型的准确率则从 0.515（截断）提升至 0.577（p = 0.04）。在由 27B 推理模型端到端运行的 100 项 SWE-bench Verified 任务中，该模型的窗口为 49K token（共 556 个经评分的会话）；压缩使长会话的解决率从 41% 提高到 53%（+12.3 个百分点，95% CI +1.6 至 +23.0，McNemar p = 0.043），短会话的解决率没有变化，并且在总成本相同的情况下，每个已解决任务使用的 token 减少了 13%。不进行压缩时，主要的失败原因并非历史记录溢出，而是某一轮推理耗尽了历史记录所剩的空间。这一收益也有局限：在 45 分钟的会话时限下，收益消失了，因为每次摘要耗时中位数为 161 秒；阈值研究也显示，只有在足够早地触发压缩、为后续内容留出空间时，才会出现收益。一个 8B 模型在约十轮后提交，当时上下文为 5-8K token，并且从未需要压缩。我们认为，对于模型和窗口相同的情况，准确率结果可迁移到不同硬件上，包括 CPU 推理；但耗时会随硬件而变，必须纳入预算。

    ATEST: Adaptive Resource-Aware Test-Time Scaling for LLM Inference

    ATEST：面向 LLM 推理的自适应资源感知测试时扩展

    Mobina Kashaniyan, Ali Jannesari

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    ATE​ST adaptively allocates test-time samples using answer stability and live energy costs, with empirical gains in reasoning-task accuracy and budget adherence. This advances inference-time computation and resource allocation, while reasoning itself is evaluated rather than mechanistically improved or explained.

    ATEST 利用答案稳定性和实时能耗成本，自适应地分配测试时采样，并在推理任务准确率和预算遵守方面取得了实证提升。这推动了推理时计算和资源分配，而推理能力本身仅作为评估对象，并未在机制层面得到改进或解释。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Test-time scaling (TTS) improves large language model (LLM) reasoning by sampling multiple answers, but fixed sampling budgets ignore both query difficulty and the changing energy cost of inference under GPU contention. We measure up to a 4.1-fold increase in energy for the same four-sample query as GPU load rises. We present ATEST, a resource-aware TTS framework that jointly considers the expected value of additional samples and their current GPU cost. ATEST-Online, its default mode, requires no offline calibration: it incrementally generates samples, estimates the stability of the plurality answer, monitors live GPU conditions, and learns step energy cost online to decide when to stop. ATEST-Calibrated instead selects a per-query budget using offline accuracy and cost models, favoring deployments with stable loads. We evaluate both modes on four reasoning and question-answering datasets using Phi-3-mini on an NVIDIA A100 under controlled varying load, and test transfer to an NVIDIA L40S and Qwen2.5-3B. Across the four A100 datasets, ATEST-Online answers every query without exceeding the energy budget, while achieving the highest or statistically tied accuracy and reducing sampling as load increases. On GSM8K at high load, it achieves 60.0% accuracy with no deferrals, versus 44.0% accuracy and 42.4% deferrals for ATEST-Calibrated. Ablations show that online cost learning drives adaptation to load. Including offline profiling, ATEST-Online uses 42 times less GPU time and 48 times less energy than ATEST-Calibrated for the evaluated workload. Online control trades higher tail latency and lower throughput on short tasks for robustness under varying load; offline calibration remains competitive under stable conditions.

    中文

    测试时扩展（TTS）通过采样多个答案来提升大语言模型（LLM）的推理能力，但固定的采样预算忽略了查询难度，以及 GPU 争用时推理能耗的变化。我们测得，随着 GPU 负载上升，同一项包含四次采样的查询能耗最多增加到原来的 4.1 倍。我们提出 ATEST，这是一种资源感知的 TTS 框架，同时考虑增加采样的预期收益及其当前 GPU 成本。其默认模式 ATEST-Online 无需离线校准：它逐步生成样本，估计多数答案的稳定性，监控实时 GPU 状况，并在线学习每一步的能耗，以决定何时停止。ATEST-Calibrated 则利用离线准确率和成本模型，为每个查询选择预算，适用于负载稳定的部署环境。我们使用 Phi-3-mini，在受控的变化负载下，于 NVIDIA A100 上对两个模式进行评估，所用数据集涵盖四项推理和问答任务；并测试其向 NVIDIA L40S 和 Qwen2.5-3B 的迁移效果。在 A100 上的四个数据集中，ATEST-Online 回答了每个查询，且没有超出能耗预算；同时，它达到最高或在统计上相当的准确率，并随负载增加而减少采样。在高负载下的 GSM8K 上，它的准确率为 60.0%，且没有延后处理；相比之下，ATEST-Calibrated 的准确率为 44.0%，延后处理率为 42.4%。消融实验表明，在线成本学习驱动了系统对负载的适应。计入离线分析后，在所评估的工作负载中，ATEST-Online 使用的 GPU 时间比 ATEST-Calibrated 少 42 倍，能耗少 48 倍。在线控制以短任务中更高的尾延迟和更低的吞吐量为代价，换取变化负载下的鲁棒性；在稳定条件下，离线校准仍有竞争力。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Any-to-any generation seeks a single model that translates flexibly among text, image, and audio, yet existing approaches either require fully aligned multimodal tuples or a shared representation that suppresses modality-specific structure. We introduce Modaliff, a novel token-based diffusion model that learns from widely available bimodal pairs while preserving each modality in its native latent sequence. Modaliff assembles conditions and targets into a unified token sequence, with per-token attributes to disambiguate token identities and role-based positional embedding to preserve each modality's internal structure across sequence layouts. This design enables a single denoiser to support diverse generation tasks without task-specific architectural changes or a shared cross-modal latent space. Beyond one-to-one generation, Modaliff supports multiple conditions either by combining single-condition predictions at inference or by lightweight finetuning on captions that jointly describe multiple inputs. Experiments across text, image, and audio show that Modaliff achieves the best fidelity among any-to-any models on most generation tasks while using substantially fewer parameters and training data.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The study diagnoses how independent exploration causes RL policies to over-commit and shows that imitation-guided policies can accelerate MILP while preserving solution quality.     本研究诊断了独立探索如何导致 RL 策略过度承诺，并表明由模仿引导的策略能够在保持解质量的同时加速 MILP。这为优化和规划训练提供了重要的算法洞见；学习到的策略用于引导求解器，则构成较有限的系统贡献，而组合性只是附带关联。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Reinforcement learning (RL) is increasingly proposed as a fast solver for unit commitment (UC), but standalone agents remain far more expensive than mixed-integer linear programming (MILP). In the first study of RL on the 51-generator, 72-hour benchmark of the Electric Power Research Institute (EPRI) AI-ccelerating Unit Commitment competition, we trace this gap to the agents' own exploration, close most of it, and show that the resulting policy can accelerate an exact solver. In every configuration tested, Proximal Policy Optimisation (PPO) and an action-branching Deep Q-Network (DQN) trained from scratch committed about twice the units of a thermal-only MILP optimum, at 39-64% higher cost, whereas a merit-order rule came within 1.6-7% (10-24% when unserved energy is priced). When each unit's decision is sampled independently, spare units insure against random de-commitments. Consistent with this, injecting exploration noise during fine-tuning enlarged a lean policy's fleet, a reward without shaping terms did not remove the over-commitment, and under their training noise the agents outperformed the rule subjected to comparable noise. Imitating the MILP solutions and fine-tuning conservatively brought PPO within 2.6% of the optimum, and these policies had the lowest penalised cost of any evaluated (about 5%). Fixing the fine-tuned policy's confident decisions made the MILP 3.8-8.5 times faster within 0.10-0.25% of the best solution, with a smaller worst case than an imitation-only policy fixing as many variables (1.1% against 8.9%). Because dispatch method and benchmark scope alone shift the reported optimality ratio by up to 3.6% and 9%, we propose a reporting protocol.

    中文

    强化学习（RL）越来越常被提议作为机组组合（UC）的快速求解器，但单独运行的智能体仍比混合整数线性规划（MILP）昂贵得多。在针对电力研究院（EPRI）AI-ccelerating 机组组合竞赛的 51 台发电机、72 小时基准任务中，我们首次研究了 RL；我们将这一差距追溯到智能体自身的探索，弥合了其中大部分差距，并表明由此得到的策略能够加速精确求解器。在所有测试配置中，从头训练的近端策略优化（PPO）和动作分支深度 Q 网络（DQN）所承诺运行的机组数量，约为仅考虑火电机组的 MILP 最优解的两倍，成本高出 39-64%；相比之下，按优先顺序调度规则的成本仅高出 1.6-7%（计入未供电能源成本时则高出 10-24%）。当每台机组的决策独立采样时，备用机组可以防范随机停用。一项与此相符的发现是：微调时注入探索噪声会扩大精简策略所使用的机组规模；不包含塑形项的奖励并未消除过度承诺；而在其训练噪声下，这些智能体优于施加相当噪声的规则策略。模仿 MILP 解并进行保守微调，使 PPO 达到距最优解 2.6% 以内；这些策略的惩罚成本也是所有评估方法中最低的（约为 5%）。固定微调策略中有把握的决策后，MILP 的运行速度提高了 3.8-8.5 倍，与最佳解的差距为 0.10-0.25%；其最坏情况误差低于固定相同数量变量的纯模仿策略（1.1%，而非 8.9%）。由于仅调度方法和基准范围就会使报告的最优性比率分别偏移至多 3.6% 和 9%，我们提出了一套报告规范。

    NCE trains LLM agents to edit their own context through generated tokens, improving long-horizon task success while reducing token use.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    A synopsis in novels folds a story into a few lines; a function in code gathers many steps with a single execution. Context editing is native to language itself. In this paper, we propose the Native Context Editing (NCE) framework, which gives language model agents a grammar for natively editing their own context. By encoding context-editing operations in a grammar of dedicated special tokens, we teach the agents to invoke edits through the language itself. We train agents on iteratively constructed trajectory segments, with each teacher edit conditioned on the evolving context. This establishes context editing as an atomic and inherent capability of LLM agents, enabling them to dynamically modify their context as they generate responses over long-horizon reasoning and interaction. Compared with context-editing methods that learn to generate tool-use code within specific external harness environments, our approach integrates context editing as an internal mechanism of the model's native generation process, enabling better generalization across diverse real-world workflows. On four long-horizon agentic benchmarks (Terminal-Bench 2.0, SWE-bench Verified, SWE-bench Multilingual, and SWE-bench Pro), NCE improves the average task success rate over the base model by 5.6 percentage points for LongCat-Flash-Lite-Sparse and by 4.5 for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, while reducing average token usage by 36% and 15%, respectively.

Existing work retrieves relevant tools and checks plan feasibility, without learning which eligible device returns a useful observation. Unlike previous works, we study online tool grounding: binding an already specified tool call to one physical endpoint under service cost and device participation constraints. We propose a framework that learns which physical device should execute each agent-issued call. It formulates selection as a contextual bandit problem and combines adaptive context partitions with hierarchical endpoint trees, so that execution feedback is reused across related requests and devices. Selection balances task success against service cost while respecting device capability, authorization, battery reserves, and availability. Gaussian reward aggregation provides an optional mechanism for protecting individual feedback values. Theoretical results establish a finite-horizon regret bound and differential privacy for released reward statistics under fixed, reward-independent assignments.     断言与信念：语言模型中的摩尔悖论

    Anshun Asher Zheng, Weili Cao, Fangcong Yin, David Beaver, Junyi Jessy Li

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper tests whether language models account for speech acts when judging Moorean sentences, finding that they recognize the infelicity but appear to recall facts and apply rules rather than reason about a speaker. This provides substantial evidence about models' reasoning behavior, while it does not establish an internal-mechanism or compositional-generalization contribution.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Moore's paradox \citep{moore1942} concerns sentences such as ``It is raining, but I don't believe that it is,'' which may well be true yet cannot be sensibly asserted. The absurdity lies not in the content but in the act, since to assert is to vouch for one's own belief. This makes the paradox a test of whether language models take the speech act into account when computing meaning. We present the first test of Moore's paradox in LLMs, evaluating 12 models on a curated set of Moorean sentences in varied contexts. We find that models largely recognize the infelicity of Moorean sentences, and that the judgement is not tied to a memorized form and tracks the speech act. Using the Rational Speech Act framework (RSA; \citealt{goodmanfrank2016}), we then test whether these judgements arise from a listener reasoning about a speaker. We find the models' own listeners do not reason about their own speakers, and their reasoning traces suggest that they instead recall knowledge about the paradox and apply rules therein. The models thus appear to have learned the paradox as a fact about sentences, not as a requirement on speakers.

    William L. Tong, Aryo Lotfi, Emmanuel Abbe, Josh Susskind, Cengiz Pehlevan, Eran Malach

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces query-dependent weighting to compose cached SSM states, with a sparse variant and theoretical arguments about when state souping works. This strongly advances reusable composition and efficient context retrieval; its retrieval and variable-tracking evaluations connect partially to reasoning, but it does not investigate internal representations mechanistically.

    本文提出依赖于查询的加权方法来组合缓存的 SSM 状态，并给出稀疏变体和关于状态混合何时有效的理论论证。这显著推进了可复用组合和高效上下文检索；其检索和变量追踪评估与推理部分相关，但并未以机制方式研究内部表征。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    State space models (SSMs) combine fast inference and fixed state size with competitive language-modeling performance. Recently, state souping has been proposed as a procedure whereby an SSM independently encodes chunks of tokens like documents, tool definitions, or memory records. The resulting state encodings may be cached and recombined to cheaply construct a context for downstream queries. However, both state souping and vanilla SSMs deteriorate on long, crowded contexts, limiting their utility for long-horizon domains. To address this issue, we propose weighted state souping, a simple method that learns query-dependent weights for composing cached states. The resulting models improve long-context performance substantially across both single- and multi-hop document question answering, needle-in-a-haystack retrieval, variable tracking, and tool use. Our method can be further adapted into an efficient sparse variant, yielding near-constant encoding cost with respect to context length while preserving (and sometimes improving) performance. We also present simple theoretical arguments that illustrate why souping works and when it may fail, and discuss informally the advantages of weighted souping. Weighted state souping thus combines reusable context representations with selective retrieval, offering an efficient approach to language modeling over large collections of documents, tools, and other forms of structured context that increasingly dominate modern agentic workloads.

    ENGLISH

    Agent pattern catalogs describe architectural alternatives, but engineers also need evidence for selecting and composing them. We extend a cognitive-function--execution-topology framework with an evidence-driven selection procedure and explicit composition contracts. The study combines two industrial case accounts, a contributor's collaboration design, seven practitioner workshops, and executable fault-injection experiments. Three local reference systems use SQLite state, shared artifact files, and a file-backed map-publication surrogate. A 2 x 2 ablation separates function-specific contracts from execution controls across 36 scenario families, with ten input variants per family. Under equal family weighting, composition correctly completes or safely refuses 11 of 12 families in each system, compared with 2, 2, and 1 for the simple baselines. These are constructed challenge-suite results, not production success rates. Recovery without consumer-side verification increases false-success cases in the map surrogate. All composed systems still fail a boundary case in which trusted evidence is wrong. An audit of a frozen six-arm language-model pilot reproduces its scores but confirms an evaluator-dependent ranking reversal. The contribution connects industrial failure, pattern selection, executable treatment, external acceptance, and revision. Selection is demonstrated rather than evaluated against an alternative procedure; catalog admission rests on separate criteria. The results support bounded composition mechanisms, not a claim that the framework improves engineers' design decisions over an equally informative conventional method.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    TCA trains multimodal models to compress extended reasoning into target-relevant context for more accurate localization, using staged reinforcement-learning rewards.     TCA 通过分阶段的强化学习奖励，训练多模态模型将扩展推理压缩为与目标相关的上下文，以提高定位准确率。这显著推进了推理训练和落地应用；任务中虽包含组合推断，但核心贡献不在模型内部机制或系统组织。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Extended reasoning has substantially improved multimodal large language models (MLLMs) on tasks requiring compositional and relational inference. However, multimodal grounding imposes a distinct requirement: reasoning must ultimately converge on a target-specific compact representation that supports precise localization. As reasoning trajectories grow longer, they often expand into broad scene narratives and peripheral relational details, which can dilute grounded perceptual evidence and lead to ambiguous or incorrect predictions. Motivated by the information bottleneck principle, we propose Think-Compress-Answer (TCA), a reinforcement learning framework that decomposes multimodal grounding into three phases: free-form reasoning, target-aware context compression, and answer generation conditioned on the compressed context. TCA is optimized through a multi-stage Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with progressive rewards that establish the structured output protocol, minimize reasoning-specific information while preserving target-relevant content, and directly improve localization accuracy. This staged design enables MLLMs to retain the benefits of extended reasoning while distilling it into the minimal context required for grounding. Experiments across six multimodal grounding benchmarks show that TCA attains substantial zero-shot performance gains, demonstrating the effectiveness of reasoning compression.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    SFPRM uses spherical fixed-point iteration and adaptive halting to allocate computation, with convergence guarantees and puzzle results; token-input angles also reveal structure and predict correctness.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Looped (weight-tied) transformers enable adaptive computation by allocating more iterations to harder inputs. Fixed-Point Reasoners (FPRM) achieve this with a damped fixed-point solver, but operate in an unbounded Euclidean residual space with coupled rescaling and relative-norm halting. We introduce Spherical Fixed-Point Reasoners (SFPRM), which perform the same computation on the unit hypersphere of normalized transformers (nGPT). Input injection, damping, and halting become geodesic operations, yielding boundedness by construction and eliminating coefficient coupling. We prove fixed-point existence, local convergence under an explicit step-size condition, and global convergence under strong injection. On Sudoku-Extreme, Maze-Hard, and Mini-ARC, SFPRM achieves 96.6%, 87.9%, and 59.1% test accuracy, respectively, outperforming FPRM and other baselines while allocating test-time compute more effectively. Its converged geometry is also interpretable: token-input angles capture puzzle structure and predict correctness.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper compares consistency-training methods and uses a known cue-carrying circuit to show that training suppresses cue influence without teaching cue selectivity.     Language models often change answers because of a cue, a hint such as "I believe the answer is B" that gives no valid evidence. Consistency training (CT) trains a model to answer the same with and without the cue. Four CT methods apply this idea to output tokens (BCT), residual activations (ACT), attention patterns (AttCT) and sampled-answer rates (RMCT). Prior work suggests some learn different solutions. We train all four on Gemma-2-2B-it and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct with the same data. We test predictions written in advance and inspect the models with a known circuit that carries cues to the answer. All four make the trained cue less effective, and their fixes share three properties. First, correct cues lose about as much influence as wrong ones. Second, the fix is usually large for cues before the answer options, as in training, and much smaller after them. Llama RMCT depends least on position. Third, the circuit heads still carry most remaining cue-induced errors. Making BCT targets depend on the cue's correctness mostly weakens the fix. CT thus weakens the trained cue without teaching models when a cue is right. Evaluations with only wrong cues at the trained position miss the first two properties.

    LOOP interleaves layer pruning with on-policy distillation and uses recovery trajectories to select layers based on reasoning contribution and recovery sensitivity, advancing reasoning-capability preservation and model computation design.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Layer-level pruning is attractive for large language model (LLM) deployment as it reduces the model size while preserving a dense architecture that can be efficiently executed on standard hardware. Current methods typically follow a one-shot paradigm, which first removes selected layers to reach a target model size and then performs additional training to recover model capabilities. However, pruning directly to the target size can substantially degrade reasoning capabilities, making subsequent recovery more difficult under a limited training budget. Moreover, this paradigm separates layer selection from recovery, limiting the use of recovery information to guide selection and potentially hindering the recovery of reasoning capabilities. To address these limitations, we propose LOOP, a Layer-level Recovery-Oriented On-Policy Pruning framework that interleaves pruning and recovery across multiple shots. In each shot, LOOP removes a single layer and performs short on-policy distillation, mitigating the abrupt degradation in reasoning capabilities associated with one-shot pruning. To guide layer selection in subsequent shots, LOOP reuses on-policy trajectories and optimization signals from recovery to jointly assess each remaining layer's reasoning contribution and recovery sensitivity, thereby making layer selection recovery-aware. Evaluations on several benchmarks show that LOOP consistently outperforms one-shot baselines in average accuracy across different model scales and pruning ratios.

    Chu Zhao, Lei Tang, Yanming Wang, Jianzhe Zhao, Guibing Guo, Zhengzong Chen, Yuanyuan Zhao, Fei Huang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    ToolOPD analyzes how outcomes affect credit for actions and uses hindsight skills to reweight distillation alongside reinforcement learning, improving long-horizon tool-use reasoning.     本文分析了结果如何影响行为信用，并利用事后技能对蒸馏重新加权，同时结合强化学习来提升长时程工具使用推理能力。这对推理训练和智能体工具使用方法作出了重要推进，但其信用分析并未解释模型的内部表征或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    On-policy distillation (OPD) enhances the capabilities of small language agents by providing dense, token-level supervision from a teacher model on student-generated trajectories. However, standard OPD implicitly assumes that credit is uniformly distributed across long-horizon trajectories, assigning the same strength of teacher supervision to different actions. Through credit-distribution analysis and outcome-reversal counterfactual experiments, we find that trajectory credit is concentrated on a small number of critical actions. Moreover, even when the trajectory is held fixed, reversing only the final outcome substantially changes the credit assigned to multiple interaction turns. These findings show that the uniform-credit assumption fails to identify critical decisions and ultimately degrades the model's reasoning accuracy. To address these challenges, we propose ToolOPD, an outcome-aware on-policy distillation framework designed for long-horizon tool use. ToolOPD first summarizes each completed trajectory and its outcome into a reusable hindsight skill. It then measures how this skill changes the teacher's probability of each student action token and converts the change into outcome-aware credit. The resulting credit preserves supervision that supports successful decisions or discourages failed ones, while suppressing irrelevant and conflicting signals. ToolOPD uses these credits to reweight the action-level distillation loss and jointly optimizes it with reinforcement learning. Extensive experiments across multiple long-horizon tool interaction benchmarks demonstrate that ToolOPD significantly outperforms existing reinforcement learning and self-distillation baselines.

    中文

    在线策略蒸馏（OPD）通过教师模型针对学生生成的轨迹提供密集的词元级监督，增强小型语言智能体的能力。然而，标准 OPD 隐含地假设信用在长时程轨迹上均匀分布，因此对不同行为分配同等强度的教师监督。通过信用分布分析和结果反转反事实实验，我们发现，轨迹信用集中于少数关键行为。此外，即使轨迹保持不变，仅反转最终结果也会显著改变分配给多个交互轮次的信用。这些发现表明，均匀信用假设无法识别关键决策，最终会降低模型的推理准确率。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 ToolOPD，这是一种面向长时程工具使用、具备结果感知能力的在线策略蒸馏框架。ToolOPD 首先将每条已完成轨迹及其结果总结成可重用的事后技能。随后，它测量该技能如何改变教师模型对学生每个行为词元的概率，并将这一变化转化为结果感知信用。由此得到的信用保留支持成功决策或抑制失败决策的监督，同时压制无关和相互冲突的信号。ToolOPD 使用这些信用对行为级蒸馏损失重新加权，并与强化学习联合优化。在多个长时程工具交互基准上的大量实验表明，ToolOPD 显著优于现有强化学习和自蒸馏基线。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Inference-time steering is crucial for deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) in real-world applications, where they must flexibly adjust behavior preferences. For instance, a model should dynamically adjust its caution level based on the risk of the scenario. This requirement introduces a challenge: modulating the intensity of LLM preferences. Prompt engineering can require task-specific prompt design, while fine-tuning requires additional optimization and data. These requirements can make repeated behavioral adjustments costly. To address this, we introduce NeuroSteer, a plug-and-play framework that enables flexible, quantitative adjustment of LLM preferences at inference time. NeuroSteer employs a Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) as its controller. Comparing neuron activation frequencies between positive and negative examples isolates "feature neurons" that correspond to target preferences such as politeness and positive sentiment. During inference, the activations of selected SAE features are amplified in the latent representations to steer the output distribution. Users can adjust the strength of this steering on a per-scenario or per-user basis, granting the LLM fine-grained, quantifiable trait modulation. Our experiments show that NeuroSteer can alter sentiment, toxicity, stance, and politeness at inference time. It achieves higher target-direction steering scores than the compared baselines in several settings, with task- and strength-dependent trade-offs in generation quality.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Shared long-term memory lets an LLM agent serving one user inadvertently retrieve another user's credentials, but it is unclear when such exposure leads to actual harm. We introduce a three-stage audit that separates three events: a foreign credential reaches the prompt (exposure), the agent acts with it (behavior), and the other user's account changes (state). In AppWorld, a store that mixes 763 past logins from all users retrieves another user's credential for 84.7 percent of required apps, yet agents rarely act on it. Misuse appears in a stress test where memory lacks the user's own credential and presents a single foreign one as the user's record: seven agents then use it in 80 to 94 percent of runs and change the victim's account in up to 43 percent, sometimes passing the official check. Naming the owner before or inside each credential line prevents most of this: with all else fixed, misuse falls from 92 to 1 of 305 paired runs, also with name-free usernames, though owner-bound notes cost 3 to 5 successful tasks per model on clean memory. A wrongly written owner largely restores misuse; trailing owner tags and added safety instructions help only some models. Agent memory should consistently record whose credential it stores, and evaluations should measure behavior, not only exposure.

    Omid Shams Solari

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper formalizes block-sparse spectral objectives and proves convergence, finite support identification, and local dynamics, with experiments showing more monosemantic and class-specialized components in model activations. This provides substantial insight into representation structure, while the work does not center on reasoning, compositional generalization, or system organization.

    本文形式化了块稀疏谱目标，并证明了收敛性、有限支持集识别和局部动态；实验表明，模型激活中的分量具有更高的单义性和类别专门化。这为理解表征结构提供了重要洞见，而该工作并不以推理、组合泛化或系统组织为核心。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    The block generalized-power method pairs threshold-based support selection with inexpensive Stiefel updates, but the standard block formulation conflates two nonequivalent objectives and leaves inactive components, threshold ties, and post-selection refitting ill-specified. We rebuild the model from the primal. Eliminating each loading column from the normalized loading-ball problem gives a sum of soft-thresholded Euclidean norms (A-SUM); the squared-threshold objective in common use arises from a quadratic lift (A-SQ). We prove both identities, exhibit a two-component instance whose maximizers disagree, and specify explicit conventions for zero-response columns, ties, rank deficiency, and mask-before-refit. For A-SQ we separate the historical full-polar iteration from a safeguarded Riemannian ascent and prove, for the latter, whole-sequence convergence via a sufficient-ascent lemma, a relative-error lemma, and the Kurdyka-Lojasiewicz property, which applies because the soft-threshold objective and the Stiefel constraint are semi-algebraic. A strict threshold margin then forces finite identification of the support and sign pattern. The post-identification map is ordinary power iteration on the active covariance for a rank-one hard threshold, and the Frechet derivative of a coupled polar map for component-specific supports; a radius-based safe-screening rule follows from the same local analysis. Planted-spike experiments match the predicted identification time and local rates. On modern-AI panels (GPT-2 residual stream, ViT CLS stream, Pitprops) the thresholded block-sparse components match dense PCA on reconstruction and improve on it in monosemanticity and class specialisation. On three native-label scRNA datasets (Zheng17 FACS-sorted PBMCs, 68k donor-A with FACS-correlated labels, Tabula Muris) A-SQ beats dense PCA on cluster-recovery AMI by +0.023 to +0.044 at matched sparsity.

    块广义幂方法将基于阈值的支持集选择与低成本的 Stiefel 更新相结合，但标准块形式混淆了两个并不等价的目标，也没有明确规定非活跃分量、阈值并列以及选择后重拟合的处理方式。我们从原始问题出发重建模型。从归一化负载球问题中消去每一列负载，得到软阈值化欧几里得范数之和（A-SUM）；常用的平方阈值目标则来自二次提升（A-SQ）。我们证明了这两个恒等式，给出一个最大化解不一致的双分量实例，并明确规定零响应列、并列、秩亏以及先掩码后重拟合的处理约定。对于 A-SQ，我们将历史上的全极分解迭代与带保护的黎曼上升方法区分开来，并通过充分上升引理、相对误差引理和 Kurdyka-Lojasiewicz 性质，证明后者的整个序列收敛；该性质适用，是因为软阈值目标和 Stiefel 约束均为半代数集合。随后，严格的阈值间隔会迫使支持集和符号模式在有限步内被识别。识别后的映射在秩一硬阈值情况下，是作用于活跃协方差矩阵上的普通幂迭代；在分量特定支持集的情况下，则是耦合极分解映射的 Frechet 导数。基于同一局部分析，我们还得到一条基于半径的安全筛选规则。植入尖峰实验与预测的识别时间和局部收敛速率一致。在现代 AI 数据集（GPT-2 残差流、ViT CLS 流、Pitprops）上，阈值化块稀疏分量的重构表现与稠密 PCA 相当，在单义性和类别专门化方面则优于稠密 PCA。在三个具有原生标签的单细胞 RNA 测序数据集（Zheng17 FACS 分选的 PBMC、带有 FACS 相关标签的 68k donor-A、Tabula Muris）上，在稀疏度相同的条件下，A-SQ 的聚类恢复 AMI 比稠密 PCA 高出 +0.023 至 +0.044。

    Zilei Shao, Ian Li, Heng Zhao, Kewei Lian, Guy Van den Broeck, Zhe Zeng, Anji Liu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces a context-adaptive joint denoiser with exact conditional inference and reports gains on reasoning benchmarks, making reasoning capability a substantial evaluation focus. Its probabilistic coupling is an algorithmic contribution, but the abstract does not establish compositional generalization, internal representation analysis, or a broader systems contribution.

    本文提出一种具有精确条件推理能力的上下文自适应联合去噪器，并报告了其在推理基准上的性能提升，因此推理能力是重要的评估重点。其概率耦合是一项算法贡献，但摘要没有证明其实现了组合泛化、内部表征分析或更广泛的系统贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Diffusion language models accelerate generation by predicting multiple tokens in parallel, but factorized denoisers treat simultaneous predictions as conditionally independent. Decoding heuristics reduce the resulting errors by controlling which tokens are committed, but leave the underlying distribution factorized. Joint modeling addresses the source of the problem, yet existing methods attach separately learned layers to frozen denoisers, leaving the backbone unadapted to the joint objective and the coupling parameters fixed across contexts. We propose Codpula, a context-parameterized denoiser combining a Transformer with a tractable probabilistic inference layer. Given a partially masked input, the Transformer produces token potentials that shape per-position predictions and compact gates that modulate the layer's coupling parameters, yielding a context-dependent joint distribution while retaining exact conditional inference. We jointly optimize both components under a conditional denoising objective using a dual-flow multiplicative update that preserves valid probabilistic parameters. At inference, Codpula supports standard heuristics and uses conditional queries to adapt commitments to dependencies among proposed tokens without extra Transformer evaluations within a step. Codpula sets new state-of-the-art results across a broad suite of reasoning benchmarks while advancing the accuracy-latency Pareto frontier in mathematical reasoning and code generation.

    中文

    扩散语言模型通过并行预测多个词元来加快生成，但因子化去噪器会将同时进行的预测视为条件独立。解码启发式方法通过控制提交哪些词元来减少由此产生的错误，却仍保留因子化的底层分布。联合建模能够从源头解决问题，但现有方法会将单独训练的层接到冻结的去噪器上，使主干网络无法适配联合目标，且耦合参数在不同上下文中保持固定。我们提出 Codpula，这是一种上下文参数化的去噪器，将 Transformer 与可处理的概率推理层相结合。给定部分掩码输入，Transformer 会生成用于塑造各位置预测的词元势能，以及用于调节该层耦合参数的紧凑门控，从而得到上下文相关的联合分布，同时保留精确的条件推理能力。我们在条件去噪目标下联合优化这两个组件，并采用能够保持概率参数有效性的双流乘法更新。推理时，Codpula 支持标准启发式方法，并通过条件查询来根据候选词元间的依赖关系调整提交决策，且单步内无需额外运行 Transformer。Codpula 在一系列广泛的推理基准上取得新的最先进结果，并推动数学推理和代码生成的准确率—延迟帕累托前沿。

    Anatomy of Off-Policy Policy Gradient: Importance Sampling, KL Regularization, and Baselines

    离策略策略梯度剖析：重要性采样、KL正则化与基线

    Haoqun Cao, Yurun Yuan, Tengyang Xie

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops theoretical conditions, regret bounds, and an interpretation of off-policy policy-gradient methods used in LLM post-training, directly advancing training methods for reasoning and problem-solving. LLM post-training is the context, but it offers no internal-mechanism or model-system contribution beyond the incidental use of reinforcement learning.

    本文针对LLM后训练中使用的离策略策略梯度方法，提出理论条件、遗憾界及其解释，直接推动了推理和问题求解训练方法的发展。LLM后训练是研究背景；除附带使用强化学习外，论文没有提出内部机制或模型系统方面的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Reinforcement learning has become a central tool for large language model (LLM) post-training, where policy gradient methods are routinely deployed off-policy, even though vanilla policy gradient assumes on-policy sampling. We study when such off-policy deployment is justified, and what roles its core ingredients, including importance sampling, KL regularization, and baselines, play in handling the resulting distribution shift. We show that for a general class of off-policy policy gradient updates, consistency, in the sense that the optimal policy remains a stationary point, requires one of two structures at the optimal policy: trajectory-level importance weighting, which suffers from the well-known curse of horizon, or KL regularization with a baseline equal to the optimal soft value, instantiated by the grouped mean. Focusing on the KL route, we identify it with the group-relative policy gradient (GRPG) update, establish an equivalence to a trajectory-level Bellman residual minimization objective, and obtain a finite-sample regret bound under all-policy coverage. This also gives a theoretical account of a variant of the empirically successful GRPO objective. We further uncover a hidden role of baselines in the off-policy setting: a constant shift in the baseline implements pessimism, the standard remedy in offline RL for partial data coverage. We instantiate this via the asymmetric REINFORCE objective, and connect it to the game-theoretic offline RL framework, showing a regret bound with single-policy coverage. Together, these results offer a unified theoretical view of off-policy policy gradient in LLM post-training and connect it to classical ideas in offline RL.

    中文

    强化学习已成为大型语言模型（LLM）后训练的核心工具，其中策略梯度方法经常以离策略方式部署，尽管普通策略梯度假设采用同策略采样。我们研究这种离策略部署在何种情况下合理，以及其核心要素——包括重要性采样、KL正则化和基线——在应对由此产生的分布偏移时发挥何种作用。我们证明，对于一类一般的离策略策略梯度更新，若要保持一致性，即最优策略仍为一个驻点，则最优策略处必须具备以下两种结构之一：轨迹级重要性加权（会遭受众所周知的时域跨度灾难），或者采用KL正则化，并使用等于最优软价值的基线，具体可由分组均值实现。聚焦KL路径，我们将其认定为组相对策略梯度（GRPG）更新，证明它等价于一个轨迹级贝尔曼残差最小化目标，并在全策略覆盖条件下得到有限样本遗憾界。这也为一种在实证上表现成功的GRPO目标变体提供了理论解释。我们进一步揭示基线在离策略情形下的一项隐藏作用：对基线进行常数平移可以实现悲观估计，这是离线RL应对数据覆盖不完整的标准方法。我们通过非对称REINFORCE目标具体实现这一点，并将其与博弈论离线RL框架联系起来，证明在单策略覆盖条件下存在遗憾界。总体而言，这些结果为LLM后训练中的离策略策略梯度提供了统一的理论视角，并将其与离线RL中的经典思想联系起来。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper shows that collaboration can restore forgotten information through pooled messages and proposes unlearning that uses recovery feedback and credit assignment to reduce this risk. Its main contribution advances LLM team coordination and information management, while references to knowledge removal, clue combination, and credit assignment do not establish core interpretability, compositional generalization, or reasoning contributions.

    本文表明，协作可能通过汇总消息恢复已遗忘的信息，并提出利用恢复反馈和信用分配来降低这一风险的遗忘方法。其主要贡献推动了LLM团队协作和信息管理；文中关于知识移除、线索组合和信用分配的内容，并未构成对核心可解释性、组合泛化或推理的推进。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    LLM unlearning is essential for removing sensitive or unwanted knowledge while preserving useful capabilities. As LLM teams are increasingly used to solve complex problems, forgetting must remain effective during collaboration. Despite advances in forgetting effectiveness, efficiency, and robustness to relearning, team deployment remains underexplored. We find that collaboration weakens forgetting: final-answer evaluations miss recoverable evidence in team messages, including complementary clues supporting joint recovery. We establish theoretically and confirm empirically that controlling final answers or individual messages does not ensure low recovery from their combination. To address this challenge, we propose Aggregation-Conditioned Unlearning (ACU). ACU trains a shared model using reconstruction feedback from individual and pooled messages, prioritizes views with higher recovery risk, and uses replacement-based credit assignment while protecting direct and collaborative utility. TOFU evaluates trajectory-level recovery, while WMDP-bio tests native forgetting and retained utility. On TOFU, ACU lowers full-trajectory recovery from 41.8% to 19.3% in ROUGE-L recall and factual recovery from 34.2% to 18.7% versus output-supervised training, with comparable retained-task performance. These results demonstrate that ACU curbs information leakage in LLM teams and generalizes across team sizes and readers.

    中文

    LLM遗忘对于移除敏感或不需要的知识，同时保留有用能力至关重要。随着LLM团队越来越多地用于解决复杂问题，遗忘在协作过程中也必须持续有效。尽管遗忘效果、效率以及抵抗重新学习方面已有进展，团队部署仍未得到充分研究。我们发现，协作会削弱遗忘：最终答案评估会漏掉团队消息中可恢复的证据，包括支持联合恢复的互补线索。我们从理论上证明并通过实证确认，控制最终答案或单条消息，并不能确保无法从其组合中恢复信息。为应对这一挑战，我们提出聚合条件遗忘（ACU）。ACU使用来自单条消息和汇总消息的重建反馈训练共享模型，优先处理恢复风险较高的视角，并采用基于替换的信用分配，同时保护直接效用和协作效用。TOFU用于评估轨迹级恢复，WMDP-bio用于测试原生遗忘和效用保留。在TOFU上，与输出监督训练相比，ACU将ROUGE-L召回率衡量的完整轨迹恢复率从41.8%降至19.3%，将事实恢复率从34.2%降至18.7%，同时保留任务的表现相当。这些结果表明，ACU能够抑制LLM团队中的信息泄漏，并且能推广到不同的团队规模和读取者。

    JooKyung Yuh, Byungmin Park, Eunseo Choi, Jinheon Baek, Junmo Cho, Kyu Hyun Choi, Sung Ju Hwang, Kyong Hwan Jin, Hae Beom Lee

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    BMD combines LLM hypothesis generation with Bayesian model comparison and information-guided experiment selection, using feedback to refine proposals; benchmarks show improved scientific discovery. This substantially advances experimental reasoning, with partial relevance to composition through the iterative coupling of proposal and evaluation, and to systems through the LLM–numerical engine workflow, but the abstract gives no evidence of internal mechanisms or structured compositional generalization.

    BMD将LLM假设生成与贝叶斯模型比较和信息引导的实验选择相结合，并利用反馈改进提案；基准测试显示其提升了科学发现能力。这显著推进了实验推理，通过提案与评估的迭代耦合与组合研究部分相关，也通过LLM与数值引擎的工作流程与系统研究部分相关，但摘要没有提供内部机制或结构化组合泛化方面的证据。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Scientific model discovery requires proposing candidate models of an unknown system and designing experiments that discriminate among them. However, LLM-based approaches typically rely on in-context learning to predict outcomes and select experiments, lacking explicit model evaluation to systematically guide hypothesis search, while Bayesian approaches enable principled model comparison but are confined to a predefined candidate set which results in limited search spaces. To this end, we introduce BMD, which closes the loop between LLM-driven hypothesis generation and Bayesian experimental design. Specifically, an LLM proposes model families, while a numerical engine fits their parameters, weighs them by model evidence, and averages their predictions. Then, BMD chooses the next experimental conditions by maximizing the joint expected information gain over families and their parameters, while feeding the updated beliefs and residual diagnostics back to the LLM to guide its next proposals. Across four scientific discovery benchmarks, BMD achieves lowest final prediction error than in-context learning and LLM-based scientific agents while recovering exact functional forms more often, with ablations supporting numerical feedback and the joint objective.

    科学模型发现需要提出关于未知系统的候选模型，并设计能够区分这些模型的实验。然而，基于LLM的方法通常依赖上下文学习来预测结果和选择实验，缺乏明确的模型评估来系统地引导假设搜索；贝叶斯方法虽能进行有原则的模型比较，却局限于预先定义的候选集合，导致搜索空间有限。为此，我们提出BMD，将LLM驱动的假设生成与贝叶斯实验设计形成闭环。具体而言，LLM提出模型族，数值引擎则拟合其参数、依据模型证据赋予权重，并对预测进行平均。随后，BMD通过最大化跨模型族及其参数的联合期望信息增益来选择下一组实验条件，同时将更新后的信念和残差诊断反馈给LLM，以指导其后续提案。在四个科学发现基准上，与上下文学习和基于LLM的科学智能体相比，BMD取得了最低的最终预测误差，也更常恢复出精确的函数形式；消融实验支持数值反馈和联合目标的作用。

    In-context learning (ICL) tackles downstream tasks conditioned on demonstrations. This paradigm relies heavily on neighbor-based matching between queries and demonstrations, limiting out-of-distribution (OOD) performance. For better generalization, rule-based inductive reasoning derives task-level regularities, which we term task-level inductive representations (TIR), before directly answering. However, existing methods lack generalizable inductive ability across diverse tasks. Inspired by meta-learning, we propose Cognitive-Decoupling meta-Induction (CoDI) for TIR-based inductive reasoning on general tasks. CoDI comprises a Cognitive-Decoupling Framework for query-blind TIR induction, and a Dual-Loop Meta-Inductive Learning method for cross-task inducer optimization. We ask how an agent's actions depend on its reasoning when the correct action depends on a changing state. In a small file-system task, background events announce which file's lock has been toggled but not its new value. The agent therefore has to reconstruct the current locks from its history before it can move files safely. With Qwen3-8B and Qwen3.5-9B, we separate two roles of reasoning: generating it before each action, and retaining earlier reasoning in the prompt. Most of the reduction in lock-violating commands comes from reasoning written at the moment of action. Retaining earlier reasoning adds little to rule-following, although it helps one model complete the task. The benefit depends on what the reasoning says. Filler text, reasoning written for another history and an accurate table of the state do not reproduce it. When we give the agent reasoning written for a history that differs in one lock value, the agent acts on that reasoning even against its own history. Without reasoning, linear probes recover the state from the model's activations about as well as a text classifier recovers it from the transcript. However, decoding accuracy does not predict which interventions change the agent's actions. In this setting, the benefit of reasoning for rule-following comes mainly from generating it at each step. The state that can be decoded without reasoning is a limited guide to how the agent acts.

    语言模型智能体通常会在行动前进行推理，而监控这种推理的价值取决于它与行动之间的关系。我们研究当正确行动取决于不断变化的状态时，智能体的行动如何依赖其推理。在一个小型文件系统任务中，后台事件会告知哪个文件的锁状态已切换，却不告知切换后的状态。因此，智能体必须根据历史记录重建当前锁状态，才能安全移动文件。使用Qwen3-8B和Qwen3.5-9B，我们区分推理的两种作用：在每次行动前生成推理，以及在提示中保留先前的推理。锁违规命令的大部分减少来自行动当下写出的推理。保留先前推理对遵循规则帮助不大，但能帮助其中一个模型完成任务。这种益处取决于推理内容。填充文字、针对另一段历史写出的推理，以及准确的状态表格，都无法重现这种效果。当我们给智能体提供针对仅有一个锁值不同的历史所写出的推理时，即使这与智能体自身的历史相矛盾，它仍会依据该推理行动。没有推理时，线性探针从模型激活中恢复状态的能力，与文本分类器从对话记录中恢复状态的能力大致相当。然而，解码准确率无法预测哪些干预会改变智能体的行动。在这一场景中，推理对遵循规则的益处主要来自每一步都生成推理。不借助推理也能解码出的状态，对于理解智能体如何行动而言只是有限的参考。

    Yun Shen, Ming Shen, Tianjun Yao

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    CoMem trains agents to use retrieved cross-task experience to form failure hypotheses and guide later attempts, with reported transfer to out-of-distribution tasks.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Reflection lets LLM agents improve from their own attempts, but the memory it builds is local to a single task, so an agent reflecting on its own tends to revisit the same explanation for failure. Cross-task reflective memory addresses this in two forms: retrieved memory keeps past experience explicit and looks up related cases, which is specific but bounded by the bank, and parametric memory internalizes experience into parameters, which generalizes but is grounded in nothing beyond the task description. When both are used, existing agents combine them additively, feeding their outputs to the solver side by side, so retrieved experience never changes what the learned memory produces. We introduce CoMem (Compounding Memory), which makes retrieved experience an input to the learned memory itself, at training and at inference. The agent builds a bank of its own successful and failed reflections, learns from retrieved cases to write failure hypotheses, candidate explanations of how an attempt is likely to go wrong, and at test time reasons from newly retrieved cases to guide each attempt. Varying the retrieved cases gives the memory different perspectives, yielding reflective diversity that is not merely sampled but also grounded in retrieved experience. Across two backbones and five benchmarks in math, code, and multi-hop QA, CoMem achieves strong overall performance. Additional evaluations show that it generalizes to out-of-distribution tasks and enables smaller models to provide effective guidance to stronger solvers.

    反思让 LLM 智能体能够从自身尝试中改进，但由此构建的记忆局限于单个任务，因此智能体仅靠自我反思往往会反复回到同一种失败解释。跨任务反思记忆有两种形式：检索式记忆将过去的经验显式保存下来并查找相关案例，针对性强但受记忆库限制；参数化记忆则将经验内化到参数中，具有泛化能力，但其依据仅限于任务描述。当两者同时使用时，现有智能体会将它们以加法方式结合，把两者的输出并列提供给求解器，因此检索到的经验从未改变学习式记忆所产生的内容。我们提出 CoMem（复合记忆），让检索到的经验在训练和推理时都成为学习式记忆本身的输入。智能体构建一个包含自身成功与失败反思的记忆库，从检索到的案例中学习撰写失败假设，即对一次尝试可能如何出错的候选解释；在测试时，它根据新检索到的案例进行推理，以指导每次尝试。改变检索到的案例会让记忆获得不同视角，从而带来反思多样性；这种多样性不只是采样所得，也以检索到的经验为依据。在数学、代码和多跳 QA 领域的五个基准测试上，使用两种骨干模型的 CoMem 整体表现强劲。额外评估表明，它能够泛化到分布外任务，并使较小模型能够为更强的求解器提供有效指导。

    Yudai Ebato, Sou Nobukawa, Yusuke Sakemi, Takashi Kanamaru, Nina Sviridova, Kazuyuki Aihara

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper allocates decay timescales across reservoir modes and reuses computed states to reduce search cost, with benchmark evidence for prediction and reconstruction. This substantially advances adaptive memory and computation in model systems; the prediction tasks alone provide only an incidental connection to reasoning.

    本文为储备池模态分配不同的衰减时间尺度，并复用已计算的状态以降低搜索成本，同时提供了预测和重构基准测试结果。这显著推进了模型系统中的自适应记忆与计算；预测任务本身与推理只有附带关联。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    In reservoir computing, performance depends on whether the fixed dynamics of the reservoir suit the task, and the appropriate memory length and frequency response differ across tasks. The reservoir settings are found by a search on each task, and driving the reservoir with the input and collecting its states for every candidate setting dominates the cost of the search. In a reservoir with a linear recurrence, the dynamics decompose into modes, one per eigenvalue, and the eigenvalue distribution becomes a design variable. We propose the Sector-Ring Linear Reservoir (SRLR), in which the eigenvalue angles are fixed at evenly spaced positions around a circle and one decay timescale, chosen from a few values, is assigned to each sector of consecutive angles. To keep the scale of each mode's state equal across candidates, the input weights are scaled using the power spectrum of the training input. To reduce the cost of the search, the states of the modes for each decay-timescale value are computed once and reused across candidates. On prediction and reconstruction benchmarks built from chaotic systems, the SRLR achieved, in all eight cases, a lower mean test error than a reference model in which all modes share one decay timescale, and was competitive with nonlinear echo state network and leaky-integrator echo state network baselines. The selected decay-timescale profiles changed with the prediction target and horizon. The state reuse reduced the number of computed mode trajectories in the search by 99.8% relative to per-candidate recomputation.
