    在储备池计算中，性能取决于储备池的固定动力学是否适合任务，而不同任务所需的记忆长度和频率响应各不相同。每个任务都要通过搜索确定储备池设置；对每个候选设置都用输入驱动储备池并收集其状态，是搜索成本的主要部分。在线性递归储备池中，动力学可分解为多个模态，每个特征值对应一个模态，而特征值分布因此成为一个设计变量。我们提出扇区环形线性储备池（SRLR）：特征值角度固定在圆周上均匀间隔的位置，并为每个由连续角度构成的扇区分配一个衰减时间尺度，该时间尺度从少数几个取值中选出。为了使不同候选设置下各模态状态的尺度相同，我们根据训练输入的功率谱缩放输入权重。为降低搜索成本，每种衰减时间尺度对应的模态状态只计算一次，并在候选设置之间复用。在基于混沌系统构建的预测和重构基准测试中，SRLR 在全部八种情形下的平均测试误差都低于所有模态共用一个衰减时间尺度的参考模型，并且与非线性回声状态网络和漏积分回声状态网络基线相比具有竞争力。所选衰减时间尺度配置会随预测目标和预测跨度而变化。与针对每个候选设置重新计算相比，状态复用使搜索中计算的模态轨迹数量减少了 99.8%。

We test this on their procedural counting task with Qwen3-4B-Base and LoRA, comparing GRPO to rejection-sampling fine-tuning (RFT) on the same prompts, verifier and token cap. We use three seeds per arm. Hypotheses and falsifiers were registered before training. On test the advantage survives the least favorable treatment of truncated completions; out of distribution, truncation prevents a conclusion. Curating prompts does not help RFT (-2.7 points). Mixed-difficulty data helps RFT (+3.7 points), while for GRPO the evidence is inconclusive. A secondary iterated-RFT arm, which resamples from the current policy, recovers 3.2 of the 10.9-point gap (about 30%).     Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper tests whether LLMs judge when information suffices for a decision, identifying factor coverage bias and showing how added reasoning effort affects it. This is a strong contribution to reasoning evaluation, but the abstract does not investigate internal mechanisms or model-system design.

    本文检验 LLM 是否能够判断信息是否足以支持决策，识别出因素覆盖偏差，并展示增加推理力度对该偏差的影响。这是对推理评估的重要贡献，但摘要没有研究内部机制或模型系统设计。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Clinical decision-making often begins with underspecified information and requires not only gathering missing information but also knowing when to stop. This calls for judging determinability (whether the available information is sufficient for a decision) by considering whether missing information could change the conclusion, not simply the amount of available decision-relevant information. Reliance on this amount as a cue for determinability, which we term \textit{factor coverage bias}, could undermine the trustworthiness of large language models (LLMs) through premature conclusions or excessive information gathering, such as unnecessary invasive tests. Yet whether LLMs exhibit this bias remains insufficiently studied. To address this gap, we construct a controlled pairwise benchmark in which LLMs identify the determinable case within each determinable--undeterminable pair. We add a decision-relevant factor to either side while keeping each case's determinability unchanged, and similarly add irrelevant text to distinguish this bias from context-length effects. Adding a relevant factor made LLMs more likely to select the augmented case as determinable even when it remained undeterminable, an effect that persisted with increased reasoning effort, while adding irrelevant text made them less likely to select the augmented case, an effect that reasoning substantially reduced. These findings identify factor coverage bias as a failure mode distinct from context-length effects and a potential risk to LLM trustworthiness. Our work provides an evaluation framework for LLM trustworthiness under underspecification.

    中文

    临床决策往往从信息不充分的情形开始，所需的不仅是收集缺失信息，还包括知道何时停止。这要求判断信息是否足以作出决策（即可判定性）时，考虑缺失信息是否可能改变结论，而不只是看现有的决策相关信息有多少。将信息量作为可判定性线索，我们称之为 \textit{因素覆盖偏差}；这种依赖可能通过过早下结论或过度收集信息（例如进行不必要的侵入性检查）损害大型语言模型（LLM）的可信度。然而，LLM 是否表现出这种偏差，仍缺乏充分研究。为弥补这一空白，我们构建了一套受控的成对基准测试，其中 LLM 需要从每组可判定与不可判定的案例中识别可判定案例。我们在保持每个案例可判定性不变的同时，向任一侧添加一个决策相关因素；我们也以同样方式添加无关文本，以区分这种偏差与上下文长度效应。添加相关因素后，LLM 更可能将增补后的案例选为可判定，即使该案例仍不可判定；这一效应在提高推理力度后依然存在。添加无关文本则降低了模型选择增补案例的可能性，而推理显著减弱了这一效应。这些发现指出，因素覆盖偏差是一种不同于上下文长度效应的失效模式，也是 LLM 可信度面临的一种潜在风险。我们的工作为评估信息不充分情况下 LLM 的可信度提供了框架。

    Language models increasingly use skills that provide reusable instructions and procedures for task execution. We introduce SourceClash, a matched benchmark with 1,271 bundles and 6,355 prompts across ten procedural domains. Each bundle fixes the task, skill specification, and answer space while varying the relation between the skill and retrieval. Across nine models, valid-answer rates average 25.7% under conflicting retrieval, compared with 78.2% and 72.8% under two supportive retrieval settings. Mechanistic analysis of open-weight models shows that the answer-preference difference typically reaches its maximum shortly after generation begins. Residual replacement moves the model toward valid answers, while attention decomposition attributes most of the repair to value vectors. Intervention at the identified value pathway also improves final answer validity. These results characterize how partly conflicting retrieval changes skill-guided generation.

    Mohsen Fayyaz, Ali Modarressi, Daniel Israel, Lucas Bandarkar, Nanyun Peng

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The study measures how diffusion language models allocate decoding passes across tasks and languages, and uses decoding effort to improve answer selection. Its main contribution concerns adaptive computation and inference efficiency; links to internal representations or compositional generalization are incidental, while reasoning is examined as an evaluation setting.

    这项研究测量扩散语言模型如何在不同任务和语言中分配解码传递次数，并利用解码用力程度改进答案选择。其主要贡献涉及自适应计算和推理效率；与内部表征或组合泛化的联系只是附带的，而推理仅作为一种评估场景。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Diffusion language models can write several tokens in one forward pass, and they decide during generation how many passes to spend. Two outputs of the same token length can therefore vary a lot in cost. To understand the underlying factors of this cost variation, we analyze two diffusion models across 10 tasks. We find that the number of forward passes per token depends heavily on the task. Text copied or lightly edited from the input is cheap, while open-ended writing is costly. In DiffusionGemma, generating a token for story writing requires more than three times as many forward passes as for grammar correction. Two output properties explain much of this gap: how much of it is new relative to the input, and how rare its words are within the task. The same holds within a single response when thinking is involved. The final answer is cheap when it repeats the model's reasoning trace and costly when it adds something new. In multilingual generation, we find that highly tokenized languages also require more passes per token, adding to the cost they already pay with more tokens. Finally, cost tracks correctness: on the same math problem, wrong answers take more passes per token than correct ones, and weighting candidate answers by decoding speed beats majority voting by up to 4.2 points at no extra cost. Taken together, our results show that diffusion's computational advantage depends on how much of the output is already determined, while its decoding effort offers a practical signal for making inference more efficient and reliable.

    中文

    扩散语言模型可以在一次前向传递中生成多个令牌，并在生成过程中决定需要执行多少次传递。因此，令牌长度相同的两个输出，其成本可能相差很大。为了解这种成本差异的影响因素，我们分析了两个扩散模型在 10 项任务上的表现。我们发现，每个令牌所需的前向传递次数很大程度上取决于任务。从输入中复制或略作编辑的文本成本低，而开放式写作成本高。在 DiffusionGemma 中，生成故事文本的一个令牌所需的前向传递次数，是语法纠正任务的三倍以上。两个输出属性可以解释这种差距的大部分：输出相对于输入有多少内容是新的，以及其中的词在该任务中有多罕见。涉及思考时，同样的规律也适用于单个回答内部。当最终答案重复模型的推理轨迹时，成本较低；当它添加新内容时，成本较高。在多语言生成中，我们发现，令牌化程度高的语言每个令牌也需要更多传递次数，这使其在令牌数量更多之外还要付出额外成本。最后，成本与正确性相关：对于同一道数学题，错误答案每个令牌所需的传递次数高于正确答案；按解码速度对候选答案加权，效果比多数投票最多高出 4.2 个百分点，且不增加成本。总的来说，我们的结果表明，扩散模型的计算优势取决于输出内容有多少已被确定，而其解码用力程度可以作为一种实用信号，使推理更高效、更可靠。

    Xinyi Wang, Danqi Chen

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper localizes RL reasoning failures through characteristic n-grams and uses them to retrieve targeted pretraining data, yielding consistent gains across several reasoning settings. This provides substantial evidence about failure signals and capability development, but the n-gram analysis does not establish internal mechanisms or representation structure.

    该论文通过特征性 n 元语法定位 RL 推理失败，并用这些语法检索有针对性的预训练数据，从而在多种推理设置中取得稳定提升。这为失败信号和能力发展提供了有力证据，但 n 元语法分析并未揭示内部机制或表征结构。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is widely used to improve reasoning in language models, yet growing evidence suggests that it mostly sharpens what the base model can already do. This raises a practical question: when RL fails, what is the base model missing? We look inside the RL policy's own rollouts and find that failures are localized: whether a rollout fails is strongly predicted by a small set of characteristic n-grams, ranging from reflection phrases such as "let's recheck" to specific operations such as "the inverse of A". These failures persist throughout RL training, although they are not beyond the model's reach: other sampled answers to the same question are often correct. Building on this observation, we use the failure $n$-grams to retrieve text from the pretraining corpus and continue pretraining the base model on it before RL. The resulting corpus has only 35M tokens, 3--4 orders of magnitude smaller than typical mid-training. We evaluate this approach on OLMo2 and Qwen3 models trained with RL on (1) GSM8K; (2) a mixture of math, commonsense, and knowledge questions; and (3) general math and science reasoning. Despite its size, the corpus yields consistent gains: our approach outperforms continued pretraining on the same amount of text sampled from the pretraining corpus across 10 out of 11 settings, including by $2.0$ points on GSM8K when inserted before mid-training. The retrieved text also transfers across model families: text retrieved for OLMo2-1B's failures improves Qwen3-4B on the mixture by $1.9$ points over the same baseline. Together, our results suggest that where RL fails is a cheap and effective signal for selecting pretraining data.

    可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）被广泛用于提升语言模型的推理能力，但越来越多的证据表明，它主要是在强化基础模型已有的能力。这引出了一个实际问题：强化学习失效时，基础模型缺少什么？我们检查 RL 策略自身生成的轨迹，发现失败具有局部性：轨迹是否失败，可以由少量特征性 n 元语法强烈预测，其范围从“我们再检查一下”等反思短语，到“ A 的逆”等特定运算。这些失败在 RL 训练过程中一直存在，但并非模型无法企及：对同一问题采样得到的其他答案往往是正确的。基于这一观察，我们利用失败$n$-gram 从预训练语料库中检索文本，并在 RL 之前用这些文本对基础模型继续预训练。所得语料库仅含 3500 万个 token，比典型的中期训练规模小 3—4 个数量级。我们在 OLMo2 和 Qwen3 模型上评估了这一方法；这些模型通过 RL 在以下任务上训练：(1) GSM8K；(2) 数学、常识和知识问题的混合数据；以及 (3) 通用数学与科学推理。尽管规模很小，该语料库仍带来了稳定收益：在 11 种设置中的 10 种设置下，我们的方法优于使用从预训练语料库中抽取的等量文本进行继续预训练；在中期训练之前插入该方法时，GSM8K 上的提升为 $2.0$ 分。检索到的文本还可迁移到不同模型系列：针对 OLMo2-1B 失败检索的文本，使 Qwen3-4B 在混合任务上的表现比相同基线高 $1.9$ 分。总的来说，我们的结果表明，RL 失效之处是一个成本低且有效的预训练数据筛选信号。

    Harrison Zhao, Lei Huang, Fei Liu, Wen Shi, Zijian Jin

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper measures gradient-signal redundancy in on-policy self-distillation and uses correctness filtering to reduce training compute while retaining reasoning-task performance. This directly advances reasoning training and has a substantial compute-efficiency contribution, while its gradient measurements are not an account of internal representations or mechanisms.

    本文测量了在线策略自蒸馏中的梯度信号冗余，并使用正确性筛选降低训练计算量，同时维持推理任务表现。这直接推进了推理训练，并在计算效率方面作出重要贡献；其梯度测量并未构成对内部表征或机制的解释。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) supervises student-generated trajectories with a reference-conditioned version of the same base model. We ask whether every trajectory supplies distinct supervision that warrants its distillation cost. Gradient measurements on Qwen3-1.7B at initialization reveal that correct and incorrect responses have similar individual gradient magnitudes, but incorrect responses have approximately three times the coherent gradient share. Their estimated population-mean directions also largely overlap. A signal--noise model fitted at a small group size tracks alignment at larger group sizes without refitting. Motivated by these measurements, we introduce correctness-filtered OPSD (C-OPSD), which generates one response per problem and distills only a subset of incorrect responses. Removing unselected rows before both distillation forwards avoids their teacher/student forward and student backward work. Across Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, and 8B on AIME24, AIME25, and HMMT25, C-OPSD achieves on-par performance with full OPSD. In a measured micro-batch-size-four implementation, executed rows decrease by approximately 68%, and with retained rows packed into full micro-batches, training takes about 40% less time while rollout generation remains unchanged. Together, the measurements and training results connect outcome-conditioned supervision redundancy to more compute-efficient distillation.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces rubric-structured reinforcement learning that recovers capability structure and routes capability-specific learning signals to improve training.     本文提出评分标准结构化强化学习，通过恢复能力结构并路由特定能力的学习信号来改进训练。这显著推进了推理能力发展；其能力结构与可复用组合有一定联系，但摘要没有描述模型内部机制或系统架构。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Rubrics are widely used to evaluate open-ended question answering by breaking overall quality into explicit criteria. These explicit criteria make rubrics a rich source of learning guidance, yet their potential for guiding the training process has been largely overlooked. Existing methods use rubrics mainly as direct feedback signals, without explicitly modeling the capabilities behind their criteria. This leaves their capability structure largely unused in guiding the training process. We introduce Rubric-Structured Reinforcement Learning (RSRL), an RL framework that unlocks the full potential of rubrics by exploiting their structure throughout the training process, rather than treating them simply as direct reward signals. At its core, RSRL builds on three key designs: (1) Rubric-to-Capability Structuring first recovers the capability structure hidden in rubric criteria, (2) Self-Sufficient Capability Learning then uses this structure to bootstrap underdeveloped capabilities into effective learning, (3) Capability-Residual Credit Routing finally preserves capability-specific gains during optimization. Experiments show that RSRL consistently improves both overall performance and underdeveloped capabilities, boosting downstream scientific question-answering performance by up to 7.43 over the initial policy and 7.60 over non-rubric structured RL baselines, showing that reinforcement learning can substantially benefit from the capability structure encoded in rubrics.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper studies implicit failures as signals for observing error recovery and propagation in multi-agent traces, and uses them in trace selection and an RL algorithm. This is a strong contribution to multi-agent process observability and organization, with a partial connection to training problem-solving behavior; error analysis alone does not reveal internal model representations.

    本文将隐式失败作为观测多智能体轨迹中错误恢复与传播的信号加以研究，并将其用于轨迹选择和一种 RL 算法。这对多智能体过程可观测性和组织方式作出了重要贡献，也与问题求解行为训练部分相关；仅靠错误分析无法揭示模型的内部表征。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Multi-agent systems (MAS) can complete a task despite local execution errors that are corrected, bypassed, or carried forward without individually determining its outcome. We call these implicit failures (IFs) and study them as signals for process observability beyond final task outcome. Across 1,828 traces from nine MAS-benchmark configurations, IFs occur in 54.3% of successful and 75.2% of failed traces. We develop taxonomies of error types and subsequent absorption mechanisms, supported by human and cross-model annotation audits. Counterfactual replay further probes how repairing an IF changes the final outcome. To examine the practical value of IFs, we evaluate IF-based best-of-N trace selection against existing process reward models, and introduce a novel RL algorithm, IF-GRPO, that uses IF costs to refine preferences among successful trajectories in GRPO. Experiments show that IF-GRPO exhibits some gains in accuracy and process metrics. Importantly, it exposes trade-offs between task performance, IF count and cost, and token-normalized IF density. Overall, our results show that IFs provide complementary process observability into how MAS reach their outcomes, including error recovery, propagation, and IF-based process differences that final task success alone does not expose.

    自我演进的智能体是持续学习者吗？

    Xiaoyin Chen, Yizheng Huang, Yinglun Xu, Ziyun Zhao, Emmett McQuinn, Julie Liu, Hope Yao

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper evaluates continual adaptation in self-evolving agents and identifies a stability–plasticity tradeoff, including how global edits and localized memory retrieval affect earlier and unseen tasks. This is a substantial contribution to agent memory and adaptation systems; connections to internal representations, compositional generalization, and reasoning are incidental to the evaluated task streams.

    本文评估了自我演进智能体的持续适应能力，并指出稳定性与可塑性之间存在权衡，包括全局编辑和局部记忆检索如何影响先前任务及未见任务。这对智能体记忆和适应系统作出了重要贡献；与内部表征、组合泛化和推理的联系只是评估所用任务流中的附带因素。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language model agents are often deployed in environments where new knowledge, tools, and workflows keep arriving. Such an agent is therefore expected to adapt continually, learning new tasks as they arrive without forgetting earlier ones. This resembles the continual learning problem, but at a pace that conventional gradient updates cannot sustain. Nonparametric self-evolving agents are a natural alternative: they adapt by rewriting their own harness, such as prompts, memory, and skills, from task feedback while the model weights stay frozen. We study whether such agents are effective continual learners across four drifting task streams that shift in topic, workflow, or domain (built from BIRD, BFCL, and ScienceWorld). Evaluating three representative methods spanning experience retrieval and self-modification (ReasoningBank, GEPA, and Meta-Harness), we find that although self-evolution improves aggregate performance on most streams, higher plasticity consistently comes at the cost of stability. Specifically, self-modifying methods apply global edits to a shared prompt or workspace, interfering with unseen tasks and overwriting earlier knowledge as the stream shifts. Conversely, similarity-based memory retrieval localizes updates across distant domains, but still retrieves foreign memories on unseen tasks and suffers from retrieval collision when similar queries require conflicting workflows. These findings show that current self-evolving agents remain incomplete continual learners.

    大型语言模型智能体常被部署在新知识、工具和工作流程不断涌现的环境中。因此，人们期望这类智能体能够持续适应，在学习新任务的同时不遗忘先前任务。这类似于持续学习问题，但其变化速度是传统梯度更新无法维持的。非参数化的自我演进智能体是一种自然的替代方案：模型权重保持冻结，智能体则根据任务反馈重写自身的运行框架，例如提示、记忆和技能，从而实现适应。我们研究这类智能体能否在四种不断变化的任务流中有效持续学习；这些任务流在主题、工作流程或领域上发生变化，由 BIRD、BFCL 和 ScienceWorld 构建而成。我们评估了涵盖经验检索和自我修改的三种代表性方法（ReasoningBank、GEPA 和 Meta-Harness），发现尽管自我演进能提升大多数任务流的总体表现，但更高的可塑性始终以牺牲稳定性为代价。具体而言，自我修改方法会对共享提示或工作区进行全局编辑；随着任务流变化，这会干扰未见任务，并覆盖先前知识。相比之下，基于相似度的记忆检索将更新分散到不同领域，但在未见任务上仍会检索无关记忆；当相似查询需要相互冲突的工作流程时，还会发生检索冲突。这些发现表明，当前的自我演进智能体仍未能实现完整的持续学习。

    The paper experimentally studies an adaptive rollout-support schedule for RL with verifiable rewards, finding a validation gain over fixed top-K=10 in three runs while noting noisy evidence.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Rollout decoding affects both which trajectories are used for reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) and how many completion tokens are spent collecting them. We study whether candidate-token support should remain fixed or widen during training in the context of rollout sampling efficiency. Our main schedule moves from top-K=10 to K=20 and then to full support as the attempted-token budget increases. In a 4B code-RLVR setting, the schedule has a higher interpolated 150M-token validation value than its matched fixed-K=10 continuation in all three runs, with a mean gain of $1.80{\pm}0.42$ points. The schedule also performs comparably to a separately trained fixed-K=20 baseline, the strongest fixed-support setting in our sweep. Follow-up experiments suggest that late widening to full support is the most promising variant, although the evidence remains noisy, and mixed-reward-group diagnostics do not clearly explain the gain. An exploratory single-run test replay yields identical point estimates for the schedule and fixed $K=10$. Overall, our results show that rollout support is an important control for sampling efficiency in RLVR and motivate further study of adaptive support schedules.

    Minimum-Cost Robust Evidence Certificates for Horn Reasoning under Correlated Source Failures

    相关来源失效下 Horn 推理的最小成本鲁棒证据证书

    Yukun Yang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops an exact, optimal method for selecting evidence certificates that preserve Horn conclusions under correlated source failures, with complexity results and a tractable restriction. Its core is formal rule-based inference, giving Reasoning a strong score; the use of combinations of evidence and proofs is relevant to composition but does not directly study compositional representations or generalization, while no model internals or agent systems are addressed.

    本文提出一种精确且最优的方法，用于选择证据证书，使其在相关来源失效时仍能保留 Horn 结论，并给出复杂度结果和一个可处理的限制条件。其核心是形式化的基于规则的推理，因此在推理方面贡献突出；证据和证明的组合与组合性相关，但本文没有直接研究组合表征或泛化，也没有涉及模型内部机制或智能体系统。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    A small justification for a rule-based conclusion may disappear when a source is withdrawn, and multiple derivations need not provide independent evidence. We study minimum-cost certificates that preserve a Horn conclusion under every withdrawal of at most k source domains. Evidence records remain distinct from asserted facts, supporting replicated attestations and overlapping failure dependencies. Transversals of minimal-support footprints characterize robustness and explain why disjoint-proof requirements can reject valid certificates. An exact procedure alternates weighted evidence selection with a source-failure oracle. A rule-closed counterinterpretation yields a globally valid selection cut without enumerating supports or failure scenarios. We prove correctness, finite termination, and cost optimality, establish coNP-completeness of unrestricted verification and NP-completeness of synthesis for every fixed budget, and identify a tractable reachability restriction. Experiments on controlled benchmarks, reachability graphs, and ontology-derived instances demonstrate that our counterinterpretation-guided synthesis achieves up to 92% optimum coverage within practical resource bounds, outperforming scenario expansion and general abduction while confirming the necessity of transversal-based reasoning over proof-packing heuristics.

    中文

    当某个来源被撤回时，对规则结论的一项简短论证可能随之消失；而多种推导也未必能提供相互独立的证据。我们研究最低成本证书，使其在最多 k 个来源域中的任意域被撤回时，仍能保留一个 Horn 结论。证据记录与断言事实保持区分，从而支持重复证明和相互重叠的失效依赖。最小支持集足迹的横截集刻画了鲁棒性，并解释了为何要求证明彼此不相交可能会排除有效证书。一个精确过程交替进行加权证据选择和来源失效预言机调用。规则闭合的反解释能够产生全局有效的选择割，而无需枚举支持集或失效情景。我们证明了正确性、有限终止性和成本最优性，确定了无约束验证的 coNP 完全性，以及每个固定预算下合成问题的 NP 完全性，并指出一种可处理的可达性限制。在受控基准、可达图和源自本体的实例上的实验表明，反解释引导的合成在实际资源限制内实现了最高达 92% 的最优覆盖率，优于情景展开和一般溯因，同时证实了基于横截集的推理相较于证明打包启发式的必要性。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    DeltaTrace provides a signed token-attribution method based on finite context masking and backward propagation, with local conservation and support for attention and linear-attention models. This is a substantial interpretability contribution, while reasoning is an evaluation domain rather than the central target; compositional generalization and system organization are not substantively addressed.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    We study how words in the context support or oppose a language model's response and present DeltaTrace, a novel attribution framework that explains the effect of input tokens on a fixed model response. DeltaTrace measures how the response's log-probability changes when the context tokens being explained are masked. To distribute this difference among source tokens, it constructs operator-specific local rules for finite changes and composes them backward through the computational graph using effective secant slopes. Each token is assigned a signed attribution as the inner product of its embedding displacement and the corresponding backward-propagated slope. Local conservation makes these contributions sum to the measured score difference and preserves their meaning when aggregated over sentences or passages. DeltaTrace supports both attention and linear-attention models, with auxiliary memory growing linearly with sequence length at fixed model dimensions and chunk size. On the evaluated attention model, DeltaTrace achieves the lowest deletion-faithfulness scores (RISE and MAS) on most retrieval and reasoning tasks and the highest needle-in-a-haystack Recall, exceeding FlashTrace by 5.67-24.33 percentage points. On the evaluated hybrid attention and linear-attention model, DeltaTrace lowers RISE on 9 tasks and MAS on 12 relative to FlashTrace.

    Xidong Wu, Qi Qi, Yuqiong Ji, Shangqian Gao

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces asynchronous self-distillation with staleness-aware training to improve throughput, reporting gains on mathematical reasoning benchmarks. Its main contribution advances training systems; reasoning is an evaluation context rather than a contribution to reasoning mechanisms.

    本文提出带有陈旧度感知训练的异步自蒸馏，以提升吞吐量，并报告了数学推理基准上的效果提升。其主要贡献推进了训练系统；推理只是评估情境，而非对推理机制的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Unlike on-policy distillation (OPD), which depends on a separate teacher model, on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) leverages a single language model acting simultaneously as the student and the teacher, with the teacher conditioned on privileged information. Despite this architectural simplicity, synchronous rollout generation dominates overall training time, creating a severe systems bottleneck when scaling OPSD. To address this, we introduce Asynchronous On-Policy Self-Distillation (AsyncOPSD), a framework that decouples rollout generation from learner updates to improve training throughput. Since the teacher and student share parameters, AsyncOPSD eliminates the multi-model coordination overhead inherent to OPD architectures in asynchronous training. As the student policy evolves, buffered trajectories generated by older policies become stale, potentially degrading performance. To mitigate this, we introduce a distillation objective based on staleness-aware policy control and token-level entropy weighting. Across three model sizes and mathematical reasoning benchmarks, AsyncOPSD improves the training throughput by $1.96$--$2.25\times$ over synchronous OPSD while increasing average benchmark accuracy.

    中文

    与依赖单独教师模型的在线策略蒸馏（OPD）不同，在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）利用单个语言模型同时充当学生和教师，其中教师以特权信息为条件。尽管这种架构简单，同步生成 rollout 仍占据总体训练时间的大部分，因此在扩展 OPSD 时会形成严重的系统瓶颈。为解决这一问题，我们提出异步在线策略自蒸馏（AsyncOPSD）框架，将 rollout 生成与学习器更新解耦，以提高训练吞吐量。由于教师和学生共享参数，AsyncOPSD 消除了异步训练中 OPD 架构固有的多模型协调开销。随着学生策略不断演进，由旧策略生成并缓冲的轨迹会逐渐过时，可能导致性能下降。为缓解这一问题，我们提出一种蒸馏目标，基于感知陈旧度的策略控制和 token 级熵加权。在三种模型规模和数学推理基准上，AsyncOPSD 相较于同步 OPSD 将训练吞吐量提高了 $1.96$--$2.25\times$，同时提升了基准平均准确率。

    SWE-Residual：评估编码智能体的初始状态鲁棒性

    Jinze Li, Weijie Liu, Jinfeng Xu, Shuo Yang, Xin Yang, Yang Zhang, Yijin Wang, Zifei Shan, Edith C.H. Ngai

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Introduces SWE-Residual to measure coding agents’ ability to continue from flawed prior work, finding substantial performance drops and acceptance bias. This is a strong agent-evaluation contribution, but it offers limited evidence about reasoning mechanisms or compositional generalization and none about internal representations.

    本文提出 SWE-Residual，用于衡量编码智能体从有缺陷的先前工作继续任务的能力，并发现其表现大幅下降且存在接受偏差。这是重要的智能体评估贡献，但关于推理机制或组合泛化的证据有限，也没有提供内部表征方面的证据。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Software engineering (SWE) benchmarks are the primary way to measure the capabilities of coding agents: an agent is placed in a code repository or machine environment, given a request, and judged by hidden tests. These benchmarks almost always start the agent from a clean state that contains no earlier work on the task. In practice, however, agents often continue work that a developer or another agent has already done and reported as complete, with no indication of what remains incorrect or missing. We introduce SWE-Residual, a benchmark for Starting-State Robustness: the ability to maintain performance on a task when the starting state already contains earlier work on that task. SWE-Residual contains 198 Residual States drawn from 111 tasks in DeepSWE and Terminal-Bench, where the earlier work modifies a code repository or a whole machine environment. Each Residual State is the state a predecessor agent left behind after submitting its work as complete, although the hidden tests still fail. The evaluated agent receives only the original request and this state, without the predecessor's trajectory or any sign that the attempt failed; because the request and hidden tests are unchanged, the starting state is the only difference from the source benchmark. Across five frontier agents, success drops by 20.6--53.5 percentage points on DeepSWE and 20.6--34.9 points on Terminal-Bench relative to a Clean Start, and agent rankings on DeepSWE reverse. Failed continuations show a pattern we call acceptance bias: agents treat the inherited work as the definition of what remains to be done instead of checking it against the request. On DeepSWE, in 58.9--88.2% of failed runs, they submit with exactly the same tests failing, although they pass most of these tests from a Clean Start. SWE-Residual thus exposes a capability gap that clean-start evaluation does not capture.

    中文

    软件工程（SWE）基准是衡量编码智能体能力的主要方式：将智能体置于代码仓库或机器环境中，给出请求，再通过隐藏测试进行评判。这些基准几乎总是让智能体从不包含该任务先前工作的干净状态开始。然而在实践中，智能体经常会接手开发者或其他智能体已经完成并报告为完成的工作，却不知道仍有哪些部分有误或缺失。我们提出 SWE-Residual，这是一个用于评估初始状态鲁棒性的基准：当任务的起始状态中已包含该任务的先前工作时，智能体维持任务表现的能力。SWE-Residual 包含来自 DeepSWE 和 Terminal-Bench 中 111 个任务的 198 个残留状态；这些先前工作修改了代码仓库或整个机器环境。每个残留状态都是前序智能体提交工作并报告完成后留下的状态，尽管隐藏测试仍然失败。受评估的智能体只收到原始请求和该状态，既看不到前序智能体的轨迹，也没有任何迹象表明先前尝试失败；由于请求和隐藏测试均未改变，起始状态是它与源基准之间唯一的差异。在五个前沿智能体中，相较于干净起始状态，DeepSWE 上的成功率下降了 20.6--53.5 个百分点，Terminal-Bench 上下降了 20.6--34.9 个百分点，而且 DeepSWE 上的智能体排名发生逆转。失败的续接任务呈现出一种我们称为接受偏差的模式：智能体把继承来的工作当作剩余任务的定义，而不是对照请求检查它。在 DeepSWE 上，58.9--88.2% 的失败运行中，智能体提交时失败的测试与起始时完全相同，尽管从干净起始状态出发时，它们能通过这些测试中的大多数。因此，SWE-Residual 揭示了干净起始状态评估无法捕捉到的能力差距。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Large reasoning models (LRMs) have achieved strong performance on challenging mathematical and scientific tasks through long chain-of-thought reasoning, but they often suffer from overthinking with unnecessary reasoning steps. Existing truncation-based methods typically detect consecutive trial-answer agreement and force early exit, yet such local stopping signals do not necessarily indicate final-answer stability and can disrupt useful subsequent reflection or verification, potentially leading to performance degradation. We propose consistency-aware logit masking (CALM), a training-free decoding intervention for mitigating overthinking in LRMs. CALM first monitors trial answers at step boundaries and then applies logit masking to action transition point (ATP) tokens such as "Wait", "Alternatively", and "Hmm", suppressing redundant transitional reasoning while allowing the model to continue its thought process more naturally. Experiments across four advanced LRMs and five benchmarks show that CALM reduces token consumption by 18.6%-25.0% compared with full CoT reasoning while maintaining performance, and can even improve accuracy by 0.07%-1.48% by reducing redundant reasoning. LLM-as-a-Judge results also demonstrate that CALM provides more coherent and concise results.

Based on this insight, we propose FisherEdit, a theoretically grounded method built on Fisher geometry, which replaces coarse activation-space projections with importance-aware regularization in parameter space.     In this work we focus on the problem of embodied task planning, which requires an agent to accomplish a complex task by separating it into atomic actions. Recent studies have developed LLM-based methods to address this problem. However, the executability and correctness of the generated plans remain suboptimal in complex environments and tasks. On the other hand, classical search algorithms have the potential to solve the planning problems perfectly, yet they require fully observable environments, known state transitions and goal state, which are often unattainable in general task domains. Therefore, we propose to implement an LLM-guided search algorithm that makes the search process possible and efficient by incorporating LLMs' commonsense knowledge. Our method leverages LLMs to (1) translate natural language instructions into formatted goal conditions, (2) facilitate efficient exploration in partially observable environments, (3) implement a rule-based world simulator, and (4) prune the space of candidate actions to improve search efficiency.     Minoo Ahmadi, Seyedarmin Azizi, Mehdi Kamal, Massoud Pedram

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces lineage-preserving resampling for diffusion LLM inference, improving diversity and accuracy in mathematical reasoning and code generation. This is a substantial algorithmic contribution to inference-time reasoning search, while the population and resampling design has a more limited connection to model systems and does not study internal representations or compositional generalization.

    本文提出一种用于扩散 LLM 推理的谱系保留重采样方法，提高了数学推理和代码生成中的多样性与准确率。这是对推理时推理搜索的重要算法贡献；总体和重采样设计与模型系统的关联较有限，且没有研究内部表征或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Inference-time sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) decoding can improve the reasoning accuracy of masked diffusion language models (diffusion LLMs) without post-training by resampling a population of partial generations according to a reward. Its effectiveness therefore depends on the resampling step, which must concentrate computation on promising candidates while retaining enough diversity to explore alternative reasoning paths. The reward can be internal, the decoder's own confidence on the committed prefix, or external, a process reward model scoring that prefix. Under either reward, multinomial resampling can disrupt this balance by duplicating high-weight particles and discarding lineages that may still reach a correct solution. The effective sample size (ESS) does not register this loss: multinomial resampling resets it to its maximum even as distinct lineages disappear. To retain such lineages, we introduce lineage-preserving SMC (LP-SMC), which combines Chopthin resampling with an input weight floor. Instead of equalizing weights, Chopthin bounds the ratio between the largest and smallest weights it returns and carries the unequal weights forward. The floor limits how far below the maximum a weight may fall before resampling so that lineages with low early weight keep a chance to recover. Across mathematical-reasoning and code-generation benchmarks on two base models, LP-SMC raises oracle coverage, the fraction of problems with at least one correct particle, in every setting, by 1.8 to 25.6 points, and raises end-to-end accuracy under a common reward-model selector in eleven of twelve settings, by up to 7.9 points on LLaDA-1.5 and 18.3 on Dream-7B. The coverage gain persists under the external reward model, which suggests that diversity-preserving resampling and the guidance signal contribute separately to inference-time search.

    推理时序贯蒙特卡洛（SMC）解码可以根据奖励对部分生成结果构成的总体进行重采样，从而在无需后训练的情况下提高掩码扩散语言模型（扩散 LLM）的推理准确率。因此，其效果取决于重采样步骤：该步骤必须将计算集中在有希望的候选项上，同时保留足够多样性，以探索其他推理路径。奖励可以是内部的，即解码器对已确定前缀自身的置信度；也可以是外部的，即过程奖励模型对该前缀的评分。在任一奖励下，多项式重采样都可能打破这种平衡，因为它会复制高权重粒子，并丢弃仍有可能得出正确解的谱系。有效样本量（ESS）无法反映这种损失：即使不同谱系正在消失，多项式重采样仍会将 ESS 重置到最大值。为保留这些谱系，我们提出谱系保留 SMC（LP-SMC），将 Chopthin 重采样与输入权重下限相结合。Chopthin 不会将权重均等化，而是限制其返回的最大权重与最小权重之比，并将不等权重继续传递。该下限限制了重采样前权重能够低于最大值的幅度，使早期权重较低的谱系仍有机会恢复。在两个基础模型上的数学推理和代码生成基准中，LP-SMC 在所有设置下都提高了预言机覆盖率（即至少有一个正确粒子的问题所占比例），提升幅度为 1.8 至 25.6 个百分点；在十二种设置中的十一种设置下，它还提高了使用通用奖励模型选择器时的端到端准确率，在 LLaDA-1.5 上最多提高 7.9 个百分点，在 Dream-7B 上最多提高 18.3 个百分点。使用外部奖励模型时，覆盖率提升仍然存在；这表明保多样性的重采样与引导信号分别对推理时搜索有所贡献。

    Moritz Wagner, Christophe Roux, Max Zimmer, Sebastian Pokutta

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops a compensation-aware algorithm for jointly compacting KV caches, using a quadratic surrogate to account for attention interactions, and reports better cost–accuracy tradeoffs. This advances model computation and memory efficiency; attention interactions alone do not amount to a study of internal representations, composition, or reasoning mechanisms.

    本文提出一种具备补偿感知能力的算法，用于联合压缩 KV 缓存，并通过二次代理目标考虑注意力交互；结果显示其实现了更优的成本—准确率权衡。这提升了模型的计算和内存效率；仅研究注意力交互并不等同于研究内部表征、组合或推理机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Offline compaction of the key--value cache (KV-cache) reduces the cost of repeatedly querying a fixed context by constructing a smaller cache once and reusing it subsequently. The central challenge of compaction is deciding which cache entries to delete and which to retain. Existing methods score each candidate for deletion on its own, with the rest of the cache being held fixed. However, softmax renormalization of the attention operation couples these decisions in a nonlinear manner: removing one entry changes the attention weights of every remaining one. In this work, we introduce KV-Surgeon, which uses calibration data to take interactions into account in a tractable way. We derive a quadratic surrogate that admits closed-form expressions for jointly making the optimal greedy removal decision as well as compensation within the remaining entries. On QuALITY, LongHealth, and Long Code Arena, and at every evaluated compaction ratio, KV-Surgeon substantially advances the cost--accuracy Pareto frontier of dense and mixture-of-experts models from 4B to 30B parameters. At $50\times$ compaction, KV-Surgeon improves question-answering accuracy by up to four points over attention matching (Zweiger et al., 2026), the state of the art, at comparable cost. Lastly, we introduce an even faster variant, which also exceeds the state of the art while requiring only two fifths of its cost.

    中文

    离线压缩键值缓存（KV-cache）通过一次性构建更小的缓存并在后续重复使用，降低反复查询固定上下文的成本。压缩的核心挑战在于决定删除哪些缓存条目、保留哪些条目。现有方法会在其余缓存保持固定的情况下，单独为每个待删除候选项评分。然而，注意力操作中的 softmax 重新归一化以非线性方式耦合了这些决策：删除一个条目会改变所有剩余条目的注意力权重。在本工作中，我们提出 KV-Surgeon，利用校准数据以可行的方式考虑这些交互。我们推导出一个二次代理目标，它具有闭式表达式，可用于联合作出最优的贪心删除决策，并对剩余条目进行补偿。在 QuALITY、LongHealth 和 Long Code Arena 上，以及在每个评估的压缩率下，KV-Surgeon 都显著推进了参数规模从 4B 到 30B 的稠密模型和混合专家模型的成本—准确率帕累托前沿。在 $50\times$ 的压缩率下，与当前最先进方法 attention matching（Zweiger et al., 2026）相比，KV-Surgeon 在成本相当的情况下将问答准确率最多提高了四个百分点。最后，我们提出了一个速度更快的变体；该变体同样超越了当前最先进方法，且成本仅为其五分之二。

    Rui Wang, Zishen Lai, Jiayu Liu, Cheng Qian, Jeonghwan Kim, Heng Wang, Xuejun Zhang, Jiateng Liu, Bingxuan Li, Shujin Wu, Qing Zong, Tianshi Zheng, Chunyang Li, Qihan Lin, Chen Li, Dadi Guo, Xiusi Chen, Yangqiu Song

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    AdaExploreBench tests whether agents can acquire evidence, infer hidden rules, detect rule drift, and re-explore, exposing a substantive limitation in reasoning and agent adaptation. Its benchmark provides partial evidence about compositional rule transfer, but does not analyze internal mechanisms or introduce a new agent-system architecture.

    AdaExploreBench 测试智能体能否获取证据、推断隐藏规则、检测规则漂移并重新探索，揭示了推理和智能体适应能力方面的实质性局限。该基准为组合规则迁移能力提供了一定证据，但没有分析内部机制，也没有提出新的智能体系统架构。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large Language Model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in unfamiliar and evolving environments, requiring them to proactively explore, understand, and adapt to environmental dynamics. However, existing benchmarks rarely test whether agents can proactively discover how an environment works and adapt as it evolves. To address this gap, we introduce AdaExploreBench, a benchmark for proactive exploration and test-time adaptation in evolving environments. By instantiating environmental dynamics as hidden rules, AdaExploreBench requires agents to actively acquire evidence and infer the rules. Under implicit rule drift, the latent rule changes without announcement, requiring agents to detect from degraded performance that prior knowledge is stale and re-explore. Experiments on eight leading LLMs show that proactive and adaptive exploration remain challenging: GPT-6 Sol achieves only 61.9% calibrated accuracy, while providing sufficient evidence or removing rule drift improves average performance significantly by close to 10%. These results reveal a critical bottleneck in current LLM agents: they can often reason effectively from informative evidence once it is available, but struggle to actively acquire the right evidence and recognize when previously acquired evidence is no longer valid.

Its observation about state-representation mismatch is motivational, with no stated mechanistic analysis of model representations.

    ENGLISH

    Reinforcement Learning (RL) for Large Language Model (LLM) agents in multi-turn, long-horizon environments remains challenging due to inefficient action selection and repetitive behavioral patterns. In particular, agents often become trapped in high-confidence yet unproductive behaviors, repeatedly executing invalid actions or entering action loops that hinder task completion. We observe that these frequently violate environment preconditions, revealing a mismatch between the agent's representation of the internal state and the dynamics of the underlying environment. In addition, repetitive high-confidence actions lead to cyclical behaviors that provide little to no progress towards the goal. We argue that addressing these challenges requires more productive task-aligned exploration to improve the agent's understanding of environment dynamics. Motivated by intrinsic curiosity-driven exploration, we propose a conditional state-space exploration framework that balances task completion with intrinsic information-seeking behavior. Specifically, we introduce an intrinsic reward that penalizes actions whose observation duplicates prior state memory. This provides the benefit of reducing redundant behaviors and encouraging state-space coverage without relying on a general information-theoretic measure. Strong experimental results demonstrate that our approach substantially improves policy learning in multi-turn environments, mitigating invalid actions and repetitive loops.

    Most existing approaches to LLM swarm optimization are utility-driven, focusing on final task utility while leaving the processing, integration, and reliance of information within individual interactions largely implicit. To address this, we study LLM swarm interactions from an information-flow-based view and introduce behavioral probes to quantify information flow patterns. Specifically, we repurpose External Context Score (ECS) and Parametric Knowledge Score (PKS)---originally designed for hallucination analysis---to measure a node's external-context dependence and parametric-knowledge dependence, respectively. Across controlled and realistic swarm settings, we observe consistent patterns: ECS increases with input relevance and distinguishes useful multi-source contributions, while PKS decreases as informative context accumulates. Building on this heuristic interpretation, we demonstrate how these probes can complement utility-driven structure optimization in two controlled applications. Probe-guided node pruning reduces redundant communication and token consumption, and probe-guided reasoning-path search accelerates convergence compared to utility-only baselines. Our empirical results suggest that behavioral probes can make the internal information flow of LLM swarms observable and serve as effective auxiliary signals for structure optimization.

    GLOBE uses semantic trajectory geometry to detect when chain-of-thought generation can stop, reducing tokens and latency while maintaining task performance. This is a substantial algorithmic contribution to reasoning efficiency and serving computation, but the geometric signal is used for early exit rather than to explain internal representations, and the abstract does not address composition.

    GLOBE 使用语义轨迹几何来判断何时可以停止思维链生成，在维持任务表现的同时减少 token 数和延迟。这是对推理效率和服务计算作出的实质性算法贡献，但几何信号用于早停，而非解释内部表征；摘要也未涉及组合。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning can improve problem solving, but models often keep generating after the correct answer is already reachable; the extra steps raise serving costs and may replace a correct intermediate result with an incorrect one. We propose GLOBE (Geometry-Led Online Behavioral Early Exit), an online, training-free algorithm that terminates the model's CoT process early. GLOBE embeds each completed reasoning segment as a point on a unit sphere and reads the shape of the resulting semantic trajectory. GLOBE first applies a trial phase that generates short trial answers in a separate branch, stopping the main stream on an accepted trial after checking confidence against a threshold. If generation continues, a trajectory phase stops the stream once this path repeatedly reverses direction with little net progress. On five benchmarks including mathematical reasoning, tool calling, and agent memory, GLOBE cuts output tokens by 49.7% and active end-to-end wall time (E2E) by 51.0% across two models, and achieves a five-task average of 80.58%, comparable to Full CoT.

    思维链（CoT）推理能够提升问题求解能力，但模型往往在正确答案已经触手可及后仍继续生成；额外步骤会增加服务成本，也可能用错误结果取代正确的中间结果。我们提出 GLOBE（几何引导的在线行为早停），这是一种在线、无需训练的算法，可提前终止模型的 CoT 过程。GLOBE 将每个已完成的推理片段嵌入为单位球面上的一个点，并读取由此形成的语义轨迹形状。GLOBE 首先进入试探阶段，在单独分支中生成简短的试探答案，并在将其置信度与阈值比较后，于试探答案获接纳时停止主流生成。如果生成继续，轨迹阶段会在路径反复改变方向、但总体进展很小的时候停止生成。在包括数学推理、工具调用和智能体记忆在内的五个基准测试上，GLOBE 在两个模型中将输出 token 减少了 49.7%，将端到端（E2E）活跃墙钟时间缩短了 51.0%，并在五项任务上取得 80.58% 的平均成绩，与完整 CoT 相当。

    APSD uses correctness-dependent self-distillation targets to improve reinforcement-learning post-training, with divergence and gradient analyses and fewer training steps at comparable performance.     ENGLISH

    Self-distillation policy optimization provides dense token-level supervision for LLM post-training through feedback-conditioned self-teachers. However, directly matching the self-teacher can disrupt successful behaviors on correct rollouts while providing insufficient correction on incorrect ones. We propose Asymmetric Policy Optimization via Self-Distillation (APSD), which constructs correctness-dependent targets by mixing student and self-teacher distributions: interpolation preserves successful behaviors on correct rollouts, while extrapolation beyond the self-teacher strengthens correction on incorrect ones. We analyze APSD through divergence decomposition, reverse-KL barycentric geometry, and gradient analysis, highlighting the importance of gradient flow through student-dependent targets. Experiments under reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards and rich feedback show that APSD achieves strong overall performance against reinforcement-learning and self-distillation baselines and matches SDPO performance with 2.6x fewer training steps on average across Qwen3 model scales.

    自蒸馏策略优化通过受反馈条件约束的自教师，为 LLM 后训练提供密集的 token 级监督。然而，直接匹配自教师可能破坏正确轨迹中的成功行为，同时对错误轨迹的纠正又可能不足。我们提出自蒸馏非对称策略优化（APSD），通过混合学生和自教师分布来构造依赖正确性的目标：插值可保留正确轨迹中的成功行为，而超出自教师分布的外推则能加强对错误轨迹的纠正。我们通过散度分解、反向 KL 重心几何和梯度分析来分析 APSD，并强调梯度经由依赖学生的目标流动的重要性。在具有可验证奖励和丰富反馈的强化学习实验中，APSD 相较于强化学习和自蒸馏基线取得了整体较强的表现；在不同 Qwen3 模型规模上，平均而言，它以少 2.6 倍的训练步数达到与 SDPO 相当的表现。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper adds graph structure and convergence signals to self-reflective multi-hop reasoning, with bounded revision and stopping decisions. Graph composition is relevant context, but the abstract does not establish a broader contribution to compositional generalization or model systems.

    这篇论文将图结构和收敛信号引入自反思多跳推理，并据此作出有界的修订和停止决策。图组合是相关背景，但摘要并未证明其对更广泛的组合式泛化或模型系统作出了贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Multi-hop question answering (QA) requires models to chain intermediate conclusions while remaining cost-aware. Existing training-free self-reflective protocols (generate -> critique -> revise) improve accuracy but operate on a flat token stream: revisions cannot identify which prior step is unreliable, and early stopping cannot exploit structural convergence. We introduce GraphEvoResearcher, a training-free protocol that lifts EvoResearcher's self-reflective meta-reward onto an explicit reasoning graph - nodes are intermediate conclusions/evidence and edges encode support, contradict, and depends_on. A graph-aware meta-reward combines correctness, efficiency, reflection, diversity, and four structural signals (connectivity, acyclicity, branch coverage, path convergence) to decide whether to revise, backtrack, or stop. A graph-convergence early-stop terminates when evidence branches converge on a single conclusion. On a real LLM (DeepSeek), over GSM8K, MATH, and BBH (n=50 each), GraphEvoResearcher reaches 98%, 92%, and 82% respectively, the highest of all baselines, with the largest gains on the hardest set (MATH: +24 pp over single-shot, +12 pp over flat reflection), while keeping construction cost bounded at ~2 steps / 4.5-5 nodes. Our results indicate the structural signal of a reasoning graph is most valuable exactly where single-step reasoning is unreliable.

    中文

    多跳问答（QA）要求模型串联中间结论，同时考虑成本。现有无需训练的自反思流程（生成 -> 批评 -> 修订）能够提高准确率，但它们处理的是扁平 token 流：修订时无法识别先前哪一步不可靠，早停也无法利用结构收敛信息。我们提出 GraphEvoResearcher，这是一种无需训练的流程，它将 EvoResearcher 的自反思元奖励提升到显式推理图上：节点表示中间结论或证据，边表示支持、矛盾和依赖关系。图感知元奖励结合正确性、效率、反思、多样性以及四种结构信号（连通性、无环性、分支覆盖率、路径收敛），以决定修订、回溯还是停止。当证据分支汇聚到单一结论时，图收敛早停机制会终止推理。在真实 LLM（DeepSeek）上，针对 GSM8K、MATH 和 BBH（每项 n=50），GraphEvoResearcher 分别达到 98%、92% 和 82%，在所有基线中最高；它在最难的数据集上提升最大（MATH：比单次回答高 +24 pp，比扁平反思高 +12 pp），同时将构建成本限制在约 2 步 / 4.5-5 个节点。我们的结果表明，推理图的结构信号恰恰在单步推理不可靠的情况下最有价值。

    Yicheng Wang, Wentao Tan, Yidan Huang, Yifei Liu, Qiong Cao

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    ClueFlow uses attributed research-state transitions to guide supervision and credit assignment for long-horizon search, advancing both reasoning training and agent task execution. Explicit state updates and evidence chains touch composition and memory, but the abstract does not show these as central contributions.

    ClueFlow 使用带归因的研究状态转移来指导长时程搜索的监督和信用分配，推进了推理训练和智能体任务执行。明确的状态更新和证据链涉及组合与记忆，但摘要并未表明这些是其核心贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Long-horizon search requires agents to acquire relevant evidence and integrate it into an evolving research state. Existing methods maintain research states to guide exploration or assign turn-level progress signals, yet grounding these signals in explicit, attributable state changes remains underexplored. We introduce ClueFlow, which learns long-horizon search from attributed research-state transitions. ClueFlow constructs Source-State-Final attribution chains that connect evidence-acquiring browser actions, Evidence and Candidate updates, and the final answer supported by those updates. During search, ClueFlow records typed state changes and potentially supporting browser actions, then applies gold-conditioned semantic validation and source tracing after execution. We use this attribution to guide both supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning. During SFT, attribution selects which decisions receive supervision with their original interaction contexts. During Turn-PPO, the same attribution augments outcome-based turn advantages with credit assigned along the Source-State-Final chains. Transition-level validation also recovers useful supervision from gold-consistent state changes in trajectories with incorrect final answers. We evaluate ClueFlow across two Qwen backbones and four search benchmarks spanning live-web and fixed-corpus settings, observing consistent gains from SFT and further improvements from PPO. With Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, ClueFlow achieves 60.0% accuracy on BrowseComp and 72.0% on BrowseComp-Plus. In controlled BrowseComp-Plus experiments, attribution-guided SFT matches all-turn exact-context SFT using about 30% of the training tokens, while attribution-guided PPO outperforms outcome-only PPO by 4.1 pp. These results demonstrate that state-transition attribution enables efficient supervision and effective credit assignment for long-horizon search agents.

    中文

    长时程搜索要求智能体获取相关证据，并将其整合进不断演进的研究状态中。现有方法会维护研究状态以引导探索，或分配轮级进度信号，但如何将这些信号建立在明确且可追溯的状态变化之上，仍未得到充分探索。我们提出 ClueFlow，通过带属性的研究状态转移来学习长时程搜索。ClueFlow 构建 Source-State-Final 归因链，连接用于获取证据的浏览器操作、Evidence 和 Candidate 更新，以及由这些更新支持的最终答案。搜索期间，ClueFlow 记录带类型的状态变化以及可能提供支持的浏览器操作，并在执行后进行以标准答案为条件的语义验证和来源追踪。我们利用这种归因来指导监督微调和强化学习。在 SFT 期间，归因会选择哪些决策应当结合其原始交互上下文接受监督。在 Turn-PPO 期间，同一归因会扩充基于结果的轮级优势，并沿 Source-State-Final 链分配信用。转移级验证还能够从最终答案错误的轨迹中，挖掘与标准答案一致的状态变化所提供的有用监督。我们在两个 Qwen 主干模型和四个涵盖实时网络与固定语料库场景的搜索基准上评估 ClueFlow，观察到 SFT 持续带来提升，PPO 则进一步改善表现。使用 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 时，ClueFlow 在 BrowseComp 和 BrowseComp-Plus 上分别达到 60.0% 和 72.0% 的准确率。在受控的 BrowseComp-Plus 实验中，归因引导的 SFT 使用约 30% 的训练 token，便达到与全轮次精确上下文 SFT 相当的表现；归因引导的 PPO 则比仅基于结果的 PPO 高 4.1 pp。这些结果表明，状态转移归因能为长时程搜索智能体实现高效监督和有效的信用分配。

    NIOCIS：面向工具使用智能体的类型化决策下一跳路由与节点条件选项空间

    Jin Han, Mingfeng Xin, Feng Liang, Jingtao Yu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    NIOCIS routes recurring agent decisions through typed, node-conditioned action options, with empirical analysis of accuracy, limits, and cost. Its main contribution advances agent execution and routing; using action graphs and logs does not establish compositional generalization or reasoning mechanisms.

    NIOCIS 通过类型化的节点条件动作选项，为重复出现的智能体决策进行路由，并实证分析其准确率、局限和成本。其主要贡献在于推进智能体执行和路由；使用动作图和日志并不能证明其实现了组合式泛化或揭示了推理机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Tool-use agents pay per decision: at each hop a language model re-reads the state and thinks for seconds, though its actions are finite and decisions recur. We present NIOCIS, a routing layer that folds execution logs into a loop-collapsed action graph (forward transitions plus recovery back-edges) answering one typed question: which declared option at a state, plus stop, does the fleet take next? A small model reads a calibrated distribution over them in one pass, emitting no text. On 1,615 production security-operations episodes we measure what the layer replaces, returns and is bounded by. Replaces: the typed encoder matches the logged next hop on 32.2% of the 3,875 held-out decisions (34.9% within the declared options) in 10 ms of encoder time (19.5 ms for the typed-choice form), against 2.2 s per LLM hop; two feature readouts reach 32.8% and 32.3%, an ordering the paired test does not resolve, so the typed layer is chosen for cost, not a separated lead. Tuning: jpt-4b reaches 9.9% zero-shot and 31.9% fine-tuned, a gap an exact paired test does not resolve (p=0.68), at 244 ms. Returns little: the realised hop falls outside the declared options for 7.9% of decisions and outside the model's top twenty for 9.3%; the most confident 15% holds 91.9% accuracy. Bounded: a cross-trace leave-one-out test puts the released state's ceiling at 25.6--44.9% as the state key grows more specific, i.e. repeated states disagree more often than they agree; the option-space ablation attributes the gain to per-node candidate restriction (+3.5 points over a flat catalog) rather than graph traversal (zero within its interval); a gated self-evolution loop lifts every arm above its anchor yet ends below full supervision; a confidence-gated cascade loses agreement when the escalation arm is the zero-shot stand-in; and agreement past a third of the fleet needs a state carrying the plan and the observation.

    中文

    工具使用智能体需要为每次决策付出成本：每一跳都要由语言模型重新读取状态并思考数秒，尽管其动作集合有限且决策会重复出现。我们提出 NIOCIS，这是一种路由层，它将执行日志折叠成循环折叠动作图（前向转移加恢复用的反向边），以回答一个类型化问题：在某个状态下，整个智能体集群接下来会采取哪个已声明选项（包括停止）？一个小型模型只需一次前向计算即可读取这些选项上的校准分布，不生成任何文本。我们在 1,615 个生产环境安全运营事件上衡量该层取代了什么、返回了什么，以及受到哪些边界限制。取代方面：类型化编码器在 3,875 个留出决策中，有 32.2% 与日志记录的下一跳相匹配（在已声明选项范围内为 34.9%）；编码器耗时为 10 ms（类型化选择形式为 19.5 ms），而 LLM 每跳耗时为 2.2 s。两种特征读取方式分别达到 32.8% 和 32.3%；配对检验无法确定二者的排序，因此选择类型化层是出于成本考虑，而非它显著领先。调优方面：jpt-4b 的零样本表现为 9.9%，微调后为 31.9%；精确配对检验无法确定两者差异（p=0.68），耗时为 244 ms。收益有限方面：实际执行的下一跳在 7.9% 的决策中不属于已声明选项，在 9.3% 的决策中不属于模型排名前二十的选项；置信度最高的 15% 决策准确率为 91.9%。边界方面：跨轨迹留一测试表明，随着状态键变得更具体，发布状态的准确率上限为 25.6--44.9%；也就是说，重复状态意见不一致的情况比一致的情况更常见。选项空间消融将收益归因于按节点限制候选项（相比平面目录提升 +3.5 个百分点），而非图遍历（在其区间内为零）；带门控的自进化循环使每个实验组都高于其基准点，却仍低于完全监督；当升级分支采用零样本替代方案时，置信度门控级联的一致性会下降；若要让一致率超过整个智能体集群的三分之一，状态必须同时包含计划和观测。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops and evaluates a mixture-of-experts router that selects among specialized MAPF policies based on local situations. This is a substantive contribution to conditional computation in multi-agent systems, while pathfinding and policy fusion alone provide limited evidence about compositional generalization or reasoning mechanisms.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Designing capable neural policies for multi-agent pathfinding (MAPF), which map local observations to action distributions, represents an important challenge in multi-agent learning, with practical relevance to scalable collective automation problems such as warehouse logistics. In contrast to prior studies focusing primarily on individual policy design, this study explores a meta-level Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) approach to learning-based MAPF. Specifically, given a collection of compact yet high-performing experts specialised for different map distributions, our architecture learns a router that selectively fuses their outputs according to each agent's local situation. We instantiate and validate this MoE approach with a commonly used graph neural network-based policy as well as a newly developed recursive action-token refinement model. Combined with supervised and reinforcement learning fine-tuning of the experts, our experiments show that MoE generally improves upon the pretrained policy and outperforms existing leading methods. At the same time, our findings reveal that appropriately trained, parameter-matched monolithic models still outperform MoE, highlighting a nuanced role for map-distribution MoE for MAPF.

    Graph-to-table systems combine three design choices: an encoder that maps relational evidence to feature rows, a context constructor that selects labelled examples, and a tabular decoder. Across logistic regression, CATBOOST, and TABPFN-3 on CLUTRR, 57 GraphLog worlds, and 57 knowledge graphs, we show that conclusions about one component can change when the others change. Across different knowledge graphs, adding the frozen ULTRA score to local features is consistently useful, whereas adding local features to the score has a smaller and less stable effect. These results show that encoder assessment depends jointly on context and decoder, while panel-level conclusions can also depend on evaluation and aggregation protocols.

    The paper constructs looped transformers that simulate Turing machines with reduced context and token resources, directly advancing theoretical computational reasoning. Recurrence in hidden states is an architectural mechanism, but the abstract does not analyze learned internal representations or systems such as memory or agents.

    本文构造了能够模拟图灵机、同时减少上下文和 token 资源消耗的循环 Transformer，直接推进了理论计算推理。隐藏状态中的递归是一种架构机制，但摘要没有分析学习到的内部表征，也没有研究记忆或智能体等系统。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Chain-of-thought (CoT) enables constant-bit-size transformers to perform general-purpose computation through generated tokens (Li and Wang, 2025a), whereas looped transformers carry out the same computation by recurrence in hidden states (latent thought). We construct a family of constant-bit-size looped transformers that interpolates between CoT and latent thought. For a prescribed loop count $L=L(n)$ and a fixed integer $k\ge1$ satisfying $s(n)^{1/k}=\Omega(L)$, our transformer simulates a time-$t(n)$, space-$s(n)$ Turing machine using a context window of $O(s(n)/L)$ and $O(t(n)s(n)^{1/k}/L)$ generated tokens, reducing both resources by a factor of $L$ relative to the corresponding unlooped queue-machine simulation. The construction also holds with softmax attention at constant bit-size, under the finite-precision kernel specified in this paper.

    TempoMoE：识别并引导快慢思维专家以实现高效多模态推理

    Xiyue Zhang, Keru Zhou, Ziyi Wang, Bing Hu, Li Wang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper uses tempo-dependent routing shifts and expert suppression as causal evidence about mechanisms controlling reasoning depth, then applies that insight to adapt reasoning effort by difficulty. This substantially connects to expert computation and reasoning, while it does not address compositional generalization.

    本文将依赖推理节奏的路由变化和专家抑制作为因果证据，揭示控制推理深度的机制，并据此根据难度调整推理投入。这与专家计算和推理高度相关，但没有涉及组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Multimodal Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) reasoning models rely on long chain-of-thought (CoT) for complex tasks, yet often overthink easy inputs, increasing token cost and latency, and sometimes degrading accuracy. Existing methods optimize reasoning length during training or impose external control at inference, but leave the underlying reasoning mechanism a black box. We find that fast and slow thinking exhibit distinct expert-routing patterns: holding the input fixed and varying only the prompted reasoning tempo produces stable routing shifts. Suppressing slow-thinking experts shortens the reasoning chain, whereas suppressing fast-thinking experts lengthens it, providing causal evidence that these experts influence reasoning depth. Based on this finding, we propose TempoMoE, a training-free, two-stage framework. It identifies fast- and slow-thinking experts via tempo-contrastive routing analysis and redistributes routing weights within the original top-k set according to sample difficulty. It amplifies fast-thinking experts and suppresses slow-thinking experts on easy inputs and reverses this adjustment on hard ones, enabling difficulty-adaptive control over reasoning depth. We evaluate TempoMoE on Kimi-VL, Qwen3-VL, and ERNIE-4.5-VL across six benchmarks. Compared with Vanilla, TempoMoE consistently improves accuracy while reducing output tokens, with accuracy gains of up to 2.6 points and token reductions of up to 35.4%.

    多模态混合专家（MoE）推理模型依赖较长的思维链（CoT）来处理复杂任务，但面对简单输入时常会过度思考，增加 token 成本和延迟，有时还会降低准确率。现有方法会在训练期间优化推理长度，或在推理时施加外部控制，但底层推理机制仍是黑箱。我们发现，快思考和慢思考呈现出不同的专家路由模式：固定输入、仅改变提示的推理节奏，就会产生稳定的路由变化。抑制慢思维专家会缩短推理链，而抑制快思维专家则会延长推理链，这为这些专家会影响推理深度提供了因果证据。基于这一发现，我们提出无需训练的两阶段框架 TempoMoE。它通过节奏对比路由分析识别快思维和慢思维专家，并根据样本难度在原有的 top-k 集合内重新分配路由权重。面对简单输入时，它增强快思维专家并抑制慢思维专家；面对困难输入时则反向调整，从而能够根据难度控制推理深度。我们在六个基准上使用 Kimi-VL、Qwen3-VL 和 ERNIE-4.5-VL 评估 TempoMoE。与 Vanilla 相比，TempoMoE 始终提升准确率并减少输出 token，准确率最高提升 2.6 个百分点，token 数最高减少 35.4%。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    TimesJev develops a compressed time-series representation and a sufficiency-based objective to enable fast System 1 prediction, with improved performance and lower inference time. This substantially addresses reasoning capability and computational efficiency, while its gating and compression are not evidence of a broader systems contribution; the abstract does not study internal representations or compositional generalization.

    TimesJev 构建压缩的时间序列表示和基于充分性的目标，以实现快速的系统 1 预测，并提升性能、降低推理时间。这项工作实质性地解决了推理能力和计算效率问题，但其门控与压缩并不能体现更广泛的系统贡献；摘要也没有研究内部表征或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language models (LLMs) have recently shown strong potential for time series reasoning, while models that reason over time series are usually with long chains of thought. However, this process often consumes thousands of tokens, directly leading to substantial latency during inference. In contrast, System 1 models such as Jev make decisions instantly and can naturally be an alternative, but raw time series are not compatible with the embedding space of these models, thus hindering the reasoning performance, especially when input series contain thousands of numeric points. In this paper, we make a very early attempt to propose a time series System 1 model, namely TimesJev. Specifically, we first formalize System 1 sufficiency in time series reasoning, which motivates a compressed representation for time series with key frequency patterns preserved. To construct this representation, we derive a dimension reduction objective that combines (i) a sufficiency divergence that measures the core information lost during compression, and (ii) a realizability divergence that quantifies the incompatibility of the System 1 model to the optimal prediction given this representation. We optimize this objective by learning time series compression with a gating mechanism for sufficiency, and then aligning the selected representation with the embedding space for realizability. Finally, experiments on 13 datasets demonstrate that TimesJev outperforms reasoning models by over 62% with 62.9% less inference time than their fine-tuned versions on average.

    大型语言模型（LLM）近期展现出进行时间序列推理的巨大潜力，但对时间序列进行推理的模型通常会生成很长的思维链。然而，这个过程往往消耗数千个 token，直接导致推理时延显著增加。相比之下，Jev 等系统 1 模型能够即时做出决策，因此自然可以成为替代方案；但原始时间序列与这类模型的嵌入空间不兼容，从而妨碍其推理性能，尤其是在输入序列包含数千个数值点时。本文进行了一项非常初步的尝试，提出一种时间序列系统 1 模型，即 TimesJev。具体而言，我们首先形式化时间序列推理中的系统 1 充分性，由此提出一种保留关键频率模式的时间序列压缩表示。为构造这种表示，我们推导出一个降维目标，该目标结合了（i）衡量压缩过程中丢失核心信息的充分性散度，以及（ii）量化系统 1 模型在给定该表示时与最优预测之间不兼容程度的可实现性散度。我们通过带有充分性门控机制的学习来优化时间序列压缩，然后将选定的表示与嵌入空间对齐以实现可实现性。最后，在 13 个数据集上的实验表明，与推理模型相比，TimesJev 的表现提升超过 62%；与这些模型的微调版本相比，其推理时间平均减少 62.9%。

    Jiaxuan Sun, Biao Wang, Shuai Li

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    FrameGRPO's multi-frame rollouts and gated temporal credit improve video reasoning through exploration and credit assignment, a substantial algorithmic contribution to reasoning capability development.     FrameGRPO 通过探索和信用分配提升视频推理，其多帧展开和门控时间信用构成了对推理能力发展的实质性算法贡献。多样化证据视图与组合有一定的附带关联，而该方法并未实质性地重新设计智能体或模型系统。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, particularly Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), has improved video reasoning in multimodal large language models. However, standard video GRPO varies only linguistic trajectories while conditioning every rollout in a group on the same sampled frames, which can produce homogeneous rewards and weaken group-relative learning when the shared visual evidence is insufficient or distracting. We propose \textbf{FrameGRPO}, a simple and effective reinforcement-learning framework that requires neither auxiliary networks nor changes to the model architecture. Specifically, FrameGRPO combines two lightweight components: (1) \textbf{Multi-Frame Rollouts}, which use only uniform temporal subsampling of a single maximal-frame decode to construct aligned views that diversify visual evidence and reasoning trajectories; and (2) \textbf{Gated Temporal Efficiency Credit}, which selectively reinforces a correct lower-ratio trajectory when all rollouts in a fixed full-ratio reference subset fail, without imposing an unconditional preference for fewer frames. Extensive experiments across diverse video understanding and reasoning benchmarks demonstrate robust overall improvements over standard GRPO, highlighting temporal-view diversification as an effective mechanism for exploration and credit assignment in video MLLMs.

    中文

    采用可验证奖励的强化学习，尤其是群体相对策略优化（GRPO），提升了多模态大型语言模型的视频推理能力。然而，标准视频 GRPO 只改变语言轨迹，却让同一组中的每次展开都以相同的采样帧为条件；当共享视觉证据不足或具有干扰性时，这会造成奖励趋同并削弱群体相对学习。我们提出 \textbf{FrameGRPO}，一种简单有效的强化学习框架，无需辅助网络，也无需改变模型架构。具体而言，FrameGRPO 结合了两个轻量组件：（1）\textbf{多帧展开}，仅通过对单次最大帧数解码结果进行均匀时间下采样，构造对齐视图，以丰富视觉证据和推理轨迹的多样性；（2）\textbf{门控时间效率信用}，当固定的全比例参考子集中所有展开都失败时，有选择地强化正确且帧比例较低的轨迹，而不无条件偏好较少帧数。在多种视频理解和推理基准上进行的大量实验表明，相较于标准 GRPO，该方法取得了稳健的整体提升，凸显了时间视图多样化作为视频 MLLM 探索和信用分配有效机制的作用。

    FinHopper：面向复杂金融智能体的渐进式多跳基准与逐步评估

    Yuxuan Wu, Miaopei Lin, Qiufang Ying, Lin Dan, Hao Zhao, Qirui Liu, Yuteng Shen, Shaohui Wu, Weihong Luo, Xiku Du, Xing Tang, Hao Chen

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    FinHopper contributes a verified benchmark with controlled multi-hop depth and intermediate-answer evaluation, exposing error cascades and partial reasoning progress in financial agents. Its dependency-preserving synthesis has some compositional relevance, while the main contribution advances reasoning evaluation; search-tool use alone provides only incidental systems relevance.

    FinHopper 提供经过验证的基准，支持可控多跳深度和中间答案评估，从而揭示金融智能体中的错误累积以及部分推理进展。其保留依赖关系的合成方法与组合有一定关联，但主要贡献在于推进推理评估；使用搜索工具本身仅与系统领域存在附带关联。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Financial agents are expected to answer factual investment queries through open search, but financial multi-hop retrieval differs from general multi-hop QA in a crucial way: each intermediate answer is an exact typed constraint, such as an entity, date, event, or numerical indicator, that determines the next query. This strict answer-conditioned dependency makes small intermediate errors cascade into plausible but wrong search trajectories. We introduce FinHopper, a benchmark for complex financial agents with controlled reasoning depth from 1 to 6 hops, covering stocks, funds, and macroeconomic facts, with gold intermediate answers for process-level evaluation. To construct FinHopper at scale, we design a state-transition-based synthesis framework that composes verified atomic financial QA patterns into dependency-preserving chains, followed by targeted in-synthesis verification, model-ensemble checking, and public-search validation by financial experts. Experiments with 20 LLM-agent configurations show that public search tools are necessary but insufficient: performance drops sharply as hop depth increases, the best model remains far below human experts, and process-aware scoring reveals partial reasoning progress hidden by final-answer-only evaluation. The benchmark is available at https://github.com/justajustin/FinHopper/.

    中文

    金融智能体需要通过开放式搜索回答事实型投资查询，但金融多跳检索与一般多跳问答有一个关键区别：每个中间答案都是精确的类型化约束，例如实体、日期、事件或数值指标，并由此决定下一个查询。这种严格依赖答案的关系会使微小的中间错误逐步累积，导致看似合理却错误的搜索轨迹。我们推出 FinHopper，这是一个面向复杂金融智能体的基准，推理深度从 1 跳到 6 跳可控，涵盖股票、基金和宏观经济事实，并提供用于过程级评估的标准中间答案。为大规模构建 FinHopper，我们设计了基于状态转移的合成框架，将经过验证的原子金融问答模式组合成保留依赖关系的链条，随后进行有针对性的合成过程中验证、模型集成检查，以及由金融专家进行的公开搜索验证。对 20 种 LLM 智能体配置的实验表明，公开搜索工具必不可少但并不足够：随着跳数增加，性能急剧下降；最佳模型仍远逊于人类专家；而过程感知评分能揭示仅评估最终答案时无法看到的部分推理进展。该基准可在 https://github.com/justajustin/FinHopper/ 获取。

    面向并行扩散式 LLM 解码的平衡感知枢轴选择

    Yejin Lee and Hyundong Jin and Yo-Sub Han

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Balance-Aware Pivot Decoding proposes a decoding schedule that selects central masked positions to reduce interval decoding depth logarithmically, with confidence-based handling of uncertainty. This is a substantive systems contribution to parallel computation; mathematical reasoning is an evaluation setting, not the paper’s central contribution, and token selection alone does not establish compositional or mechanistic insight.

    平衡感知枢轴解码提出一种解码调度方案：选择掩码区间的中心位置，以对数级降低区间解码深度，并通过基于置信度的机制处理不确定性。这是对并行计算作出的实质性系统贡献；数学推理只是评估场景，并非论文的核心贡献；仅凭 token 选择并不能证明其具有组合性或机制层面的洞见。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Diffusion language models enable parallel token generation, offering a promising alternative to sequential autoregressive decoding. Existing acceleration methods use predictive confidence to enable parallel token commitment while preserving generation quality. However, confidence-based selection prioritizes reliable token predictions without explicitly considering how token positions shape the remaining decoding schedule. Moreover, such ordering does not always reflect inter-token dependencies, suggesting that confidence need not be the sole criterion for token selection. Motivated by this limitation, we propose Balance-Aware Pivot Decoding (BPD), which favors central pivots within contiguous masked intervals and decodes the selected positions in parallel. Balanced pivots yield logarithmic decoding depth in the interval length. Our practical method accounts for model uncertainty by combining confidence-based prefilling with confidence-thresholded center selection. We evaluate the resulting quality-efficiency tradeoff on LLaDA and Dream across five mathematical reasoning, code generation, and instruction-following benchmarks. Our implementation is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/DLM_random_pivot-EE62/

    Open resources for computer use agents (CUAs) -- environments, datasets, and models -- remain scattered: without a standard, these resources cannot be integrated and scaled; additionally, evaluation, RL, and SFT cannot share one infrastructure. (2) Unified supervised data format, into which we convert the major public CUA datasets, from GUI grounding and understanding to full rollouts, and record our fresh rollouts from frontier CUAs on these verifiable environments. (3) Model harnesses shared across evaluation, RL, and SFT, one per model and implemented for 14 model families.     LLM agents can turn natural-language financial research requests into executable and backtested strategies, but a successful run may still implement the wrong rule, use information unavailable at decision time, or obscure how repairs and candidate selection changed the strategy. Because these failures arise throughout development, final code and performance metrics alone are insufficient to establish either fidelity to the request or the validity of the development process. We therefore address the reliability of financial strategy development at the trajectory level: the system must control how intermediate outputs become downstream state and preserve the evidence needed to justify the terminal outcome. We introduce QuantHarness, a two-layer agent harness in which a finance-specific Workflow structures specification, data grounding, construction, testing, and review, while Harness Core enforces stage-specific information, action, and commitment boundaries. We also introduce FinRelBench, a benchmark that evaluates strategy-development reliability through execution success, requirement satisfaction, and runtime evidence. QuantHarness achieves the highest Task Success at 90.72\%, compared with 74.23\%--84.54\% for the comparison systems. Controlled stress tests show that its boundaries contain targeted violations, while structured run records improve evidence retrieval and support decision replay under the evaluated protocol.

    Voice-based public services have evolved from manual switchboards to intelligent platforms to meet modern user needs. However, current systems remain constrained by rigid menu-driven interaction, fragmented vertical services, and limited extensibility. To address these issues, we present VISAGENT, an agent-based end-to-end voice interaction system for large-scale public services that integrates end-to-end speech interaction, hierarchical agent routing, a scalable voice-agent marketplace, and user memory support. The system replaces menu-driven workflows with natural speech and dynamically dispatches user requests to either a general conversational model or specialized domain agents via a two-level routing paradigm that achieves sub-second intent-to-agent selection over hundreds of agents. User memory informs preference-aware agent selection and supplies relevant preferences and context to selected agents, supporting personalized task execution and reducing the need for users to repeat previously provided information. A voice-agent registration mechanism converts task agents into conversational entities, enabling dynamic onboarding and ecosystem-level extensibility. We validate VISAGENT through a real-world deployment in China's 114 hotline across multiple service domains. Experimental results demonstrate low-latency full-duplex interaction, robust routing scalability, and competitive speech naturalness.     Tool-using voice agents often leave users waiting after speech ends, even when actionable information arrives earlier in the request. Speculative approaches begin work during speech, but chunk-bounded or interrupt-on-update generation can truncate a tool call before its arguments are complete. This couples computation time to speech updates, limiting useful work completed in advance. We introduce Heartbeat Thinking, which handles updated input through new Thinker invocations while allowing ongoing invocations and dispatched tools to finish. Periodic invocations read the latest partial transcript and a shared record of completed reasoning and tool results. These results help resolve missing arguments and initiate dependent calls, allowing preparation to progress across speech updates. Across SpeechFCEval, FDBench v3, and AudioCRAG, Heartbeat improves aggregate speculative tool coverage or retrieval reuse over a SHANKS-style windowed baseline, with benchmark-dependent effects on final task quality. On FDBench v3, it increases tool coverage by 16 percentage points and reduces mean final-response latency by 36.4\%. The results show that heartbeat thinking paradigm preserving ongoing computation during speech can turn listening time into reusable preparation for faster and more capable voice-agent responses.

    Online robust zero-sum Markov games pose a coupled operator-learning and game-solving problem: from nominal interaction data, the learner must recover a worst-case minimax Bellman operator while maintaining strategic coverage and controlling stage-game approximation error. Existing robust reinforcement-learning theory does not yet provide such an operator-learning perspective beyond specialized multi-agent settings. We develop an optimistic dual robust Bellman framework that combines dual robust Bellman fitting, optimistic minimax planning, backward-validated confidence sets, and exploiter-mix data collection. Our analysis is organized around the robust Bellman residuals induced by the candidate value class and yields a regret reduction that separates exploration complexity, robust operator-estimation error, stage-game solution error, and misspecification. Under explicit interpretable assumptions, we obtain conditional theorem interfaces for general and projected function approximation, together with closed results in several structured regimes, including tabular, epochwise cross-fit linear, self-normalized pure-online linear / finite-rank kernel, and projected RKHS truncation.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Work on efficient large-language-model inference has concentrated almost entirely on reducing the cost of decoding once a request is complete. The quantity a user experiences, however, is the interval between submitting a request and receiving a usable response, and that interval can be shortened without making decoding itself faster. While a request is being composed it is already partially specified, yet conventional deployments begin no computation until submission. We propose and study streaming generation, a decoding regime in which the model begins producing a response from an incomplete request and revises it as the remaining input arrives, so that only a small residue of the answer remains to be computed once the request is submitted. We evaluate the regime on autoregressive and diffusion language models, characterise the conditions under which it reduces user-visible latency, and analyse the mechanism responsible.

    关于高效大型语言模型推理的研究几乎全部集中于降低请求完成后的解码成本。然而，用户实际体验到的是从提交请求到收到可用响应之间的时间间隔，而且无需加快解码本身也能缩短这一间隔。用户正在撰写请求时，请求已经部分明确，但传统部署方式要等到用户提交后才开始计算。我们提出并研究流式生成，这是一种解码范式：模型根据不完整的请求开始生成响应，并随着剩余输入到达而对其进行修订，因此请求提交后只需再计算答案的一小部分。我们在自回归和扩散语言模型上评估了这一范式，刻画了它能降低用户可感知延迟的条件，并分析了产生这一效果的机制。
